details.body: RABBET: sanDikAzWam (??).
RABBI: svAmin (m.): v. Master, lord.
RABBINIC, -AL: iyudIyapaRqitAnAM (gen.) or -paRqita- -in comp.
Rabbit, SaSaH, SaSakaH.
RABBIT: SaSakaH (prop. hare).
RABBIT , s. SaSaH, SaSakaH, lambakarRaH, lomakarRaH -rRakaH, mfdulomakaH; ‘its skin,’ SaSorRaH, SaSaloma n. (n), SaSacarmma n., SaSakAjinaM.
Rabble, s. prAkftAH, pfTak-prAkfta-janAH; nIcAH; prAkftagaRaH.
RABBLE: (1) prAkftAH (m. pl.);(2) pfTagjanAH (m. pl.);(3) nIcAH.

RABBLE , s. antyajAtIyAH m. pl., prAkftajanAH m. pl., antyAH m. pl., [Page652-a+ 51] KalAH m. pl., hInavarRAH m. pl., pfTagjanAH m. pl., aDamajAtIyAH m. pl., aDamajanasamUhaH, nIcajanasamUhaH, prAkftajanasammardaH.
Rabid, a. unmatta, saMBrAMta, vikziptacitta, vAtula. [Rabid]ly, adv. sonmAdaM, unmattavat. [Rabid]ness, s. unmAdaH, vAtulatA.
RABID: unmatta (f. ttA): v. Mad. R. dog: alarkaH; r. poison: AlarkaM vizam, U. i. 40.
RABID , a. unmattaH -ttA -ttaM, unmAdaH -dA -daM, unmAdavAn -vatI -vat (t), mattaH -ttA -ttaM, pramadaH -dA -daM, vAtulaH -lA -laM; ‘a rabid dog,’ alarkaH, alakaH.
RABIDLY: unmattavat: v. Madly.
RABIDLY , adv. unmattavat, mattavat, sonmAdaM, unmAdena, pramadavat.
RABIDNESS , s. unmattatA, unmAdaH, sonmAdatA, pramadatA. See MADNESS.

Race, s. anvayaH, kulaM, vaMSaH, saMtAnaH, saMtati f., vaMSAvali-lI f., gotraM. 2 jAti, vargaH. 3 March, q. v. 4 caryA, DAvanaM. 5 mUlaM; ‘to run a r(ace)’ ahamahamikayA-parasparajigIzayA-DAv 1 P; ‘slow and steady wins the r(ace)’ maMdopya-viratodyogaH sadA vijayaBAgBavet, (kUrmavfttiM samAsTAya sarvatra vijayI Bavet); ‘r(ace)-course’ caryABUmi f.; ‘r(ace)-horse’ javASvaH, javanaH. v. i. DAv 1 P; See Run. [Rac]ial, a. jAtIya, vargIya.

RACE (subs.): I Lineage:(1) anvayaH, this king is born of that r.: tasyAnvaye BUpatireza jAtaH, R. vi. 41.;(2) kulam: v. Family;(3) vaMSaH: v. Dynasty.II Nation, tribe: q. v.: jAtiH (?). [Page568] III March, progress: q. v.: yAtrA.IV A contest in running: chariot -r.: raTacaryA (?), Mah. i. 132. 28.; horse -r.: aSvaDAvanam (?); to win a r.: aSvaDAvane etc. jayaM laBate (laB, c. 1.). V. A root: mUlam.
RACE (v.): I Intrans: DAvati (DAv, c. 1.): v. To run.II Trans.(1) DAvayati (c. of DAv);(2) gamayati (c. of gam), Si. v. 60.

RACE , s. (Lineage) vaMSaH, santatiH f., santAnaH, anvayaH, kulaM, jAtiH f., anvavAyaH, gotraM, vaMSaparamparA, vaMSAvaliH f., vaMSavitatiH f., putrapOtrA- divaMSaparamparA, tantuH m., aBijanaH, pravaraM, varRaH, jananaM, anUkaM, sagotraM; ‘human race,’ manuzyajAtiH f., nfjAtiH f. — (A running or course) caryyA, DAvanaM, mArgaH; ‘horse-race,’ aSvacaryyA, aSvaDAvanaM, aSvamArgaH. — (Ginger) gulmamUlaM.
To RACE , v. n. agropasTAnecCayA DAv (c. 1. DAvati -vituM), agrABiga- manecCayA DAv, parasparajigIzayA DAv, javena DAv.
RACE-COURSE: (1) raNgaBUmiH (gen. term);(2) perh. vITiH, Si. v. 60.;(3) caryABUmiH.
RACE-COURSE , s. caryyABUmiH f., caryyAmTAnaM, DAvanaBUmiH f., DAvanasTAnaM.
RACE-HORSE: no equiv.: (1) javanavAjin (m.); (2) javASvaH and sim. comp.s. may be used.
RACE-HORSE , s. javASvaH, javanaH, javI m. (n), javADikaH, DAvakaH.
RACER , s. DAvakaH, DAvanakft. See RACE-HORSE.
RACINESS: sarasatA: v. Racy.

Rack, s. tIvravedanA, yAtanA, ativyaTA; ‘put to the r(ack)’ ard 1 P or c., saMpIq 10. 2 gavAdanI, droRi-RI f. 3 saMpIqanayaMtraM, pramATa-yAtanA-yaMtraM; ‘r(ack) and ruin’ ucCedaH. v. t. atyaMtaM pIq or vyaT c. (vyaTayati), yAtanA-yaMtreRa pIq or pramaT c.

RACK (subs.): I For torture: no equiv.: *sampIqanI or sampIqanayantram. To put to r.: i. e. to torment: q. v.II Extreme pain: q. v.: yAtanA. R. and ruin: ucCedaH: v. Annihilation; go to r.: vinaSyati: v. To perish.III A framework: clothes -r.: *vastraDAraRI etc.IV Vapour or thin broken clouds: q. v.
RACK , s. (For hay) gavAdanI, droRI -RiH f. — (Instrument of tor- ture) yAtanAyantraM, yAtanayantraM, pramATayantraM. — (Extreme pain) yAtanA, ativyaTA, tIvravedanA, tIkzRavedanA.
To RACK , v. a. yat (c. 10. yAtayati -yituM), yAtanayantreRa vyaT (c. 10. vyaTayati -yituM) or pramaT (c. 10. -mATayati -yituM), atyantaM vyaT or pIq (c. 10. pIqayati -yituM), yAtanAM kf.
RACKED , p. p. ativyaTitaH -tA -taM, atipIqitaH &c., pramATitaH &c., pramaTitaH &c.
Racket, s. kolAhalaH, kalakalaH, tumularavaH. 2 gulikAtAqanI. [Racket]y, a. tumulakArin.
RACKET: (1) The bat: gulikAtAqanI or -grAhiRI, and sim. comp.s.II Clamour, din: q. v.: (1) kolAhalaH;(2) kalakalaH.

RACKET , s. (Confused noise) kolAhalaH, kalakalaH, kalaravaH, hala- halASabdaH, kAlakIlaH, rAsaH, tumulaM. — (In tennis) gulikAtAqanI, gulikAprakzepaRI, gulikApraRodanI, gulikAkzepaRayazwiH m., gulikA- praRodanayantraM.
RACKETY , a. kolAhalakArI -riRI -ri (n), tumulakArI &c., tumulI &c.
Racy, a. sarasa, rasavat; tIkzRa-ugra-rasa.
RACY: (1) sarasa (f. sA);(2) rasavat (f. tI).
RACY , a. rasikaH -kA -kaM, rasI -sinI -si (n), rasavAn -vatI -vat (t), sarasaH -sA -saM, surasaH &c., tIkzRarasaH &c., ugrarasaH &c.
RADIANCE: (1) praBA;(2) dIptiH: v. Brilliancy, lustre.
RADIANCE , RADIANCY, s. praBA, dIptiH f., tejas n., ujjvalatA, prakASatA, CaviH f., udBAsaH, BrAjizRutA, DarmmaraSmiH m. See BRIGHTNESS, BRILLIANCY, LUSTRE.
RADIANT: (1) samujjvala (f. lA);(2) dIptimat (f. tI): v. Brilliant, bright.

RADIANT , a. dedIpyamAnaH -nA -naM, prakASamAnaH &c., dyotamAnaH &c., dIpti- mAn -matI -mat (t), pradIptimAn &c., praBAvAn &c., supraBaH -BA -BaM, tejomayaH -yI -yaM, kAntimAn &c., kiraRamayaH -yI -yaM, marIcimAlI -linI -li (n), viSadaH -dA -daM. See BRIGHT, BRILLIANT, LUSTROUS.
RADIANTLY , adv. atitejasA, supraBaM, ujjvalaM, suprakASaM.

Radiate, v. i. nirgam 1 P, samaMtataH prasf 1 P or ud-i 2 P (rays); sPur 6 P, kiraRAn vikF 6 P or prasf c., dIp freq. (dedIpyate). [Radiat]ion, s. aMSuprasaraRaM-sPuraRaM, kiraRapAtanaM-vikiraRaM. Radiant, a. ujjvala, dIptimat, supraBa, dedIpyamAna, tejasvin; See Bright. [Radiant]ly, adv. supraBaM, atitejasA, ujjvalaM. Radiance, s. praBA, dIpti f., kAMti f., tejas n., OjjvalyaM; See Lustre, Light.

RADIATE: (1) nirgacCati (gam, c. 1. = to come out: q. v.);(2) udeti (i, c. 2. = to arise: q. v.), light r.d from the head of Śiva: SamBumUrDna udiyAya tejaH, Ki. xvi. 31.;(3) sPurati (sPur, c. 1. = to sparkle).

To RADIATE , v. n. sPur (c. 6. sPurati -rituM), kiraRa (nom. kiraRAyate), dIp in freq. (dedIpyate), varccas (nom. varccAyate), aMSu (nom. aMSUyati), kiraRarUpeRa sPur, kiraRAn pat (c. 10. pAtayati -yituM).
RADIATION: in physics: perh. sPuraRam or sPuritam.
RADIATION , s. kiraRamPuraRaM, raSmisPuraRaM, aMSupAtanaM, kiraRapAtanaM, raSmi- vikiraRaM, aMSuvikiraRaM, dIptivikiraRaM.
Radical, a. mUlaM in comp., mOlika (kI f.); mOla (lI f.). 2 nisargaja, svABAvika-nEsargika- (kI f.); See Natural. [Radical]ly, adv. samUlaM, mUlataH, AmUlaM. 2 svaBAvataH, prakftyA, jAtitaH.
RADICAL: I Primitive, original: q. v.: mUla- in comp., r. word: mUlaSabdaH or DAtuH (= verbal root).II Fundamental, real: q. v.: prakfta (f. tA).III In politics: the r. s: *mUlapAvakAH (m. pl.).

RADICAL , a. (Original, fundamental) mOlikaH -kI -kaM, mOlaH -lI laM, mUlikaH -kI -kaM, mUlI linI -li (n), vAstavaH -vI -vaM. — (Natural) svABAvikaH -kI -kaM, prAkftikaH &c., svaBAvajaH -jA -jaM, sAttvikaH -kI -kaM. — (Primitive) mUlikaH &c., see the word.
RADICALLY: (1) AmUlam;(2) samUlam;(3) mUlataH.
RADICALLY , adv. mUlatas AmUlaM, samUlaM, svaBAvatas, jAtitas.
To RADICATE , v. a. mUlato ruh in caus. (ropayati -yituM) badDamUlaM -lAM kf.
Radish, s. mUlakaH-kaM.
RADISH: mUlakaH (use n. for the root).
RADISH , s. mUlakaH -kaM, kandamUlaM, sekimaM, pAwIraH, pawIraM, hariparRaM, haritparRaH.
Radius, s. trijyA, jIvA; vyAsArDaM, vizkaM-BArDaM. 2 (Of a wheel) araH.
RADIUS: I In Geo.:(1) vyAsArDam, “vyAsArDArDaM nayet kendrAt”, A. b.;(2) vizkamBArDam, A. b.; (3) trijyA (jIvA) (of the meridian), Su. ii. 60.II A bone: bAhunalakam (?).
RADIUS , s. (Of a circle) trijyA, vyAsArdDaM, vyAsArdDareKA, karkawaH. — (Of the equator) BUkarRaH. — (Of a wheel) araM.
RAFF , s. aDamajAtIyAH m. pl., hInavarRAH, antyajAtIyAH &c. See RABBLE.
RAFFLE (subs.): guwikApAtAdinA svatvanirUpaRam (?).
RAFFLE (v.): to r. a horse: guwikApAtenASvADikAraM nirUpayati (?).
RAFFLE , s. guwikApAtaH, mahAmUlyadravyaprApaRArTaM guwikApAtanaM.
To RAFFLE , v. n. mahAmUlyadravyaprApaRArTaM guwikAH pat (c. 10. pAtayati -yituM).
Raft, s. uqupaM, plavaH, kolaH, taraMqaH.
RAFT: (1) uqupa (mn.), R. i. 2.;(2) plavaH; M. n.;(3) kolaH, A.
RAFT , s. uqupaH -paM, taraRaH -RI, taraRiH m., plavaH, plavAkA, taraRqaH, tarat n., tarRiH m., tAraRaH, vahitraM, vAriraTaH, kolaH, BelaH -lakaH, hoqaH.
Rafter, s. tulA, dIrGasTURA-kAzWaM, dIrGadAru, gfhasTURA.
RAFTER: tulA, “bfhattulErgfhEH”, Si. iii. 50.
RAFTER , s. gfhasTURA, veSmasTURA, pawalasTURA, sTURA, pawalakAzWaM, pawaladAruH m., gfhadAruH m., gfhakAzWaM, dIrGasTURA, dIrGakAzWaM, dIrGadAraH m.

Rag, s. vastraKaMqaH-qaM, pawaKaMqaH, cIraM, cIvaraM, karpawaH, na(la)ktakaH. 2 jarjara-jIrRa-vastraM, pawaccaraM; ‘dressed in r(ag)s’ cIravAsas, pari-hitacIra, karpawika. [Rag]ged, a. jIrRa, jarjara.
RAG: I A piece of cloth: vastraKaRqam and sim. comp.s.II Worn-out cloth: jIrRavastram;(2) cIram;(3) cIvaram.

RAG , s. (Piece of tattered cloth) vastraKaRqaH, jIrRavastraKaRqaH, jarjara- vastraKaRqaH, pawaKaRqaH, cIraM, cIvaraM, karpawaH, kanTA, laktakaM, karaH. — (Ragged garment) jIrRavastraM, jarjjaravastraM; ‘dressed in rags, see RAGGED; ‘a bundle of rags,’ cIrasamUhaH, karotkaraH.
RAGAMUFFIN: (1) nIcajanaH: v. Low;(2) DUrtaH: v. Rogue.
RAGAMUFFIN , s. cIravAsAH m. (s), karpawI m. (n), KalaH, DUrttaH, aDamajAtIyaH.

Rage, s. saMraMBaH, manyuH, rozaH, kroDaH, prakopaH; uttApaH, saMtApaH, kroDAveSaH, amarzaH. 2 utka-wecCA, lAlasA, tIkzRatA, uccaMqatA, tIvratA, ugratA, tigmatA. v. i. nitarAM kzuB 4 P, 1 A, kuDkruD-ruz-kup 4 P, saMraMBaM-manyuvaSaM-gam 1 P or prAp 5 P, kroDAkula a. BU 1 P. 2 ugra-caMqa-tIkzRa a. BU; ‘r(age) on (oh cloud)’ garja, garjAMstizWa. [Rage]ful, a. kroDAnvita, kopAkula, ruzwa; kupita, jAtAmarza, saMraMBita. [Rag]ing, saMraMBin, ugra, tIkzRa, tIvra, uccaMqa, vegavat.

RAGE (subs.): I Violent anger:(1) rozaH (rarely ruz, -zA), tears of r.: ruzASru, Si. xv. 4.: v. Anger;(2) saMramBaH, Sita's laugh excited her r.: saMramBaM mETilIhAso ninAya tAm, R. xii. 36.; the excitement of r.: saMramBavegaH, Ki. xvii. 49.II Vehemence, excitement: q. v.: prakopaH.III Violent passion:(1) vyasanam;(2) lAlasA (= longing).
RAGE (v.): I To be angry: q. v.:(1) saMramBam Apnoti (Ap, c. 5.), eti (i, c. 2.), etc.II To be violently agitated: q. v.: atitarAM kzuByati (kzuB, c. 4.), “r. ing Sea”: kzubDArRavaH.

RAGE , s. (Great anger, fury) kroDaH, kopaH, prakopaH, atikroDaH, atikopaH, kroDAveSaH, koDAveSaH, saMramBaH, pratiramBaH, saMrabDatA, amarzaH, kruD f., ugratA -tvaM, rOdraM -dratA, caRqatA, uccaRqatA, rAgaH, atirAgaH, uttApaH, santApaH, kopAkulatA, pratiGaH; ‘in a rage,’ saMrabDaH -bDA -bDaM, saMramBI -mBiRI &c., krudDaH -dDA -dDaM, kroDI -DinI &c., jAtakroDaH -DA -DaM, kopAkulaH -lA -laM, jAtAmarzaH -rzA -rzaM, kroDAvizwaH -zwA -zwaM. — (Violence, vehemence) saMramBaH, ugratA, tIkzRatA, atitIkzRatA, tEkzRyaM, rOdratA, tIvratA, tigmatA. — (Agitation) kzoBaH, vyAkzoBaH, vegaH, atikzoBaH.

To RAGE , v. n. (Be angry) kruD (c. 4. kruDyati, krodDuM), saMkruD, ruz (c. 4. ruzpati, rozituM), kup (c. 4. kuzyati, kopituM), prakup, kroDAkulaH -lA -laM BU, kopAkulaH -lA -laM BU, saMrabDaH -bDA -bDaM BU, saMrabDIBU. — (Become violent or intense) ugrataraH -rA -raM BU, tIkzRataraH -rA -raM BU, rOdrataraH -rA -raM BU, rOdrIBU, tigmataraH -rA -raM BU, BfSa (nom. BfSAyate), uccaRqaH -RqA -RqaM BU, kzuB (c. 4. kzuByati, kzoBituM).
RAGEFUL , a. kroDI -DinI -Di (n), kroDAnvitaH -tA -taM, kopAnvitaH &c., kopAkulaH -lA -laM, kopI &c., saMramBI &c., sakopaH -pA -paM.
RAGGED: I Rent, torn:(1) jIrRa (f. rRA); (2) jarjara (f. rA).II Rough, uneven: q. v. banDura (f. rA).III Clad in rags: (1) cIracIvarin (f. RI);(2) karpawin or karpawa- DArin (f. RI).

RAGGED , a. jarjjaraH -rA -raM, jarjjarIkaH -kA -kaM, jIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, CinnaH -nnA -nnaM, vicCinnaH &c., vizamaDAraH -rA -raM; ‘ragged garment,’ jIrRavastraM, jarjjaravastraM, CinnavastraM, BikzusaMGAwI m. (n), karpawaH, cIraM cIvaraM, kanTA; ‘dressed in ragged garments,’ cIravAsAH -sa -saH (s), karpawaDArI -riRI -ri (n), karpawikaH, cIvarI &c.
RAGGEDNESS , s. jarjjaratA, jarjjarIkatA, jIrRatA, CinnavastratA, CinnatA.

RAGING , part. or a. ugraH -grA -graM, rozaRaH -RA -RaM, vegI -ginI -gi (n), mahAvegaH -gA -gaM, udIrRavegaH &c., saMramBI &c., saMrabDaH -bDA -bDaM, tIkzRaH -kzRA -kzRaM, tIvraH -vrA -vraM, caRqaH -RqA -RqaM, uccaRqaH &c.
RAGMAN , s. cIravyApArI m. (n), cIravikretA m. (tf), CinnavastravyApArI.
RAGOUT: no equiv.: *mAMsarasA.
RAGOUT , s. mizwAnnaM, savyaYjanAhAraH, vyaYjanaM, upaskaraH.

RĀHU , s. (The ascending node, fabled as a demon, the son of Singhikā, with the tail of a dragon. His head was cut off by Viṣṇu, at the churning of the ocean; but being immortal, by having tasted the amrit, the head and tail retained their separate existence, and were transferred to the stellar sphere. The head, or Rāhu, became the cause of eclipses, by endeavouring at various [Page653-a+ 51] times to swallow the sun and moon. The tail was called Ketu, or the descending node, see PLANET) rAhuH, siMhikAsUnuH m., sEMhikaH, sEMhikeyaH, grahaH, grahakallolaH, KewaH, viDuntudaH, sUryyagrahaH. An eclipse is called rAhugrAhaH, rAhugrAsaH, rAhusaMsparSaH.
Raid, s. avaskaMdaH, ApAtaH.

Rail, v. i. ava-A-aDi-kzip 6 P, apa-BAv 1 A, apavad 1 A, AkruS 1 P, Sap 1, 4 U, garh 1, 10 A, niMd 1 P, Barts 10 A; ‘r(ail)ing words’ AkzepavAdaH, garhaRA, niMdA-vacaH. v. t. lohastaMBEH parivf 5 U or pari-vezw 1 A or c., niruD 7 U. s. lohaSaMkuH-SalAkA-tulA; ‘r(ail)-way’, ‘r(ail)-road’ loha-paTaH-mArgaH. [Rail]er, s. avakzepakaH, niMdakaH, nirBartsakaH, apavAdakaH, AkroSakaH. [Rail]ing, s. lohAvaraRaM, lohaSalAkAvfti f. 2 ava-A-kzepaH, AkroSaH, niMdA, nirBartsanA, garhaRA, apavAdaH, upAlaMBaH, apaBAzaRaM, tiraskAraH.
RAIL (subs.): I Lit.: lohatulA (of big. r. s.: ?) or -SalAkA (in r. ing).II Fig., r. road: q. v.III A bird: pakziviSezaH.
RAIL (v.): I Lit.: lohaSalAkABiH AvfRoti (vf, c. 5.): v. To enclose.II To abuse, revile: q. v.: aDi-kzipati, ava-, (kzip, c. 6.).
RAIL , s. lohastamBaH, lohaSaNkuH m., lohAvaraRaM. See RAILING.
To RAIL , v. a. (Inclose with rails) lohastamBena paribizw or parivf or Avf or avaruD or saMruD, lohastamBAvftaM -tAM kf.
To RAIL , v. n. (Reproach, revile, abuse) nind, apavad, tiraskf, AkruS, avagur, avakzip, aDikzip, parikzip, kzip, Sap, aBiSap, pariSap, Akzar, garh, Barts, kuts, muKarIkf, gup in des., upAlaB.
RAIL-ROAD , RAIL-WAY, s. lohavartma n. (n), lohamArgaH ayovartma n. (n).
RAILED AT , p. p. AkruzwaH -zwA -zwaM, upAlabDaH -bDA -bDaM, aDikziptaH -ptA -ptaM.
RAILER , s. nindakaH, AkroSakaH, upakrozwA m. (zwf), kutsAvAdI m. (n), apavAdakaH, nirBartsakaH, upAlamBakArI m., avakzezakaH.
RAILING (subs.): I A fence: q. v.: lohavftiH [Page569] (of iron rails) or sim. vftiH.III Abuse, reviling: q. v.: AkzAraH.
RAILING (adj.): (1) avakzepaka (f. pikA);(2) aDikzepaka (f. pikA);(3) AkzArin (f. RI); etc.

RAILING , s. (Reviling) nindA -ndanaM, apavAdaH, parivAdaH, parIvAdaH, tiraskAraH, upAlamBaH, jugupsA, vAkpAruzyaM, AkroSaH -SanaM, upakroSaH, durvAkyaM, DikkriyA. — (Fence) AvaraRaM, lohAvaraRaM, AvAraH, kawaYjanaM, see FENCE.
RAILLERY , s. apahAsaH, parihAsaH, parIhAsaH, prahasanaM, hAsikA.
RAILROAD, RAILWAY: *lohapaTaH and sim. comp.s.
Raiment, s. vastraM, vasanaM, vAsas n., aMbaraM AcCAdanaM, veSaH-zaH, paricCadaH; See Cloth, Garment; ‘food and r(aiment)’ grAsAcCAdanaM, annavastraM.
RAIMENT: vastram: v. Clothes.

RAIMENT , s. vastraM, vAsas n., vasanaM, veSaH, ambaraM, AcCAdanaM, pariDAnaM, prasADanaM, saMvyAnaM, sicayaH, pacCAdanaM, paricCadaH; ‘clothed in white raiment,’ SuklAmbaraDArI riRI, -ri (n), SuklavAsAH -sAH -saH (s).

RĀMA , s. The name common to three incarnations of Viṣṇu, viz. 1. Paraśu Rāma, or Rāma with the axe, the sixth avatār or incarnation of Viṣṇu. He was a Brahman, the son of the holy sage Jamadagni, and born at the begin- ning of the second or Treta age, for the purpose of repressing the tyranny, and punishing the violence of the Kshatriya or military tribe. He appears to typefy the class of Brahmans, and their contest with the Ksha- triyas. Some of his names are paraSurAmaH -makaH, paraSuDaraH, parSurAmaH, jamadagnisutaH, jAmadagnyaH. 2. Rāmachandra or the moon-like Rāma, the seventh incarnation of Viṣṇu. He was born into the world as the son of Daśaratha, king of Oude, and great grandson of Raghu, at the close of the second or Treta age, for the purpose of destroying the demons who infested the earth, and especially Rāvana, the Daitya sovereign of Ceylon. His names are rAmacandraH, raGunandanaH, raGUdvahaH, raGuvaraH, raGunATaH, rAGavaH, rAvaRAriH m., rAvaRa- jit m., daSAsyajit m., maKatrAtA m. (tf), rAmaBadraH. 3. Balarāma, or the strong Rāma, according to some the eighth incar- nation of Viṣṇu. He was born at the end of the Dvā- para, or third age, as the seventh son of Vasudeva and Devakī, and therefore elder brother of Krishna, but was transferred from the womb of Devakī to that of Rohinī the other wife of Vasudeva. Hence one of his names saNkarzaRaH. He is sometimes regarded as an incarnation of the serpent Ananta or Śeṣa, and hence called, anantaH, SezaH. His other names are balarAmaH, baladevaH, balaBadraH, balaH, balalaH, halAyuDaH, halaBft m., halI m. Ramp, v. i. plu 1 A, valg 1 P. s. pluti f., plutaM, valgitaM; See Leap. Rampant, a. aniyaMtrita, niravagraha, niryaMtraRa, ucCfMKala. 2 atirikta, udrikta, utsikta, atimaryAda. 3 paScAtpAdayoH sTita. Rampancy, s. a-niyaMtraRA, atirekaH, utsekaH, atikramaH, utkramaH.
RAMP: I Subs.: lamPaH.II Verb.: lamPaM dadAtiH v. To leap.
To RAMP , v. n. plu (c. 1. plavate, plotuM), valg, nft, krIq, visPul.
RAMP , s. plavaH -vanaM, plutaM, valgitaM, JampaH -mpA, utplutaM, utPAlaH.
RAMPANCY , a. ativfdDiH f., utsekaH, udrekaH, maryyAdAtikramaH, aparimitatA, atiriktatA, atikramaH, utkramaH, ADikyaM.
RAMPANT: I Wild, ferocious: q. v.:(1) niravagraha (f. hA);(2) aniyantrita (f. tA); etc. II Standing on the hind legs: paScAtpAdayoH sTita (f. tA).
RAMPANT , a. atiriktaH -ktA -ktaM, udriktaH &c., utsiktaH &c., maryyAdAtItaH -tA -taM, atikrAntamaryyAdaH -dA -daM, utkrAntamaryyAdaH &c., atimaryyAdaH &c., aparimitaH &c.
Rampart, s. prAkAraH, vapraH-praM, varaRaH, sAlaH; See Fence.
RAMPART: (1) prAkAraH;(2) vapraH;(3) varaRaH; (4) SAlaH.
RAMPART , s. prAkAraH, vapraH, cayaH, DUlikedAraH, DUlikuwwimaM, pragaRqI.

sanskrit.slp1: AgneyanAqIsambadDo lohadaRqaH sa ca nAqImuKanivizwo BUtvA AgneyacUrRagu-
sanskrit.word: आग्नेयनाडीसम्बद्धो लोहदण्डः स च नाडीमुखनिविष्टो भूत्वा आग्नेयचूर्णगु-
sanskrit.iast: āgneyanāḍīsambaddho lohadaṇḍaḥ sa ca nāḍīmukhaniviṣṭo bhūtvā āgneyacūrṇagu-

details.body: RAMROD: cUrRamardanI and sim. comp.s.
RAMROD , s. cUrRasaMhananI, cUrRasampIqanI, cUrRapraRodanI, cUrRapraRodakadaRqaH, AgneyanAqIsambadDo lohadaRqaH sa ca nAqImuKanivizwo BUtvA AgneyacUrRagu- likAdi saMhatIkaroti.
Rancid, a. ugra or tIkzRa-rasa or gaMDa, virasa, pUtigaMDi.
RANCID: (1) ugraganDa (f. nDA);(2) ugraganDi (mfn.).
RANCID , a. ugraganDaH -nDA -nDaM, ugraganDikaH -kA -kaM, ugrarasaH -sA -saM, tIkzRarasaH &c., virasaH &c., kurasaH &c., paryuzitaH -tA -taM.
RANCIDNESS , RANCIDITY, s. ugrarasatvaM, tIkzRarasatvaM, virasatA, vErasyaM, kurasatA.
RANCOR , s. atidvezaH, drohabudDitvaM, atidrohaH, dIrGadvezaH, atimAtsaryyaM, atimatsaratA, vizapUrRatA, daMSaH, daMSaSIlatA, atidaMSaH, jiGAMsA. See MALIGNITY, MALICE.
RANCOROUS: (1) vidvezin (f. RI);(2) aBi- drohin (f. RI).

RANCOROUS , a atidvezI -ziRI -zi (n), dIrGadvezI &c., daMSI &c., ati- daMSI, daMSaSIlaH -lA -laM, drohabudDiH -dDiH -dDi, atidrohI -hiRI &c., atimatsarI &c., jiGAMsuH -suH -su, vizahfdayaH -yA -yaM, vizapUrRaH -rRA -rRaM. See MALIGNANT.
RANCOROUSLY: (1) paramadvezAt;(2) aBidroheRa; (3) drohabudDyA.
RANCOROUSLY , adv. atidbezeRa, sadrohaM, atidroheRa, sadaMSaM, savizaM.

Rancour, s. aBidrohaH, vidvezaH, atidvezaH-drohaH, atimAtsaryaM; See Malice. [Rancour]ous, a. aBidrugDa, vidvezin, ati dIrGa-dvezin-drohin, droha-matsara-budDi. 2 jiGAMsu; vizapUrRa, daM-SaSIla. [Rancour]ously, adv. sadvezaM, atidroheRa.
RANCOUR: vidvezaH: v. Hatred; (2) aBidrohaH: v. Malignity.
Rancous, a. paruza (svana).

sanskrit.slp1: hA hA kaTaM Dara-RIpfzWe nirutsAhaniHsahaM viparyastaH
sanskrit.word: हा हा कथं धर-णीपृष्ठे निरुत्साहनिःसहं विपर्यस्तः
sanskrit.iast: hā hā kathaṃ dhara-ṇīpṛṣṭhe nirutsāhaniḥsahaṃ viparyastaḥ

details.body: Random, a. Akasmika-yAdfcCika- (kI f.), aniyata, ayaMtrita, saMDAnahIna, dEvAdAgata, atarkitopanata, sahasA utpanna; ‘at r(andom)’ akasmAt, yadfcCayA, niHsaMDAnaM, avicArya, sahasA, asaMbadDaM, aniyataM, ucCfMKalaM; avyava-sTayA, akrameRa; ‘talk at r(andom)’ akrameRa jalp or vad 1 P, (jalpatorakrameRa U. 1); ‘oh ! how he lies at r(andom) carelessly diffused on the ground’ hA hA kaTaM Dara-RIpfzWe nirutsAhaniHsahaM viparyastaH (U. 3).

RANDOM: (1) Akasmika (f. kI): v. Accidental; (2) aniyata (f. tA): v. Unsettled. Ph.: at r.:(1) akasmAt (= accidentally);(2) ucCwaNKalam (= without any order, as to talk at r.);(3) yadA tadA (of time, as to come at r.);(4) prakIrRam (in speaking), Si. ii. 73.

RANDOM , a. sanDAnahInaH -nA -naM, sanDAnarahitaH -tA -taM, aBisanDihInaH &c., aBisanDAnahInaH &c., AkasmikaH -kI -kaM, AgantukaH -kA -kaM, aniyamitaH -tA -taM, aniyataH -tA -taM, anirUpitaH &c., ayantritaH &c., niryantraRaH -RA -RaM, yAdfcCikaH -kI -kaM, ApatikaH &c., dEvAgataH -tA -taM, dEvopasTitaH &c., akasmAdupasTitaH &c., akasmAdAgataH &c., aka- smAdutpannaH -nnA -nnaM, akasmAtkftaH &c., aSfNKalaH -lA -laM; ‘at random,’ [Page655-a+ 51] akasmAt, sanDAnaM vinA, aBisanDAnaMvinA, aniyataM, ayantritaM, niryantraRaM, yadfcCayA, aSfNKalaM; to talk at random,’ pralap (c. 1. -lapati -pituM).
RANDY , a. unmattaH -ttA -ttaM, mattaH &c., ucCfNKalaH -lA -laM.

Range, s. rAjiH, SreRiH-RI, mAlA, paMktiH, tatiH, AvaliH-lI, AliH-lI, vITiH-TI, (all f.). 2 gaRaH, vargaH, varRaH. 3 pariBramaRaM, paryawanaM. 4 sopAnaM, ArohaRaM. 5 vizayaH, paTin m., gocaraH in comp.; ‘beyond the r(ange) of sight’ cakzurvizayaM-nayanagocaraM atItya or atIta; ‘within the r(ange) of hearing’ Sruti-paTe-vizaye-gocare; ‘beyond the r(ange)’ avizaye, avizaya-vizayAtIta a.; ‘r(ange) of an arrow’ SarapAtaH, bARavizayaH. v. i. pariBram 1, 4 P, vicar 1 P, vihf 1 P (for diversion); ‘r(ange) about’ itastato Bram, paryaw 1 P. 2 sTA 1 P, vft 1 A; See Be. v. t. vinyas 4 U, krameRa rac 10, vyUh 1 U. [Rang]er, s. lubDakaH, vyADaH. 2 vanagrAhin m., vanapAlaH.

RANGE (subs.): I A row, line: q. v.:(1) SreRiH (RI);(2) rAjiH (jI)II A class, order: q. v.: gaRaH.III Excursion, wander- -ing: q. v.: pariBramaRam.IV Compass, reach: q. v.: vizayaH, beyond the r. of Lakṣmaṇa's arrows: sOmitrerapi patriRAmavizaye, U. iii. 44.:V Kichen-r.: *lOhayogarAjiH.VI Of a ladder: v. Step.
RANGE (v.): I To arrange: q. v.: viracayati (rac, c. 10.).II To wander: q. v.: pari- Bramati (Bram, c. 1.).III To have r.: expr. by subs.: v. Range (IV).IV To rank: q. v.
To RANGE , v. a. (Arrange, dispose) vinyas, virac, viDA, saMviDA, prativiDA, vyUh, vyUhIkf, krameRa sTA, paMktikrameRa vinyas.

To RANGE , v. n. (Wander) Bram (c. 4. BrAmyati, BramituM), pariBram, BramaRaM kf, aw, paryaw, vicar (c. 1. -carati -rituM), vihf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), gAh (c. 1. gAhate -hituM), vraj, pravraj, paryawanaM kf. — (Lie in a par- ticular direction, be situated) vft (c. 1. varttate -rttituM), sTA (c. 1. tizWati, sTAtuM).

RANGE , s. (A row, rank) paMktiH f., SreRiH -RI f., rAjiH -jI f., rA- jikA, AvaliH -lI, padDatiH f., vITiH -TI, tatiH f., AliH -lI f., pAliH -lI f., mAlA, viYjolI. — (Class, grade) vargaH, gaRaH, varRaH — (Reach, compass, extent, room) vizayaH, gocaraH -raM, parimARaM, prasaraH; ‘the range of sight,’ cakzurvizayaH, nayanavizayaH; ‘of an arrow,’ vARagocaraH -raM, SarAyaRaM, vAtarAyaRaM; ‘within range of the ear,’ karRagocaraH -rA -raM; ‘the utmost range,’ pAraH; ‘beyond the range,’ avizayaH -yA -yaM, vizayAtikrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, vizayAtItaH &c., agamyaH -myA -myaM, apAraRIyaH -yA -yaM. — (Kitchen range) pAkopakaraRapaMktiH f. — (Range of mountains) kulaparvvataH, kulagi- riH m., kulaSElaH; ‘range of mountains supposed to encircle the earth,’ cakravAlaH, lokAlokaH. See the names of the seven ranges under MOUNTAIN.
RANGED , p. p. vinyastaH -stA -staM, vyavasTApitaH &c., vyUQaH -QA -QaM.
RANGER: I One who ranges or rows: expr. by verb.II Robber: lubDakaH. q. v.III Of a forest: araRyapAlaH; vanapAlaH; and sim. comp.s.
RANGER , s. pariBramakaH. — (Keeper of a forest) araRyarakzakaH -rakzI m. (n), araRyapAlaH -lakaH, araRyADyakzaH.

Rank, s. SreRi-RI f., paMkti f., rAji f.; See Range, Line. 2 (Of an army) vyUhaH, daMqaH, sEnyapaMktiH-vinyAsaH. 3 vargaH, varRaH, gaRaH. 4 padaM, sTAnaM, AspadaM, vftti f., sTiti f. 5 pra-tizWA, mAnaH, gOravaM, utkarzaH, unnatti f., pratipatti f. prADAnyaM, ucca or parama-padaM or padavI, kulo-tkarzaH, ABijAtyaM; ‘a man of high r(ank)’ pratipattimat, aBijAta, kulIna, uccapadaBAk. v. i. samAna-tulya. a. vft 1 A or sTA 1 P; paMktikrameRa sTA. v. t. paMktikrameRa nyas 4 U or rac 10, vargakrameRa rac; oft. ex. by varge-pakze-sTA c. or gaR-kFt- 10, (dfzwipAtamapyu-pakArapakze sTApayaMti Ka. 108); ‘fit to be r(ank)ed first’ Duri pratizWApayitavya or kIrta-nIya. 2 tulya-sama. a. man 4 A. a. praBUta, pracura, vipula, atisPIta, atirikta, udrikta. 2 ugragaMDa, pUtigaMDi, tIkzRagaMDa. [Rank]ness, s. udrekaH, atisPIti-vfdDi- f., atirekaH, pracura-vfdDiH. 2 ugratA, tIkzRatA.

RANK (subs.): I A row, line: q. v.:(1) SreRiH (RI);(2) rAjiH (jI).II Of soldiers: perh. paMktiH. Ph.: r. and file: daRqaH (= army); to leave the r. s: vyUhaM parityajati.III Place, position: q. v.: padam.IV High station: (1) uccapadam. and sim. comp.s.;(2) mAnaH (= honour);(3) pratizWA (= glory);(4) kOlInyam (= nobility).
RANK (v. i.): expr. by vartate (vft, c. 1. = to be) or tizWati (sTA, c. 1. = to stand), character r. s at the head of all excellences: atItya hi guRAn sarvAn svaBAvo mUrDni vartate, H.
RANK (v. t.): I To place in a line: sTApayati (c. of sTA).II To class, reckon: q. v.: (1) gaRayati (gaR, c. 10.);(2) by circumlo.
RANK (adj.): I Exuberant, rich: q. v.: praBUta (f. tA).II Rancid:(1) ugraganDa (f. nDA); (2) ugraganDi (mfn.).III Gross, course: q. v.

RANK , (Line, row) paMktiH f., SreRiH -RI f., rAjiH -jI f., rAjikA, AvaliH -lI, padDatiH f., tatiH f., AliH -lI f., pAliH -lI f. — (Station in life) padaM, padaviH -vI f., AspadaM, sTAnaM, vfttiH f. — (High station, high rank or dignity) uccapadaM, paramapadaM, uccapa- datA, uccapadaviH f., pratipattiH f., utkfzwapadaM, utkarzaH, kulotkarzaH, OtkarzaM, utkfzwatA, aBijAtatA, ABijAtyaM, ABijanaM, unnatiH f., samunnatiH f., kulInatA, kOlInaM, praDAnatA, mAnyatA, sevyatA, maryyAdA, mAnaM; ‘man of high rank,’ uccapadasTaH, uccapadaBAk m. (j), padaBAk m., prati- pattimAn m. (t), aBijAtaH, aBijanavAn m. (t), kulInaH. See HIGH-BORN. — (Class, order) vargaH, gaRaH, varRaH. — (Ranks of the army, line of soldiers) vyUhaH, sEnyapaMktiH f., daRqaH; ‘breaking the ranks,’ vyUhaBaNgaH, vyUhaBedaH.

RANK , a. (Luxuriant in growth) ativarDizRuH -zRuH -zRu, ativarDI -rDinI -rDi (n), ativarDanaH -nA -naM, atisPItaH -tA -taM, atipInaH -nA -naM. — (Strong to the smell or taste) ugraganDaH -nDA -nDaM, ugraganDikaH -kA -kaM, ugrarasaH -sA -saM, ugraH -grA -graM, tIkzRaganDaH &c., tIkzRarasaH &c.

To RANK , v. a. (Place in a line) paMktikrameRa sTA in caus. (sTApa- yati -yituM) or vinyas or virac. — (Place in a particular class or station) varRakrameRa or vargakrameRa virac (c. 10. -racayati -yituM) or vinyas, yaTAvargaM or yaTAvarRaM sTA in caus., viSezapadasTaM -sTAM kf, viSezagaRAByantaraM -rAM kf, viSezavargAByantaraM -rAM kf.

To RANK , v. n. (Be placed or stand in a line) paMktikrameRa sTA. — (Be placed in a particular class or station) viSezapadasTaH -sTA -sTaMBU, viSezagaRAByantaraH -rA -raMBU, viSezavargAByantaraH -rA -raM BU, viSezapa- dayuktaH -ktA -ktaM BU, yaTAvargaM sTA.

Rankle, v. i. uddIp 4 A; ugratara-tIkzRatara- a. BU 1 P; oft. ex. by SalyaM; ‘those words r(ankle) in my heart’ tadvaco mama hfdaye SalyaM jAtaM, Salyamiva hfdaye pratyuptaM; ‘I r(ankle) in his eyes’ akzigatohaM tasya. 2 aMtaH pUy 1 A or pUtIBU; ‘the wound r(ankl)ed’ sa prahAraH karAlatAM gataH (P. iv. 3).
RANKLE: (1) BfSAyate (nomi.);(2) by adj.: v. Violent.

To RANKLE , v. n. (Be inflamed, fester) antas tap in pass. (tapyate), antar dah (c. 4. dahyati -te, dagDuM), vraRavat pakvaH -kvA -kvaM BU or pUy (c. 1. pUyate -yituM) or sapUyaH -yA -yaM BU. — (Become more violent or virulent) ugrataraH -rA -raM BU, tIkzRataraH -rA -raM BU, rOdrataraH -rA -raM BU, tigmataraH -rA -raM BU, caRqataraH -rA -raM BU, BfSa (nom. BfSAyate).
RANKNESS: I Luxuriant growth: praBUtatA: v. Abundance.II Strong smell: ugraganDaH, -tA.

RANKNESS s. (Too great luxuriance) ativfdDiH f., aDikavfdDiH f., ativarDanaM, atyantavarDanaM, atisPItiH f., atisPAtiH f., atipInatA, utsekaH, udrekaH. — (Of smell or taste) ugratA, tIkzRatA, ugraganDatA, tIkzRaganDatA, ugrarasatvaM, ugrasvAdaH, ugravAsaH.
Ransack, v. t. luMw-W 1 P, 10; See Plunder. 2 nipuRaM-sUkzmaM-anviz 4 P or mfg 10 A.

RANSACK: I To plunder, pillage: q. v.II To violate, ravish: q. v.III To search thoroughly: q. v.: nipuRamanusandaDAti (DA, c. 3.). IV loqayati, -vi (luq, c. 10.), r. ed the forest: vanaM loqayAmAsa, Mah. i. 66. 19.

To RANSACK , v. a. (Plunder, pillage), see the words. — (Search by turning things over) astavyastIkftya anviz (c. 4. -izpati -ezituM) or anusanDA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM), anusanDAnArTaM or anveza- RArTam astavyastIkf.
RANSACKED , p. p. luRWitaH -tA -taM, anvezaRArTam astavyastIkftaH -tA -taM.

Ransom, s. nizkrayaH, udDAraH, nistAraH, mukti f., mokzaH; nistAra parikraya-mUlyaM. v. t. mUlyaM-DanaM-datvA muc c. or udDf 1 P or nistF c., nizkrI 9 U, parikrI 9 A. [Ransom]er, s. ni-stArakaH, nizkretf m.

RANSOM (subs.): (1) udDAraH (= release);(2) by circumlo., to pay a heavy r. for one's liberty: bahu DanaM dattvA muktiM krIRAti (comp. H. iv. 121.,) “kozAMSenArDakozeRa sarvakozeRa vA punaH . Sizwasya pratirakzArTaM parikraya udAhftaH ..”
RANSOM (v.): DanaM dattvA mokzayati (mokz, c. 10.). : v. To release.

RANSOM , s. parikrayaRamUlyaM, parikrayamUlyaM, trARamUlyaM, tAraRamUlyaM, nistAramUlyaM, udDAramUlyaM, nizkftimUlyaM, trARaM, udDAraH, muktiH, mokzaH; ‘he gave his life a ransom for many,’ bahUnAM trARAya or bahUnAM mokzAya svaprARAn dadO.

To RANSOM , v. a. mUlyaM dattvA parikrI (c. 9. -krIRIte -kretuM), samamUlyakadravyaM, dattvA parikrI or trE (c. 1. trAyate -trAtuM) or paritrE, mUlyaM dattvA nistF (c. 10. -tArayati -yituM) or tF or udDf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM) or muc (c. 6. muYcati, moktuM) or mokz (c. 10. mokzayati -yituM).
RANSOMED , p. p. parikrItaH -tA -taM, trAtaH -tA -taM, nistAritaH -tA -taM.
RANSOMER , s. parikretA m. (tf), trAtA m. (tf), nistArakaH, parikrayakft.
Rant, s. nirarTaka-nirargala-pralApaH, SabdamAtraM vAkyaM. v. i. uccEH svareRa pralap 1 P, Sabda-pAMqityaM kf 8 U. [Rant]er, s. pralApin m.
RANT: I Verb: sAqambaraM or uccEH pralapati (lap, c. 1.).II Subs.: nirarTakapralapitam and sim. comp.s.
To RANT , v. n. uccEHsvareRa SabdAlaNkAramayaM PalguvAkyaM vad (c. 1. vadati -dituM), uccEHsvareRa SabdamAtramayaM vAkyaM vad, atiSabdanavAkyaM vad, uccEH- svareRa pralap.
RANT , s. SabdamAtramayaM PalguvAkyaM or nirarTakavAkyaM, SabdamAtravAkyaM, alaNkA- ramAtramayam atiSabdanavAkyaM, pralApaH.
RANTER: uccEH pralApin (f. nI) and sim. comp.s.
RANTER , s. SabdamAtravAdI m. (n), SabdamAtravaktA m. (ktf), mahASabdakavAkya- vAdI m., pralApI m.
Rap, v. t. tIvraM prahf 1 P or taq 10 or aBihan 2 P. 2 apa-, hf 1 P; grah 9 U, cittaM-manaH-Akfz 1 P or grah. s. tIvra-prahAraH-AGAtaH.
RAP (subs.): kziprAhatiH and sim. comp.s.: v. Stroke.
RAP (v.): I To strike with a sharp blow: kzipramAhanti (han, c. 2.). or tAqayati (taq, c. 10.).II To snatch away: apaharati (hf, c. 1.).

To RAP , v. a. (Strike with a quick, sharp blow) laGu or laGu- prahAreRa taq (c. 10. tAqayati -yituM), laGu prahf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM) or Ahan (c. 2. -hanti -ntuM) or aBihan. — (Snatch or hurry away) hf, apahf, aBihf, grah, kfz, samAkfz. — (Seize the mind, affect with rapture) gano or cittaM hf or apahf, hfdayaM hf or grah, parama- harzeRa muh (c. 10. gohayati -vituM).
RAP , s. lavuprahAraH, laGvAGAtaH, AGAtaH, AhatiH f., tAqanaM.

Rapacious, a. ati-, lubDaka, apahArin, apaharaRaSIla, grasanabudDi, sarvahArin-grAhin, sAhasika (kI f.). [Rapacious]ly, adv. prasahya, prasaBaM, balAt; apahArabudDyA, atiloBena. [Rapacious]ness, Rapacity, s. sAha-sikatA, AtatAyitvaM, apahAraSIlatA, apa-haraRabudDi f. 2 lubDatA, atiloBaH.
RAPACIOUS: (1) lubDa (f. bDA);(2) lubDaka (f. kA);(3) gfDnu (mfn.).

RAPACIOUS , a. haraRaSIlaH -lA -laM, apaharaRaSIlaH &c., apahArabudDiH -dDiH -dDi, apahArapravaRaH -RA -RaM, azahArakaH -kA -kaM, apahArI -riRI -ri (n), grasanaSIlaH &c., grasanabudDiH &c., grahaRaSIlaH -lA -laM, sarvva- grAhI &c., sarvvahArI &c., sarvvagrAsI &c., lubDaH -bDA -bDaM, atilubDaH &c., atiloBI &c., loBI &c., vipralumpakaH -kA -kaM, hiMsrakaH &c., sAhasikaH -kI -kaM.
RAPACIOUSLY: (1) by adj.;(2) prasahya (= with violence).
RAPACIOUSLY , adv. haraRaSIlatvAt, apahArabudDyA, atiloBena.
RAPACIOUSNESS, RAPACITY: (1) lubDatA;(2) gfDnutA; (= greediness);(3) AtatAyitA;(4) sAhasikatA (= boldness).
RAPACIOUSNESS , RAPACITY, s. haraRaSIlatA, apahAraSIlatvaM, apahAra- budDiH f., apahArakatvaM, apahAritA, grahaRaSIlatA, lubDatA, atiloBaH, sAhasikatvaM.

Rape, s. apa-, haraRaM. 2 dUzaRaM, balAtkAreRa-balAt-rataM-saMBogah; haWasaMBogaH, ADarzaH-rzaRaM, balAtkAraH, strIsaMgrahaH; ‘to commit r(ape)’ balAtkAreRa ram 1 A or aBigam 1 P or saMgam 1 A, ADfz c.

RAPE: I. Abduction: haraRam, the r. of Draupadī: drOpadIharaRam, Mah. II Violence on chastity: balAtkAreRa samBogaH, M. n. on R. x. 47., or sim. balAtkAraH, Mit. Ph.: to commit r.: balAtkAreRa ramate, gacCati, etc. or balAd vrajati, M.; attempted to r. me: mAM balAtkAreRa rantumudyuMkte, D. III. A tree: KasaH (?), r. -seed-oil: KasabIjAnAM tElam (?), Bha.
RAPE , s. balAtkAreRABigamaH, balAtkArasamBogaH, strIharaRaM, kanyAharaRaM, DarzaRaM, strIDarzaRaM, balAtkAraDarzaRaM, haWaDarzaRaM, kanyAdUzaRaM, haWasamBogaH, sAhasaM, rAkzasaM.
Rapid, a. SIGra, druta, kzipra, laGu. [Rapid]ity, [Rapid]ness, s. tvarA, vegaH, taras n.; drutatA. [Rapid]ly, adv. SIGraM, satvaraM, drutaM; See Quick, [Quick]ly &c. Rapids, s. vegavat, srotas n.
RAPID: (1) SIGra (f. GrA);(2) tvarita (f. tA) : v. Quick, swift.

RAPID , a. SIGraH -GrA -GraM, tvaritaH -tA -taM, satvaraH -rA -raM, tvarAnvitaH -tA -taM, drutaH &c., kzipraH -prA -praM, tUrRaH -rRA -rRaM, vegavAn -vatI -vat (t), mahAvegaH -gA -gaM, SIGragaH -gA -gaM. See QUICK, SWIFT.
RAPIDITY: (1) SIGratA: v. Quickness, swift- -ness;(2) vegaH: v. Velocity.
RAPIDITY , RAPIDNESS, s. SIGratA, tvarA, satvaratA, drutatA, SEGryaM, vegaH, mahAvegaH, kzipratA, taras n., tUrRatA. See QUICKNESS, VELOCITY,
RAPIDLY: (1) SIGram;(2) kzipram;(3) by comp.: v. Quickly.
RAPIDLY , adv. SIGraM, tvaritaM, satvaraM, kzipraM, drutaM, aSanEs, mahAvegena, SIGra in comp.; ‘going rapidly,’ SIGragAmI -minI &c.
Rapier, s. CurikA, kartarikA, kzudrakfpARaH.
RAPIER: nistriMSaH: v. Dagger.
RAPIER , s. kzudraKaqgaH, kzudrakfpARaH, kfpARaH, nistriMSaH.
RAPINE: luRWanam: v. Plunder, pillage.
RAPINE , s. luRWanaM, luRWA, luRwanaM, azahAraH -raRaM, yudDenApahAraH -raRaM, haraRaM, upadravaH, viplavaH, haWaH. See PILLAGE, PLUNDER.
To RAPINE , v. a. luRW, apahf, upadru. See To PILLAGE, PLUNDER.
RAPPER , s. tAqayitA m. (tf), tAqakaH, praharttA m. (rttf).

Rapt, a. harzonmatta; paramahfzwa, atyAnaMdita; (for ‘wrapt’) para, lIna, nimagna in comp. Rapture, s. harzonmAdaH, AnaM-dAtirekaH, harzAveSaH, atyaMtaharzaH, praharzaH, u-nmAdaH. [Raptur]ed, a. harzonmatta, unmatta. [Raptur]ous, a. unmatta, paramaharzada, mohana; ‘r(apturous) joy’ para-mAnaMdaH. [Raptur]ously, adv. sonmAdaM, paramaharzeRa; See Ecstasy.
RAPT (p. adj.): (1) harzonmatta (f. ttA);(2) hfzitavapus (mfn.); and sim. comp.s.
RAPT , a. harzamohitaH -tA -taM, sammohitaH &c., paramahfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, paramAna- nditaH -tA -taM, harzonmattaH -ttA -ttaM, AnandamattaH &c., mattaH &c.
RAPTURE: harzonmAdaH: v. Ecstasy, joy, pleasure.

RAPTURE , s. paramaharzaH, paramAnandaH, atyAnandaH, atyantaharzaH, harzasammohaH, AnandamohaH, mohAvasTA, AnandAveSaH, AhlAdAveSaH, harzAveSaH, parama- suKaM, brahmasuKaM, brahmAnandaH, praharzaH, pramadaH, unmadaH, mAdaH, harzonmattatA, harzonmAdaH, romaharzaH, pulakitatvaM; ‘to feel rapture,’ atyantaM hfp or prahfz.
RAPTURED , a. harzamohitaH -tA -taM. See ENRAPTURED, ECSTASIED.
RAPTUROUS: unmAdin (f. nI) and sim. comp.s. Ph.: r. joy: paramAnandaH.
RAPTUROUS , a. mAdanaH -nA -naM, unmAdanaH &c., mohanaH &c., paramAnandadaH -dA -daM, paramAnandakaraH -rA -raM, paramaharzadaH &c., sapulakaH -kA -kaM. See ECSTATIC.
RAPTUROUSLY: (1) saharzonmAdaH;(2) harzonmatta (f. ttA);(3) sAhlAdam.
RAPTUROUSLY , adv. saparamAnandaM, paramaharzeRa, paramAhlAdena, samAdaM.

Rare, a. virala, durlaBa, duzprApa, aprApya, asulaBa; ‘of r(are) occurrence’ virala, virala-dfzwa. 2 apUrva, adfzwapUrva, parama, atyuttama, atulya, atyutkfzwa. 3 virala, sUkzma, aGana. [Rare]ly, adv. viralaM, kvacit, kfcCreRa, kaTamapi, kazwena, dur pr.; oft. ex. by (a.); ‘r(arely) to be found’ duzprApa, durlaBa; ‘r(arely) to be seen’ durlaBadarSana. [Rare]ness, s. viralatA, duzprApatA, durlaBatvaM. 2 apUrvatA, atyuttamatA. 3 sUkzmatA. Rarity, s. apUrvaM vastu, camatkAraH, kOtukaM, durlaBavastu. 2 Rareuess, q. v. Rarefy, v. i. sUkzmI-tanU-viralI-BU 1 P. v. t. tanUkf 8 U, viralIkf.

RARE: I In gen.:(1) virala (f. lA), with r. dew-drops: viralatuzArakaRaH, Ki. x. 28.; avirala- lAYCanahAriRaSca kAlAH, Ki. x. 38.; their advi- sers are rare: viralAstezAmupadezwAraH, K,(2) durlaBa (f. BA) and sim. comp.s. (= scarce).II Excellent: apUrva (f. rvA), I saw a rare flower- stalk: adfzwapUrvAM kusumamaYjarImadrAkzam, K.

RARE , a (Not frequent, scarce) viralaH -lA -laM, viralAgataH -tA -taM, durlaBaH -BA -BaM, durlaByaH -ByA -ByaM, dupprApaH -pA -paM, dupprAzyaH -zyA -zyaM, alaByaH -ByA -ByaM, aprAppaH &c., asADAraRaH -RA -RaM, asAmAnyaH -nyA -nyaM, aprasidDaH -dDA -dDaM, kvAcitkaH -tkI -tkaM, kAdAcitkaH &c., kArhi- citkaH &c., ciracezwitaH -tA -taM. — (Unusually excellent) paramo- tkfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, atyutkfzwaH &c., sarvvotkfzwaH &c., paramaH -mA -maM, uttamaH &c., atyuttamaH &c., adButaH -tA -taM, atulyaH -lyA -lyaM, apUrvvaH -rvvA -rvvaM, sOndaryya- viralaH -lA -laM. — (Thin, not dense) sUkzmaH -kzmA -kzmaM, aGanaH -nA -naM.
RAREFACTION: (1) tanUkaraRam (?);(2) viralI- karaRam (?).
RAREFACTION , s. tApaprayuktasUkzmatA -tvaM, tApajanitasUkzmatA, sfkzmatA, sOkzmyaM. — (The act) sUkzmIkaraRaM.
RAREFIED , p. p. sUkzmaH -kzmA -kzmaM, sUkzmIBUtaH -tA -taM, sUkzmIkftaH &c.
RAREFY: I Lit.: viralIkaroti.II Of air: tanUkaroti (?). Ph.: r. ed. air: sUkzmIBUto vAyuH.
To RAREFY , v. a. sUkzmIkf, sUkzmaM -kzmAM kf, sUkzmatAM kf or jan.
To RAREFY , v. n. sUkzmIBU, sUkzmaH -kzmA -kzmaM BU, sUkzmataraH -rA -raM BU.
RARELY , adv. viralaM, vEralyena, kvacit, kadAcit, karhicit, yaTAkaTAca, kaTamapi, dur in comp.; as, ‘rarely to be met with,’ durlaBaH -BA -BaM, duzprApaH -pA -paM.
RARENESS: I Lit.:(1) viralatA;(2) durlaBatA. II Excellence: apUrvatA.III Thinness.

RARENESS , s. (Infrequency, scarceness) viralatA -tvaM, vEralyaM, dOrlaByaM, durlaBatA, durlaByatA, aprasidDatA -tvaM, duzprApatvaM, asAmAnyatA, asADAraRatA, kvAcitkatA -tvaM. — (Unusual excellence) atyutkfzwatA, paramotkfzwatA, sarvvotkfzwatA, uttamatA, atulyatA, apUrvvatA. — (Thinness) sUkzmatA, sOkzmyaM.
RARITY: I Rareness: q. v.II A rare thing: apUrvavastu (n.).
RARITY , s. (Scarceness), see the last. — (Rare thing) durlaBavastu n., durlaBadravyaM, utkfzwadravyaM, kOtukaM, kOtUhalaM.

Rascal, s. DUrtaH, durjanaH, jAlmaH, SaWaH, ki-tavaH, durAtman m., durvfttaH, KalaH, pApAtmA, niMdyacaritaH, aDama-jaGanya-vftti. [Rascal]ity, s. DUrtatA, dOrjanyaM, dOrAtmyaM, kEtavaM, SAWyaM, KalatA, pApavftti f., aDama-nIca-vartanaM. [Rascal]ly, a. See (s.).
RASCAL (1) durAtman (mfn.);(2) durvftta (f. ttA); (3) DUrta (f. rtA).

RASCAL , s. DUrttaH, durjanaH, durAtmA m. (n), durvfttaH, kfzRakarmmA m. (n), KalaH, aDamavfttiH m., duzwajanaH, pApAtmA m., jaGanyavfttiH m., nIca- vfttiH m., apakfzwavfttiH, pApizWaH, SaWaH, duzkarmmA m.
RASCALITY: dOrAtmyam; (2) durvfttatA;(3) DUrtatA.
RASCALITY , s. DUrttatA, durjanatA -tvaM, dOrjanyaM, durAtmyaM, durAtmatvaM, durvfttatvaM, KalatA, duzwatA, pApizWatA -tvaM, SaWatA, jaGanyatA, apakfzwatA, aDamavfttitvaM, kEtavaM, vaYcanaM.
RASCALLY: jaGanya (f. nyA): v. Low, base, rascal.
RASCALLY , a. durvfttaH -ttA -ttaM, pApizWaH -zWA -zWaM, aDamavfttiH -ttiH -tti, jaGanyavfttiH &c., SaWaH -WA -WaM, kApawikaH -kI -kaM, duzwaH -zwA -zwaM.
Rase, v. t. pramfj 2 P or c., vilup c.; Gfz 1 P, ulliK 6 P. 2 BUmisAtkf 8 U; See Raze, Erase. [Ras]ure, s. pramArjanaM, vilo-panaM.
RASE: I To graze: Garzati (Gfz, c. 1.).II To erase pramArzwi (mfj, c. 2.).III To level with the ground: BUmisAtkaroti.
To RASE , v. a. (Graze) Gfz (c. 1. Garzati -rzituM). See To RAZE.

Rash, s. kzipra-avimfSya-asamIkzya-kArin, avivekin, apariRAmadarSin, sAhasin, sAhasika (kI f.), adUradarSin, asAvaDAna. 2 (Of acts) asamIkzya &c. kfta; avimfzwa, saraBasa, sAhasika, avi-cAra-asamIkzA-pUrva; better ex. by ‘r(ash)ly’. s. Eruption, Pimple, q. v. [Rash]ly, adv. asamIkzya, avimfSya, sahasA, avivekena, avicArya, anAlocya, anavekzA-aviveka-pUrvaM, saraBasaM, kzipraM, uttApena, sAvegaM. [Rash]ness, s. a-samIkzya-avimfSya-kAritA, sAhasaM, avivekaH, avicAraH, asamIkzA, anavekzA, raBasaH, AvegaH, uttApaH.

RASH (adj.): I Of men:(1) avimfSyakArin (f. RI);(2) asamIkzyakArin (f. RI);(3) apariRAmadarSin (f. nI); and sim. comp.s.II Of acts:(1) expr. with adv. s. avimfSya, asamIkzya.;(2) ayaTAlocita (f. tA) and sim. comp.s.

RASH , a. avimfSyakArI -riRI -ri (n), asamIkzyakArI &c., avicAryya- kArI &c., sAhasI &c., sAhasikaH -kI -kaM, jAlmaH -lmA -lmaM, gama- kArI &c., pramattaH -ttA -ttaM, apariRAmadarSI &c., adUradarSI &c., asAva- DAnaH -nA -naM, avicArI &c. — (Of measures) avicAryya kftaH -tA -taM, avimfSya kftaH &c., avicArapUrvvaH -rvvA -rvvaM, asamIkzApUrvvaH &c., anavekzApUrvvaH &c.
RASH , s. (Eruption) dadruH m., KarjjUH f., udardaH, sPowotpattiH f., visPowaH, varawI, raktavarawI, raktasPowotpattiH f., raktasPowaH.
Rasher, s. (vallUra) KaMqaH, CedaH.
RASHER: of bacon: KaRqam: v. Price.
RASHER , s. (Of bacon) vallUraKaRqaH, vallUraCedaH, SUkaramAMsaKaRqaH.
RASHLY: (1) avimfSya;(2) asamIkzya;(3) anAlocya;(4) sahasA, Ki. ii. 30.
RASHLY , adv. avicAryya, asamIkzya, avimfSya, sahasA, anavekzayA, avi- cAreRa, avicArapUrvvaM, asamIkzApUrvvaM, anavekzApUrvvaM, darpAt, darpeRa.
RASHNESS: (1) avimfSyakAritA;(2) asamIkzya- kAritA;(3) asamIkzA;(4) avivekaH;(5) sAhasam (= boldness).

RASHNESS , s. avimfSyakAritA -tvaM, asamIkzyakAritA -tvaM, avicAryyakA- ritA, gamakAritvaM, sAhasaM, sAhasikatvaM, vizamasAhasaM, duHsAhasaM, avi- cAraH, avicAritA, anavekzA, asamIkzA, avivekaH, aMsAvaDAnatA, apariRAmadarSanaM, madaH, darpaH; ‘of youth,’ yOvanadarpaH.
Rasp, s. saM-, GarzaRI. v. t. GarzaRyA Gfz 1 P.
RASP: I Subs.: *saMGarzaRI.II Verb: saMGarzaRyA Garzati (Gfz, c. 1.).
RASP , s. GarzaRI, GarzaRayantraM, nirGarzaRakaH, GarzakaH, AGawwakaH.
To RASP , v. a. pUrvvoktayantreRa Gfz (c. 1. Garzati -rzituM).
RASPBERRY: PalaviSezaH.
RASPBERRY , s. kaRwakagulmaPalaM, kaRwakastambaPalaM.
RASPED , p. p. pUrvvoktayantreRa GarzitaH -tA -taM, AGarzitaH &c.
RASURE: I Scraping: GarzaRam.II Erasure: pramArjanam.
RASURE , s. (Scraping) GarzaRaM, ulleKanaM, takzaRaM. See ERASURE.
Rat, s. AKuH, mUza(zi)kaH, bileSayaH, uM-duruH, KanikaH; ‘I smell a r(at)’ kimapya-nizwaM-aSuBaM-ASaMkate me manaH. v. i. kAryAt anyapakzaM avalaMb 1 A or ASri 1 U.
RAT (subs.): (1) mUzi(za)kaH, the story about the r. and the cat: mArjAramUzikasaMvAdaH, Mah. xii.; (2) AKuH, H. i.;(3) u(i)nduruH. Ph.: I smell a r.: kimapyanizwamASaNke.
RAT (v.): svapakzaM tyaktA parAn ASrayati, sam-, (Sri, c. 1.).

RAT , s. unduruH m., undaruH m., undaraH, induraH, induruH m., mUzikaH -kA, muzakaH -kA, mUzI m., (n), mUzIkaH -kA, AKuH m., vileSayaH, vajradantaH, tuwumaH, DAnyAriH m., mahinDakaH, AKanikaH; ‘swarm of rats,’ A- KUtTaH; ‘rat-hole.’ mUzikavivaraM, AKuvilaM, mUzikotkaraH.
To RAT , v. n. (Desert one's party and go over to the oppo- site) svapakzaM tyaktvAanyapakzam or viparItapakzam ASri (c. 1. -Srayati -yituM).
RAT-CATCHER , s. mUzikaGAtI m. (n), mUzikagrAhI m., AKuGAtaH -takaH.
RATABLE , a. SulkayogyaH -gyA -gyaM, karayogyaH &c., SulkasTAnaM.
Ratan, s. vetasaH, veRuH, vetraH-traM, vAnIraH, vaMjulaH; ‘crackling r(atan)’ kIcakaH.
RATAN: I The plant:(1) vetasaH, r. -like [Page572] conduct (i. e. easy submission): vEtasI vfttiH, R. iv. 35.;(2) vetraH.II A. r. stick: vetram.
RATAN , s. vetasaH, kIcakaH, veRuH m., vetraH -traM, vaMSaH, vAnIraH, vaYjulaH, BedI m. (n) CEdikaH.

Rate, s. mUlyaM, arGaH, mUlya-arGa-pramARaM, vasnaH, avakrayaH. 2 mAnaM, pra-pari°. 3 vegaH, gati f., gatimAnaM-pramARaM. 4 niyata-nirUpita-mUlyaM-vetanaM. 5 karaH, SulkaM, baliH; ‘at any r(ate)’ yena kena prakAreRa; tAvat; ‘market-r(ate)’ ApaRikaH; arGabalAbalaM. v. t. arGaM-mUlyaM-nirRI 1 P or saMsTA c., (sTApayati) or nirUp 10 or saMKyA c. 2 pramARaM nirUp; oft. ex. by gaR 10, man 4 A; See Consider. 3 niMd 1 P, upAlaB 1 A; See Reproach.

RATE (subs.): I Price, value: q. v.: mUlyam. Ph.: market r.: ApaRikaH; r. s.: arTabalAbalam, M.II. Tax: q. v.: karaH.III Of interest: expr. by circumlo.: v. Interest.IV Of velocity: vegaH. Ph.: at any r.: antataH, Da. com.
RATE (v.): I To fix r. s: arGaM or mUlyaM saMsTApayati (c. of sTA).II To estimate, value: q. v.: manyate (man, c. 4.).III To reprove, censure: q. v.: upAlaBate (laB, c. 1.).

RATE , s. (Price) mUlyaM, arGaH. — (Degree of price or value) arGaba- lAbalaM, mUlyabalAbalaM, mUlyapramARaM, arGaparimARaM, arGapragARaM; ‘market rate,’ ApaRikaH. — (Proportion, degree) pramARaM, parimARaM, mAnaM, mitiH f., parimitiH f.; ‘at the rate of,’ pramARena -Ratas. — (Degree of velocity) vegaH, gatiH f., gatipramARaM, gatimAnaM, gatimitiH f.; ‘rate of the velocity of light,’ prakASakiraRagatimitiH f.; ‘at a quick rate,’ drutagatyA, laGugatyA, drutapadaM. — (Settled allowance) nirUpi- tamUlyaM, niyatamUlyaM, parimitamUlyaM. — (Tax, assessed sum) SulkaH -lkaM, karaH, deyaM, grAhyaM. — (At any rate) tAvat.

To RATE , v. a. (Set a value on, fix the value) mUlyaM nirUp (c. 10. -rUpayati -yituM), arGaM nirUp, arGabalAbalaM nirUp or nirRI, arGapari- mARaM nirUp, mUlyapramARaM nirUp, dravyAdimUlyaM, nirUp or sTA in caus., arGaM saMKyA in caus. (-KyApayati -yituM), arGasaMKyApanaM kf, mUlyanirRayaM kf, mUlyanirUpaRaM kf. — (Fix the magnitude or proportion) pramARaM or parimARaM nirUp or nirRI, pramARanirUpaRaM kf, pramARanirRayaM kf. — (Chide, scold) nind (c. 1. nindati -ndituM), upAlaB (c. 1. -laBate -labDuM) Barts.
RATED , p. p. nirUpitamUlyaH -lyA -lyaM, nirRItamUlyaH &c., saMKyAtaH -tA -taM, [Page657-a+ 51] saMKyApitaH &c., parisaMKyAtaH &c. — (Chid) ninditaH -tA -taM, upA- labDaH -bDA -bDaM.

sanskrit.slp1: rAzwrA raRe hanyus tan me kzemataraM Bavet
sanskrit.word: राष्ट्रा रणे हन्युस् तन् मे क्षेमतरं भवेत्
sanskrit.iast: rāṣṭrā raṇe hanyus tan me kṣemataraṃ bhavet

details.body: Rather, adv. Ex. by varaM with na ca-na punaH; for ‘than’; See Prefer; ‘I would r(ather) die than be disgraced’ varaM mftyurna punarapamAnaH; ‘I had r(ather) not go there’ varaM tatra na gata eva, yadi na gacCeyaM tarhi varaM-SreyaH-syAt. 2 Izat, kiMcit, kimapi, kiMcidiva; ‘r(ather) less’ IzadUna, kiMcinnyUna.
RATHER: I In gen.: varam: v. Better (II). II Somewhat: r. less: IzadUna (f. nA).: v. Little. (adv.).

RATHER , adv. (Preferably) varaM usually followed by na ca or na punar as ‘rather death than poverty,’ varaM mftyur na ca dAridraM. The root Siz with vi may be used to express the sense of ‘rather,’ as ‘rather death than dishonour,’ apamAnAt prARatyAgo viSizyate or the sense may be expressed by some other construction, as ‘I would rather that the sons of Dhṛtarāṣtra should kill me in the battle,’ yadi mAM DArtta- rAzwrA raRe hanyus tan me kzemataraM Bavet. See PREFERABLE, PRE- FERABLY. — (Somewhat, a little) Izat, kiYcit, kimapi; ‘rather less,’ IzadUnaH -nA -naM, kiYcinnyUnaH -nA -naM.
RATI , s. (The wife of Kāmadeva the god of love) ratiH f., kA- mapatnI, kAmapriyA, kAmakalA, smarapriyA, kAmiH f., rAgalatA, prItiH f., revA, mAyAvatI, kelikilA.
RATIFICATION: (1) sTirIkaraRam;(2) satyApanam; (3) by verb.
RATIFICATION , s. satyAkftiH f., satyAkaraRaM, satyApanaM, satyaNkAraH, satyakaraRaM, dfQIkaraRaM, sTirIkaraRaM, saMstamBaH, niScayakaraRaM, niScitakaraRaM.
RATIFIED , p. p. satyAkftaH -tA -taM, dfQIkftaH -tA -taM, sTirIkftaH &c.
RATIFIER , s. satyApakaH, satyakArI m. (n), satyaNkArI m., dfQakArI m., sTirakArI m., niScayakArI m., saMstamBakArI m.

Ratify, v. t. sTirIkf 8 U, dfQIkf, satyAkf, draQayati-satyApayati- (D.), saMstaMB 9 P or c. pramARIkf. [Ratif]ier, s. satyApakaH, saMstaMBakaH. [Ratif]ication, s. sTirI-dfQI-karaRaM, saMstaMBanaM, satyApanaM, satyaMkAraH.
RATIFY: (1) sTirIkaroti;(2) satyApayati: v. To confirm.

To RATIFY , v. a. satyAkf, satyaM -tyAM kf, satya (nom. in caus. satyApa- yati -yituM), dfQIkf, sTirIkf, draQa (nom. draQayati -yituM), niScayaM kf, saMstamB (c. 5. -staBnoti -stamBituM, c. 10. -stamBayati -yituM).
RATING (subs.): upAlamBaH: v. Reproach, censure.
RATING , s. (Chiding) nindA, BartsanaM, nirBartsanaM, upAlamBaH.
Ratio, s. saMbaMDaH, pramARaM.
RATIO: sambanDaH (?). Common r. two: dviguRottarA vfdDiH, Li. 100.
RATIO , s. pramARaM, mAnaM, parimARaM, kramaH. See PROPORTION.
Ratiocinate, v. i. yuktipUrvaM-sahetukaM-upapad c. or vicar c. or vitark 10; See Argue. [Ratiocinat]ion, s. vitarkaH, vicAraH, yuktivAdaH.
RATIOCINATE (v.): yuktiyuktaM or sahetukaM or upapatti- mudAhftya vicArayati. (c. of car).
To RATIOCINATE , v. n. vicAraMkf, vicar (c. 10. -cArayati -yituM), vitarkaM kf.
RATIOCINATION: (1) yuktiyukto vicAraH, and sim. comp.s.;(2) by circumlo.
RATIOCINATION , s. vicAraH -raRaM, vitarkaH -rkaRaM, tarkavidyA, tarkajYAnaM.
Ration, s. annaparimARaM, AhArAMSaH, nirUpitAhAraBAgaH.
RATION: exptexpr. with AhAraH and its syn.: v. Food.
RATION , s. AhAraBAgaH, AhArAMSaH, nirUpitAhArAMSaH.

Rational, a. vicAravat, sacetana, sacetas, vivekin, sajYAna, vyutpattimat, vyutpanna, pratiboDavat, cicCakti-jYAnaSakti-saMpanna. 2 yukta, upapanna, sayuktika, nyAyya, yaTocita, yaTAyogya, nyAyAnurUpa, yuktisidDa, upapatti-mat, nyAyAnusArin. [Rational]ism, s. hetu-kAraRa-vAdaH, hEtukatvaM. [Rational]ist, s. hetu-nyAya-vAdin m., hEtukaH [Rational]ity, [Rational]ness, s. jYAnaSakti f., cicCaktiH, jYAnaM, ava-prati-boDaH, cetanatvaM, tarka-vicAra-SaktiH. 2 yuktatA, nyAyyatA, upapatti f. [Rational]ly, adv. nyAyataH, yuktipUrvaM, nyAyAnusAreRa, tarka-viveka-dvAreRa. Rationale, s. upapattiH.

RATIONAL: I Possessing reason:(1) vyutpattimat (f. tI), of r. beings: vyutpattimatAM puruzARAm, S. i. 1. p.;(2) vyutpannacitta (f. ttA), S.;(3) vivekin (f. nI).II Relating or agreeable to reason: vivekin (f. nI), your r. mind: vivekinI te matiH, Ki. ii. 6.III In alg.: r. quantity: rUpam, Vij.

RATIONAL , a. (Having the faculty of reasoning) jYAnaSaktikaH -kA -kaM, jYAnaSaktisampannaH -nnA -nnaM, cicCaktikaH &c., sacetanaH -nA -naM, sacetAH -tAH -taH (s), budDijIvI -vinI -vi(n), tarkaSaktikaH &c., tarkaSaktisampannaH -nnA -nnaM, sajYAnaH -nA -naM, budDimAn -matI -mat (t), tarkajYaH -jYA -jYaM. — (Agreeable to reason) yuktaH -ktA -ktaM, upayuktaH &c., yaTAyuktaH &c., yaTAyogyaH -gyA -gyaM, yaTocitaH -tA -taM, nyAyyaH -yyA -yyaM, yuktisidDaH -dDA -dDaM, nyAyasidDaH &c., nyAyAnusArI -riRI &c., yaTArTaH -rTA -rTaM, yuktimAn &c., sayuktikaH -kA -kaM, upapattimAn &c., upapannaH -nnA -nnaM, tarkavidyAnusArI &c.
RATIONALE: i. e.: reasons: upapattiH (f.).
RATIONALE , s. (Detailed account of principles) upapattiH f.
RATIONALISM: (1) hetuvAdaH;(2) nyAyavAdaH (?); (3) hEtukatA.
RATIONALISM , s. hetuvAdaH, kAraRavAdaH, hetudarSanaM, hEtukatvaM.
RATIONALIST , s. hetuvAdI m. (n), kAraRavAdI m., hetudarSI, hEtukaH.
RATIONALITY: I Of men:(1) vyutpattimattA; (2) vyutpannacittatA;(3) vivekitA.II Of acts: vivekitA.
RATIONALITY , RATIONALNESS, s. (Power of reasoning) jYAnaSaktiH f., cicCaktiH f., tarkaSaktiH f. — (Reasonableness) yuktatA, yuktiH f., upa- yuktatA, yuktisidDatA, nyAyasidDatA.
RATIONALIZE: in alg: *rUpIkaroti. after mUlI- karoti of A. c.
RATIONALLY: vivekadvArA or -dvAreRa: v. Wisely.
RATIONALLY , adv. yuktaM, yaTAyuktaM, nyAyatas, nyAyAnusAreRa, tarkAnusAreRa -ratas, upapannaM, yaTocitaM, yuktitas, yaTArTaM, tarkavidyAnusAreRa.
RATIONLIST: (1) hetuvAdin (f. nI);(2) hEtuka (f. kI), V. p. iii. 19.

Rattle, v. i. kvaR-Dvan-svan-raR 1 P, SiMj 2 A, vi-ru 2 P, JaRaJaRAyate (D.); (as a wheel) saMkrIq 1 P, (saMkrIqati cakraM S. K.). 2 prajalp 1 P, pralap 1 P. v. t. Causal of roots above. [Rattl]ing, s. kvaRanaM, SiMjitaM, DvaniH, kvaRitaM, vi-, rAvaH, JaRaJaRAyitaM; saMkrIqitaM. 2 pralapitaM, prajalpanaM. 3 (Instrument) SiMjinI, kvaRanI.

RATTLE (v.): I Lit.:(1) kUjati (kUj, c. 1.); (2) kvaRati (kvaR, c. 1.).;(3) saMkrIqati (krIq, c. 1.), r. ing pole: saMkrIqantI DUH, Si. xvii. 7. II To r. away (of men):(1) pralapati (lap, c. 1.);(2) vi-jalpati (jalp, c. 1.).
RATTLE (subs.): I R. ing noise:(1) kUjitam; (2) kvaRitam;(3) saMkrIqitam; r. of wheels: raTANga- saMkrIqitam, Ki. xvi. 8.II Of men:(1) pralapitam;(2) vi-jalpitam.III An instru- -ment: *SiYjinI.

To RATTLE , v. n. kvaR (c. 1. kvaRati -RituM), SiYj (c. 2. SiMkte, c. 1. SiYjate -YjituM), viSiYj, Dvan (c. 1. Gvanati -nituM), stan (c. 1. stanati -nituM), svan (c. 1. svanati -nituM), viru (c. 2. -rOti -ravituM), JaRa- JaRa (nom. JaRaJaRAyate), JajJana (nom. JajJanAyate), JajJanaM kf, JajJA (nom. JajJAyate), kvaRitaM kf, SiYjitaM kf, JaRaJaRaSabdaM kf. — (Utter words in a clattering manner) jalp, cawacawaSabdaM kf, [Page657-b+ 51] cawacawa (nom. cawacawAyate), kawakawa.
To RATTLE , v. a. Dvan in caus. (Dvanayati, DvAnayati -yituM), kvaR in caus., svan in caus., stan in caus., SiYj in caus.

RATTLE , s. (Rattling nossenoise) kvaRitaM, kvaRanaM, stanitaM, stananaM, DvaniH m., DvanitaM, SiYjitaM, JajJanaM, JajJA, JanatkAraH, JaRaJaRaSabdaH. — (Clat- tering talk) jalpanaM, jalpitaM, cawacawaSabdaH. — (Instrument for making a rattling sound) SiYjinI, kvaRanI, JajJanI.
RATTLESNAKE: ahiviSezaH; *SiYjABogaH.
RATTLING: I Adj.:(1) kUjat (f. ntI); (2) kvaRat (f. ntI).II Subs.: kUjitam: v. Rattle (1).
RATTLING , s. kvaRitaM, kvaRanaM, JajJanaM; ‘of thunder,’ rasitaM, stanitaM, garjitaM, meGanirGozaH. See RATTLE.
RATTLING , part. kvaRan -RantI -Rat (t), kvaRitaH -tA -taM, JajJanakArI -riRI -ri (n), SiYjI -YjinI -Yji (n), Dvanan &c., svanan &c.

Ravage, v. t. vi-upa-plu 1 A, upa-dru 1 P, pra-saM-bAD 1 A, ava-mfd 9 P, ucCid 7 P, vinaS c., udDvaMs c. s. vi-upa-plavaH, saM-bADA, upadravaH, avamardaH, ucCedaH, vinASaH, udDvaMsaH. [Ravag]er, s. upaplavakArin m., pra-saM-bADakaH, avamardakaH, ucCedakaH.
RAVAGE (v.): upaplavate (plu, c. 1.): v. To depredate, plunder.
RAVAGE (subs.): upaplavaH: v. Depredation, devastation, plunder.

To RAVAGE , v. a. upaplu (c. 1. -plavate -plotuM), upadru (c. 1. -dravati -drotuM), bAD (c. 1. bADate -DituM), prabAD, paribAD, avamfd (c. 1. -mardati -rdituM), viplavaM kf, upaplavaM kf, upadravaM kf, avamardaM kf.
RAVAGE , s. upaplavaH, viplavaH, upadravaH, avamardaH -rdanaM, upamardaH, bADA -DanaM, prabADA, utpAtaH, ucCedaH, vinASaH.
RAVAGED , p. p. upadrutaH -tA -taM, viplutaH &c., upaplutaH &c., avamarditaH &c., prabADitaH &c., vinASitaH &c., ucCinnaH -nnA -nnaM.
RAVAGER: (1) upaplavakArin (f. RI);(2) upa- drAvaka (f. vikA);(3) avamardaka (f. rdikA);(4) saMbADaka (f. DikA).
RAVAGER , s. upadravI m. (n), viplavakArI m. (n), prabADakaH, avamardakaH.
RĀVANA , s. (The Daitya sovereign of Ceylon, fabled as having ten faces. He was killed by Rāmachandra) rAvaRaH, laNkA- patiH m., laNkeSaH, daSAnanaH, daSAsyaH, daSamuKaH, daSagrIvaH, daSakaRWaH.

Rave, v. i. (BramAt-unmattavat) pralap 1 P, prajalp 1 P, budDiBrameRa vad 1 P. 2 unmad 4 P, nazwacetana-budDiBrazwa a. BU 1 P. [Rav]ing, s. vi-Brama-pralApaH; cittaviplavaH-viBramaH, cEtanya-nASaH. [Rav]ingly, adv. unmattavat, BrAMtavat, BrAMtacetasA, budDiBrameRa.
RAVE: I Lit.: unmattavat pralapati (lap, c. 1.)II To wander in mind: unmAdyati (mad, c. 4.), of the r. ing (kings): unmAdyatAm, Vi. ii. 29.

To RAVE , v. n. (Be delirious, talk incoherently) cittaviBramAt or BrAntacittatvAt pralApaM kf, cittaviplavAt pralap (c. 1. -lapati -pituM), cEtanyanASAd jalp (c. 1. jalpati -lpituM) or jalpanaM kf. — (Wander in mind) BrAntacittaH -ttA -ttaM BU, cEtanyarahitaH -tA -taM BU, nazwacetanaH -nA -naM BU, budDiBrazwaH -zwA -zwaM BU, unmad (c. 4. -mAdyati -madituM), pramad.
Ravel, v. t. saMgraMT 9 P, saMSliz c., jawilIkf 8 U; See Entangle. 2 viSliz c., ud-graMT. [Ravell]ing, s. viSlizwataMtuH.
RAVEL: I To unravel: q. v.: viSlezayati (c. of Sliz).II To entangle, involve: q. v.: saMSlezayati.

To RAVEL , v. a. (Untwist) udgranT (c. 9. -graTnAti, c. 1. -granTati -nTituM), samudgranT, tantrodgranTanaM kf, tantUdgranTanaM kf, viSliz in caus. — (Entangle, entwist) granT, granTilIkf, AkuYc, saMSlizwIkf, vyAvft in caus.
RAVELED , p. p. (Untwisted) udgraTitaH -tA -taM, samudgraTitaH &c., udgranTitaH &c., viSlizwaH -zwA -zwaM. — (Twisted) graTitaH &c., AkuYcitaH &c., saMSlizwaH -zwA -zwaM.
RAVELIN: *pratiSAlaH; kUwaviSezaH.
RAVELIN , s. durgavahiHsTitaH setudvayayuktaH parikUwaviSezaH.
RAVELINGS , s. pl. udgraTitatantavaH m. pl., viSlizwatantavaH, udgraTitatantrARi n. pl.

Raven, s. droRakAkaH, kAkolaH. v. gfD 4 P, atiloBena Bakz 10 or gras 1 A. [Raven]ous, a. Gasmara, atikzuDArta-kzuDAtura, atilolupa, Amiza-lolupa, atibuBukzu. [Raven]ously, adv. ati-Gasmaravat, atilolupatayA.
RAVEN: (1) droRakAkaH;(2) kAkolaH.
RAVEN , s. droRakAkaH, kAkolaH, kAkAlaH, dagDakAkaH, parvvatakAkaH, araRya- vAyasaH, vanASrayaH, krUrarAvI m. (n), palalapriyaH, mahAprARaH, darA -rI, kAkapakzI m. (n).
To RAVEN , v. a. and n. atigfDratvena Bakz (c. 10. Bakzayati -yituM), ati- loBena AmizaM gras (c. 1. grasate -situM), gfD (c. 4. gfDyati, garDituM), GasmaraH -rA -raM BU, hiMsanaSIlaH -lA -laM BU.
RAVENOUS: I Lit.:(1) Gasmara (f. rA), the r. destructive Rudra: GasmarakAlarudraH, Vi. iii. 48.; (2) admara (f. rA): v. Also hungry.II Fig.: parama (f. mA): v. Excessive.

RAVENOUS , a. atiGasmaraH -rA -raM, atibuBukzuH -kzuH -kzu, atikzuDitaH -tA -taM, kzuDApIqitaH &c., kzuDAturaH -rA -raM, AmizaloBI -BinI -Bi (n), atiBakzakaH -kA -kaM, grasanaSIlaH -lA -laM, haraRaSIlaH &c., hiMsanaSIlaH -lA -laM. See HUNGRY.
RAVENOUSLY: (1) Gasmaravat;(2) admaravat;(3) buBukzu (mfn.).
RAVENOUSLY , adv. atikzuDitavat, atiGasmaravat, atibuBukzayA.
RAVENOUSNESS: (1) GasmaratA;(2) admaratA;(3) gfDnutA (fig.).
RAVENOUSNESS , s. atibuBukzA, atiGasmaratvaM, atiBakzakatvaM, atikzuDA.
RAVER , s. cittaviBramAt pralApI m. (n), BrAntacittatvAt pralApI m.
RAVĪ , s. (River in the Panjāb) ErAvatI.
Ravine, s. kaMdaraH, darIBUH, darI, droRI.
RAVINE: (1) kandaraH (rA, raM);(2) kandaraBUH;(3) darIBUH, -miH.
RAVINE , s. darA -rI, darIBUH f., kandaraH -rI, droRI, nimnaBUmiH f.
RAVING , s. cittaviBramaprayuktaH pralApaH or jalpaH -lpanaM, cittaviBramaH, cittaviplavaH, cEtanyanASaH, jYAnaBrAntiH f. — (The disease) pralApavAyuH m., pralApavAtaH.
RAVINGLY: (1) unmattavat;(2) unmAdAt;(3) unmAdena.

Ravish, v. t. prasahya-balAtkAreRa-aBigam 1 P or Buj 7 A or ram 1 A, A-pra-Dfz c., duz c. (dUzayati), parA-pari-mfS 6 P; See Rape. 2 balAd apahf 1 P or nI 1 P. 3 (cittaM) hf, Akfz 1 P, muh c., vi-luB c., atyaMtaM-paramaM-AnaMd c. or hfz c.; See Attract. [Ravish]er, s. A-, DarzakaH, haWadUzakaH, apahartf m. [Ravish]ing, s. DarzaRaM, balasaMBogaH, saMgrahaH; See Rape. a. hArin, mohin, cittAkarzin; hAriRA gItarAgeRa (S. 1) ‘by the r(avishing) melody of song’. [Ravish]ment, s. apaharaRaM, DarzaRaM, dUzaRaM, &c. 2 harzonmAdaH, cittamodaH, manoharaRaM.
RAVISH: I To rape: balAtkAreRa BuNkte (Buj, c. 7.). or ramate (ram, c. 1.).II To carry off: (prasahya) harati, apa-, (hf, c. 1.).III To enrapture: harati: v. To charm.

To RAVISH , v. a. (Have carnal knowledge of by force) balA- tkAreRa aBigam (c. 1. -gacCati -gantuM) or samBogaM kf, Dfz (c. 10. Darza- yati -yituM), praDfz, balAtkAreRa kanyAM duz (c. 10. dUzayati -yituM) or hf (c. 1. harati, harttuM) or apahf, parAmfS (c. 6. -mfSati -mrazwuM), pramaT in caus. (-mATayati -yituM), balAtkArasamBogaM kf, haWaDarzaRaM kf, haWasamBogaM kf, DarzaRaM kf, haWaDarzaRaM kf. — (Seize, carry away by force) hf, apahf, vyapahf. — (Enrapture) mano or cittaM hf or paramaharzeRa muh (c. 10. mohayati -yituM).
RAVISHED , p. p. DarzitaH -tA -taM, haWaDarzitaH &c., balAtkAreRa dUzitaH &c., balAtkAreRABigataH &c., pramATitaH &c., hftaH &c., apahftaH &c. — (Enraptured), see the word.

RAVISHER , s. strIharttA m. (rttf), strIhArI m. (n), kanyAharttA m., DarzakaH, haWaDarzakaH, haWadUzakaH, balAtkAradUzakaH, kanyAdUzakaH, strIpramATI m., pramATI m., harttA m., aBiharttA m., apahArI m., ratahiRqakaH.
RAVISHING (adj.): manohArin (f. RI): v. Charming.
RAVISHING , s. strIharaRaM, strIDarzaRaM, balAtkAreRABigamaH. See RAPE.
RAVISHING , part. or a. cittahArI -riRI -ri (n), cittApahArI &c., manoharaH -rA -raM, cittamohanaH -nA -naM, cittamohI &c.
RAVISHMENT: I Abduction: haraRam, apa-.II Rape: balAtkArasamBogaH.III Rapture, delight: q. v.: harzonmAdaH.
RAVISHMENT , s. (Of a woman) strIharaRaM, kanyAharaRaM, DarzaRaM, balAtkA- reRABigamanaM. — (Of the senses) cittaharaRaM, cittApaharaRaM, manoharaRaM, cittamohaH -hanaM, see ENRAVISHMENT, RAPTURE.

Raw, a. Ama, apakva, asidDa, asaMskfta. 2 (Fruit) Ama, apakva, apariRata, akaWora, aprOQa. 3 (Mind) apariRata, aparipakva, apakva; (person) apariRata-akaWora-apakva-mati-budDi; adfzwakarman; not ‘mature’ q. v. 4 niScarman, tvagrahita. 5 ArdraSItala. 6 jalA-miSrita, asaMsfzwa; ‘r(aw) flesh’ kravyaM; AmA-mizaM; ‘smell of r(aw) flesh’ visraM, AmagaMDaH; ‘r(aw) fruit’ SalAwu m. f. n. [Raw]ness, s. apAkaH, AmatA, apariRAmaH, aparipAkaH; apakvabudDitvaM, matyaparipAkaH &c.

RAW: I Lit.:(1) Ama (f. mA), r. -fish-eaters: AmamInASinaH, Ram.; r. mango: AmamAmram, Bha.; who cuts a r. (i. e. a r. sore) unwittingly: yo CinattyAmamajYAnAt, Sr.;(2) apakva (f. kvA = unripe: q. v.);(3) asidDa (f. dDA = uncooked). II Inexperienced, untried:(1) (1) apakva- budDi (mfn.);(2) adfzwakarman (mfn.); and sim. comp.s.III Of spirits: vinA jalena (= without water) or asaMsfzwa (f. zwA = unmixed).IV Chilly and damp: klinnaSiSira or -tuzAra (f. rAH ?). V Unwrought, impure, etc.: perh. asaMskfta (f. tA).

RAW , a. (Undressed, uncooked) AmaH -mA -maM, apakvaH -kvA -kvaM, asidDaH -dDA -dDaM, asaMskftaH -tA -taM, anupaskftaH &c.; ‘half-dressed, nearly raw,’ ApakvaH -kvA -kvaM, yAtayAmaH -mA -maM. — (Unripe, crude) apakvaH -kvA -kvaM, aparipakvaH &c., apariRataH -tA -taM, kalaH -lA -laM. — (Inexperienced) apakvaH &c., avipakvabudDiH -dDiH -dDi, aparipakva- budDiH &c., see the word. — (Not covered with skin) carmmarahitaH -tA -taM, vigatacarmmA -rmmA -rmma (n), vicarmmA &c., niScarmmA &c., acarmmA &c., tvagrahitaH &c. — (Damp and cold) ArdraSItalaH -lA -laM, ArdraSiSiraH -rA -raM. — (Raw flesh) AmamAMsaM, kravyaM; ‘smell of it,’ visraM; ‘eater of it,’ AmamAMsAdaH, kravyAdaH, see CANNIBAL. — (Raw fruit) AmaPalaM, SalAwuH -wuH -wu.
RAW-BONED (adj.): (1) tvagasTiSeza (f. zA);(2) kzAmakzAma (f. mA), D. v.; and sim. comp.s.
RAW-BONED , a. tyagasTimAtraBUtaH -tA -taM, kevalAsTimayaH -yI -yaM.

RAWNESS , s. (State of being uncooked or unripe) AmatA, apakvatA, apaktiH f., apAkaH, aparipAkaH, aparipakvatA, asidDatA, asaMskftatvaM, anupaskftatvaM, apariRatatvaM, apariRatiH f., apariRAmaH, asidDiH f., kalatA. — (Inexperience) apAkaH, aparipAkaH, apakvatA, apakvabudDitvaM, avipakvabudDitvaM. — (Dampness and coldness) ArdraSItatA, ArdraSI- talatA. — (Of smell) visatA.
Ray, s. kiraRaH, karaH, raSmiH, aMSuH, usraH, pAdaH, mayUKaH, marIciH, dIDitiH, gaBastiH, DAman n., GfRiH, BAnuH, aBISuH-zuH; ‘a pencil of r(ay)s’ aMSujAlaM.

RAY: I Of light:(1) kiraRaH;(2) karaH;(3) raSmiH;(4) aMSuH;(5) pAdaH, r. s of the moon: candrapAdAH, V.;(6) mayUKaH, the cold-r. ed (moon): SItamayUKaH, Ki.;(7) marIciH, having streams of r.s (sun): marIcimAlin, H.;(8) dIDitiH, the hot-r. ed (sun): aSItadIDitiH;(9) gaBastiH;(10) usraH.II A fish: *aMSumat (m.).

RAY , s. (Of light) kiraRaH, raSmiH m., marIciH m. f., karaH, aMSuH m., aBISuH m., aBIzuH m., mayUKaH, gaBastiH m. f., dIDitiH m., arkatviw f. (z) pAdaH, usraH, ruciH f., tviziH m., viBA, arccis f., BAnuH m., SipiH m., DfzRiH m., pfzwiH f., vIciH f., GfRiH m., upaDftiH f., pfSniH f., syonaH, syUmaH; ‘ray of the sun,’ sUryyaraSmiH m., sUryyakaraH; ‘of the meridian sun,’ varkarAwaH; ‘of the moon,’ candrapAdaH, SaSipAdaH, SaSikaraH, SaSimayUKaH, somAMSuH m.; ‘pencil or stream of rays,’ karajAlaM, aMSujAlaM.
RAYLESS , a. kiraRahInaH -nA -naM, raSmihInaH &c., nistejAH -jAH -jaH (s).
Raze, v. t. ucCid 7 P, avasad c., nipat c., DvaMs c., vinaS c.; unmUl 10, udDf 1 P; See Erase, also; ‘r(aze) to the ground’ BUmisAtkf 8 U. [Raz]ure, s. ucCedaH, vinASaH, viDvaMsaH.
RAZE: I Subs.: mUlam.II Verb: ucCinatti (Cid, c. 7.): v. To erase.
To RAZE , v. a. (Demolish) ucCid (c. 7. -Cinatti -CettuM), udDf, saMhf, naS or vinaS in caus., DvaMs or viDvaMs in caus., aDaHpat or nipat in caus., lup, vilup, unmUl. See ERASE.
RAZED , p. p. ucCinnaH -nnA -nnaM, unmUlitaH -tA -taM, vinASitaH &c.
Razor, s. kzuraH; ‘r(azor)-case’ kzuraBAMqaM; ‘r(azor) strop’ kzuratejanI.
RAZOR: I For shaving: kzuraH, r. case: kzura- BARqam, H.II. A fish: matsyaviSezaH.
RAZOR , s. kzuraH, KuraH, kzOrI, kzOrayantraM, kzOrikayantraM, vfdDipatraM; ‘the edge of a razor,’ kzuraDArA; ‘sharp as a razor,’ kzuraDArABaH -BA -BaM.
RAZOR-CASE , s. kzuraBARqaM, KuraBARqaM, kzurADAraH, KurAlikaH.
RAZOR-STROP , s. kzuratejanI, KuratejanI, kzuratejanacarmma n. (n).
RAZURE , s. ucCedaH -danaM, vinASaH -SanaM, vyAmarzaH -rzaRaM, lopaH.
Re, as a prefix of verbs, ex. by punar or prati; ‘re-consider’ punaH vicar c.; ‘re-fill’ punaH pUr 10, &c.

RE . This prefix is expressed in Sanskrit by punar or prati, by the former when ‘re’ signifies again, as in the verbs, ‘re-absorb,’ ‘re-appear;’ by the latter when it signifies back, as in the verbs, ‘re-demand,’ ‘repay.’ In cases where the word formed with ‘re’ is not given in this Dictionary, the student must take the simple verb or noun, and use the above prefixes.
RE-: (1) expr. by punar;(2) sometimes by prati-.
To RE-ACT , v. n. pratikf, pratihan (c. 2. -hanti -ntuM), pratyAhan, pratikAraM [Page659-a+ 51] kf, pratikftiM kf, pratikriyAM kf, pratIkAraM kf, pratiGAtaM kf, pratyAGAtaM kf.
RE-ACTING , RE-ACTIVE, part. or a. pratikArakaH -kA -kaM, pratIkArakaH &c., pratikArI -riRI -ri (n), pratiGAtakaH -kA -kaM, pratyAGAtakaH &c.
RE-ACTION , s. pratikriyA, pratikftiH f., pratikAraH, pratIkAraH, pratiGAtaH, pratyAGAtaH, karmmAntaraM; ‘action and reaction,’ AGAtapratyAGAtO m. du.
To RE-ADMIT , v. a. punaH praviS (c. 10. -veSayati -yituM), punar grah.
To RE-ANIMATE , v. a. punar ASvas, (c. 10. -SvAsayati -yituM), pratyASvas, punar jIv (c. 10. jIvayati -yituM) or saMjIv, punarjIvanaM dA, punarjI- vitaM -tAM kf.
To RE-ASSUME v. a. pratyAdA, punar AdA or grah or pratigrah.
RE-ASSURANCE , s. punarASvAsanaM, punarASA, pratyASA, ASvAsanaM.
To RE-ASSURE , v. a. punar ASvas (c. 10. -SvAsayati -yituM), pratyASvas.
RE-ASSURED , p. p. punarASvAsitaH -tA -taM, punarASvastaH -stA -staM, pratyASvasitaH &c.
RE-ASSURING , part. or a. punarASvAsakaH -kA -kaM, pratyASvAsakaH &c., ASvAsakaH &c.
RE-DELIVERY , s. pratyarpaRaM, pratisamarpaRaM, punaHsamarpaRaM, avahAraH.
RE-ECHO: I Trans.:(1) pratiDvanayati (c. of Dvan);(2) pratinAdayati (c. of nad): v. To [Page580] echo.II Intrans.:(1) pratiDvanati (Dvan, c. 1.);(2) pratinadati (nad, c. 1.).
To RE-ENFORCE , s. balADikyaM kf senADikyaM kf. See RE-INFORCE.
To RE-ENTER , v. a. punaH prAvaS (c. 6. -viSati -vezwuM), punar Agam.
To RE-ESTABLISH , v. a. punaH sTA in caus. (sTApayati -yituM) or pratizWA, punaH saMsTA.
To RE-IMBURSE , v. a. pratidA, punar dA, kzatipUraRaM kf, hAnipUraRa kf, nizkftiM dA, apAkf, pratikf, pratyupakf, pariSoDanaM kf.
RE-IMBURSEMENT , s. punardAnaM, pratidAnaM, kzatipUraRaM, hAnipUraRaM, pariSoDanaM
RE-INFECT , a. akftArTaH -rTA -rTaM, asidDArTaH &c., akftArTIBUtaH &c.
To RE-INSTATE , v. a. punaH sTA in caus. (sTApayati -yituM), pratizWA, pratyavasTA, punar avasTA, punar niyuj (c. 10. -yojayati -yituM), punaH sTApanaM kf.
RE-INSTATED , p. p. punaH sTApitaH -tA -taM, punar avasTApitaH &c. or niyojitaH &c.
RE-INSTATEMENT , s. punaHsTApanaM -nA, punaravasTApanaM, pratizWApanaM -nA, pratyavasTApanaM, punarniyogaH, punarniyojanaM.
To RE-ITERATE , v. a. (Say again) punar vad, punaHpunar vad, muhur vad, anuvad, punaruktiM kf, Amreqa. — (Do again) punaH kf, punaHpunaH kf, muhuH kf, vAraM vAraM kf, muhur muhuH kf.
RE-ITERATED , p. p. punaHpunaH kftaH -tA -taM, vAraM vAraM kftaH &c., muhur muhuH kftaH &c., pOnaHpunikaH -kI -kaM, punaruktaH -ktA -ktaM, punaHpunaruktaH &c.
RE-ITERATION , s. punaHpunaHkaraRaM, muhuHkaraRaM, pOnaHpunyaM, punaruktiH f., pOnaruktaM, punarvacanaM, anuvAdaH, AmreqanaM, samaBihAraH.
To RE-PRODUCE , v. a. pratyutpad (c. 10. -pAdayati -srituM), punar utpad or jan.
RE-UNION , s. punaryogaH, punaHsaMyogaH, punaHsaMsargaH, punarmelanaM, punaHsanDiH m., punaHsanDAnaM, pratisamADAnaM, punaHsamAgamaH. — (Assembly) saBA.
To RE-UNITE , v. a. punaH saMyuj, punaH sanDA, punaH saMsfj, punar ekIkf.
RE-UNITED , p. p. punaHsaMyuktaH -ktA -ktaM, punaHsaMsfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, punarmilitaH -tA -taM.

Reach, v. t. Ap 5 P, A-samA-sad c., upA-A-gam 1 P or yA 2 P, prati-pra-pad 4 A; See Arrive. 2 aDigam, aS 5 A, vid 6 U, laB 1 A; See Get. 3 (Hand) pra-sf c., dA 3 U, ucCri 1 U. 4 (Extend to) vyAp, yA, gam; prasf 1 P, vistF-vitan- pass.; oft. ex. by paryaMta, pramARa, in comp.; (in height) mAtra (trI f.), daGna (GnI f.), dvayasa (sI f.); vfttAMtena SravaRavizayaprApiRA (R. xiv. 87) ‘by the account r(each)ing (her) ears’ idaM prAyeRa kalyARABiniveSinaH SrutivizayamApatitameva (Ka. 136) ‘must have probably r(each)ed the ears of’ &c. s. gocaraH, vizayaH, paTin m. 2 prasaraH, paryaMtaH, pramARaM; ‘the utmost r(each)’ pAraH; ‘within the r(each) of’ gamya, grAhya, laBya, vizaya in comp.; DIgamya, hastaprApya, prAMSu-laBya, &c.; ‘beyond the r(each) of’ avizaya, atIta, atiga, vizayAtIta, agocara, agrAhya, agamya in comp.; ati pr.; boDAtIta, nayanAgocara, boDavizaya, atimAnuza, &c. [Reach]ing, a. gAmin, prApin, ga in comp.; better by (v.).

REACH (v. i.): I To extend: q. v.: vistIryate (pass. of stF): v. Also to touch, attain, penetrate.II To stretch the hand: hastaM prasArayati. Ph.: as far as the eye can r.: yAvaccakzuzA darSanIyam. (?.): v. Reach (subs.).

REACH (v. t.): I To stretch: q. v.: prasArayati (c. of sf).II To hand over: q. v.: prApayati (c. of Ap).III To come to: q. v.: AyAti (yA, c. 2.).IV To attain: q. v.: aDigacCati (gam, c. 1.).V To arrive at: q. v.: AsAdayati, sam-, (c. of sad).

REACH (subs.): I In gen.: vizayaH, beyond the r. of even Lakṣmaṇa's arrows: sOmitrerapi patriRAmavizaye, U. iii. 44.;(2) gocaraH, beyond the r. of speech and mind: avANmanasagocara (f. rA), R. x. 15; beyond the r. of the senses: agocara (f. rA), Ki. N.B. Within r., out of r.: often expr. by grAhya, a-, (= comprehensible, not-), gamya, a- (= approachable, not-), etc., within r. of tall men: prAMSulaBya (f. ByA), R. i. 3.II Capacity, influence: q. v.

To REACH , v. a. (Arrive at, attain to) prAp (c. 5. -Apnoti -AptuM), samprAp, avAp, anusamprAp, upasamprAp, Ap, Agam (c. 1. -gacCati -gantuM), aBigam, aDigam, upagam, gam, AyA (c. 2. -yAti -tuM), aBiyA, samAyA, upAyA, upasTA (c. 1. -tizWati -sTAtuM), Asad (c. 10. -sAdayati -yituM), i (c. 2. eti -tuM), aBI, f (c. 1. fcCati, arttuM), Apad, prati- pad, aBipad, aS (c. 5. aSnute, aSituM), upAS, samaS, spfS, AviS. — (Extend to) vyAp, see the next. — (Reach out, stretch out) prasf in caus., pragrah, dA.

To REACH , v. n. (Extend, stretch unto) vyAp (c. 5. -Apnoti -AptuM), vitan in pass., (-tanyate), prasf (c. 1. -sarati -sarttuM), gam (c. 1. gacCati, gantuM) Agam, yA (c. 2. yAti -tuM), AyA, vistF in pass., (-stIryyate) or expressed by paryyanta or pramARa or parimARa in comp. as ‘a staff that reaches to the forehead,’ lalAwaparyyanto daRqaH or lalAwaparyyantaparimARo daRqaH; ‘How far does the wall reach?’ kimparyyantaH or kimpramARaH or kimparimARaH sa prAkAraH; ‘it reaches from the mountain to the sea,’ parvvatAdAraBya samudraparyyantaM vistIryyate. — (Be received) prAp in pass., (-Apyate) prAptaH -ptA -ptaM BU.

REACH , s. (Extend, compass, range) paryyantaH -ntaM, pramARaM, parimARaM, vizayaH, prasaraH, gocaraH -raM; ‘the utmost reach,’ pAraH; ‘the reach of a man,’ pOruzaM, puruzavizayaH; ‘of the eye,’ cakzurvizayaH; ‘of an arrow,’ vARagocaraH -raM; ‘beyond the reach,’ avizayaH -yA -yaM, vizayAtikrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, vizayAtItaH -tA -taM, agamyaH -myA -myaM, atItaH &c., atigaH -gA -gaM, apAraRIyaH -yA -yaM, ati pre- fixed; ‘beyond the reach of the wise,’ DImatAm api avizayaH -yA -yaM; ‘beyond the reach of the understanding,’ budyagamyaH -myA -myaM, budDyagrAhyaH -hyA -hyaM, budDyatItaH -tA -taM, boDAtItaH &c.; ‘beyond the reach of mortals,’ atimAnuzaH -zA -zaM, atimaryaH -rtyA -rtyaM, janAtigaH -gA -gaM; ‘within the reach,’ vizaya in comp., gamyaH -myA -myaM, grAhyaH &c.; ‘within the reach of the under- standing,’ budDigamyaH -myA -myaM; ‘within reach of the hand,’ hastagrAhyaH &c., hastasparSanIyaH -yA -yaM, hastaprAzyaH &c.

REACHED , p. p. (Attained) prAptaH -ptA -ptaM, anuprAptaH &c., AgataH -tA -taM, aDigataH &c., AsAditaH &c., ApannaH -nnA -nnaM, prapannaH &c.; ‘having reached,’ prApya, AsAdya. — (Stretched forth) prasAritaH -tA -taM, ucCritaH &c., dattaH -ttA -ttaM.
REACHING , part. gAmI -minI -mi (n), gaH gA gaM in comp.; as, ‘reaching beyond,’ atigaH -gA -gaM, atItaH -tA -taM or expressed by paryyanta in comp, See under To REACH, v. n.
React, v. i. pratikf 8 U, pratihan 2 P, pratyA-han. [React]ion, s. pratikriyA, pratikAraH; pratiGAtaH, pratyAGAtaH.
REACT: I Lit.: punaH karoti: v. To act.II To resist: q. v.III To exercise a reci- -procal effect: pratikaroti.
REACTION: I Counteraction:(1) pratikriyA; (2) pratikAraH or pratikftiH (rare).II Of two forces: pratiGAtaH.

Read, v. paW 1 P, vac c.; aDi-i 2 A, aDi-gam 1 P; ‘r(ead) out’ nirvac c., Sru c.; ‘r(ead) to oneself’ anuvac c.; ‘r(ead) through’ aSezataH paW, pAraM gam or dfS 1 P, sAdyaMtaM paW, tF 1 P; ‘he who has r(ead) through the Vedas’ SrutipAradfSvan m. vedapAraMgataH; ‘well-r(ead)’ aDItin, (aDItI caturzvAmnA-yezu D. K. ii. 5), svaDIta, vidyAsaMpanna; See Learned. [Read]er, s. vAcakaH, paWitf m., aDyetA, aDIyAnaH, aDyayana-paWana-kft m. [Read]ing, s. pAWaH, paWanaM, aDyayanaM, aDigamanaM, vAcanaM, anuvAcanaM, SrAvaRaM; ‘this is a various r(eading)’ iti vA pAWaH, pAWAMtarametat, pAWa-Bedo'yaM; ‘r(eading) through’ pArAyaRaM, aSezapaWanaM; ‘suspension of r(eading)’ anaDyAyaH, anaDyayanaM.

READ: I Lit.:(1) paWati (paW, c. 1.), we r. in the Kāṭhaka: kAWake paWyate, S.; himself opened and r. it (the letter): svayameva tadunmucya papAWa, K.; some r. lAsikA for vilAsikA: kecidvilAsikAsTAne lAsiketi paWanti, Sah.;(2) vAcayati, nir-, (c. of vac) (= to r. out), taken and r.s: gfhItvA vAcayati, An.II To study:(1) paWati, r. lessons for children: papAWa bAlapAWyAni, V. p. 1. 17. 10.;(2) aDIte (i, c. 2.), (well) r. in the four Vedas: aDItI caturzvAmnAyezu, D.

To READ , v. a. (Peruse) paW (c. 1. paWati -WituM), sampaW, aDI (c. 2. aDIte, aDyetuM, rt. i), aDigam (c. 1. -gacCati -gantuM), aDigA used only in the 3d pret. ātm. (aDyagIzwa), aDyayanaM kf, paWanaM kf. — (Read out or aloud) vac in caus. (vAcayati -yituM), anuvac, Sru in caus. (SrAvayati -yituM), paW, sampaW; ‘he reads the letter,’ patraM vAcayati. — (Read to one's self) svADyAyaM kf. — (Read through) pAram aDI or aDigam, pArAyaRaM kf, sAdyantaM paWanaM kf or aDyayanaM kf; ‘one who reads through,’ pArAyaRikaH, pArAyaRI m. (n); ‘one who has read through the Vedas,’ vedapAragataH; ‘easy to be read,’ supaWanIyaH -yA -yaM, suvAcyaH -cyA -cyaM.
To READ , v. n. (Be studious, practise reading) aDyayanaM kf, paWanaM kf, aByas (c. 4. -asyati -situM), aByAsaM kf, vidyAByAsaM kf.

READ , p. p. or a. aDItaH -tA -taM, paWitaH -tA -taM, nipaWitaH &c., aDi- gataH &c., AgamitaH &c.; ‘one who has read the Vedas,’ aDI- tavedaH. — (Read out) SrAvitaH -tA -taM, vAcitaH &c., anuvAcitaH &c. — (Studied) aByastaH -stA -staM. — (Well-read) svaDItaH -tA -taM, svaDItI -tinI -ti (n), kftADyayanaH -nA -naM, vidyAsampannaH -nnA -nnaM, aByastavidyaH &c.

READ THROUGH: (1) AdyantaM or sampUrRaM or aSezataH paWati;(2) pAraM gacCati (gam, c. 1.). and sim. comp.s., one who has r. t. the Vedas: SrutapAradfSvan (mfn.), R. v. 24.;(3) tarati (tF, c. 1. = to cross: poet), R. iii. 30.
READABLE: (1) pAWya (f. WyA);(2) paWanIyaH (yA, yaM);(3) pAWayogya (f. gyA). and sim. comp.s.
READABLE , a. paWanIyaH -yA -yaM, aDyayanIyaH -yA -yaM, aDyetavyaH -vyA -vyaM, pAWyaH -WyA -WyaM, aDigamyaH -myA -myaM, aDigamanIyaH &c., SrAvyaH &c.

READER: (1) pAWaka (f. WikA), a r. is a religious lecturer: pAWako DarmaBARakaH, T. s.;(2) paWitin (f. nI: rare), a careless r.: haWena paWitI, N. xxii. 154.;(3) vAcaka (f. cikA = one who reads out, such as letter), public r.: pustaka- vAcakaH, C. iii.;(4) aDyetf (f. trI = one who has studied).

READER , s. aDyetA m. (tf), aDyayanI m. (n), aDyAyI m., paWitA m. (tf), pAWakaH, aDyayanakArI m. (n), aDyayanakft m., paWanakArI m., aDIyAnaH; ‘one who has read through,’ pArAyaRikaH, pArA- yaRI m.; ‘public reader,’ pAWakaH.
READILY: I Willingly, cheerfully: q. v.: sotsAham.II Quickly, promptly: q. v.: acireRa.III Easily: q. v.: suKena.

READILY , adv. (Willingly) kAmaM, kAmatas, prakAmaM, icCAtas, paryyAptaM. — (Quickly, promptly) SIGraM, ASu, tvaritaM, avilambena, Jawiti, acireRa, acirAt. — (Easily) suKena, suKaM, anAyAsena, alpAyAsena, nirAyAsaM, sukaraM, ayatnena, ayatnatas, aduHKena, akazwena, akleSena, su or suKa prefixed, see EASILY. — (Without being asked) ayAcitaM.

READINESS: I Willingness, cheerfulness: (1) sotsAhatA;(2) utsukatA or Otsukyam: v. Also promptitude, quickness.II Facility, dexterity: q. v.: lAGavam.III State of preparation:(1) sajjitatA;(2) prastutatA;(3) better by adj.

READINESS , s. (Promptness, quickness) pratyutpannatA, udyuktatA -tvaM, SIGratA, avilambaH, avilambatvaM; ‘of mind or wit,’ pratyutpannamatitvaM. — (Willingness) sakAmatvaM -tA, kAmanatvaM, icCutA, icCukatvaM, paryyA- ptiH f., paryyAptatA. — (State of preparation) sidDatA, sidDiH f., prastutatvaM, udyatatvaM.

READING: I Perusal: paWanam or pAWaH, incessant r. of the Vedas: aSrAntaSrutipAWaH, N.; r. -room: pAWaSAlA.II Studying: aDyayanam, r. with Yājnavalkya: yogISvarAdaDyanam, An.; r., teaching sacrificing: aDyayanamaDyApanaM yajanam, Vas.III. R. out as letters: vAcanam, nir-.IV Scholar- -ship, learning: q. v. V. A. lecture or recital: pAWaH, morning r.: prABAtikapAWaH, C. ii. VI Section, version: pAWaH, an erroneous r.: BramamUlakaH pAWaH, Va. com.

READING , s. (Act of reading, perusal) aDyayanaM, paWanaM, pAWaH -WanaM, aDItiH f., aDyAyaH, aDyayaH, prADyayanaM, nipAWaH, nipaWaH, paWiH f., ni- paWitiH f., aDigamaH -manaM; ‘reading through,’ pArAyaRaM, pAragamanaM; ‘reading to one's self,’ svADyAyaH, svADyayanaM; ‘ignorant of reading and writing,’ alipijYaH. — (Reading out, causing to be heard) vAcanaM, anuvAcanaM, SrAvaRaM. — (Committing to memory upon reading) pAWaH, aByAsaH. — (Suspension of read- ing) anaDyAyaH; ‘day on which it is suspended,’ anaDyAya- divasaH. — (Matter read) aDyayanaM, pAWaH. — (Variation in reading, in a copy or edition) pAWAntaraM, pAWaBedaH, dvirUpapAWaH, dvirUpaH, pAWaH; ‘false reading,’ apapAWaH.
READING-BOOK: pAWyapustakam, and sim. comp.s.
READING-DESK , s. aDyayanamaYcaH, maYcaH, maYcakaH aDyayanaPalakaH -kaM.
READING-ROOM , s. pAWaSAlA, paWanaSAlA, aDyayanaSAlA.
