Ready, a. sajja, sidDa, upakxpta, sajjIBUta-kfta, Ayojita, upasTita; sannadDa; upa-pari-kalpita; ‘to get r(eady)’ sajjIkf 8 U, upa-pari-kxp c., upasTA c., (sabARAsanaM raTamupasTApaya S. 2), sannah 4 P or c.; See Prepare; ‘to be r(eady)’ sajjIBU; (food) sidDa, saMskfta, nizpanna. 2 (Of persons) udyata, sidDa, sajja, sannadDa, udyukta, unmuKa, aBimuKa; oft. by desid.; kUlaM pipatizati ‘is r(eady) to drop down’; ‘r(eady) to go’ gaMtumudyata, gamanodyata, gamanonmuKa; ‘stands r(eady) to burst forth’ BedonmuKaM tizWati (V. 2). 3 pratyutpanna, tIkzRa, kuSAgra, sUkzma, samayopayukta, kAlocita. 4 SIGra, tvarita, druta, avilaMbita, kzipra; kuSala, nipuRa, dakza, pawu, laGu. 5 sukara, sugama, suKa, anAyAsin. 6 utsuka, icCu, sakAma, oft. ex. by manaH or kAma with inf.; ‘r(eady) at hand’ upa-sTita, hastagata, nikawavartin; ‘having r(eady) wit’, ‘r(eady)-witted’ pratyutpannamati-DI-budDi, vidagDa. [Read]ily, adv. kAmaM, kAmataH, prakAmaM, icCApUrvaM, sotsAhaM, sotsukaM. 2 Jawiti, SIGraM, sapadi, acirAt, ASu, avilaMbitaM; See Quickly. 3 suKena, anAyAsena, suKaM, ayatnena, akleSena, suKa in comp. [Read]iness, s. sidDatA, sajjatA, sidDi f. 2 sakAmatvaM, icCA, OtsukyaM, utsAhaH. 3 avilaMbaH, SIGratA, tIkzRatA, sUkzmatA, pratyutpannatA; dakzatA, &c.

READY: I Prepared:(1) sajja (f. jjA) or sajjita (f. tA), be r.: sajjA tAvadBava, Sa. iv.; when the equipments were being got r.: sajjI- kriyamARe sADane, K. ii.;(2) prastuta (f. tA);(3) kalpita, pari-, upa-, (f. tA = only of things).II Willing, cheerful: q. v.:(1) utsuka (f. kA), pari-;(2) utsAhavat (f. tI).III On the point of, about: q. v.:(1) udyata (f. tA); (2) unmuKa (f. KA).IV Quick, prompt: of r. wit: pratyutpannamati (mfn.); of r. apprehension: tIkzRabudDi (mfn.).V Near, short: q. v. Ph.: r. money: waNkaH and an adv. tatkAlam (= at the time) or haste (= in hand).

READY , a. (Prepared, said of things) sajjaH -jjA -jjaM, prastutaH -tA -taM, suprastutaH &c., sajjitaH &c., sajjIBUtaH -tA -taM, sajjIkftaH &c., upakalpitaH &c., parikalpitaH &c., kalpitaH &c., upakxptaH -ptA -ptaM, sidDaH -dDA -dDaM, saMskftaH &c., AyojitaH &c., AyuktaH -ktA -ktaM, upasTitaH -tA -taM; ‘to be ready,’ sajjIBU, sajj in pass. (sajyate), prastutIBU, sidDIBU; ‘to make ready,’ see To PREPARE; ‘go and make ready,’ gatvA sajjIkuru. — (Prepared, said of persons) udyataH -tA -taM, samudyataH &c., aByudyataH &c., udyuktaH -ktA -ktaM, AyuktaH &c., unmuKaH -KA -KaM, aBimuKaH &c., kalyaH -lyA -lyaM; ‘ready to go,’ gantum udyataH -tA -taM, gamanodyataH &c., gamanonmuKaH &c.; ‘ready to burst forth,’ BedonmuKaH &c. or expressed by the desiderative, see on the point of, under POINT, s. — (Prompt) pratyutpannaH -nnA -nnaM, pragalBaH -lBA -lBaM; ‘ready wit,’ pratyutpannamatitvaM; ‘having it,’ pratyutpannamatiH -tiH -ti. — (Quick) SIGraH -GrA -GraM, tvaritaH -tA -taM, drutaH &c., kzipraH -prA -praM, avilambI &c., avilambitaH -tA -taM. — (Easy) suKaH -KA -KaM, sukaraH -rA -raM, sugamaH -mA -maM, laGuH -GuH -GvI -Gu anAyAsI &c. — (Opportune) upayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, samayopayuktaH &c., anukUlaH -lA -laM. — (Expert) kuSalaH -lA -laM, dakzaH -kzA -kzaM, nipuRaH -RA -RaM, pawuH &c. — (At hand, in hand, present) upa- sTitaH -tA -taM, nikawaH -wA -waM, hastagataH -tA -taM, hastasTaH -sTA -sTaM, vidyamAnaH -nA -naM, varttamAnaH &c.; ‘ready money,’ upasTitamudrA; ‘buying with ready money,’ rokaH. — (Willing) sakAmaH -mA -maM, icCuH -cCuH -cCu, icCukaH -kA -kaM, paryyAptaH -ptA -ptaM.
READY , adv. prastutaM, suprastutaM, udyataM, samudyataM, paryyAptaM.
READY-MADE , a. prastutaH -tA -taM, upasTitaH &c., sidDaH -dDA -dDaM.
READY-WITTED , a. pratyutpannamatiH -tiH -ti, vidagDaH -gDA -gDaM, vidagDamatiH &c.

Real, a. satya, avitaTa, vAstavika-tAtvika- (kI f.), akftrima, paramArTa, yaTArTa, taTya, akalpita, akapawa, anvarTa. 2 (Property) sTAvara; ‘to take to be r(eal)’ paramArTena grah 9 U; See Earnest. [Real]ity, s. satyatA, yATArTyaM, satyaM, taTyaM, tattvaM; ‘un-r(eality)’ mi-TyAtvaM, asAratA-tvaM, niHsAratA; ‘a r(eality)’ satyaM, tattvaM, vastu n., ‘in r(eality)’ vastutaH, tattvataH, paramArTataH. [Real]ly, adv. vastutaH, paramArTataH, tattvataH, yaTArTaM, satyameva, nUnaM, Kalu; ‘r(eally) speaking’ vastuvfttena, paramArTadfzwyA, tattvataH, vastutaH. Realize, v. t. sAD c.; pari-, pUr 10, saMpad c.; See Get. 2 pratyakzIkf 8 U, satyAkf, pratyakzaM anuBU 1 P. [Realiz]ation, s. sADanaM, sidDi f., nizpatti f., saMpAdanaM, pUraRaM, pratyakzIkaraRaM; ‘r(ealization) of an object’ kftArTatA, izwasidDiH.

REAL: I True, genuine: q. v.:(1) satyaH (tA, taM), a r. elephant: satyagajaH, K. s. xii. 16.; (2) fta (f. tA: rare), coupling the r. and the unreal: satyAnfte miTunIkftya;(3) prakfta (f. tA) (4) vAstava (f. vA) or vAstavika (f. kI).II In law:(1) sTAvara (f. rA);(2) jaNgametara (f. rA): v. Property.

REAL , a. satyaH -tyA -tyaM, vAstavikaH -kI -kaM, vAstavaH -vI -vaM, taTyaH -TyA -TyaM, yaTArTaH -rTA -rTaM, prakftaH -tA -taM, san -satI -sat (t), sAttvikaH -kI -kaM, tAttvikaH -kI -kaM, avitaTaH -TA -TaM, akftrimaH -mA -maM, akalpitaH -tA -taM, satyakaH -kA -kaM, ftaH -tA -taM, yaTAtaTyaH &c., yaTAtaTaH &c., vidyamAnaH -nA -naM, paramArTaH -rTA -rTaM, pAramArTikaH -kI -kaM, gatAlIkaH -kA -kaM, nirmAyikaH -kI -kaM, akapawaH -wA -waM, nizka- pawaH &c., nizkapawI &c., anvarTaH &c. — (In law) sTAvaraH -rA -raM, jaNgametaraH -rA -raM; ‘real property,’ sTAvaraM, sTAvaraDanaM.
REALGAR: i. e. red orpiment: raktaDAtuH.
REALIST: *yATArTika (f. kI); vyAptijYAnavAdin (f. nI).
REALITY: I The condition:(1) satyatA;(2) prakftatA;(3) vAstavikatA;(4) vyalIkatA;(5) akftrimatA. Ph.: in r.: tattvataH, K. xviii. 27. II Anything real: satyam: v. Real. (1).

REALITY , s. satyatA -tvaM, satyaM, vAstavikatvaM, vAstavatvaM, taTyatA -tvaM, yaTA- rTatA, yATArTyaM, tattvaM, tattvArTaH, sattvaM, sattA, astitvaM, prakftatA -tvaM, prakftiBAvaH, vidyamAnatA, akftrimatA, akalpitatvaM, yATAtaTyaM; ‘a reality,’ sattvaM, tattvaM, satyaM, satyavizayaH, vastu n., asti indec.; ‘in reality,’ vastutas, tattvatas.
REALIZATION: I Accomplishment: q. v.: sADanam.II Of ideas etc.: anuBavaH or anuBUtiH.
REALIZATION , s. sidDiH f., sADanaM, sidDIkaraRaM, satyIkaraRaM, svIkaraRaM, AtmIyakaraRaM, AtmasAtkaraRaM; ‘of an object,’ arTasidDiH f., PalasidDiH f.
REALIZE: I To accomplish: q. v.: sADayati (c. of sAD).II To feel vividly: anuBavati, as if r. ing the pain: vedanAmanuBavanniva, Ki. iii. 69.III To convert into real property: expr. by circumlo.
To REALIZE , v. a. sAD (c. 10. sADayati -yituM), sidDIkf, sidDiM kf sidDatAM kf or jan, satyIkf, svIkf, AtmIyaM -yAM kf, AtmasAtkf; ‘to realize any object,’ arTasidDiM kf, PalasidDiM kf.
REALIZED , p. p. sidDaH -dDA -dDaM, sidDIkftaH -tA -taM, sidDArTaH -rTA -rTaM.
REALLY: I In truth:(1) yaTArTataH;(2) paramA- rTataH;(3) satyam.II In reality:(1) tattvataH; (2) vastutaH (= in fact), S. p. b. 1. 69.
REALLY , adv. vastutas, arTatas, tattvatas, paramArTatas, yaTArTaM, yaTArTatas, satyaM, taTyaM, yaTAtaTyaM; ‘the star appears higher than it really is,’ nakzatraM vAstavasTAnAd uccadeSe dfSyate.
Realm, s. rAzwraM, vizayaH, rAjyaM; See Kingdom. 2 pra-, deSaH, lokaH, BuvanaM; ‘r(ealm)s below the earth’ aDolokaH, pAtAlalokaH, aDo-BuvanaM.
REALM: rAzwram: v. Kingdom, province.
REALM , s. rAzwraM, rAjyaM, vizayaH lokaH. See KINGDOM.
REAM: of paper: *rImam; potram.
REAM , s. rImAKyo leKanapatrARAM mudrANkanapatrARAM vA mahABAraH.
Re-animate, v. t. punar-jIv c. 2 See Refresh.
REANIMATE: I To cheer, gladden: q. v.: pratyASvAsayati (c. of Svas).II To revive:(1) punar ujjIvayati (c. of jIv);(2) saYjIvayati.
REANIMATED , p. p. punarASvAsitaH -tA -taM, ASvAsitaH &c., pratyASvAsitaH &c., pratyASvastaH -stA -staM, punarjIvitaH &c., saMjIvitaH &c.
REANIMATION , s. punarASvAsanaM, pratyASvAsanaM, punarjIvanadAnaM, saMjIvanaM.

Reap, v. t. (Corn) lU 9 U, Cid 7 P, ava-kft 6 P, do 4 P; CittvA saMgrah 9 P or saM-ci 5 U. 2 laB 1 A, prAp 5 P, Buj 7 A, Baj 1 A, anuBU 1 P, A-svAd 1 A; svakarma-PalaBAg Bavatu (Mu. 1) ‘let him r(eap) the fruit of his own deeds’; ‘as you sow, so you r(eap)’ yaTA bIjaM taTAMkuraH. [Reap]er, s. lavitf m., lavakaH, SasyacCid, SasyasaMgrahin saMcayin m. [Reap]ing, s. lavanaM, CedanaM, saMgrahaH, saMcayaH; ‘r(eaping)-hook’ lavitraM, dAtraM, SasyakartanI.

REAP: I Lit.:(1) lunAti (lU, c. 9.), r. ing machine: lavitram;(2) Cinatti (Cid, c. 7.), time for r. ing crops: SasyaCedanakAlaH, Nil. on Mah. ii. 5. 64.: Also to gather.II To get: q. v.: laBate (laB, c. 1.): v. To sow.

To REAP , v. a. (Cut with a sickle) lU (c. 9. lunAti, lavituM), lavitreRa Cid (c. 7. Cinatti, CettuM) or avaCid or kft (c. 6. kfntati, karttituM) or avakft or do or dA (c. 4. dyati c. 2. dAti -tuM) or nirdo or Co (c. 4. Cayati, CAtuM) or avaCo, lavanaM kf. — (Gather) saMgrah (c. 9. -gfhlAti -grahItuM), ci (c. 5. -cinoti, cetuM), avaci, saMci; ‘to reap corn,’ SasyasaMgrahaM kf; ‘to reap the fruits of any thing,’ PalasidDiM kf, PalaprAptiM kf, PalaM Buj or anuBU or prAp, PalaBojI -jinI &c., BU; ‘of an action,’ karmmaPalaM Buj or prAp.
REAPED , p. p. lUnaH -nA -naM, lavitraCinnaH -nnA -nnaM, karttitaH -tA -taM, CAtaH &c., avaCAtaH &c., CitaH &c., dAtaH &c., nirdAtaH &c., ditaH -tA -taM, saMgfhItaH &c., saYcitaH -tA -taM.
REAPER: I The man:(1) lAvaka (f. vikA) or lAva (f. vA); flower-r.: puzpalAvI, Me. i. 27.; (2) SasyacCedaka (f. dikA: of crops.).II A machine: lavitram.

REAPER , s. lavakaH, lavitA m. (tf), SasyalavakaH, CedakaH, CettA m. (ttf), SasyaCedakaH, SasyaCid m., SasyaCettA m. (ttf), nirdAtA m., SasyasaMgrahI m. (n), SasyasaMgrAhakaH, SasyasaYcayI m., lavanakArI m., kArttakaH.
REAPING , s. lavanaM, lAvaH, aBilAvaH, SasyalAvaH, lavaH, SasyaCedaH -danaM, CedanaM, SasyasaMgrahaH, SasyakarttanaM, dAtiH f., dAnaM.
REAPING-HOOK: lavitram: v. Sickle.
REAPING-HOOK , s. lavitraM, lavARakaM, lavAkaH, SasyakarttanI, SasyaCedanI.
REAPPEAR: punar AvirBavati etc.: v. To appear, again.

Rear, s. pfzWaM, pArzRiH, pfzWaBAgaH-deSaH; ‘in the r(ear)’ pfzWataH, paScAt; ‘we having fallen in the r(ear)’ asmAsvavahInezu (S. 2). 2 (Of an army) pfzWaM, pArzRiH, pratyAsA(sa)-raH, sEnyapfzWaM, pari-prati-grahaH, patadgrahaH; ‘one who attacks the r(ear)’ pArzRigrAhaH; ‘r(ear)-guard’ pArzRitraM. v. t. ut-sTA c. (utTA-payati). unnI 1 P, ucCri 1 U, udyam 1 A, unnam c. (unnamayati); See Raise. 2 pari-saM-vfD c., pari-, puz 1, 4, 9 P or c., vi-nI 1 P, prati-pari-yA c. (pAlayati), saMBf 3 U; See Nourish. [Rear]ing, s. utTApanaM, ucCrayaH, unnamanaM, 2 pozaRaM, BaraRaM, saMvarDanaM, pAlanaM, vinayaH.

REAR (subs.): I The back: q. v.: pfzWam.II Of an army:(1) pfzWam, on the r.: anupfzWam, Ka. xix. 36.;(2) pArzRiH, with the r. guarded: SudDapArzRiH, R. iv. 26. Ph: or shall put the r. in disorder and attack the front with the pick [Page575] of the army: paScAdvA saNkulIkftya hanyAt sAreRa pUrvataH, Ka. xviii. 58.

REAR (v.): I To bring up, nourish: q. v.: varDayati (c. of vfD).II To raise, lift up: q. v.: utTApayati (c. of sTA).III To rise on hind legs: shall strike on the eyes when (a horse) r. s.: hanyAnnetramArge durutTitam, M. n. on Si. v. 10.; r. ing; puruza kam, Williams.

REAR , s. (That which is behind) paScAdBAgaH, pAScAtyaBAgaH, paScimaBAgaH, pArzRiH m., pfzWaM; ‘in the rear,’ paScAt, pfzwatas, paScAdBAge; ‘in our rear,’ asmatpaScAt. — (Rear of an army) pArzRiH m. f., vyUhapA- rzRiH m., pratyAsAraH, pratyAsaraH, pratisaraH, sannayaH, sarjjanaM; ‘a body of forces in the rear,’ pArzRitraM; ‘an enemy in the rear,’ pA- rzRigrAhaH; ‘bringing up the rear,’ pratigfhya.

To REAR , v. a. (Raise to maturity, bring up) puz (c. 10. poza- yati -yituM), paripuz, pAl (c. 10. pAlayati -yituM), pratipAl, Bf (c. 3. biBartti, c. 1. Barati, BarttuM), samBf, saMvfD (c. 10. -varDayati -yituM), vfD, parivfD, vinI (c. 1. -nayati -netuM), anunI, pozaRaM kf, pAlanaM kf, pA- lanapozaRaM kf. — (Raise, lift) utTA in caus. (-TApayati -yituM, rt. sTA), unnam (c. 10. -namayati -yituM), ucCri (c. 1. -Crayati -yituM, rt. Sri), uttul, unnI, udyam, udDf, udvfh, uccIkf, UrdDvIkf.
To REAR , v. n. (As a horse) aSvavat puruzakaM kf.
REAR-GUARD , s. pArzRitraM, vyUhapArzRitraM, sEnyapArzRitraM.

REARED , p. p. (Brought up) pozitaH -tA -taM, puzwaH -zwA -zwaM, pAlitaH -tA -taM, pratipAlitaH &c., BftaH &c., samBftaH &c., saMvarDitaH -tA -taM, parivarDitaH &c., varDitaH &c. — (Raised, elevated) utTApitaH -tA -taM, ucCritaH &c., aByucCritaH &c., udyataH &c.
REARING , s. (Educating) pozaRaM, pozaH, pAlanaM, BaraRaM, saMvarDanaM, pari- varDanaM, varDanaM. — (Elevating) utTApanaM, unnayanaM, unnamanaM, ucCritiH f. — (Of a horse) puruzakaM.

Reason, s. (The faculty) mati-budDi-vyutpatti f., vivekaH, prajYA, vicAraRASakti f., jYAnaM, cicCaktiH, tarka-anumAna-SaktiH; See Intellect. 2 upapatti f., yukti f., yuktatA, nyAyaH, nyAyyatA, sAmaMjasyaM, yATArTyaM, hetuH. 3 hetuH, kAraRaM, nimittaM, prayojanaM, (gen. with loc.); ‘for what r(eason)’ kinnimittaM, kutaH, kena hetunA, kasya hetoH, kimarTaM; ‘for this r(eason)’ ataH, anena hetunA, asmAtkAraRAt; ‘by reason of’ ex. by abl. or instr.; hetunA, kAra-RAt, arTaM; ‘for some r(eason)’ kenApi kAraRena. v. i. vi-, tark 10, Uh 1 A, anu-mA 3 A, 2 P, yuktivAdena sAD c. or pratipad c.; vicar c.; See Argue, ‘r(eason)ing faculty’ vivekaH, DISakti f., vicAraH. [Reason]able, a. Rational, q. v. 2 yukta, nyAyya, ucita, yogya, upapanna, yaTArTa, nyAya-yukti-sidDa, yaTAnyAya; See Just also; ‘to be r(easonable)’ Gaw 1 A, upapad 4 A, yuj pass. 3 pari-, mita, niyata, anatimahat, nAtiguru, maryAdAnatikrAMta. [Reason]ableness, s. nyAyyatA, OcityaM, yukti f., upapattiH, yATArTyaM, yuktatA; parimitatA, anatikramaH, &c. [Reason]ably, adv. nyAyataH, yuktipUrvaM, sopapattikaM, yuktitaH, yaTAnyAyaM, yaTocitaM, nyAyAnusAreRa. 2 pari-mitaM, niyataM. [Reason]er, s. tArkikaH, tarkin m., nEyA-yikaH, hetuvAdin m., Uhin m., vicArakaH, nyAyavid m. [Reason]ing, s. vi-, tarkaH, vicAraH, UhaH-hanaM, aDyAhAraH, UhApohaH, nyAyaH, anumAnaM; ‘art of r(easoning)’ tarkaSAstraM-vidyA. [Reason]less, a. nirbudDi, jYAnahIna. 2 ahetuka, nizkAraRa, animitta.

REASON (subs.): I The intellect;(1) vivekaH (good r.);(2) budDiH: v. Intellect;(3) matiH: v. Mind;(4) prajYA: v. Wisdom;(5) vyutpattiH, of men endowed with r.: vyutpattimatAM puruzARAm, S. II. Ground, motive, cause:(1) hetuH, speaks of its r. s in the (following) Sūtras: atra hetUnAha sUtrEH, S. p. b.;(2) kAraRam: v. Cause;(3) nimittam (= ground), say for what r.: kaTaya kasminnimitte. Ph.: (a) for what r.: kinnimittam: v. Why; (b) without r.: akAraRam, nirarTakam, (c) by r. of by abl.: v. Account of, on; (d) for that, this r.: tadarTam, etadarTam or tannimittam, etannimittam; (e) for some r. (lit. with some object): kenApi kAmena, Ku. i. 57.III Argu- -ment:(1) hetuH, crushing the opponent's r. s: parapakzahetUnunmaTya, S.;(2) yuktiH, to prove some doctrine by mere r. s.: kevalABiryu ktiBiH kaYcit sidDAntaM sADayitum, S.;(3) upapattiH, r. s have been forcibly adduced: upapattirudAhftA balAt, Ki. ii. 28.IV Justice, propriety: q. v.
REASON (v.): (1) tarkayati, vi-, (tark, c. 10.); (2) vicArayati (c. of car): v. To argue, debate. Ph.: r. ing faculty: DISaktiH: v. Reason (I).

REASON , s. (Reasoning faculty, understanding) budDiH f., DIH f., manas n., matiH f., cittaM, cetas n., jYAnaM, cicCaktiH f., cetanA, cit f., tarkaSaktiH f., anumAnaSaktiH f., AkalanaSaktiH f., mAnasaM, prajYA, upala- bDiH f., SemuzI, manIzA, svAntaM. — (Right, justice) yuktatA, yuktiH f., [Page660-b+ 51] upapattiH f., upapannatA, yogyatA, yaTAyogyatA, yaTArTatA, yATArTyaM, nyAyaH, nyAyyatA, sAmaYjasyaM, samyaktvaM; ‘with reason,’ yuktaM, yaTAyuktaM, yaTAyogyaM, nyAyatas, samyak. — (Cause, ground) hetuH m., kAraRaM, nimittaM -ttakaM, nidAnaM, nibanDanaM, prayojanaM; ‘by reason of,’ hetoH hetO, nimitte, kfte, arTaM, kAraRAt, or expressed simply by the abl. c.; as, ‘by reason of anger,’ kopAt; ‘for this reason,’ anena hetunA, ataHkAraRAt, tasya hetoH, tadarTaM; ‘for some reason,’ kenApi kAraRena; ‘for what reason,’ kena hetunA, kasya hetoH, kimarTaM; ‘without reason,’ kAraRena vinA, hetunA vinA, akasmAt; ‘He assigns a reason,’ sa hetum Aha; ‘the reason of their barrenness is the absence of seed,’ tezAM banDyatve vIjABAvaH kAraRaM; ‘the reason of the indistinct- ness is as follows,’ aTa aspazwatve hetur ucyate.

To REASON , v. n. (Deduce inferences, exercise the faculty of reason) tark (c. 10. tarkayati -yituM), vitark, anutark, anumA (c. 2. -mAti -tuM), Uh (c. 1. Uhate -hituM), apoh, proh, vitarkaM kf, vitarkaRaM kf, UhaM kf, UhApohaM kf, arTApattiM kf, sidDAsidDavicAraM kf. — (Argue, debate) vivad, visaMvad, vicar, vitark, vAdAnuvAdaM kf.
REASONABLE: I Rational: q. v.: vivekin (f. nI).II Just, proper: q. v.: nyAyya (f. yyA).III Moderate: q. v.: parimita (f. tA).

REASONABLE , a. (Having the faculty of reason), see RATIONAL. — (Conformable to reason, just, right) yuktaH -ktA -ktaM, upayuktaH &c., yogyaH -gyA -gyaM, yaTAyuktaH &c., yaTAyogyaH &c., yaTocitaH -tA -taM, yuktimAn -matI -mat (t), sayuktikaH -kA -kaM, upapannaH -nnA -nnaM, upapattimAn -matI &c., yaTArTaH -rTA -rTaM, nyAyyaH -yyA -yyaM, nyAyAnu- sArI -riRI -ri (n), nyAyAnurUpaH -pA -paM, nyAyasidDaH -dDA -dDaM, yukti- sidDaH &c., yaTAnyAyaH -yA -yaM, tAttvikaH -kI -kaM. — (Moderate) parimitaH -tA -taM, mitaH &c., saparimARaH -RA -RaM, niyataH -tA -taM, samaH -mA -maM. — (Acting or thinking rationally), samadarSI &c., nyAyakArI &c., nyAyavfttiH -ttiH -tti, samavfttiH &c.
REASONABLENESS: I Rationality:(1) vivekitA;(2) DISaktiH: v. Also reason (I). II Justness, propriety: q. v.: nyAyyatA.III Moderation: parimitatA.

REASONABLENESS , s. (Faculty of reason) jYAnaSaktiH f., cicCaktiH f., tarkaSaktiH. — (Conformity to reason), yuktatA, upayuktatA, yogyatA, yaTApogyatA, yuktiH f., upapattiH f., upapannatA, yaTArTatA, yATArTyaM, nyAyya- tA -tvaM, nyAyasidDatA, yuktisidDatA, OcityaM, samBavaH, samBUtiH f., samBA- vanA. — (Moderation) parimitatA, samatA, anatikramaH, maryyAdAnatikramaH.
REASONABLY: I Justly:(1) nyAyataH;(2) yuktitaH;(3) sopapatti.II Moderately: (I) parimitam;(2) better by adj.
REASONABLY , adv. (Conformably with reason) yuktaM, yaTAyogyaM, upapannaM, nyAyatas, nyAyAnusAreRa, nyAyAnurUpeRa, yaTAnyAyaM, yaTArTaM, yaTocitaM, guktitas. — (Moderately) parimitaM, niyataM, samaM.
REASONER: (1) tarkin (f. RI);(2) tArkika (f. kI);(3) tarkakArin (f. RI).
REASONER , s. tarkI m. (n), tArkikaH, vitarkI m., UhI m. (n), prohI m., prohaH, vicArakaH, tarkakArI m., vitarkakArI, nEyAyikaH, nyAyavid m., pratipAdakaH. See LOGICIAN.
REASONING (subs.): (1) tarkaH;(2) vicAraH, “vicAramUQaH”, R. ii. 47.

REASONING , s. tarkaH, vitarkaH -rkaRaM, vicAraH, UhaH -hanaM, prohaH, aByUhaH, UhApohaH, apohaH, -hanaM, vyUhaH, nirUhaH, nyAyaH, anumAnaM, aGyAhAraH, arTApattiH f., anumAnoktiH f.; ‘art or science of reasoning,’ tarkavidyA, tarkaSAstraM, tarkajYAnaM, vicAravidyA; ‘chain of reasoning,’ tarkaprabanDaH, anumAnaprabanDaH; ‘skill in it,’ tArkikyaM.
REASONLESS , a. (Destitute of reason) budDihInaH -nA -naM, nirbudDiH -dDiH -dDi, jYAnahInaH &c. — (Without a reason) ahetukaH -kA -kaM, nirhetukaH &c., nizkAraRaH -RA -RaM.
REASSUME: punaH pari-gfhRAti (grah, c. 9.): v. To assume, take.
REASSURE: punar ASvAsayati (c. of Svas): v. To assure, cheer.
REBATE: laGayati: v. To lessen, diminish.

Rebel, s. rAjadrohin m., rAjApaTyakArI, rAjadruh m., rAjapratiroDI. v. i. (rAjYe) druh 4 P, aBidruh (with acc.); vyutTA 1 A, pratiyuD 4 A, rAjaSAsanaM laMG 1 A, 10 or atikram 1 U, 4 P. [Rebel]lion, s. prakfti-kopaH, rAjABidrohaH, prajA or prakfti-kzoBaH or prakopaH, AjYA or SAsana-atikramaH or ullaMGanaM. [Rebel]lious, n. rAjadruh, rAjApaTyakArin, rAjABidrohin, &c.; See Mutiny, [Mutin]eer, &c.
REBEL (subs.): (1) rAjadrohin (f. RI);(2) rAjABidrohin (f. RI);(3) rAjadviz (mfn.);(4) rAjadruh (mfn.);(5) rAjjApaTyakArin (f. RI), Mu.; and sim. comp.s.
REBEL (v.): rAjYe druhyati (druh, c. 4.) or rAjAnamaBi- druhyati or rAjadrohaM karoti or rAjYA viroDaM karoti and sim. expr. s.

REBEL , s. rAjadrohI m. (n), rAjABidrohI m., rAjayuDvA m. (n), rAjapra- tiyoDI m., svAmidrohI m., rAjaSAsanAtAgI m., rAjapratIpaH, rAja- pratIpakArI m., rAjaviparItakArI m., rAjaviroDI m., rAjavirudDA- cArI m., kalahakArI m., avaSaH, pratIpaH, viparItakArI m.

To REBEL , v. n. rAjadrohaM kf, rAjAnam aBidruh (c. 4. -druhyati -drohituM droQuM) rAjABidrohaM kf, svAmidrohaM kf, rAjaSAsanatyAgaM kf, rAjaSAsa- nalaMGanaM kf, rAjAnaM pratiyuD (c. 4. -yuDyate -yodDaM), prakftikzoBaM kf, prakftikalahaM kf.
REBELLION: (1) rAjadrohaH;(2) rAjABidrohaH;(3) rAjaviroDaH.
REBELLION , s. rAjadrohaH, rAjABidrohaH, rAjayudDaM, rAjaSAsanatyAgaH, svAmi- drohaH, prakftikzoBaH, prakftikalahaH, rAjaSAsanalaMGanaM, rAjopadravaH, upadravaH, prakopaH, kopaH, KaRqanaM.
REBELLIOUS: rAjavirudDa (f. dDA): v. Rebel (subs.).

REBELLIOUS , a. rAjadrohI -hiRI -hi (n), rAjABidrohI &c., rAja- Druk m. f. n. (druh), rAjapraDruk, drohI &c., praDruk m. f. n., rAjapratIpaH -pA -paM, rAjapratIpakArI &c., pratIpaH -pA -paM, rAjaviparItakArI &c., viparItakArI &c., upadravI &c., rAjopadravI &c., rAjaSAsanalaMGI &c., sajaSAsanatyAgI &c., laMGitaSAsanaH -nA -naM, ullaMGitaSAsanaH &c., rAjAvaSaH -SA -SaM. See REBEL. s.
Rebound, v. t. utpat 1 P, (pAtitopi karAGAtErutpatatyeva kaMdukaH); utplu 1 A, pratihan pass. s. utpatanaM, pratiGAtaH.
REBOUND: I Verb: pratiGAtAd utpatati, (pat, c. 1.), and made the (ball) r. by striking; praSAntaM taM prahArErudapAtayat, D. vi.II Subs.: expr. by circumlo.
To REBOUND , v. n. utpat (c. 1. -patati -tituM), parApat, utplu (c. 1. -plavate -plotuM), pratihan in pass. (-hanyate).
REBOUND , s. utpatanaM, parApatanaM, pratiGAtaH, pratihatiH f., pratihananaM, utplutaM.
Rebuff, v. t. prati-parA-han 2 P; parABU 1 P, parAji 1 A. 2 pratyAdiS 6 P, nirAkf 8 U. s. pratiGAtaH; parABavaH; parAjayaH; pratyAdeSaH; See Repulse.
REBUFF (subs.): I Repulsion:(1) pratyAdeSaH; (2) avaDIraRA.II Repercussion:(1) pratiGAtaH; (2) pratihatiH.
REBUFF (v.): (1) pratyAdiSati (diS, c. 6.);(2) avaDIrayati (avaDIr, c. 10.).
REBUFF , s. (Repercussion) pratiGAtaH, pratihatiH f., pratihananaM, parAhananaM. (Check, defeat) parABavaH, parAjayaH, apajayaH. — (Refusal) pratyAdeSaH, avaDIraRA.
To REBUFF , v. a. pratihan (c. 2. -hanti -ntuM), parAhan, pratyAdiS, ava- DIr, parAji.
REBUILD: prativi-daDAti or -Datte (DA, c. 3.): v. To build, again.
To REBUILD v. a. punar nirmA or vinirmA (c. 2. -mAti -tuM), punarnirmARaM kf.
REBUILT , p. p. punarnirmmitaH -tA -taM, punarvinirmmitaH &c., punarnicitaH &c.
REBUKABLE , a. nindanIyaH -yA -yaM, nindyaH -ndyA -ndyaM, nindArhaH -rhA -rhaM.
Rebuke, v. t. niMd 1 P, upAlaB, 1 A, AkruS 1 P, garh 1, 10 A, nir-, Barts 10 A. s. niMdA, upAlaMBaH, nirBartsanA, AkroSaH; vAgdaMqaH; See Censure.
REBUKE: I Verb: Bartsayati, -te (Barts, c. 10.): v. To censure, reproach.II Subs.: BartsanA: v. Censure, reproach.

To REBUKE , v. a. nind (c. 1. nindati -ndituM), pratinind, vinind, upA- laB (c. 1. -laBate -labDuM), Barts (c. 10. Bartsayate -yituM), pratyAdiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM), garh c. 1. garhate -rhituM), vigarh, gup in des., (jugupsate -psituM), AkruS c. 1. -kroSati -krozwuM), kzip (c. 6. kzipati kzeptuM), tarj (c. 10. tarjayati -yituM).
REBUKE , s. nindA -ndanaM, parIvAdaH, parivAdaH, BartsanaM, BartsanavAkyaM, pari- BAzaRaM, upAlamBaH, pratyAdeSaH, AkroSaH, upakroSaH, jugupsA, vAgdaRqaH, SabdadaRqaH.
REBUKER: BartsanAkArin (f. RI): v. Censurer.
REBUKER , s. nindakaH, parivAdakaH, pratyAdeSakaH, BartsanakArI m. (n).
REBUS: no equiv.: *citraprahelikA.
REBUS , s. pravahliH f., -hlikA. See RIDDLE.
REBUT: (1) nirasyati (as, c. 4.):(2) pratikzi- pati (kzip, c. 6.), D. s. iii.
To REBUT , v. a. niras (c. 4. -asyati -asituM), upamardaM kf, KaRq. See REPEL.

Recall, v. t. pratyAhve 1 P, ni-pratyA-vft c., pratyAnI 1 P, pratyAdA 3 A. 2 (To mind) smf 1 P, anuciMt 10. 3 vi-lup 6 P or c., nivft c., pratyAnI, KaMq 10, niras 4 U, pra-tyAdiS 6 P. s. pratyAhvAnaM, nivartanaM, pratyAnayanaM, pratyAdAnaM.
RECALL (v.): I Lit.: pratyAhvayati (hve, c. 1.): v. To call, back.II To remember: q. v.: smarati (smf, c. 1.).III To annul, revoke: q. v.: nivartayati (c. of vft).
RECALL (subs.): (1) pratyAhvAnam (= calling back);(2) nivartanam (= revocation).

To RECALL , v. a. (Call back, take back, bring back) punar AdA (c. 3. -dadAti -dAtuM) pratyAdA, punar AnI (c. 1. -nayati -netuM), pratyAnI, pratyAnayanaM kf, pratyAvarttanaM kf, pratinivarttanaM kf, nivarttanaM kf, nivft or pratinivft or pratyAvft in caus. — (Revoke, annul) nivft (c. 10. varttayati -yituM), pratyAdiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM), KaRq (c. 10. KaRqayati yituM), nivarttanaM kf, KaRqanaM kf, lopaM kf. — (Call to mind) smf (c. 1. smarati, smarttuM), anusmf, amucint, anubuD.
RECALL , s. pratyAnayanaM, punarAnayanaM, pratyAvarttanaM, pratyAdAnaM, punarAdAnaM.

RECALLED , p. p. (Called back, brought back) pratyAnItaH -tA -taM, [Page661-b+ 51] punarAnItaH &c., pratyAvarttitaH &c., pratinivarttitaH &c., nivarttitaH &c., — (Revoked, annulled) nivarttitaH -tA -taM, KaRqitaH &c., pratyAdizwaH -zwA -zwaM, luptaH -ptA -ptaM. — (Called to mind) smftaH -tA -taM, udbudDaH -dDA -dDaM, udgrAhitaH -tA -taM.
Recant, v. t. pratyAKyA 2 P, pratyAdiS 6 P, KaMq 10, vilup c. [Recant]ation, s. pratyAKyAnaM, pratyAdeSaH, KaMqanaM, vilopaH, viparIta-vAdaH.
RECANT: pratyAKyAti (KyA, c. 2): v. To deny, retract.
To RECANT , v. a. pUrvvoktaviparItaM vad (c. 1. vadati -dituM), pUrvvoditaviparItaM vad, pUrvvoktaKaRqanaM kf, pUrvvoktalopaM kf, anuSayaM kf, vipratipattiM kf.
RECANTATION: pratyAKyAnam: v. Contradiction, retraction.
RECANTATION , s. pUrvvoktaviparItavAdaH, pUrvvoditaviparItavAdaH, pUrvvoktaKaRqa- kavAdaH, pUrvvoktaKaRqanaM, pUrvvoktalopaH, anuSayaH, vipratipattiH f.
Recapitulate, v. t. saMkzepataH kaT 10 or varR 10, vizayasAraM varR, BAzaRasAraM anuvad 1 P. [Recapitulat]ion, s. saMkzepataH varRanaM, saMkzepeRa anuvAdaH; (of past events) siMhAvalokanaM.
RECAPITULATE: saMkzepataH kaTayati, (kaT, c. 10.): v. To relate.

To RECAPITULATE v. a. saMkzepataH punaH kaT (c. 10. kaTayati -yituM), vAkya- sAram anuvad (c. 1. -vadati -dituM) or anuvac (c. 2. -vakti -ktuM), saMkzepeRa vAkyaM punar vad, sAravizayAn punar vad or anuvad, sAraprakaraRAni punarvad or punarvac.
RECAPITULATED , p. p. saMkzepataH punaruktaH -ktA -ktaM or punaHkaTitaH -tA -taM.
RECAPITULATION: saMkzepataH punaruktiH and sim. expr. s.
RECAPITULATION , s. saMkzepataH punaHkaTanaM or punaruktiH f. or punarvacanaM or anuvAdaH, saMkzepeRAnuvAdaH, pUrvvakaTitAnuvAdaH, saMkzepataH punarvyAKyA.
Recede, v. i. apasf 1 P, apA-parA-ni-vft 1 A, apasfp 1 P, apakram 1 U, 4 P, apa-gam 1 P, apa-yA-i 2 P. [Reced]ing, s. apasaraRaM, apakramaRaM, apayAnaM, &c.
RECEDE: I To move back, retreat: q. v.: apasarati (sf, c. 1.).II To desist: q. v.: nivartate (vft, c. 1.).

To RECEDE , v. a. apakram (c. 1. -krAmati -kramituM), vyapakram, apasf (c. 1. -sarati -sarttuM), nivft (c. 1. -varttate -rttituM), parAvft, apAvft, pratinivft, avasTA (c. 1. -tizWate -sTAtuM), palAy (c. 1. palAyate -yituM, rt. i), vipalAy, apasfp (c. 1. -sarpati -sraptuM), apagam (c. 1. -gacCati -gantuM), apayA (c. 2. -yAti -tuM), ape (c. 2. apEti -tuM, rt. i).
RECEIPT: I Receiving:(1) AdAnam;(2) pari (prati) grahaH, -Ram;(3) by verb.II Income: q. v.: AyaH.III Note of acknowledge- -ment: *pratigrahaRam.

RECEIPT , s. (Act of receiving) AdAnaM, grahaRaM, pratigrahaRaM, prAptiH f., avAptiH f., prApaRaM, labDiH f., upalabDiH f. — (Income) AyaH, AgamaH, udayaH, AdAyaH, utpannaM, prAptiH f., lABaH, labDiH f., PalaM; ‘of money or property,’ DanAgamaH, DanodayaH, arTAgamaH, PalodayaH; ‘receipts of trade,’ paRAyA; ‘receipt and expendi- ture,’ AyavyayO m. du. — (Note of ackowledgmentacknowledgment) muktipatraM, vigaRanapatraM, pratyayakAripatraM, pratyayakArI leKaH, pratyayakAriRI, svIkA- rapatraM, svIkaraRapatraM, svIkAraleKaH, sarasvatIdAnaM, AdAnapatraM, AgamapatraM, AgamaleKyaM. — (Recipe, prescription of ingredients) sADanaleKaH, yogaleKaH, saMyogaleKaH, leKaH, leKyaM.
RECEIVABLE: (1) Adeya (f. yA), sam-;(2) pari- (prati) grahaRIya (f. yA);(3) pari (prati) grAhya (f. hyA).

RECEIVABLE , a. AdeyaH -yA -yaM, upAdeyaH &c., grAhyaH -hyA -hyaM, grahaRIyaH -yA -yaM, grahItavyaH -vyA -vyaM, pratigrAhyaH &c., prApaRIyaH -yA -yaM, prApyaH -pyA -pyaM, laByaH -ByA -ByaM, upalaByaH &c., svIkaraRIyaH &c.

Receive, v. t. A-dA 3 A, prati-iz 6 P, grah 9 U, prati-pari-°, prati-A-pad 4 A, svIkf 8 U, aMgIkf. 2 Ap 5 P, aDigam 1 P, laB 1 A; See Get. 3 praviS c.; See Admit. 4 (A guest) pratyud-gam-vraj 1 P, pratyud-i-yA 2 P, saM-man c., saM-BU c., satkf, A 6 A, svAgataM vad 1 P or vyAhf 1 P. 5 A-DA 3 U, grah, A-dA, Df 1 P, 10. [Receiv]ed, a. Adatta, Atta, gfhIta, labDa, satkfta, saMBAvita, &c. 2 lokaprasidDa, aBimata, pra-calita, aByupeta; ‘r(eceived) practice’ lokAcAraH, pracalito vyavahAraH; ‘r(eceived) doctrine’ AmnAyaH, saMpradAyaH. [Receiv]er, Recipient, s. pratigrAhakaH, pari-prati-grAhin, grahItf, AdAtf all m. pratIcCakaH. 2 ASayaH, ADAraH, BAjanaM, ni-A-DAnaM. Receipt, s. AdAnaM, grahaRaM, prApti f. 2 AyaH, lABaH, udayaH, PalaM, AgamaH, AdAyaH. 3 svIkArapatraM, aByupagamaleKaH, pratigrahapatraM-leKaH; ‘or the creditor shall give a r(eceipt) in his own hand’ DanI vopagataM dadyAt (DanaM) svahastaparicihnitaM (Y. ii. 93). 4 (Recipe) yogaH, kalpaH, saMskAraleKaH. Receptacle, s. ADAraH, A-ni-DAnaM, BAjanaM, ASayaH, pAtraM, niDiH, ASrayaH, AspadaM, padaM; ‘r(eceptacle) of bile’ pittASayaH; AmASayaH, &c. Reception, s. pari-prati-grahaH, AdAnaM, grahaRaM, svI-aMgI-kAraH, praveSaH-SanaM. 2 saMBAvanA, upacAraH, pratyudgamaH, satkAraH, saMmAnaH, AdaraH.
RECEIVE: (1) samAsAdayati (c. of sad): v. To get gain;(2) parigfhRAti (grah, c. 9.): v. To accept.

To RECEIVE , v. a. (Take, get, obtain) AdA (c. 3. -dadAti -datte -dAtuM), upAdA, grah (c. 9. gfhlAti, gfhlIte, grahItuM), pratigrah, aBigrah, sampragrah, saMgrah, Ap (c. 5. Apnoti, AptuM), prAp, avAp, laB (c. 1. laBate, labDuM), upalaB, pratIz (c. 6. -icCati -ezituM), pratipad (c. 4. -padyate -pattuM), Apad, aBipad, samApad. — (Allow) svIkf, aNgIkf, grah, anugrah. — (Admit) praviS in caus., AviS, grah. — (Hold, contain) DA, ADA, AdA. — (Entertain a guest) satkf, AtiTyaM kf, satkAraM kf, samBU (c. 10. -BAvayati -yituM), samBAvanaM kf, AdaraM kf, svAgataM kf or vad.

RECEIVED , p. p. or a. (Taken, accepted, obtained) AdattaH -ttA -ttaM, AttaH &c., upAdattaH &c., upAttaH &c., gfhItaH -tA -taM, pratigfhItaH &c., prAptaH -ptA -ptaM, AptaH &c., avAptaH &c., labDaH -bDA -bDaM, upalabDaH &c.; ‘received as wages,’ BftirUpeRa labDaH &c. — (Generally admitted) lokaprasidDaH -dDA -dDaM, sarvvatra pracalaH -lA -laM; ‘received practice,’ lokavyavahAraH; ‘received doctrine,’ AmnAyaH; ‘received expression,’ AptavacanaM, AptoktiH f.

RECEIVER: I Lit.:(1) prati(pari)grahItf (f. trI); (2) prati (pari) grAhaka (f. hikA);(3) prati(pari)grAhin (f. RI), r. s (of stolen property): pratigrAhiRaH, Mit.II A reservoir:(1) ADAraH;(2) BAjanam.

RECEIVER , s. grAhI m. (n), grAhakaH, grahItA m. (tf), pratigrahItA m., pratigrAhakaH, AdAtA m. (tf), AdAyI m. (n), upAdAtA m., upAdAyI m., [Page662-a+ 51] pratigrahakft m., AptA m. (ptf), prApakaH, labDA m. (bDf), upalabDA m., pratIcCakaH. — (Vessel for receiving) ADAraH, dravADAraH, ADAnaM, BAjanaM, pAtraM, dravASayaH, ASayaH.
RECENCY , s. navatA -tvaM, nUtanatvaM, aBinavatA, pratyagratA. See NEWNESS.
Recent, a. nava, aBinava, nUtana, pratyagra, acira, aprAcIna, adIrGakAlIna. [Recent]ly, adv. See Lately.
RECENT: aBinava (f. vA): v. New, fresh.

RECENT , a. nUtanaH -nA -nI -naM, navaH -vA -vaM, aBinavaH &c., navInaH -nA -naM, pratinavaH &c., nUtnaH -tnA -tnaM, pratyagraH -grA -graM, idAnIntanaH -nI -naM, aDunAtanaH &c., avvocInaH -nA -naM, aprAcInaH &c., sadyaskaH -skA -skaM, sadyaskAlInaH -nA -naM, ADunikaH -kI -kaM, aciraH -rA -raM, avya- vahitadIrGakAlaH -lA -laM.
RECENTLY , adv. nUtanakAle, nUtanaM, avyavahitadIrGakAle. See LATELY.
RECEPTACLE: (1) ADAraH;(2) niDAnam or niDiH (in fig. senses);(3) BAjanam (= vessel);(4) ASrayaH (= refuge).

RECEPTACLE , s. ADAraH, pAtraM, BAjanaM, ASayaH, niDAnaM, niDiH m., ADAnaM, ASrayaH, aDiSrayaH, aDikaraRaM, garBaH, AspadaM, vinyAsaH, vIjaM. The word ASayaH is especially used in composition thus, ‘the receptacle of the blood,’ raktASayaH; ‘of the food,’ annA- SayaH, AmASayaH; ‘of bile,’ pittASayaH.
RECEPTION: I Receiving: pari (prati) grahaH.II Entertainment:(1) perh. parigrahaH;(2) upa- cAraH (courteous r.), C.;(3) samBAvanA (= hon- -ouring), Ki.

RECEPTION , s. (Receiving) AdAnaM, upAdAnaM, grahaRaM, pratigrahaH -haRaM, ADAnaM. — (Admission) svIkAraH, svIkaraRaM, aNgIkAraH, aNgIkaraRaM, grahaRaM. — (Entrance) praveSanaM, praveSaH. — (Entertainment) satkAraH, satkriyA, saMgrahaH, samBAvanaM -nA; ‘of friends,’ mitrasaMgrahaH.
RECEPTIVE: r. of: -grAhin (f. RI): v. To receive.
Recess, s. viviktaM sTAnaM, nigUQasTAnaM; koRaH, niBfta-gupta-sTAnaM. 2 nirvfti-viSrAma-sTAnaM, ArAmaH. 3 virAmaH, viSrAMti f., kzaRaH, kArya-tyAgaH-nivftti f., viSrAmaH, viSrAmakAlaH.
RECESS: I Place of retirement:(1) SaraRam (rare);(2) viviktam (= secluded spot);(3) vilam (= hole);(4) viSrAmasTAnam and sim. comp.s.II Holidays: viSrAmakAlaH and sim. comp.s.

RECESS , s. (In a wall, &c., secret or retired spot) garBaH, koRaH, viviktasTAnaM, gUQasTAnaM, niBftasTAnaM, guptasTAnaM. — (Place of retire- ment) parAvarttanasTAnaM, apAvarttanasTAnaM, apakramaRasTAnaM. — (Remission of business) virAmaH, viratiH f., viSrAmaH, nivfttiH f., kAryyanivfttiH f., kAryyatyAgaH, virAmakAlaH, viSrAmakAlaH.
RECESSION , s. apakramaRaM, apAvarttanaM, parAvarttanaM, parAvfttiH f., apasaraRaM.
RECIPE: r. s for making food: annAnAM sADanaprakAraH, Bha.
RECIPIENT: grAhaka (f. hikA): v. Receiver.
RECIPIENT , s. (Person) grAhI m. (n), AdAtA m. (tf), grAhakaH, ASrayitA m. See RECEIVER. — (Thing) ADAraH, ASayaH, pAtraM. See RECEIVER.

Reciprocal, a. anyonya, paraspara, itaretara, vyatikara, miTaH, in comp.; oft. ex. by vyati pr.; See Mutual. 2 anyonyAnugAmin, parasparAnuvartin, anupUrva. [Reciprocal]ly, adv. parasparaM, itaretaraM, miTaH. [Reciprocal]ness, Reciprocity, s. parasparatA, vyatikaraH, vyatizaMgaH, vyati(tI)hAraH, vinimayaH, pari(rI)vartaH. Reciprocate, v. t. parasparaM parivft c., vinime 1 A, vyatihf 1 P; ‘to r(eciprocate) assistance’ pratyupakf 8 U; See Exchange. [Reciprocat]ion, s. vinimayaH, vyatihAraH, parivartaH.
RECIPROCAL: I Mutual: q. v.: paraspara- in comp.II Mutually interchangeable:(1) parasparAnuvartin (f. nI);(2) anyonyapraguRa (f. RA), Mal. i. 17.; and sim. comp.s.

RECIPROCAL , a. parasparaH -rA -raM, anyonyaH -nyA -nyaM, itaretaraH -rA -raM, vyatikaraH -rA -raM, itaretarASrayaH -yA -yaM, miTas in comp. The sense of “reciprocal” is often expressed by the prepositions vi, A, ava, ati, prati, pra in combination. See MUTUAL. — (Alternate, in reciprocal succession) parasparAnugAmI -minI -mi (n), parasparAnuvarttI &c., anyonyAnugAmI &c., anyonyAnuvarttI &c.
RECIPROCALLY: (1) parasparam;(2) anyo'nyam; (3) itaretaram.
RECIPROCALLY , adv. parasparaM -rAM, anyonyaM, itaretaraM, miTas, uBayatas, paraspara in comp; ‘mutually connected,’ vyatizaktaH -ktA -ktaM, miTaHsambadDaH -dDA -dDaM, see MUTUALLY.

To RECIPROCATE , v. a. parasparaM parivft (c. 10. -varttayati yituM), paraspara- parivarttanaM kf, anyonyaM parivft, vyatikaraM kf, vyatihf, vyatihAraM kf; ‘to reciprocate gifts,’ parasparaM dAnapratidAnaM kf; ‘to reciprocate assistance,’ pratyupakAra kf; ‘civilities,’ pratipUjanaM kf, see To INTERCHANGE.
RECIPROCATION , s. parivarttanaM, vinimayaH, vyatikaraH, vyatihAraH. See INTERCHANGE.
RECIPROCITY: (1) vyatikaraH, pleasure of r.: vyati- karasuKam, Sa. iii. 27.;(2) vinimayaH (= inter- -change);(3) by adv.: v. Mutual.
RECIPROCITY , RECIPROCALNESS, s. parasparatA, anyonyatA -tvaM, vyatikaraH, vyatihAraH, vyatIhAraH, parasparayogaH, itaretarayogaH, parasparaBAvaH, vyatizaNgaH. See MUTUALITY.
RECITAL, RECITATION: I Reading:(1) pAWaH, pra-;(2) vAcanam, nir- (as of letters).II Narration, description: q. v.: varRanA.

RECITAL , RECITATION, s. (Repetition, reading out in a loud voice) paWanaM, pAWaH anuvAdaH, SrAvaRaM, vAcanaM, anuvAcanaM, ulleKaH -KanaM, uccAraRaM, udGozaH -zaRaM, udgAraH. — (Narration) kaTanaM, AKyAnaM, [Page662-b+ 51] upakaTanaM, KyAyanaM, varRanaM.
RECITATIVE , s. (Cadence introductory to a song) tenaH.

Recite, v. t. paW 1 P, udIr c., uccar c., anuvad 1 P, udAhf 1 P, ud-gF 6 P. 2 varR 10, kaT 10, AKyA 2 P, vyAhf; See Tell. [Recit]al, [Recit]ation, s. paWanaM, udAhAraH, udgAraH, uccAraRaM, anuvAdaH. 2 kaTanaM, AKyAnaM, varRanaM. [Recit]er, s. paWakaH, anuvAdakaH, uccArakaH, AKyAyakaH.
RECITE: (1) vAcayati (c. of vac): v. To read; (2) kaTayati (kaT, c. 10.): v. To narrate.

To RECITE , v. a. (Repeat, read out) paW (c. 1. paWati -WituM), sampE, anuvad (c. 1. -vadati -dituM), Sru (c. 10. SrAvayati -yituM), ASru, saMSru, vac (c. 10. vAcayati -yituM), anuvac, uccar (c. 10. -cArayati -yituM), udGuz (c. 10. -Gozayati -yituM), paWanaM kf. — (Narrate) kaT (c. 10. kaTayati -yituM), AKyA (c. 2. -KyAti -tuM), Sru in caus., varR, anuvarR, vyAhf, udAhf, nirUp, vivaraRaM kf, vft in caus.
RECITED , p. p. (Repeated, read out) paWitaH -tA -taM, SrAvitaH &c.; ‘being recited,’ paWyamAnaH -nA -naM. — (Narrated) kaTitaH -tA -taM, AKyAtaH &c., varRitaH &c.
RECITER: (1) vAcaka (f. cikA = reader);(2) kaTaka (f. TikA = narrator).
RECITER , s. paWakaH, paWitA m. (tf), paWanakArI m. (n), SrAvakaH, SrAva- yitA m. (tf), anuvAdakaH, uccArakaH, uccAraRakArI m., kaTakaH, upakaTakaH, AKyAyakaH.

Reck, v. i. gaR 10, avekz 1 A; See Care. [Reck]less, a. pramatta, anavahita, asAvaDAna, nirape(ve)kza, sAhasin. [Reck]lessly, adv. asAvaDAnaM, pramAdena, niHSaMkaM, avicArya. [Reck]lessness, s. pramAdaH, anavaDAnaM, sAhasaM, sAhasaSIlatA.
To RECK , v. a. and n. avekz, avaDA, man, pratiman. See To CARE.
RECKLESS: pramatta (f. ttA): v. Careless, rash.
RECKLESS , a. anavaDAnaH -nA -naM, asAvaDAnaH &c., anavahitaH -tA -taM, pramattaH -ttA -ttaM, sAhasikaH -kI -kaM, sAhasI -sinI -si (n), nira- pekzaH -kzA -kzaM, niSSaNkaH -NkA -NkaM.
RECKLESSLY: (1) by adj.;(2) pramAdAt: v. Carelessly.
RECKLESSLY , adv. anavahitaM, sAhasena -sAt, sAhasabudDyA, pramattaM.
RECKLESSNESS: (1) pramattatA;(2) pramAdaH: v. Carelessness.
RECKLESSNESS , s. sAhasaM, sAhasaSIlatA, sAhasabudDiH f., anavaDAnaM -natA, asAvaDAnatA, pramAdyaM, pramattatA.

Reckon, v. t. gaR 10, pari-saM-KyA 2 P, kal 10 (kalayati). 2 man 4 A, gaR, BU c. v. i. vi-, tark 10, anu-mA 3 A, 2 P, Uh 1 A. 2 man, buD 1 P; See Consider; ‘r(eckon) upon’ A-ava-laMb 1 A, ASri 1 U, viSvas 2 P; ‘r(eckon) with’ deyaM pariSuD c. [Reckon]er, s. gaRakaH, gaRayitf m. [Reckon]ing, s. gaRanaM-nA, pari-, saMKyAnaM. 2 gaRanApatraM. 3 vyayapatraM. 4 mAnaM, gaRanA, mAtrA.

RECKON: I To count:(1) gaRayati, pari-, vi-, pra-, (gaR, c. 10.), then all his excellencies might be r. ed: gaReyaniHSezaguRo'pi sa syAt, N. iii. 40.; (2) saMKyAti pari-, pra-, (KyA, c. 2.), cannot be r. ed: na SakyaM parisaMKyAtum, Mah.II To think, consider: q. v.:(1) gaRayati, vi-, pari-, r. your success is not distant: adUravartinImAtmanaH sidDiM vigaRaya, R. i. 87.;(2) manyate (man, c. 4.).III To r. on or upon i. e. to depend on:(1) gaRayati, vi-, pari-;(2) samBAvayati (c. of BU): v. To believe, rely on.IV To r. for, i. e. to be answerable for: expr. with dAyin (f. nI: ?).

To RECKON , v. a. (Count, number) gaR (c. 10. gaRayati -yituM), vigaR, parigaR, pragaR, saMKpA (c. 2. -KyAti -tuM), parisaMKyA, sampariKyA, kal (c. 10. kalayati -yituM), gaRanAM kf. — (Esteem, account) man, samman, pratiman, gaR, vigaR,

To RECKON , v. n. (Reason with one's self, conclude) vitark (c. 10. -tarkayati -yituM), tark, anumA, Uh, avagam. — (Consider, think) man (c. 4. manyate, mantuM), tark, vitark, buD. — (Reckon on, count upon) avalamb, samAlamb, saMSri, samASri, upASri, viSvas. — (Reckon with, settle accounts) vigaRanaM kf, sidDiM kf, fRasidDiM kf.
RECKONED , p. p. gaRitaH -tA -taM, vigaRitaH &c., parigaRitaH &c., mataH &c., saMKyAtaH &c.
RECKONER: (1) gaRaka (f. RikA);(2) gaRayitf (f. trI);(3) saMKyAtf (f. trI). Ph.: ready r.: *sahajagaRakaH.
RECKONER , s. gaRakaH, vigaRakaH, gaRayitA m. (tf), guRakaH, guRakAraH

RECKONING (subs.): I The act:(1) gaRanam, -nA, vi-, pari-;(2) saMKyAnam, pari-, pra-.II Thinking, consideration:(1) gaRanA;(2) [Page577] vitarkaH (= guess).III A statement: perh. gaRanA(na)patram. Ph.: dead r. (at sea): perh. gatigaRanA.

RECKONING , s. (The act) gaRanaM -nA, vigaRanaM -nA, saMKyAnaM, parisaMKyAnaM, guRanaM. — (Statement of account with another) vigaRanapatraM, vigaRanApatraM, gaRanapatraM, vigaRanaleKaH, saMKyApatraM. — (Statement of expense) vyapatraM, vyayaleKaH. — (Esteem, estimation) mAnaM, sammAnaM, matiH f.

Reclaim, v. t. satpaTe-sanmArge-pravft c. or nI 1 P, or niyuj 7 A, 10, durmArgAt-duzkarmaRaH-ni-parA-vft c. or viram c., durmArgaM tyaj c. 2 kfziyogya- a. kf 8 U. 3 punaH laB 1 A or grah 9 U. Reclamation, s. pApanivftti f., durmArgaparAvartanaM; kupaTatyAgaH. 2 punargrahaRaM; punarlABaH-avApti f.

RECLAIM: I Lit.: v. To claim, again.II To effect reformation:(1) SoDayati, pari-, (c. of SuD);(2) satpaTe pravartayati (c. of vft).III Of lands: perh. SoDayati, pari-, vi-;(2) kfzi- yogyaM (f. gyAM) karoti.

To RECLAIM , v. a. (Demand to have restored, take back) mahyam etat pratidAtavyam iti jYApayitvA grah (c. 9. gfhlAti, grahItuM), mahyam etat pratyarpaRIyam ityuktvA grah, punar laB, pratilaB, punar grah, punaH prAp, punaH svIkf. — (Call back from error, vice, &c.) pApAt or duzkarmmaRo nivft (c. 10. -varttayati -yituM) or vinivft or parAvft or viram (c. 10. -ramayati -yituM), aDarmmAd nivarttayitvA Darmme pravft in caus. or prayuj in caus. or niyuj in caus., pApAd vipratisf in caus. (-sArayati -yituM), vipratisAraM jan. — (Make fit for culti- vation) kfziyogyaM -gyAM kf.

RECLAIMABLE , a. (From vice) pApanivarttayitavyaH -vyA -vyaM, pApani- varttanIyaH -yA -yaM, duzkarmmaparAvarttanIyaH &c., kukarmmanivarttanIyaH, Sakyavi- pratisAraH -rA -raM, upadeSAvAhyaH -hyA -hyaM. — (That may be taken again) pratilaByaH -ByA -ByaM, punar laByaH &c. or grahaRIyaH -yA -yaM.

RECLAIMED , p. p. (Taken again) punar gfhItaH -tA -taM, punaH prAptaH -ptA -ptaM, pratilabDaH -bDA -bDaM, punar labDaH &c. — (From vice) pApani- varttitaH -tA -taM, nivfttapApaH -pA -paM, jAtavipratisAraH -rA -raM.
RECLAMATION: I Recovery: q. v.II In gen.: SoDanam, vi-, pari-.

RECLAMATION , s. (Taking again) punargrahaRaM, punarlabDiH f., punarupala- bDiH f., pratilabDiH, punaHprAptiH f., pratyudDaraRaM. — (From vice, &c.) pApa- nivarttanaM, duzkarmmanivarttanaM, duzkarmmaparAvarttanaM.

Recline, v. t. ava-A-laMb 1 A, samA-A-Sri 1 U. 2 SI 2 A, saM-upa-viS 6 P, As 2 A; aDyAs, aDi-SI (with acc.), nizad 1 P, viSram 4 P; See Lie. v. t. ni-DA 3 U, upa-DA; See Lean. [Reclin]ing, a. AlaMbin, ASrita, avalaMbita. 2 A-ava-namra; SayAna; saMvizwa, nizaRRa.

RECLINE: I To lean back:(1) ava-lambate, A-, samA-, (lamb, c. 1.);(2) ASrayati, upA-, samA-, (Sri, c. 1.), where other women have not r.d: anupASrito'nyayA, U. i. 37.;(3) expr. with words meaning pillow: q. v.II To lie, rest: q. v.: viSrAmyati (Sram, c. 4.).

To RECLINE , v. n. (Lean) avalamb (c. 1. -lambate -mbituM), samAlamb, saMSri (c. 1. -Srayati -te -yituM), samASri, upASri, nilI (c. 4. -lIyate -letuM), avalambanaM kf. — (Lie) SI (c. 2. Sete, SayituM), aDiSI, saMviS (c. 6. -viSati -vezwuM), upaviS, nizad (c. 6. -zIdati -zattuM), pat (c. 1. patati- -tituM). See To LIE, v. n.
RECLINING, RECLINED (adj.): (1) namra (f. mrA), ava-, pra- (= bent, low);(2) SayAna (f. nA = lying down);(3) by verb.

RECLINING , part. (Leaning) avalambI -mbinI -mbi (n), avalambitaH -tA -taM, saMSritaH -tA -taM, samASritaH &c., upASritaH &c., nilInaH -nA -naM, nilIyamAnaH -nA -naM. — (Lying) SayAnaH -nA -naM, SayaH -yA -yaM, SayitaH -tA -taM, saMvizwaH -zwA -zwaM, upavizwaH &c., nizaRaH -RA -RaM, ni- zIdan -dantI -dat (t), patitaH -tA -taM; ‘on a bed,’ Sayane saMvizwaH &c.

Recluse, s. parivrAj m., saMnyAsin m., vi-vikta-ekAMta-vAsin-sevin m., vAnaprasTaH; ‘female r(ecluse)’ parivrAjikA. a. vivikta, nirjana See Lonely. [Recluse]ness, s. AraRya-kavrataM, viviktasevA, parivrajanaM.
RECLUSE: I Subs.: sannyAsin (f. nI): v. Hermit. II Adj.: vivikta (f. ktA): v. Solitary, lonely.
RECLUSE , s. viviktavAsI m. (n), viviktasevI m., ekAntavAsI m., ekAntasevI m., vijanavAsI m., ekAkI m., araRyavAsI m., vanavAsI m., vanasTaH, vAnaprasTaH.
RECLUSENESS , s. viviktatA, viviktavAsitvaM, viviktasevA, vAnaprasTatvaM.
RECOGNITION: aBijYAnam, prati-; (2) aBijYA, prati-; (3) saMvittiH, prati- (rare).
RECOGNITION , s. pratyaBijYAnaM, pratyaBijYA, aBijYAnaM, anujYAnaM, svIkAraH, svIkaraRaM, aNgIkAraH, aNgIkaraRaM, smaraRaM, smftiH f., anusmftiH f., saMvittiH f.
RECOGNIZABLE: (1) aBijYeyaH (yA, yaM), prati-; (2) saMvedya (f. dyA) or -danIya (f. yA), prati- (rare).
RECOGNIZANCE: no equiv.: darSanANgIkAraH (comp. prAtiBAvyANgIkAraH, Mit.).
RECOGNIZANCE , s. pratijYApatraM -trakaM, pratiBUH m., prAtiBAvyaM, darSanapratiBUH m., darSanaprAtiBAvyaM, pAriBAvyaM, lagnakaH, prAtyayikapatraM -trakaM, aNgIkArapatraM.

Recognize, v. t. prati-, aBijYA 9 U, saMvid 2 A, paricCid 7 P, anu-smf 1 P, niSci 5 U, nirRI 1 P; ‘not properly r(ecogniz)ed’ na tattvataH paricCinnaH. 2 svI-aMgI-kf 8 U, prati-pad 4 A, aByupagam 1 P, aByupa-i 2 P, grah 9 U, pramARIkf. [Recogniz]ance, s. aMgIkArapatraM, prAtiBAvyaM, darSanaprAtiBAvyaM (‘r(ecognizance) bond’); ‘entered into a r(ecognizance) bond’ darSanapratiBuvaM dadO. Recognition, s. prati-, aBijYA-jYAnaM, paricCedaH. 2 aMgI-svI-kAraH, pratipatti f., aByupagamaH.

RECOGNIZE: I To see likeness or identity: (1) aBijAnAti, prati-, saM- (jYA, c. 9.), I am r. d by him: pratyaBijYAtAsmyetena, Ra. iii.; anaBijYeyapUrvA- kAraM tamahamadrAkzam, K.;(2) saMvitte, prati-, (vid, c. 2.), when even my parents do not r. me: pita- rAvapi yAvanmAM na pratisaMvidAte, D. iii.II To ac- -knowledge: q. v.: aNgIkaroti.

To RECOGNIZE , v. a. (Recover the knowledge of, recollect) pratya- BijYA (c. 9. -jAnAti -nIte -jYAtuM), aBijYA, samaBijYA, anujYA, anusmf (c. 1. -smarati -smarttuM), pratismf, smf, parici (c. 5. -cinoti -cetuM), niSci, pratyaBijYAnaM kf. — (Admit, acknowledge) svIkf, aNgIkf, aNgI- kAraM kf, anugrah, grah.
RECOGNIZED , p. p. pratyaBijYAtaH -tA -taM, aBijYAtaH &c., anujYAtaH &c., anusmftaH &c., paricitaH &c., praNgIkftaH &c., svIkftaH &c. — (Generally acknowledged) lokasidDaH -dDA -dDaM, prasidDaH &c.
Recoil, v. i. vi-parA-vft 1 A, vyapavft; parA-pat 1 P. s. (akasmAt) parA-vi-vartaH-rtanaM, parApatanaM.
RECOIL: I Verb:(1) parAvartate (vft, c. 1.); (2) vyapavartate, Mah. i. 19.: v. Also to fall back.II Subs.:(1) parAvfttiH;(2) parAvartaH, nam;(3) vyapavfttiH or -vartanam.
To RECOIL , v. n. parApat (c. 1. -patati -tituM), vivft (c. 1. -varttate -rttituM), parAvft, akasmAt parAvft, paScAt plu or pat or gam.
RECOIL , s. akasmAd vivarttaH -rttanaM or parAvarttaH -rttanaM, parApatanaM.
To RECOIL , v. n. (As in fear) vikamp (c. 1. -kampate -mpituM). FINIS.
RECOILING , part. akasmAd vivarttamAnaH -nA -naM or parApatan -tantI -tat (t).

Recollect, v. t. smf 1 P, anu-saM-°, anu-DyE 1 P, anuciMt 10, anubuD 4 A, 1 P. 2 (Oneself) DEryaM avazwaMB 9 P or avalaMb 1 A; See Courage; ‘he tries to r(ecollect)’ su-smUrzate. [Recollect]ion, s. smfti f., smaraRaM, anu-ciMtanaM, anuboDaH; ‘I am a sage having r(ecollection) of my former birth’ ahaM jAtismaraH muniH (Ka. 355).

RECOLLECT: I To remember: q. v.: smarati (smf, c. 1.).II To r. one's self, not to forget one's self: DEryaM na muYcati (muc, c. 6.); vikftiM na gacCati (gam, c. 1.); and sim. expr. s. III To recognize: q. v.

To RECOLLECT , v. a. smf (c. 1. smarati, smarttuM), anusmf, pratismf, saMsmf, anusaMsmf, aBisaMsmf, anucint (c. 10. -cintayati -yituM), samanucint, anubuD (c. 4. -buDyate -bodDuM), anuDyE (c. 1. -DyAyati -DyAtuM), upaDyE. — (Recognise) pratyaBijYA, aBijYA. — (Try to recollect) smf in des. (susmUrzate -rzituM); ‘trying to recollect,’ susmUrzamARaH -RA -RaM. — (Recollect one's self) DEryyaM kf, DEryyAvalambanaM kf.
RECOLLECTED , p. p. smftaH -tA -taM, anusmftaH &c., anucintitaH &c., pratyaBijYAtaH &c.
RECOLLECTION: smftiH: v. Remembrance.

RECOLLECTION , s. smftiH f., smaraRaM, saMsmftiH f., saMsmaraRaM, anusmftiH f., smaraH, smarttftvaM, smaratvaM, anucintA, anuboDaH, ADyAnaM, ADyA, DyAnaM, saMskAraH, cintA; ‘of a former birth,’ jAtismaratvaM; ‘proximate cause of recollection,’ smftihetuH m.

sanskrit.word: तदहं विदधे तव स्तवं दमयंत्याः सविधे
sanskrit.iast: tadahaṃ vidadhe tava stavaṃ damayaṃtyāḥ savidhe

sanskrit.slp1: ayaM bAlako BavatAvekzaRIya iti me vinatiH
sanskrit.word: अयं बालको भवतावेक्षणीय इति मे विनतिः
sanskrit.iast: ayaṃ bālako bhavatāvekṣaṇīya iti me vinatiḥ

sanskrit.slp1: taM snigDadfzwyA paSyatu BavAn iti me prArTanA
sanskrit.word: तं स्निग्धदृष्ट्या पश्यतु भवान् इति मे प्रार्थना
sanskrit.iast: taṃ snigdhadṛṣṭyā paśyatu bhavān iti me prārthanā

details.body: Recommend, v. t. SlAG 1 A, praSas 1 P; See Praise. 2 nikzip 6 P, saM-, f c. (arpayati); See Entrust; stutipUrvakaM ni-kzip or upanyas 4 U; or gen. ex. by stu 2 U, praSas; guRAn praSaMs; ‘I r(ecommend) this boy to your care’ ayaM bAlako BavatAvekzaRIya iti me vinatiH; ‘I shall, therefore, r(ecommend) you to Damayanti’ tadahaM vidaDe tava stavaM damayaMtyAH saviDe (N. ii. 47); ‘I beg to r(ecommend) him to your kind notice’ tasmin kfpAdfzwiM pAtayatu or taM snigDadfzwyA paSyatu BavAn iti me prArTanA. [Recommend]ation, s. guRavarRanaM-praSaMsA-kIrtanaM. 2 guRavarRanapatraM, praSaM-sAleKaH. 3 upadeSaH, anuSAsanaM, praboDanaM. 4 anugraha-prasAda-kAraRaM, AdarahetuH ‘a fair face is a good r(ecommendation)’ AkftiviSezezvAdaraH padaM karoti (M. 1). [Recommend]atory, a. guRa-SlAGin, praSaMsAkarin.

RECOMMEND: I To commend, praise: q. v.: praSaMsati (SaMs, c. 1.).II To another's favourable notice: expr. by circumlo., I will r. you to Damayanti in such a way: tadahaM vidaDe tava stavaM daBayantyAH saviDe taTA taTA, N. ii. 47.III To advise: q. v.: upadiSati (diS, c. 6.). IV To commit, entrust: q. v.

To RECOMMEND , v. a. (Commend to another's kindtreatmentkind treatment by favourable representations) guRavarRanena or yaSovarRanena amukajanam [Page663-b+ 51] AdaraRIyamiti or anugrahArhamiti or satkArArhamiti buD (c. 10. voDa- yati -yituM) or uddiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezWuM), guRapraSaMsApUrvvam amukajanaM satkArArham iti boDayitvA parasmin samf in caus. (-arpayati -yitu), sadguRaSAlitvAd amukaH satkaraRIya iti or anugrahaRIya iti jYApayitvA parasmin samf, guRavarRanena parArTam anugrahaM prArT. — (Commend, praise) praSaMs (c. 1. -SaMsati -situM), aBipraSaMs, SlAG, kFt, anukFt, varR, guRavarRanaM kf. — (Advise) upadiS, AdiS. — (Commit) samf or f in caus., see COMMIT.
RECOMMENDATION: I In gen.:(1) praSaMsA (= praise);(2) guRavarRanA (= description of good qualities); and sim. expr. s.II Advice: q. v.: upadeSaH.

RECOMMENDATION , s. (Favourable mention) guRapraSaMsA -sanaM, guRa- vyAKyA, guRavarRanaM, guRavAdaH, yaSovarRanaM, guRakIrttanaM, guRavarRanena parA- rTam anugrahaprArTanaM. — (Letter of recommendation) guRavarRanapatraM, guRavyAKyApatraM, guRapraSaMsApatraM, varRanapatraM, yaSovarRanapatraM, praSaMsApatraM, sAhityapatraM. — (That which recommends) prasAdakAraRaM, anugraha- kAraRaM, anurAgakAraRaM, prasAdahetuH m., kfpAkAraRaM, kfpAhetuH m. — (Advice) upadeSaH, AdeSaH, preraRA.
RECOMMENDATORY: (1) guRaKyApaka (f. pikA); (2) guRolleKin (f. nI);(3) guRaSaMsin (f. nI); and sim. comp.s.
RECOMMENDATORY , a. guRapraSaMsakaH -kA -kaM, guRavarRakaH &c., guRapra- kASakaH &c.
RECOMMENDED , p. p. praSaMsitaH -tA -taM, praSastaH -stA -staM, SlAGitaH -tA -taM.

Recompense, v. t. SuD c., nizkf 8 U, pratikf, pratiPalaM-nizkftiM dA 3 U, nistF c.; (kzatiM) pUr 10 &c.; See Compensate. 2 mUlyaM dA; parituz c., saM-BU c.; See Reward. s. pAritozikaM, mUlyaM, pratiPalaM; nizkfti f., nistAraH, SudDi f., niryAtanaM, pratikriyA; pUraRaM; kzatinizkftiH-pUraRaM.
RECOMPENSE (v.): I For some loss:(1) SoDayati, pari-, prati-, (c. of SuD);(2) kzatipUraRaM karoti.II To pay: q. v.: mUlyaM dadAti.
RECOMPENSE (subs.): (1) nizkftiH: v. Com- -pensation;(2) mUlyam (= price);(3) pAri- tozikam (= reward).

To RECOMPENSE , v. a. (Reward) parituz (c. 10. -tozayati -yituM), santuz, pAritozikaM dA, samBU in caus. — (Make a return or re- quital) pratiPalaM dA, nizkftiM dA, pratidAnaM kf, pratikftiM or prati- kriyAM kf, SoDanaM kf, SudDiM kf, pariSoDanaM kf, nistAraM kf, nizkf, pratikf, pratyupakf, apAkf, SuD in caus. — (Make amends for a loss) kzatinizkftiM kf, hAninizkftiM kf, kzatipUraRaM kf, hAnipUraRaM kf.

RECOMPENSE , s. (Reward) pAritozikaM, PalaM, pratiPalaM. — (Return, requital) pratiPalaM, nizkftiH f., pratikftiH f., pratikriyA, pratIkAraH, nistAraH, niryAtanaM, SudDiH f., SoDanaM, pariSudDiH f., pariSoDanaM, upakA- ramokzaH, pratyupakAraH, sukftaM. — (Amends for a loss) kzatipUraRaM, hAni- pUraRaM, kzatinizkftiH f., hAninizkftiH f., hAnimUlyaM.
RECOMPENSED , p. p. paritozitaH -tA -taM, santozitaH &c., samBAvitaH &c., pratiPalitaH &c., pratikftaH &c., pratyupakftaH &c., gfhItaPalaH -lA -laM.
RECOMPENSING , part. pAritozikaH -kI -kaM, tuzwikaraH -rA -raM, nizkArakaH &c.
RECONCILABLE: (1) prasAdanIya (f. yA);(2) sA- (SA) ntvanIya (f. yA), pari-.
RECONCILABLE , a. sanDeyaH -yA -yaM, sanDAtavyaH -vyA -vyaM, samADeyaH -yA -yaM.

Reconcile, v. t. saM-DA 3 U, saM-Gaw c. (Gawayati), saMmil c., dvezaM-vEraM Sam c. (Samayati), saKyaM kf 8 U; prasad c., anunI 1 P, sAMtv 10, saM-pari-tuz c.; ‘you are not yet r(econcil)ed’ nAdyApi prasAdaM gfhRAsi (M. 4), na anunIyase, prasannA na Bavasi; ‘easy to be r(econcil)ed’ ASusaMDeya. 2 (Statement &c.) visaMvAdaM-viroDaM-apanI 1 P or apA-nirA-kf, EkyatAM-ekavAkyatAM-saMgatiM-kf, samA-DA. 3 (Quarrels &c.) praSam c., saM-DA, nirAkf. [Reconcil]ed, a. kftasaMDi, SAMtavEra, prasAdita, ekIkfta; ‘to be r(econciled)’ prasad 1 P, mEtryaM gam 1 P, pra-sAdaM grah 9 U, tozaM gam, saMmil 6 P. [Reconcil]er, s. saMDAtf m., samADAtA, saMDikft m. [Reconcile]ment, Reconciliation, s. saMDAnaM, saMGawanaM, prasAdanaM, saMmelanaM, vEraSamanaM, saKya-karaRaM. 2 saMDiH, sAman n., vEraSAMti f., punaH saKyaM-mEtrI, sAMtvanaM, anunayaH, EkyaM. 3 samA-DAnaM, saMgati f., ekavAkyatA, viroDaSamanaM.

RECONCILE: I To conciliate:(1) milanaM or saMmilanaM kArayati (c. of kf);(2) saMGawayati (c. of Gaw);(3) kopaM Samayati (c. of Sam = to appease anger);(4) prasAdayati (c. of sad).II To make consistent:(1) visaMvAdam apAkaroti (kf, c. 8.);(2) EkyaM karoti.

To RECONCILE , v. a. (Restore to friendship or union) sanGA (c. 3. -daDAti -Datte -DAtuM), samADA, sanDiM kf, sanDAnaM kf, samADAnaM kf, samADiM kf, anyonyavEritvaM or anyonyadvezaM Sam (c. 10. Samayati -yituM), vEraSAntiM kf, vEraSamanaM kf, vivAdaSAntiM kf, punaHsaKyaM kf, punErmatryaM kf, punaHsOhfdyaM kf, punaHprItiM kf, punarEkyaM kf, ekIkf, mil in caus. (melayati -yituM), sammil, saha mil, melanaM kf. — (Bring to ac- quiescence, content, or submission) sAntv (c. 10. sAntvayati -yituM), sAm (c. 10. sAmayati -yituM), anunI (c. 1. -nayati -netuM), tuz (c. 10. tozayati -yituM), santuz, parituz, samparituz, tuzwiM nI. — (Make consistent) sadfSIkf, saNgataM -tAM kf, sammatIkf, ekavAkyatAM kf, anuvAditvaM kf.

RECONCILED , p. p. sanDitaH -tA -taM, samAhitaH -tA -taM, kftasanDiH -nDiH nDi, SAntavEraH -rA -raM, SAntadvezaH -zA -zaM, SAntavivAdaH -dA -daM, ekIkftaH -tA -taM; ‘to be reconciled,’ sanDA (c. 3. -daDAti -Datte -DAtuM or pass. -DIyate), saha mil (c. 6. milati, melituM), punarmEtryaM gam or i, punaHsaKyaM gam, ekIBU, tuzwiM gam or i, paritozaM gam; ‘to be recon- ciled to one's enemy,’ SatruRA or SatruRA saha sanDA; ‘to one's brother,’ BrAtrA saha mil.
RECONCILER , s. sanDAtA m. (tf), samADAtA m., sanDAnakarttA m. (rttf), sanDikft m.

RECONCILIATION, RECONCILEMENT: I The act:(1) by verb;(2) prasAdanam (= conci- -liation).II The state:(1) milanam, -saM-; (2) saMGawanam, -nA;(3) Ekyam.III Of figures etc.: ekIkaraRam: v. To reconcile (II).

RECONCILIATION , RECONCILEMENT, s. (The act) sanDAnaM, samADAnaM, sanDAnakaraRaM, sanDikaraRaM, vEraSamanaM, melanaM, sammelanaM, ekIkaraRaM, sAntvanaM, sAma n. (n), SAma n., SAmanaM. — (The state) sanDiH m., samADiH m., vEraSAntiH f., sAma n. (n), punaHsaKyaM, punarmEtryaM, punarmEtrI, punaHprItiH f., punaHsnehaH, saMvittiH f., EkyaM, ekatA.
Recondite, a. gahana, ni-, gUQa, gUQArTa, durboDa, rahasya, durjYeya, gahanArTa.
RECONDITE: (1) gUQa (f. QA), ni-;(2) gahana (f. nA = difficult, obscure: q. v.);(3) rahasya (f. syA): v. Secret;(4) durboDa (f. DA), durjYeya (f. yA), and sim. expr.s (= not intelligible).

RECONDITE , a. gUQaH -QA -QaM, nigUQaH &c., nigUQArTaH -rTA -rTaM, gahanaH -nA -naM, paramagahanaH &c., gahanArTaH &c., guptArTaH &c., guhyArTaH &c., gamBIrArTaH &c., durjYeyaH -yA -yaM, durgamyaH -myA -myaM, agamyaH &c., durboDaH -DA -DaM, duravaboDaH &c., gamBIraH -rA -raM, rahasyaH -syA -syaM.
To RECONDUCT , v. a. punar nI (c. 1. nayati, netuM), pratinI, pratyAnI.
RECONNAISSANCE: (1) gavezaRA, -Ram;(2) parIkzA (= examination).
Reconnoitre, v. t. nipuRaM-sUkzmaM-parIkz 1 A or nirUp 10 or anusaM-DA 3 U, gavez 10.
RECONNOITRE: (1) gavezayati (gavez, c. 10.); (2) parIkzate (Ikz, c. 1. = to examine). Ph.: r. ing party: cArAH (= spies), Ram. vi. 1.
To RECONNOITRE , RECONNOITER, v. a. kiyaddUrAt or nAtidUrAd avekz (c. 1. -Ikzate -kzituM) or nirIkz or vIkz or parIkz or dfS or anudfS or Alok or avalok or Aloc or anusanDA or nirUp.
RECONNOITRED , p. p. kiyaddUrAd avekzitaH -tA -taM or nirUpitaH &c.
To RECONQUER , v. a. punar ji or parAji or viji, punar vaSIkf.
RECONSIDER: paryAlocayati (loc, c. 10.): v. To consider, again.
To RECONSIDER , v. a. punar vicar or vigaR or cint, praticint, punar nirUp or anusanDA or parIkz, punar vitark, punarvicAraM kf.
RECONSIDERED , p. p. punarvicAritaH -tA -taM, punarnirUpitaH &c., pratici- ntitaH &c.

Record, s. leKyaM, leKaH, patraM, patrakaM, pawwaH, leKapramARaM (‘evidence on r(ecord)’). v. t. ABi-, liK 6 P, leKye-patre-Aruh c. or niviS c. or f c. (arpayati); See Commit. [Record]er, s. leKakaH, lipikAraH, kAyasTaH (court-officer).

RECORD (subs.); (1) leKyam or leKaH, A-, that he delivers the r.s of Laṇkā for communicating to Indra: yena laNkAleKyakamudDftya samarpayati purandaraSrAvaRAya, B. r. ix.;(2) perh. akzaH, chief r.-keeper: mahAkzapawalikaH, B. r. ix.
RECORD (v.): (1) leKye or patre niveSayati (c. of viS) or Aropayati, sam-, (c. of ruh);(2) liKati, aBi-, (liK, c. 6 = to write).

To RECORD , v. a. patre or leKye or leKyapatre Aruh in caus. (-ropa- yati -yituM) or samAruh or aBiliK (c. 6. -liKati -leKituM) or liK, leKyapatre samf in caus. (-arpayati -yituM) or f in caus. or niviS (c. 10. -veSayati -yituM) or nyas, leKyArUQaM -QAM kf, patrArUQaM -QAM kf, pawwArUQaM -QAM kf.
RECORD , s. leKyaM, leKaH, leKyaprasaNgaH, leKyapatraM, leKapramARaM, leKyapra- mARaM, liKitaM, liKanaM, patraM -trI -trikA, patrakaM, pawaH, pawwaH, AgamaH, AmnAyaH, sAkzyaM.

RECORDED , p. p. leKyArUQaH -QA -QaM, leKyAropitaH -tA -taM, leKyapatrArUQaH &c., leKyasamarpitaH -tA -taM, pawwArUQaH &c., pawArUQaH &c., aBiliKitaH -tA -taM, liKitaH &c., patraliKitaH &c., AmnAtaH &c.
RECORDER: of London and other towns: prAq- vivAkaH.
RECORDER , s. kAyasTaH, leKakaH, lipikaraH, lipikAraH, aBileKakaH, aBileKanakft. — (Officer) nagaravyavahAradarSI m. (n), praDAnavicArakaH.
Recount, v. t. kaT 10, AKyA 2 P, varR 10, nivid c., pari-, kFt 10; See Tell.
RECOUNT: SrAvayati (c. of Sru): v. To tell, narrate.
To RECOUNT , v. a. kaT (c. 10. kaTayati -yituM), AKyA (c. 2. -KyAti -tuM or caus. KyApayati -yituM), KyA, Sru (c. 10. SrAvayati -yituM), varR (c. 10. varRayati -yituM), Acakz, nivid in caus.
RECOUNTED , p. p. kaTitaH -tA -taM, AKyAtaH &c., samAKyAtaH &c., ni- veditaH &c.
RECOUNTER: saMmardaH: v. Encounter, battle.
Recoup, v. t. pUr 10, prativi-DA 3 U, pUnar laB 1 A.
Recourse, s. A-saM-upA-SrayaH, A-ava-laMbaH, 2 SaraRaM, gati f., (SrIharirme gatiH) f.; ‘have r(ecourse) to’ Sri 1 U, A-upA-samA-saM°, AsTA 1 P, A-ava-laMb 1 A; upagam 1 P.

RECOURSE (subs.): (1) ASrayaH;(2) saMSrayaH. Ph.: to have r. to: Srayati, -te, A-, samupA-, samA-, upA-, saM-, (Sri, c. 1.), having r. to spirit: tejaH samA- Sritya, Ki. xvii. 3.; will have r. to Rāma: rAGavaM saMSrayizyati, Ram.; had r. to (the forest) Naimisha: nEmizaM SiSriye, R. xix. 1.

RECOURSE , s. ASrayaH -yaRaM, samASrayaH -yaRaM, upASrayaH -yaRaM, saMSrayaH -yaRaM, ASayaH, avalambanaM, upasTitiH f., upagamanaM, pratyAgamanaM; ‘to have recourse,’ ASri (c. 1. -Srayati -yituM), samASri, upASri, samupASri, saMSri, aBiSri, avalas (c. 1. -lambate -mbituM), upasTA (c. 1. -tizwati -sTAtuM), AsTA, upagam; ‘having recourse,’ ASritya, ASritaH -tA -taM, AsTAya, upasTAya.

Recover, v. i. ArogyaM laB 1 A, rogAd vimuc pass.; oft. by nir, vi, gata in comp.; nirvizaH gOtamaH (M. 4), ‘has r(ecover)ed from (the effects of) poison’; prakftiM Apad 4 A, susTa-prakftisTa a. BU 1 P, rogamukta-nirAmaya- a. BU; pUrvasTitiM prAp 5 P. 2 (From fainting) saMjYAM-ce-tanAM-laB; See below. v. t. (punaH) laB, prAp, vid 6 U, prati-A-pad; pratyavAp, pratyA-dA 3 A, pratigrah 9 P, pratyAhf 1 P, pratyudDf 1 P; ‘r(ecover) consciousness’ saMjYAM-cetanAM-laB or prAp, prakftiM-saMjYAM prati-A-pad, prakftisTa a. BU. 2 rogaM hf or naS c. or sAD c. or Sam c., nIruja-svasTa- a. kf 8 U; See Cure; ‘she r(ecover)ed him from poison’ sA taM nirvizaM cakAra. [Recover]ed, a. pratilabDa, pra-tyAhfta, punargfhIta, &c. 2 (From sickness) gata-nazwa-SAMta-roga, nIroga, nirAmaya, rogamukta, svasTa, prakftisTa, utTita; oft. by mukta, gata, in comp.; ‘r(ecovered) from fever’ jvaramukta; ‘r(ecovered) from swooning’ nazwa-gata-moha; ‘r(ecovered) from poison’ nirviza, &c. 3 (From fainting) labDa-saMjYa-cetana, prakfti-mApanna, prakftisTa, cetanApanna. [Recover]y, s. punarlABaH, punaHprApti f., punarAdAnaM, pratipatti f., aDigamanaM, pratyudDAraH. 2 svAsTyalABaH; ArogyaprAptiH, prakftilABaH, svAsTyaM, nirA-mayatvaM, ArogyaM, rogamukti f.

RECOVER (v. t.): I To regain:(1) laBate (laB, c. 1. = to gain: q. v.), spoke to her when she r. ed her consciousness: labDacetAnAmavAdIt, K.; let him r. his eye-sight: sa labDacakzurBavet, Mah. iii. 297. 27.; if you r. your possession: yadi labDA punarAtmanaH padam, Ki. ii. 17.;(2) aSnute, sam-, (aS, c. 5.: rare), if (one) r. s his health: yadyarogitAM samaSnute, Si. xiv. 13.II To cure: q. v.
RECOVER (v. i.): (1) su(sva)sTa or prakftisTa (f. sTA) Bavati, Sr.;(2) ArogyaM laBate (laB, c. 1.): v. Health, to gain;(3) prakftiM Bajate (Baj, c. 1.), Sr.

To RECOVER , v. a. (Regain) pratilaB (c. 1. -laBate -labDuM), pratyupalaB, punar laB, punar upalaB, anuprAp (c. 5. -Aptoti -AptuM), pratyavAp, punaH prAp, punar avAp, pratyAdA (c. 3. -dadAti -datte -dAtuM), punar AdA, punar grah (c. 9. gfhlAti, grahItuM), pratigrah, pratipad (c. 4. -padyate -pattuM), punar Apad, pratyAhf (c. 1. -harati -te -harttuM), pratyudDf, udDf; ‘to recover one's consciousness,’ saMjYAM laB, cEtanyaM laB, svaprakftim [Page664-b+ 51] Apad or pratipad; ‘one who has done so,’ labDasaMjYaH, svaprakfti- mApannaH; ‘to recover recollection,’ smftiM laB. — (Restore from sickness, &c.) svasTaM -sTAM kf, rogaM Sam in caus., rogAd vimuc or muc, rogaM nivft in caus., rogaM naS in caus. or niras, samutTA in caus. pratikf, samADA, pratisamADA, see To CURE.

To RECOVER , v. n. (Regain health, be restored from sickness) rogAt samutTA (c. 1. -tizWati -TAtuM, rt. sTA) or utTA or muc in pass. (mucyate) or vimuc, rogamuktaH -ktA -ktaM, BU, SAntarogaH -gA -gaM BU, nivfttarogaH &c. BU, punaH svasTaH -sTA -sTaM BU, punaH susTaH -sTA -sTaM BU, punar nirAmayaH -yA -yaM BU, punar ArogyaM or svAsTyaM gam or i. — (From loss of consciousness or fainting) pratyASvas (c. 2. -Svasiti -tuM), saMjYAM laB (c. 1. laBate, labDuM), cEtanyaM laB, cetanAM prAp, svaprakftim Apad (c. 4. -padyate -pattuM) or pratipad, prakftimApannaH -nnA -nnaM BU. — (Regain one's former state, come right) pUrvvavad BU, yaTAsTitaH -tA -taM BU, svasTaH -sTA -sTaM BU, pUrvvAvasTAM or pUrvvasTitiM or pUrvvavfttim Apad or pratipad or gam.
RECOVERABLE: (1) pratilaBya (f. ByA);(2) punarlaBya (f. ByA);(3) gen. by laBya (f. ByA), prApya (f. pyA), AsAdanIya (f. yA), etc.
RECOVERABLE a. pratilaByaH -ByA -ByaM, punarlaByaH &c., punaHprApyaH -pyA -pyaM.

RECOVERED , p. p. (Regained) pratilabDaH, -bDA -bDaM, pratyupalabDaH &c., puna- rlabDaH &c., punarupalabDaH &c., punaH prAptaH -ptA -ptaM, anuprAptaH &c., punar avAptaH &c., pratyavAptaH &c., punargfhItaH -tA -taM, pratyudDftaH &c., pratyA- hftaH &c., ApannaH -nnA -nnaM, pratipannaH &c., pratikftaH &c. — (From sickness) rogasaplutTitaH -tA -taM, samutTitaH &c., rogotTitaH &c., roga- muktaH -ktA -ktaM, muktarogaH -gA -gaM, nivfttarogaH &c., gatarogaH &c., vigata- rogaH &c., nazwarogaH &c., nirastarogaH &c., SAntarogaH &c., svasTaH -sTA -sTaM, nirAmayaH -yA -yaM; ‘from a fever,’ gatajvaraH -rA -raM, jvaramuktaH &c. — (From unconsciousness or fainting) labDasaMjYaH -jYA -jYaM, labDacEtanyaH -nyA -nyaM, labDacetAH -tAH -taH (s), svaprakftimApannaH -nnA -nnaM. — (One who has recovered his recollection) labDasmftiH -tiH -ti.
RECOVERY: I In gen.:(1) punarlABaH;(2) punaHprAptiH;(3) better by verb.II From illness:(1) rogasamutTAnam;(2) svAsTyalABaH; and sim. expr. s.

RECOVERY , s. (Regaining) punarlabDiH f., punarlABaH, punarupalabDiH f., pratyupalabDiH f., pratilabDiH f., pratilamBaH, punaHprAptiH f., punaHprApaRaM, puna- ravAptiH f., pratyavAptiH f., anuprAptiH f., avAptiH f., punarAdAnaM, punargrahaRaM, pratigrahaRaM, pratyudDaraRaM, pratyudDAraH, avahAraH, pratyAnayanaM, AnayanaM, pratIkAraH. — (From sickness) rogasamutTAnaM, samutTAnaM, rogotTAnaM, rogamuktiH f., rogamuktatA, roganivfttiH f., svAsTyaM, svasTatA, ArogyaM, nirAmayatA -tvaM, nirAmayaM, kalyatA -tvaM.
Recreant, a. DarmaBrazwa, tyakta-laMGita-svaDarma, patita. 2 kAtara, BIru, klIba; See Coward.
RECREANT: I Cowardly: q. v.: kAtara (f. rA). II Apostate: q. v.: DarmaBrazwa (f. zwA).
RECREANT , a. (Cowardly) kAtaraH -rA -raM, klIvaH -vA -vaM, BIruH -ruH ru. — (Apostate) DarmmaBrazwaH -zwA -zwaM, saNkalpaBrazwaH &c., tyaktasaNkalzaH -lzA -lpaM, ullaMGitaDarmmaH -rmmA -rmmaM.

Recreate, v. t. (Oneself) viSram 4 P, vihf 1 P, ram 1 A, krIq 1 P. 2 A-samA-pratyA-Svas c., AnaMd c., vinud c., ram c. (ramayati), saM-pari-tuz c.; See Please, Refresh. [Recreat]ion, s. viSrAmaH, vinodaH-danaM, vihAraH, viharaRaM, krIqA, kOtukaM, manoraMjanaM. [Recreat]ive, a. suKakara (rI f.), manoraMjana (nI f.), vinodaSIla.
RECREATE: I Lit: v. To create, again. II To refresh, cheer: q. v.: ASvAsayati (c. of SvaS).III To repose, rest: q. v.: viSrAmyati (Sram, c. 4.).

To RECREATE , v. a. (Divert, gratify) vinud (c. 10. -nodayati -yituM), Anand in caus., ram in caus., suK, santuz, parituz, prI, tfp, hlAd, suKaM kf, prItiM dA. — (Refresh) ASvas (c. 10. -SvAsayati -yituM), pratyASvas, samASvas, suK (c. 10. suKayati -yituM).
RECREATED , p. p. vinoditaH -tA -taM, ASvAsitaH &c., paritozitaH -tA -taM.
RECREATION: (1) vinodaH (= amusement); (2) vihAraH (by walking about);(3) viSrAmaH (= rest). To take r.: v. To amuse, rest.

RECREATION , s. vinodaH -danaM, viSrAmaH, viSrAntiH f., vihAraH, viharaRaM, krIqA, manovinodaH, manoraYjanaM, vilAsaH, KelA, ramaRaM, kOtukaM; ‘to take recreation,’ vihf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), mano vinud (c. 10. -noda- yati -yituM), ram, krIq, viSram.
RECREATIVE: (1) vinodaka (f. dikA);(2) suKakara (f. rI);(3) manoraYjana (f. nI).
RECREATIVE , a. vinodakaH -kA -kaM, manoraYjakaH &c. See REFRESHING, a.

Recriminate, v. pratyaBiyuj 7 A, 10, pra-tyaBiSaMs 1 P. [Recriminat]ion, s. pratyaBiyogaH, pra-tyAropaH; ‘crimination and r(ecrimination)’ paraspara-dozAropaH. [Recriminat]ive, [Recriminat]ory, a. pratyaBiyogin.
RECRIMINATE: (1) pratyaBiyuMkte (yuj, c. 7.);(2) pratyaBiSaMsate (SaMs, c. 1.).
To RECRIMINATE , s. pratyaBiyogaM kf, pratyapavAdaM kf, pratyAropaM kf, pratyA- ropaRaM kf; ‘to criminate and recriminate,’ aBiyogapratyaBiyogaM kf, vAdAnuvAdaM kf.
RECRIMINATION: (1) pratyaBiyogaH;(2) pratyaBiSaMsanam.
RECRIMINATION , s. pratyaBiyogaH, pratyapavAdaH, pratyAropaH -paRaM; ‘crimi- nation and recrimination,’ aBiyogapratyaBiyogO m. au., anyo- nyadozAropaH -paRaM, parasparadozAropaH, vAdAnuvAdaH.
RECRIMINATIORY , RECRIMINATIVE, a. pratyAropakaH -kA -kaM, pratyapavAdakaH &c., pratyaBiyogI -ginI -gi (n), pratyAropakArI &c.
Recrudescence, s. punaH prasarpaRaM or udBavaH. Recrudescent, a. punaH prasarpin.

Recruit, v. t. SaktiM vfD c., prabalIkf 8 U, ASvas c., ApyE c., samA-pratisamA-DA 3 U, susTa- a. kf; ‘to r(ecruit) the strength of’ vAjIkf. 2 navasEnikEH pUr 10. v. i. ‘r(ecruit) oneʼs strength’ balaM-sattvaM laB 1 A, sva-tejaH-vIryaM prAp 5 P, susTa- a. BU. s. nUtana-nava-sEnikaH. [Recruit]ed, a. labDa-prApta-bala, varDita-sattva, ApyAyita, pratyASvasta. 2 navasEnika-yukta-pUrRa.
RECRUIT (subs.): perh. navasEnikaH and sim. comp.s.: v. Soldier, new.

RECRUIT (v.): I To supply deficiency: puzRAti or pozayati, pari-, saM-, (puz, c. 9. and causal), r. ed her pretty parts: pupoza lAvaRyamayAn viSezAn, Ku. i. 25.II To refresh, reinvigorate: (1) varDayati (c. of vfD = increase);(2) ASvAsayati (c. of Svas = to cheer);(3) prabalI- karoti (= strengthen).III Of soldiers: utTApayati, sam- (c. of sTA = to raise).

To RECRUIT , v. a. (Repair) pratikf, patisaMkf, svasTaM -sTAM kf, susTaM -sTAM kf, susTa (nom. susTayati -yituM), pUrvvavantaM, -vatIM -vata kf, samADA, pratisamADA. — (Restore exhausted strength) kzIRabalaM vfD (c. 10. varDayati -yituM), kzIRasattvaM vfD, tejo or sattvaM vfD, ASvas in caus., AppE in caus. — (Supply with new soldiers) navasEnyayuktaM -ktAM kf.

To RECRUIT , v. n. (Recover energy or strength) balaM or sattvaM laB (c. 1. laBate, labDuM), svasattvaM laB or prAp, svatejo laB, svavIryyaM prAp, svaprakftiM laB, zunaH svAsTyaM gam or i, punaH svasTaH -sTA -sTaM BU, punaH susTaH &c. BU. — (Raise new soldiers) navasEnyasaMgrahaM kf, nUta- nasEnyasaMgrahaM kf, balADikyaM kf.
RECRUIT , s. navasEnyaH, nUtanasEnyaH, navasEnikaH, navInasEnyaH, SastrAByAsI m. (n), astraSikzAkArI m., nUtanAByAsI m., navAByAsI m.

RECRUITED , p. p. (In strength) labDabalaH -lA -laM, labDasattvaH -ttvA -ttvaM, prAptabalaH &c., vaDitabalaH &c., zunaH svasTaBUtaH -tA -taM, ApyAyitaH &c., pratyASvastaH -stA -staM. — (As an army) nabasEnyayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, nUtana- sEnyayuktaH &c.
Rectangle, s. samakoRaH, samacaturasraM. Rectangular, a. samakoRa, samacaturasra.
RECTANGLE: fjukoRaH or samakoRaH caturBujaH.
RECTANGLE , s. samakoRAkftiH f., samakoRaH, samAsraM, AyatasamakoRaH, Aya- tasamAsraM, AyatasamalambaH, samacatuzkoRaH, samacaturasraM, samakoRamUrttiH f., jAtyaH.
RECTANGULAR: fjukoRa (f. RA) or samakoRa (f. RA).
RECTANGULAR , a. samacatuzkoRaH -RA -RaM, samacaturasraH -srA -sraM, samakoRaH -RA -RaM, samakoRAkftiH -tiH -ti, jAtyaH -tyA -tyaM.
RECTIFIABLE , a. SoDanIyaH -yA -yaM, saMSoDanIyaH &c., SoDyaH -DyA -DyaM.
RECTIFICATION: SoDanam, pari-, saM-, vi-: v. Correction, purification.
RECTIFICATION , s. SoDanaM, saMSoDanaM, SudDiH f., viSudDiH f., pratisamADAnaM.
RECTIFIED , p. p. SoDitaH -tA -taM, viSoDitaH &c., pratisamAhitaH &c.
Rectify, v. t. samA-pratisamA-DA 3 U, SuD c. [Rectif]ication, s. samADAnaM, SoDanaM.
RECTIFY: SoDayati, pari-, saM-, vi-, (c. of SuD): v. To correct, purify.

To RECTIFY , v. a. SuD (c. 10. SoDayati -yituM), viSuD, saMSuD, SudDIkf, samADA (c. 3. -daDAti -Datte -DAtuM), pratisamADA, SoDanaM kf, yaTArTaM -rTAM kf, taTyaM -TyAM kf, samaYjasaM -sAM kf, samyak kf.
Rectilineal, a. saralareKAviSizwa.
RECTILINEAR, RECTILINEAL: saralareKa (f. KA) and sim. comp.s.
RECTILINEAR , RECTILINEAL, a. saralareKaH -KA -KaM, saralareKAviSizwaH -zwA -zwaM, saralareKAmayaH -yI -yaM.

Rectitude, s. sAralyaM, ArjavaM, dAkziRyaM, nyA-yitA, SOcaM, satyaSIlatA, sadvartanaM, sadAcAraH; ‘path of r(ectitude)’ sanmArgaH, supaTaH, nItimArgaH-paTaH; ‘deviation from the path of r(ectitude)’ satpaTatyAgaH-BraMSaH, utpaTagamanaM.
RECTITUDE: SucitA: v. Uprightness, honesty, justice.

RECTITUDE , s. sAralyaM, saralatA -tvaM, fjutA, ArjavaM, maryyAdA, avakratA, ajihmatA, SudDatA, SucitA, matiSudDatA, sADutA, dAkziRyaM, satyaSIlatA, vimalatA, nyAyitA, aSaWatA, saccaritaM, saMsTA, sTitiH f., avasTitiH f., samyagvfttitvaM, avyaBicAraH, yaTocitaM, yATAtaTyaM; ‘law of retitudelaw of rectitude.’ nItiH f.; ‘path of rectitude,’ satpaTaH, sanmArgaH; ‘deviation from the path of rectitude,’ satpaTaBraMSaH, satpaTatyAgaH, sanmArgaBraMSaH, vimArgagamanaM, unmArgagamanaM, utpaTagamanaM, kupaTagamanaM, yaTocitAdBraMSaH, maryyAdAtyAgaH, maryyAdAlaMGanaM.
Rector, s. nAyakaH, aDyakzaH. 2 grAmAcAryaH.
RECTOR: I A clergyman: *grAmAcAryaH, grAmikaH. II Of colleges etc.: nAyakaH.
RECTOR , s. grAmapurohitaH, grAmaguruH m., grAmAcAryyaH, grAmaDarmmADyakzaH.
RECTORY: grAmikADikAraH (province); *grAmikA- vAsaH (residence).
RECTORY , s. grAmapurohitavasatiH f., grAmAcAryyagfhaM, grAmaguruniketanaM.
RECTUM , s. aDaHsTo malASayaH, jaGanyasTo malASayaH, paScimanAqI.
RECUMBENCE , RECUMBENCY, s. SayanaM, patanaM, kukziSayanaM, kukziSayyA.
Recumbent, a. pArSvaSaya, arDakAyena SayAna, kukziSaya, saMvizwa.
RECUMBENT: (1) SayAna (f. nA = lying down); (2) pArSvaSaya (f. yA = on the back);(3) saMvizwa (f. zwA = sitting down);(4) namra (f. mrA = bent, low).
RECUMBENT , a. SayAnaH -nA -naM, SayaH -yA -yaM, SAyI -yinI -yi (n), SayitaH -tA -taM, kukziSayaH -yA -yaM, kukziSApI &c., saMvizwaH -zwA -zwaM. See RECLINING, LYING DOWN.
Recuperate, v. t. punar laB 1 A.

Recur, v. i. prati-, A-vft 1 A, punar Agam 1 P, or Apat 1 P or saM-pad 4 A or saM-BU 1 P or Gaw 1 A or upasTA 1 P; (to the mind) AviH-prAduH-BU, ud-i 2 P, sPur 6 P, smf pass. 2 SaraRaM gam or prapad. [Recur]rence, [Recur]rency, s. pratyAvftti f., punarvartanaM, punarGawanaM-ApAtaH-upasTAnaM-saMBavaH. 2 smaraRaM, sPuraRaM, prAdurBAvaH, udayaH. [Recur]rent, [Recur]ring, a. Avartaka, pratyAvartin.
RECUR: I To come again: q. v.:(1) pratyAvartate (vft, c. 1.);(2) punar AgacCati (gam, c. 1.).II To the mind: udeti (i, c. 2. = to arise).

To RECUR , v. n. (Happen again) punar upasTA (c. 1. -tizWati -sTAtuM), panaH samBU, punaH saMvft or vft, punar Agam or upAgam, punaH sampad, [Page665-b+ 51] punar Apat or nipat, punar Gaw; ‘from time to time.’ vAraM vAraM or punaH punar or anuvAram upasTA. — (To the mind or thought) sPur (c. 6. sPurati -rituM), manasi sPur, punaH smf, punaHsmftaH -tA -taM BU.
RECURRENCE: I Return: q. v.: pratyAvfttiH. II To the mind: udayaH.

RECURRENCE , RECURRENCY, s. punarupasTitiH f., punarupasTAnaM, punarA- gamanaM, punarvarttanaM, punarupAgamaH, punaHsamBavaH, punaHsamBUtiH f., punarutpattiH f., punarGawanA. — (To the mind) smaraRaM, smftiH f., punaHsmaraRaM, sPuraRaM.
RECURRENT , RECURRING, a. anuvAramAgAmI -minI -mi (n), vAraM vAram upasTAyI &c., punaHpunarAgAmI &c., punaHpunarvarttI &c.,
Recusant, a. pratIpa; See Obstinate.
RECUSANT: pratIpa (f. pA): v. Refractory, obstinate.

Red, a. rakta, lohita, SoRa (‘blood-r(ed)’), rakta-lohita-varRa, aruRa (‘dark r(ed)’), kazAya, So-Rita; ‘r(ed)-hot’ uttapta, jvalat, aBi-saM-tapta, agnivarRa; ‘r(ed)-lead’ siMdUraM; See under Lead. s. (‘R(ed) colour’) raktavarRaH, aruRi-man m., lohitaH, raktaH. [Red]den, v. t. lohi-tIkf 8 U, raktIkf &c. v. i. raktIBU 1 P, lohitAyate (D.). [Red]dish, a. Arakta-lo-hita, Izadrakta, &c. [Red]ness, s. raktatvaM, lO-hityaM, raktimA, aruRimA.
RED: I Adj.:(1) rakta (f. ktA);(2) lohita (f. tA or nI);(3) raktavarRa (f. rRA) and sim comp.s;(4) SoRa (f. RA = crimson);(5) aruRa (f. RA = deep r.).II Subs.: raktaH, -varRaH and sim. expr. s.

RED , a. raktaH -ktA -ktaM, lohitaH -tA -hinI -taM, raktavarRaH -rRA -rRaM, lohi- tavarRaH &c., rohitaH -tA -hiRI -taM, SoRitaH -tA -ta, SoRaH -RA -RI -RaM, sindUravarRaH &c., kazAyaH -yA -yaM, maYjizWaH -zWI -zWaM; ‘dark red,’ aruRaH -RA -RaM, GanAruRaH &c.; ‘pale red,’ SvetaraktaH -ktA -ktaM, pAwalaH -lA -laM.
RED , s. raktaH, lohitaH, rohitaH, SoRitaH, raktavarRaH, aruRaH.
RED-HAIRED , a. raktakeSaH -SA -SaM, raktakeSI -SinI -Si (n).
RED-HANDED: SoRitaSoRapARi (mfn.) and sim. comp.s.: v. Bloody.
RED-HOT: (1) aBitapta (f. ptA = heated);(2) udarcis (mfn. = luminous);(3) jvalat (f. ntI = burning).
RED-HOT , a. agnivarRaH -rRA -rRaM, tAparaktaH -ktA -ktaM, taptaH -ptA -ptaM, upataptaH &c., santaptaH &c., aBitaptaH &c., raktataptaH &c., uzRaraktaH -ktA -ktaM.
RED-LEAD: (1) sindUram;(2) raktacUrRam;(3) nAgasamBavam, A.
RED-LEAD , s. sindUraM -rikA, raktacUrRaM. See MINIUM.
RED-LEGGED , a. raktapAdaH -dA -daM, lohitapAdaH &c., raktajaMGaH -GA -GaM.
RED-WOOD , s. (Kind of red sandal) patrANgaM, raktacandanaM.
REDDEN: I Intrans.:(1) raktIBavati;(2) lohitA- yate, -ti, (nomi.).II Trans.:(1) raktIkaroti; (2) raktayati.
To REDDEN , v. a. raktIkf, lohitIkf, aruRIkf, SoRitIkf, raktavarRIkf.
To REDDEN , v. n. aruRIBU, raktIBU, lohita (nom. lohitAyati -te). lohitIBU.
REDDENED , p. p. raktIkftaH -tA -taM, aruRIkftaH &c., aruRitaH &c., lohitIkftaH -tA -taM, pAwalitaH &c., pAwalIkftaH &c., sindUritaH &c.
REDDISH: (1) Arakta (f. ktA);(2) Alohita (f. tA or nI);(3) Izadrakta (f. ktA) and sim. comp.s.
REDDISH , a. IzadraktaH -ktA -ktaM, AraktaH &c., AlohitaH -tA -taM.
REDDISHNESS: (1) AraktatA;(2) Araktiman (m.); (3) IzadraktatA; etc.
REDDISHNESS , s. IzadraktatA, AraktatA, AlohitatA, IzallohitatA.

Redeem, v. t. ava-hf 1 P, nizkrI 9 U, pari-krI 9 A, DanaM dattvA mokz 10; muc c., mokz, vi-nir-°, pratyA-dA 3 A, upa-nI 1 U; ‘a pledge to be r(edeem)ed at a fixed time’ kftakAlopaneyaH ADiH (V. M. 66). 2 pari-, trE 1 A, ud-Df 1 P, 10, nistF c. 3 pUr 10, pratikf 8 U; See Atone for; ‘he has this r(edeem)ing virtue in him’ ayaM tasya guRo'nyAndozAn pramArzwi-lopayati. [Redeem]er, s. parikretf m., nizkrayin m. 2 trAtf m., mokzakaH, udDartf m., tArakaH. Redemption, s. ni-zkrayaH, parikrayaH-yaRaM. 2 pari-, trARaM, udDAraH, mokzaH-kzaRaM, mukti f., tAraRaM.

REDEEM: I To get back, buying back:(1) mokzayati, pari-, vi-, saM-, if a mortgage is not r.ed: yadyADirna mokzyate, Y. ii. 39.;(2) mocayati, vi-, pari-, saM- (c. of muc), the debtor should r. (it): fRI mocitumarhati, Vri.;(3) DanaM dattvA mokzayati, etc., Mit.II To save: q. v.: mokzayati.III To atone for: SoDayati, pari-, saM- (c. of SuD).

To REDEEM , v. a. (Ransom, purchase back) parikrI (c. 9. -krIRIte -kretuM), parikrayaM kf, parikrayaRaM kf, avahf, avaharaRaM kf. — (Save, de- liver) trE (c. 1. trAyate, trAtuM), paritrE, saMtrE, muc (c. 6. muYcati, moktuM, c. 10. mocayati -yituM), zarimuc, udDf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), samudDf, mokz (c. 10. mokzayati -yituM), nistF (c. 10. -tArayati -yituM), santF, uttf, tF, udDAraM kf. — (Compensate, make amends for) nizkftiM kf, hAni- nizkftiM kf, kzatinizkftiM kf, hAnipUraRaM kf.
REDEEMABLE , a. parikreyaH -yA -yaM, parikretavyaH -vyA -vyaM, avahAryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM.
REDEEMED , p. p. parikrItaH -tA -taM, trAtaH &c., paritrAtaH &c., muktaH -ktA -ktaM, parimuktaH &c., udDftaH -tA -taM, nistAritaH &c.
REDEEMER: mokzaka (f. kzikA), pari-, vi-, saM-; v. Saviour.

REDEEMER , s. (Ransomer) parikretA m. (tf), parikrayakft. — (Saviour) trAtA m. (tf), udDarttA m., samudDarttA m., udDArakaH, mokzakaH, parimocakaH, nistArakaH, tArakaH; ‘of the world,’ jagattrAtA m., jagadudDArakaH.
REDEMPTION: I Buying back:(1) mokzaH, -Ram, pari-, vi-, saM-;(2) by circumlo.: v. To redeem.II Liberation, deliverance: q. v.: mokzaH, -Ram.

REDEMPTION , s. (Ransom) parikrayaH -yaRaM, avaharaRaM. — (Rescue, sal- vation) trARaM, paritrARaM, udDAraH, samudDAraH, udDaraRaM, muktiH f., mokzaH -kzaRaM, parimokzaRaM, parimuktiH f., nistAraH, nistaraRaM, tAraRaM, nizkftiH f.
REDNESS: (1) raktatvam, -tA;(2) raktiman (m.); (3) lOhityam;(4) lohitiman (m.);(5) aruRiman (m. = deep r.): v. Red.
REDNESS , s. raktatvaM -tA, raktimA m. (n), lOhityaM, lohitatvaM -tA, aru- RimaH m. (n), SoRimA m. (n), SoRitatvaM -tA.
REDOLENCE , REDOLENCY, s. muganDaH, AmodaH, suvAmaH. See FRAGRANCE
Redolent, a. sugaMDi, saparimala, suraBiH See Fragrant; ‘to make r(edolent)’ vAs 10, suraBI-kf 8 U.
REDOLENT: (1) suraBi (mfn.);(2) suganDi (mfn.): v. Fragrant.
REDOLENT , a. suraBiH -BiH -Bi, suganDikaH -kA -kaM, suganDiH -nDiH -nDi, suvAsikaH -kI -kaM, parimalayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, tiktaH &c. See FRAGRANT.
Redouble, v. t. dviguRIkf 8 U, punaH punaH kf; aviratodyamena vfD c. [Redoubl]ed, a. vivfdDa, dviguRita, punaH punaH kfta.
