REFRESH: I In gen.:(1) ASvAsayati, sam- (c. of Svas = to cheer, comfort);(2) aBinandayati (c. of nand = to gladden, delight);(3) prahlAdayati (c. of hlAd =2), Śiva r. ed them by the cooling command of not to depart: SivaH prahlAdayA- mAsa tAn nizeDahimAmbunA, Ki. xv. 30.II To repair, restore: q. v.

To REFRESH , v. a. (Invigorate, relieve from fatigue) klAntiM or SramaM hf (c. 1. harati, harttuM), SramApahAraM kf, klAntyapahAraM kf, klAnticCedaM kf, SramacCedaM kf, viSrAntiM dA, AppE (c. 10. -zpAyayati -yituM), samAzyE, balaM or tejo or sattvaM vfD (c. 10. varDayati -yituM), sattvaM or vIryyaM dA. — (Revive, cheer) ASvas (c. 10. -SvAsayati -yituM), pratyASvas, punar ASvas, punar jIv (c. 10. jIvayati -yituM), punarjIvanaM dA, susv (c. 10. suKayati -yituM), Anand in caus., hfz in caus., hlAd in caus. — (Cool) SItala (nom. SItalayati -yituM), SItalIkf, nirvA in caus. (-vApayati -yituM), nirvApanaM kf. — (Make new or fresh) navIkf.

REFRESHED , p. p. (Relieved from fatigue) hftaklAntiH -ntiH -nti, hftaSramaH -mA -maM, hftaklamaH &c., apahftaklAntiH &c., apahftaSramaH &c., gataklamaH &c., gataSramaH &c., vigataSramaH &c., CinnaklAntiH &c., CinnaSramaH &c., viSrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, vimlAnaH -nA -naM, AppAyitaH -tA -taM. — (Revived, cheered) ASvAsitaH &c., samASvAsitaH &c., pratyASvastaH -stA -staM, AnanditaH -tA -taM, anuBUtasuKaH -KA -KaM. — (Cooled) SIta- lIkftaH -tA -taM, nirvApitaH &c. — (Made fresh) navIkftaH -tA -taM.
REFRESHING (adj.): (1) prahlAdana (f. nI): v. Delightful;(2) SItala (f. lA): v. Cool; (3) maDura (f. rA): v. Sweet;(4) SramApaha (f. hA = fatigue-removing).

REFRESHING , a. klAntiharaH -rA -raM, klAntihArakaH -kA -kaM, SrAntiharaH &c., SramahArI -riRI -ri (n), SramApahArI &c., SramApahaH -hA -haM, klAntyapahaH &c., SrAntyapahaH &c., klAntiCid m. f. n., viSrAntidaH -dA -daM, SramaCe- dakaH -kA -kaM, AppAyakaH -kA -kaM, ASvAsakaH &c., AnandadaH -dA -da, balavarDakaH &c., nirvApakaH &c.
REFRESHMENT: I The act:(1) ASvAsanam; (2) prahlAdanam: v. To refresh.II Food: q. v.: aByavahAraH, to take some r.: kiYcid aBya- vaharati; r. -room: *aByavahAraSAlA.

REFRESHMENT , s. (Act of refreshing) SramApahAraH, SramApaharaRaM, klAnti- haraRaM, klAntyapahAraH, klAntyapaharaRaM, klAnticCedaH, SramacCedaH, SrAnticCedaH, ApyAyaH -yanaM, viSrAntidAnaM, balavarDanaM, sattvavarDanaM, sattvadAnaM, ASvAsranaM, vimApanaM. — (State) viSrAntiH f., viSrAmaH, vimlAniH f., vimlAnatA.- (Food, slight repast) upAhAraH, laGuBojanaM, laGvAhAraH, alpA- hAraH, AhAraH.
REFRIGERANT , a. tApaharaH -rA -raM, santApaharaH &c., dAhaharaH &c., dAha- nASakaH -kA -kaM, SItalakArI riRI -ri (n), nirvApakaH -kA -ka.
REFRIGERANT , s. (Medicine) nirvApanaM, dAhahArakaM, tApanASakam OzaDaM.

Refrigerate, v. t. tApaM-dAhaM-hf 1 P or naS c. or Cid 7 P, nirvA c. (vApayati), SIta-lIkf 8 U; See Cool. [Refrigerat]ion, s. tApa-dAha-cCedaH, nirvApaRaM. Refrigerant, a. nirvA-paka, tApa-dAha-hara. s. uzRanirvApaRaM, tApaSamanaM.
To REFRIGERATE , v. a. tApaM or dAhaM hf (c. 1. harati, harttuM) or naS [Page669-a+ 51] (c. 10. nASayati -yituM), SItalIkf, SItala (nom. SItalayati -yituM), nirvA in caus. (-vApayati -yituM).
REFRIGERATION , s. nirvApanaM, nirvARaM, tApaharaRaM, dAhaharaRaM, SItalIkaraRaM.
REFRIGERATORY (subs.): *SItasADaRam; uzRa- nirvApaRam.

Refuge, s. ASrayaH, saMSrayaH, SaraRaM, gati f.; (person) SaraRyaH, ASrayaBUtaH, pAlakaH, rakzakaH, trAtf m. 2 upAyaH, pra-, yukti f., gatiH, sADanaM; ‘giving r(efuge)’ SaraRyaH &c.; ‘take r(efuge) with’ SaraRaM yA 2 P or gam 1 P or prapad 4 A, upA-A-saM-Sri 1 U, avalaMb 1 A, SaraRArTaM gam &c.; ‘seeking r(efuge)’ SaraRArTin; ‘come for r(efuge)’ SaraRaM prapannaH, SaraRAgata; ‘having only one r(efuge)’ ananyagatika. Refugee, s. SaraRaM prapanna, SaraRAgataH, SaraRArTin m. ASritaH, avalaMbitaH.

REFUGE: (1) ASrayaH, saMSrayaH, or samASrayaH, the r. of the wits: ASrayo rasikAnAm, K.; take r. with eneimiesenemies: dvizatAM yAnti saMSrayam, Ka. xiv. 13.;(2) SaraRam, people obtaining your r.: SaraRaM BavantamaDigamya janAH, Ki. xviii. 22.; r. of fire: agniSaraRam, Sa. iv.: v. Also shelter, abode.

REFUGE , s. (Shelter, protection) ASrayaH, samASrayaH, ASrayaRaM, saMSrayaH, SaraRaM, ASayaH, SrayaRaM, SrAyaH, gatiH f., avasTAnaM, araRaM. — (That which shelters, cause of protection) ASrayaH, SaraRaM, saMSrayaH, ASrayaBUtaH -tA -taM, SaraRaBUtaH -tA -taM, ASrayasTAnaM, SaraRyaM, SaraRyuH m., pAlakaH, rakzakaH. — (Resource, expedient) gatiH f., ASrayaH, upAyaH, yuktiH f.; ‘to take refuge,’ ASri (c. 1. -Srayati -yituM), samASri, saMSri, upASri, samupASri, SaraRArTaM gam (c. 1. gacCati, gantuM) or Agam or upe (c. 2. upEti -tuM, rt. i), avalamb (c. 1. -lambate -mbituM), ASrayaRaM kf; ‘having but one refuge,’ ananyagatiH -tiH -ti, ananyagatikaH -kA -kaM; ‘come for refuge,’ SaraRAgataH -tA -taM, SaraRArTam AgataH &c., SaraRApannaH -nnA -nnaM, prapannaH &c.; ‘seeking refuge,’ SaraRArTI -rTinI &c., SaraREzI &c.; ‘one who affords refuge,’ SaraRArpakaH.
REFUGEE: (1) SaraRAgata (f. tA);(2) SaraRaM prapanna (f. nnA); and sim. comp.s.

REFUGEE , s. SaraRAgataH, SaraRArTam AgataH, SaraRArTI m. (n), SaraREzI m. (n), SaraRArTam ASritaH, avalambI m. (n), avalambitaH, prapannaH; ‘protector of refugees, kind to them,’ SaraRAgatapAlakaH, Sara- RAgatavatsalaH, prapannapAlaH -lakaH.
REFULGENCE: Ojjvalyam: v. Brilliancy, splendour.
REFULGENGE , s. pratApaH, atitejas n., mahAtejas n., ujjvalatA, ati- praBA, viBA.
Refulgent, a. dedIpyamAna, viBrAjamAna, BA-svat, ujjvala, atitejasvin, pradyotamAna; See Bright. Refulgence, s. atipraBA-tejas n., OjjvalyaM.
REFULGENT: samujjvala (f. lA): v. Brilliant, splendid.
REFULGENT , a. pratApavAn -vatI -vat (t), atipratApI -pinI -pi (n), supraBaH -BA -BaM, ujjvalaH -lA -laM, dyotI &c., viBrAjamAnaH -nA -naM. See SPLENDID, BRIGHT.
Refund, v. t. pratidA 3 U, prati-f c. (arpayati).
REFUND: pratidadAti (dA, c. 3.): v. To repay.
To REFUND , v. a. pratidA (c. 3. -dadAti -dAtuM), punar dA or pradA or prayam.
REFUSAL: I Rejection, denial:(1) pratyAKyAnam; (2) pratyAdeSaH;(3) by curcumlocircumlo.II Pre-emp- -tion: pUrvakrayADikAraH.

REFUSAL , s. (Denial of a thing demanded) pratyAKyAnaM, pratyAdeSaH, apahnavaH, apahnutiH f., apalApaH, nirasanaM, nirAsaH, nirAkaraRaM, nirA- kftiH f., apavAdaH, nihnavaH, nihnutiH f., nizeDaH, pratizeDaH, vyapAkftiH f., praRayavihatiH f. — (Declining to accept) agrahaRaM, apratigrahaH, aparigrahaH, asvIkAraH, asvIkaraRaM, anaNgIkAraH, anaNgIkaraRaM, nira- sanaM, nirAkaraRaM, ananujYAnaM. — (Of a lover) avaDIraRaM -RA, DIratA -tvaM. — (Right of buying or taking in preference) pUrvvakrayADi- kAraH, pUrvvagrahaRADikAraH.

Refuse, v. t. pratyAKyA 2 P, ni-prati-ziD 1 P, pratyAcakz 2 A, nirAkf 8 U, pratyA-diS 6 P, nir-apa-as 4 U, vi-prati-han 2 P, na saMman 4 A or grah 9 U or aMgIkf or pratIz 6 P, avaDIr 10; ‘pray, do not r(efuse) my request’ nArhasi me praRayaM vihaMtuM (R. ii. 58). 2 (Followed by inf.) Ex. by a sentence with vac, vad &c. (Say, q. v.). s. ucCizwaM, avaSizwaM, ava-SezaH, SezaH-zaM; asAraH, malaM. a. ucCizwa, asAra, avaSizwa.

REFUSE (v.): I Not to grant, decline: na icCati (iz, c. 6. = wish): v. Also to forbid. II To reject: q. v.:(1) pratyAKyAti (KyA, c. 2.), if you r. me being asked: yadi mAM yAcitaH pratyAKyAsyasi, Mah. i. 74. 16.;(2) pratyAcazwe (cakza, c. l.), I r. not for any fault: ahaM pratyAcakze na dozataH, 17.
REFUSE (subs.): (1) ucCizwam;(2) SezaH(3) avaSizwam.

To REFUSE , v. a. (Deny a request or demand, decline to do what is asked) pratyAKyA (c. 2. -KyAti -tuM), antaHKyA, atiKyA, pratyAdiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM), apahnu (c. 2. -hnute -hnotuM), nihnu, apalap (c. 1. -lapati -pituM), niras (c. 4. -asyati -asituM), apAs, nirAkf, pratyAcakz (c. 2. -cazwe), apavad (c. 1. -vadati -dituM), niziD (c. 1. -zeDati zedDuM), pratiziD, apavyay (c. 1. -ayate -yituM), pratyAdeSaM kf, nirAsaM kf, na anujYA, na anuman, na samman. — (Decline to accept, reject) na grah (c. 9. gfhlAti, grahItuM), na pratigrah, agrahaRaM kf, na svIkf, na aNgIkf, niras, apAs, nirAkf, avaDIr (c. 10. avaDIrayati -yituM). The sense of ‘refuse’ may be expressed simply by the negative particle na; as, ‘to refuse to give,’ na dA or even by alaM as alandA.
REFUSE , a. ucCizwaH -zwA -zwaM, avaSizwaH &c., asAraH -rA -raM, niHsAraH &c.
REFUSE , s. ucCizwaM, avaSizwa, SezaH, avaSezaH, SezaBAgaH, udvarttaH, juzwaM, samujJataM, asAraH asAradravyaM, niHsAradravyaM, malaM. See LEAVINGS.

REFUSED , p. p. pratyAKyAtaH -tA -taM, pratyAdizwaH -zwA -zwaM, apahnutaH -tA -taM, nirastaH -stA -staM, nirAkftaH -tA -taM, apavAditaH &c., nizidDaH -dDA [Page669-b+ 51] -dDaM, asvIkftaH &c., anaNgIkftaH &c., ananujYAtaH -tA -taM, ananumataH &c., asammataH &c., avaDIritaH &c.
REFUTABLE: (1) nirAkaraRIya (f. yA);(2) nirasanIya (f. yA); etc.
REFUTABLE , a. KaRqanIyaH -yA -yaM, KaRqyaH -RqyA -RqyaM, KaRqitavyaH -vyA -vyaM, pratyAKyeyaH -yA -yaM, nirasanIyaH &c., upamardanIyaH &c., KaRqanaSakyaH -kapa -kyaM.

REFUTATION: (1) KaRqanam, -nA;(2) nirAsaH, your attempt for its r.: BavatastannirAsaprayAsaH, Khaṇḍana Khaṇḍa;(3) pratikzepaH;(4) vyAkzepaH;(5) bADanam or bADA (= opposition); (6) pratyAKyAnam (gainsaying).

REFUTATION , s. KaRqanaM, vAkyaKaRqanaM, pakzAGAtaH, bADA -DaH, nirAsaH, vAkyanirAsaH, vAkyanirasanaM, nirAkaraRaM, vAkyanirAkaraRaM, pratyAKyAnaM, upamardaH, aDarIkaraRaM, ADarzaRaM, vikzepaH, vitaRqA, jalpaH, aniScayaH; ‘other side of the argument,’ uttarapakzaH.

Refute, v. t. nirAkf 8 U, niras 4 U, pratikzip 6 P, KaMq 10, bAD 1 A, aDarIkf, pratyAKyA 2 P, pratyAdiS 6 P, apavad 1 U, nirDU 5, 9 U, 6 P. [Refut]ation, s. nirAsaH, nirasanaM, KaMqanaM, nirAkaraRaM, pratikzepaH, patyAKyAnaM.

REFUTE (v.): (1) nirAkaroti, r. d evidence pro- duced by a claimant by counter-evidence: vAdikftaM pramARamanyErnirAkarot praBAREH, Si. xx. 18.;(2) nir- asyati, ut-, vyut-, the weapon of the defeated is to be thus r. d: anena BagnasyAstraM nirasanIyam, Khaṇḍana Khaṇḍa;(3) prati-kzipati, vi-, (kzip, c. 6.), r. ing this doctrine: tamimaM pakzaM pratikzipantaH, D. s. vii.;(4) KaRqayati, pari-, vi-, (KaRqa, c. 10. = to break, defeat);(5) bADate, [Page582] pra-, (bAD, c. l. = to oppose), as it cannot be r. d by inference etc.: anumAnAdiBirabADyatvAt, M. n. on Ki. xi. 39;(6) pratyAKyAti (KyA, c. 2.): v. To contradict.

To REFUTE , v. a. vAkyaM KaRq (c. 10. KaRqayati -yituM) or niras (c. 4. -asyati -asituM) or nirAkf, bAD (c. 1. bADate -DituM), pratyAKyA (c. 2. -KyAti -tuM), aDarIkf, ADfz (c. 10. -Darzayati -yituM), saMsUc (c. 10. -sUcayati -yituM), vikzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzeptuM), upamardaM kf, vAkyopamardaM kf, apavad, vitaRqAM kf.

REFUTED , p. p. KaRqitaH -tA -taM, nirastaH -stA -staM, nirAkftaH -tA -taM, bADitaH &c., aDarIkftaH &c., pratyAKyAtaH &c., ADarzitaH &c., vi- kziptaH -ptA -ptaM, upamarditaH &c., nirDUtaH &c., vitaRqitaH &c., nistIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, viKaRqitaH &c.
REFUTER: (1) nirAkartf (f. rtrI);(2) nirAsakArin (f. RI);(3) bADaka (f. DikA);(4) by verb.
REFUTER , s. upamardakaH, vAkyaKaRqakaH, bADakaH, nirAsakArI m. (n).
Regain, v. t. punaH laB 1 A or prAp 5 P, pratipad 4 P; See Recover.
REGAIN: pratilaBate (laB, c. l.): v. To gain, get, again.

To REGAIN , v. a. pratilaB (c. 1. -laBate -labDuM), punar laB, punar upalaB, punaH prAp (c. 5. -Apnoti -AptuM), punar Ap, punar avAp, anuprAp, pratyavAp, pratyAdA (c. 3. -dadAti -datte -dAtuM), punar AdA, pratipad (c. 4. -padyate -pattuM), punar Apad, pratyAhf, punar grah. See To RECOVER, v. a.

REGAINED , p. p. pratilabDaH -bDA -bDaM, punarlabDaH &c., punarupalabDaH &c., pratyupalabDaH &c., punaH prAptaH -ptA -ptaM, punarAptaH &c., punaravAptaH &c., pratipannaH -nnA -nnaM, ApannaH &c. See RECOVERED.
Regal, a. rAjakIya, rAjArha, rAjocita.
REGAL: rAjakIya (f. yA): v. Royal.

REGAL , a. rAjakIyaH -yA -yaM, rAjayogyaH -gyA -gyaM, rAjArhaH -rhA -rhaM, nfpocitaH -tA -taM, rAjasambanDI -nDinI &c., ESvaraH -rI -raM, ESikaH -kI -kaM, ESaH -SI -SaM. See KINGLY, PRINCELY, MAJESTIC. — (Man of the regal class) rAjanyaH, virAw m. (j), kzatriyaH, mUrdDABiziktaH, bAhujaH,
Regale, v. t. saMtfp c., saMtuz c., AhlAd c., AnaMd c. 2 ASvas c., ApyE c., saMvfD c.; See Refresh, ‘r(egale) oneself’ uttamAnnena saMtuz 4 P or saMtfp 4 P or AtmAnaM saMtuz c., utsavaM kf 8 U.
REGALE: santarpayati (c. of tfp): v. To satisfy, entertain.

To REGALE , v. a. santuz (c. 10. -tozayati -yituM), tuz, santfp (c. 10. -tarpayati -yituM), tfp, saMvfD (c. 10. -varDayati -yituM), suK (c. 10. suKa- yati -yituM), Anand in caus.; ‘with choice food,’ paraBAnnEH or BojanaviSezEH santuz, uttamAhAraM Buj in caus. — (Regale one's self) uttamAnnEH santuz (c. 4. -tuzpati -tozwuM) or AtmAnaM santuz in caus., or santfp (c. 4. -tfppati) or AtmAnaM santfp in caus., uttamAhoraM kf, uttamaBojanaM kf, utsavaM kf, mahotsavaM kf.
REGALED , p. p. santozitaH -tA -taM, santarpitaH &c., saMvarDitaH -tA -taM.
Regalia, s. rAjacihnAni-lakzaRAni-liMgAni, rAjopacAraH.
REGALIA: I Lit.:(1) rAjaliNgAni (n. pl.); (2) rAjacihrAni (n. pl.); etc.II In gen.: (1) liNgAni;(2) cihnAni;(3) lakzaRAni.
REGALIA , s. rAjalakzaRAni n. pl., rAjacihnAni n. pl., rAjaliNgAni n. pl., nfpacihnAni n. pl., nfpaliNgAni n. pl., nfpalakzmARi n. pl., rAjESva- ryyacihnAni n. pl.
REGALITY , s. rAjatvaM -tA, nfpatvaM, rAjyaM. See KINGSHIP, ROYALTY.

Regard, v. t. Adf 6 A, prati-ava-Ikz 1 A, saMman c. pUj 10, ni-, sev, 1 A. 2 Ikz, dfS 1 P, A-ava-lok 1 A, 10, A-, lakz 10; See Look. 3 man 4 A, vi-, gaR 10. 4 ava-DA 3 U, avekz, sAvaDAna- a. BU, vigaR, Adf. 5 sev, pA c. (pAlayati), anu-zWA 1 P; See Observe. 6 uddiS 6 P, apekz; saMbaMD 9 P. s. AdaraH, saMmAnaH, pUjA, avekzA. 2 avaDAnaM, manoyogaH, avekzA. 3 dfzwi f., IkzaRaM; See Look. 4 snehaH, praRayaH, anurAgaH, prIti f. 5 vicAraH, avekzA, apekzA, anusaMDAnaM, gaRanA, uddeSaH, saMbaMDaH, anvayaH; vizayaH; ‘having r(egard) to the result’ PalApekzayA; ‘with r(egard) to’ uddiSya, aDikftya, aMtareRa, apekzya, (with acc.); apekzayA, vizaye, gata- a. in comp.; ‘a scandal with r(egard) to Mālavikā’ mAlavikAgataM kOlInaM (M. 3); BartfgatA-vizayA-ciMtA &c. [Regard]ful, a. ave(pe)kzaka, avahita, sAvaDAna, sApekza. [Regard]fully, adv. sApekzaM, sAvaDAnaM. [Regard]ing, a. sApekza, saMbaMDin, gata-vizaya- in comp.; See (s.). [Regard]less, a. nirapekza, anapekza, udAsIna, virakta, anutsuka, in comp. gen.; oft. by anAdftya, anavekzya, agaRayitvA. [Regard]lessly, adv. nirapekzaM, upe-kzayA. [Regard]lessness, s. anapekzA, upekzA.

REGARD (v. t.): I To look at, face: q. v.II To observe, (pay) attention to: q. v.:(1) Adriyate (df, c. 4.), where these three are r. ed: yatrEte traya AdritAH, M. ii. 234.;(2) prati-Ikzate, pratyava-, (Ikz, c. l.), does not r. my partisans: na matpakzAn pratyavekzate, D. viii.: v. Also to res- -pect, care.III To think, consider: q. v.: manyate (man, c. 4.).IV To have relation to: uddiSati (diS, c. 6.), r. ing the god: uddiSya dikpatim, N. xiii. 14.: v. About (III).

REGARD (sub.): I Esteem, respect, honour: q. v.:(1) AdaraH, sam-;(2) pratIkzA or pratyabekzA, to those to whom you should pay r.: pratIkzyezu, R. v. 14.II Consideration, attention, care: q. v.: avekzA. Ph.: to have r. for: avekzate (Ikz, c. l.): v. To regard (II).III Relation, reference: Ph.: with, in r. to:(1) uddiSya, sam-;(2) aDikftya;(3) pratIkzya, etc.

To REGARD , v. a. (Look at, observe) avekz (c. 1. -Ikzate -kzituM), apekz, pratIkz, pratyavekz, aBiprekz, prekz, nirIkz, vIkz, samIkz, Ikz, dfS (c. 1. paSyati, drazWuM), pratidfS, anudfS, aBidfS, Alok (c. 10. -lokayati -yituM), samAlok, Aloc, Alakz, samAlakz, lakz. — (Point or be directed towards) uddiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM), samu- ddiS. — (Mind, heed) man (c. 4. manyate, mantuM), anuman, mananaM kf, apekz, avekz, avekzaRaM kf, apekzAM kf, avaDA (c. 3. -Datte -DAtuM), ava- DAnaM kf, sAvaDAnaH -nA -naM BU, avahitaH -tA -taM BU or as. — (Esteem, [Page670-a+ 51] respect) man (c. 10. nAnayati -yituM), samman, pratiman, aBiman, pUj, sev, nizev, Baj, avekz, Adf, aBinand, sammAnaM kf — (Keep, observe) pAl, pratipAl, sev, nizev, upasev. — (Have relation to) pratikz, apekz, uddiS.

REGARD , s. REGULATION , s. (The act of regulating) avasTApanaM, vyavasTitiH f., viniyamaH, vyavasTA, anuSAsanaM, SAsanaM, viDAnaM, saMviDAnaM, parikalpanaM, viDAraRaM -RA, yantraRaM, praRayanaM, anunayaH -yanaM. — (Rule) niyamaH, vini- yamaH, viDiH m., viDAnaM, vyavasTA, vyavasTitiH f., sTitiH f., sUtraM, kramaH, maryyAdA.
REGULATOR: (1) SAsaka (f. sikA), anu-;(2) niyantf (f. ntrI), vi-, (= controller).
REGULATOR , s. niyantA m. (ntf), viniyantA m., anuSAsakaH, SAsakaH, SAstA m. (stf), anuSAstA m., viDAtA m. (tf), vyavasTATakaH, parikalpakaH.
REHEARSAL: I Recital, narration: q. v.: pAWaH.II Previous practice: perh. prayogaH: v. To rehearse (II)

REHEARSAL , s. (Repetition of the words of another) paWanaM, pAWaH, anuvAdaH, vAcanaM, anuvAcanaM, ulleKaH -KanaM. — (Narration) kaTanaM, AKyAnaM. — (Recital in preparation for the public represen- tation) BAvyanukaraRaM, pUrvvABinayaH -yanaM.
Rehearse, v. t. paW 1 P, anuvad 1 P. 2 kaT 10, varR 10; See Narrate. 3 prayogAt pUrvaM aBinI 1 P or nad 10. [Rehears]al, s. paWanaM, anuvAdaH; kaTanaM, AKyAnaM, pUrvaprayogaH, pUrvABinayaH.
REHEARSE: I To recite, narrate: q. v.: paWati (paW, c. 1.).II To practise beforehand: prayuMkte (yuj, c. 7.), Bharata will have it r. d by the nymphs: BaratastamapsaroBiH prayojayizyati, U. iv.

To REHEARSE , v. a. (Repeat the words of another) paW (c. 1. paWati -WituM), sampaW, anuvad, paWanaM kf anuvAdaM kf. — (Narrate) kaT, AKyA, Sru in caus. — (Recite, preparatory to a public re- presentation) BAvyanukaraRaM kf, pUrvvABinayaM kf.
REHEARSED , p. p. paWitaH -tA -taM, anuvAditaH &c., pUrvvABinItaH -tA -taM.

Reign, v. i. pra-, SAs 2 P, rAjyaM-mahIM &c. SAs or av 1 P or Buj 7 U. 2 Prevail, q. v. s. SAsanaM, rAjyapAlanaM, ADipatyaM, aDikAraH; better by (v.) with loc. abs.; ‘during Rāmaʼs r(eign)’ rAme mahIM SAsati; ‘after a r(eign) of 12 years’ dvAdaSAbdAn BuktakzitO tasmin. 2 rAjyaSAsanakAlaH, rAjyakAlaH. [Reign]ing, a. rAjapadArUQa, SAsat, rAjyADikArin.

REIGN (v.): (1) SAsti, pra- (SAs, c. 2.), Daśaratha r. ed at the head of the sages and r. ing (princes): daSaraTaH praSaSAsa.. yamavatAmavatAYca Duri sTitaH, R. ix. 1.;(2) avati (av, c. l.: rare);(3) rAjyaM, BahIM, etc. SAsti, while a Paurava is r. ing: pOrave vasumatIM SAsati, Sa. i.

REIGN (subs.): (1) SAsanam;(2) rAjyaSAsanam and sim. comp.s.;(3) by verb, during whose r.: yasmin mahIM SAsati, R. vi. 75.; when he was thus killed after a r. of twelve years: BuktakzitO dvAdaSAbdAMstasmin vyApAdite taTA, Raj. iv. 686.
To REIGN , v. n. rAjyaM kf, rAjatvaM kf, rAjyapAlanaM kf, rAjyaSAsanaM kf, rAjyADikAraM kf, rAjavyavahAraM kf, rAjakAryyaM kf, ADipatyaM kf, siMhA- sanArUQaH -QA -QaM BU.
REIGN , s. rAjyaM, rAjatvaM -tA, ADipatyaM. — (Period of rule) rAjyaSA sanakAlaH, rAjyakAlaH, ADipatyakAlaH. — (Prevalence), see the word.
REIGNING , part. or a. rAjyakArI -riRI -ri(n), rAjyaSAsanakArI &c., rAjyA- rUQaH -QA -QaM, siMhAsanArUQaH &c., rAjapadArUQaH &c., rAjyADikArI &c.
Reimburse, v. t. pratidA 3 U, nizkf U, apAkf, pUr 10, SuD c.
REIMBURSE: gen expr. by dadAti (dA, c. 3. = to pay: q. v.).
REIMBURSEMENT: (1) pariSoDaH, -nam;(2) niryAtanam (= repayment);(3) kzatipUraRam (of any loss).

sanskrit.slp1: SiTilA taTottaravatI mandA ca vEhAyasI vikziptEkakarArdDa-
sanskrit.word: शिथिला तथोत्तरवती मन्दा च वैहायसी विक्षिप्तैककरार्द्ध-
sanskrit.iast: śithilā tathottaravatī mandā ca vaihāyasī vikṣiptaikakarārddha-

details.body: Rein, s. aBISuH-zuH, pragrahaH, raSmiH; ‘by drawing in the r(ein)s’ raSmisaMyamanAt (S. 1); ‘give the r(ein)s to’ vaSaM yA 2 P; AyattIBU 1 P, aDIna- a. BU; ‘r(ein)s of government’ rAjyasUtrARi. v. t. ni-saM-yam 1 P, ni-pra-grah 9 P; See Control; ‘r(ein) in the horses’ pragfhyaMtAM vAjinaH (S. 1).

REIN (subs.): I Lit.:(1) aBIzuH (SuH), hold, slacken the r. s: pragfhyantAM, mucyantAm aBIzavaH, Sa.; (2) pragra (grA) haH, I am holding the r. s: DftAH, pragrahAH, Sa.;(3) raSmiH from tightening of r. s: raSmisaMyamanAt, Sa.;(4) valgA, adept in the use of r. s: valgAviBAgakuSalaH, Si. v. 60.; “utkziptA SiTilA taTottaravatI mandA ca vEhAyasI vikziptEkakarArdDa- kanDarasamotkIrRA viBaktA taTA . atyutkziptatalodDwate Kalu taTA vyAgUQagokarRike vAhAnANkaTitAScaturdaSaviDA valgA- praBedA amI ..”, M. n.II Fig. expr. by circumlo.: v. Government, power.
REIN (v.): saMyacCati (yam, c. l.): v. To control, govern.
REIN , s. (Of a horse) raSmiH m., aBISuH m., aBIzuH m., pragrahaH, pragrAhaH, vasuH m., vAgA, valgA, dantAlikA. — (Reins), see the word.
To REIN , v. a. aSvaM raSmiBir yam (c. 1. yacCati, yantuM) or saMyam or niyam or nigrah (c. 9. -gfhlAti -grahItuM) or pragrah.
REINDEER: valgAhariRaH (in Bengali) and sim. comp.s.
Reinforce, v. t. Recruit, q. v. [Reinforce]ment, s. sEnyaM, senAsAmagrI.
Reins, s. kawi-wI f., kawi-SroRI-deSaH. 2 vfkkO.
REINS (pl.): bukkO (m. dual): v. Kidney.
REINS , s. pl. (Lower part of the back) kawiH -wI, kawideSaH, SroRiH -RI f., SroRideSaH, kawipaScAdBAgaH. — (Kidneys), see KIDNEY.
Reinstate, v. t. prati-zWA c. (-zWApayati), punaH sTA c. or niyuj 7 A, 10. [Reinstate]ment, s. pratizWApanaM, punarniyogaH, punaHsTApanaM.
REINSTATE: pratizWApayati (c. of sTA): v. To restore, place, again.
REINSTATEMENT: (1) pratizWApanam;(2) by circumlo.
REINVIGORATE: pratyASvAsayati (c. of Svas): v. To refresh.
Reiterate, v. t. Repeat, q. v. 2 punaH punaH kf 8 U. [Reiterat]ed, a. punaH punarukta; pOnaHpunika (kI f.). [Reiterat]ion, s. punarvacanaM, AmreqanaM, puna-rukti f., pOnaHpunyaM.
REITERATE: samaBiharati (hf, c.1.): v. To repeat.
REITERATION: samaBihAraH: v. Repetition.

Reject, v. t. avaDIr 10, nirAkf 8 U, pratyAKyA 2 P, vi-han 2 P, pratyAcakz 2 A; pratyAdiS 6 P, nir-apa-as 4 U, nirDU 5, 9 U, prati-apa-kzip 6 P, tyaj 1 P; See Refuse. [Reject]ion, s. avaDIraRaM-RA, nirAkaraRam, pratyAdeSaH, pratyAKyAnaM, nirasanaM.

REJECT (1) pratyAKyAti (KyA, c. 2.), she r. ed the gods: tayA lokapAlAH pratyAKyAtAH, Mah;(2) pratyAdiSati (diS, c. 6.), r. ed him without saying (a word): pratyAdideSEnamamAzamARA, R. vi. 25.; pratyAcazwe (cakz, c. 2.), should not r. beds etc.: SayyAdIni na pratyAcakzIta, K. b. on M. iv. 250.;(4) nir-asyati, apa-, (as, c. 4. = to discard), the lotus r. ed bees: padminI BfNgaM nirAsa, B. ii. 6.: v. To dispel, throw away; (5) avaDIrayati (= to disregard);(6) nirAkaroti (kf, c. 8. = with contumely).

To REJECT , v. a. niras (c. 4. -asyati -situM), apAs, vyudas, pratyA- KyA (c. 2. -KyAti -tuM), nirAkf, parAkf, pratikzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzeptuM), vikzip, tyaj (c. 1. tyajati, tyaktuM), nirRud (c. 6. -Rudati -RottuM), pratyAdiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM), apAhA (c. 3. -jahAti -hAtuM), pratyAcakza (c. 2. -cazwe), nirDU (c. 5. -DUnoti -DotuM), apavyaD (c. 4. -viDyati -vyadDuM), vyapavyaD, vfj (c. 10. varjayati -yituM), avaDIr (c. 10. avaDIrayati -yituM), na svIkf, na grah, asvIkAraM kf, agrahaRaM kf. See To REFUSE.

REJECTED , p. p. nirastaH -stA -staM, apAstaH &c., vyudastaH &c., pratyAKyAtaH -tA -taM, nirAkftaH -tA -taM, parAkftaH &c., pratikziptaH -ptA -ptaM, nikziptaH &c., vikziptaH &c., pratyAdizwaH -zwA -zwaM, apavidDaH -dDA -dDaM, nirDUtaH -tA -ta, avaDIritaH &c., tyaktaH -ktA -ktaM, parityaktaH &c., varjitaH &c., asvIkftaH &c.
REJECTION: (1) pratyAKyAnam;(2) pratyAdeSaH;(3) nirAkftiH (with contumely);(4) by verb.

REJECTION , s. nirasanaM, nirAsaH, nirAkftiH f., nirAkaraRaM, nikftiH f., pratyAKyAnaM, pratyAdeSaH, pratikzepaH, tyAgaH, paritvAgaH, barjanaM, apavarjanaM, [Page672-a+ 51] visarjanaM, asvIkAraH, anaNgIkAraH, agrahaRaM, avaDIraRaM -RA.

Rejoice, v. i. prI pass. mud 1 A, AnaMd 1 P, saM-pari-tuz 4 P, hfz 4 P, ram 1 A, ullas 1 P; See Delight, ‘I r(ejoice) to see you’ prItosmi te darSanAt, tvaddarSanena mudi-tosmi; ‘this is to be r(ejoic)ed at’ etadaBi-naMdanIyaM (S. 5). v. t. Causal of roots above. [Rejoic]ing, a. AnaMdada, harzAvaha, harzakara (rI f.). 2 prIyamARa, mudita, hfzwa. s. AnaMdaH, harzaH, pramodaH, utsavaH.
REJOICE (v. i.): (1) hfzyati, pra-, sam-, (hfz, c. 4.); (2) modate, pra-, (mud, c. 2.);(3) prIyate (pass. [Page584] of prI = to be pleased): v. To be delighted.
REJOICE (v. t.): harzayati, pra-, saM-, (c. of hfz): v. To delight, please.

To REJOICE , v. n. Anand (c. 1. -nandati -ndituM), aBinand, vinand, nand, hfz (c. 4. hfppati, harzituM), prahfz, saMhfz, samprahfz, hlAd (c. 1. hlAdate -dituM), AhlAd, prahlAd, ullam (c. 1. -lasati -situM), samullas, prollas, ram (c. 1. ramate, rantuM), aBiram, Aram, saMram, tup (c. 4. tuzyati, tozwuM), parituz, santuz, mud (c. 1. modate -dituM), pramud, pratimud, prI (c. 4. prIyate, pretuM), samprI, mad (c. 4. mAdyati, madituM), AnanditaH -tA -taM BU, hfzwaH -zwA -zwaM BU, harzaM or AnandaM gam or i.

To REJOICE , v. a. Anand (c. 10. -nandayati -yituM), aBinand, nand, hfp, (c. 10. harzayati -yituM), prahfp, parihfp, hlAd (c. 10. hlAdayati -yituM), prahlAd, AhlAd, ram (c. 10. ramayati -yituM), ullas (c. 10. -lAsayati -yituM), tuz (c. 10. tozayati -yituM), santuz, tfp (c. 10. tarpayati -yituM), pramud (c. 10. -modayati -yituM), mud, prI (c. 9. prIRAti, c. 10. prIRa- yati -yituM), AnandaM or harzaM jan (c. 10. janayati -yituM), AnanditaM -tAM kf, AnandaM dA.

REJOICED , p. p. AnanditaH -tA -taM, nanditaH &c., AhlAditaH &c., harzitaH &c., hfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, praharzitaH -tA -taM, ullasitaH &c., ullAsitaH &c., tuzwaH -zwA -zwaM, parituzwaH &c., harzayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, harzAvizwaH -zwA -zwaM; ‘in mind,’ hfzwamanAH -nAH -naH (s), hfzwamAnasaH -sA -saM, hfzwahfdayaH -yA -yaM.

REJOICING , part. act. nandakaH -kA -kaM, AnandakaH &c., nandanaH -nA -naM, AnandanaH &c., AnandadaH -dA -daM, AnandakaraH -rA -raM, harzadaH -dA -daM, harzakaH -kA -kaM, harzapradaH &c., AhlAdakaH &c., modakaH &c., harzaRaH -RA -RaM, utsavakaraH -rA -raM. — Neut. part. harzamARaH -RA -RaM, ramamARaH -RA -RaM, modamAnaH -nA -naM, prIyamARaH &c., samprIyamARaH &c.
REJOICING , s. AnandaH -ndanaM, harzaH -rzaRaM, AhlAdaH -danaM, nandanaM, pramodaH -danaM, santozaRaM, see JOY. — (Public rejoicing) utsavaH, utsavakaraRaM.
Rejoin, v. See ‘Answer’. Rejoinder, s. prativacanaM, uttaraM, pratyukti f.
REJOIN: I To come again: q. v.: punar eti (i, c. 2.): v. Also to join.II To answer, reply: q. v.: prativakti (vac, c. 2.).
To REJOIN , v. n. prativac (c. 2. -vakti -ktuM), punarvac, prativad, pratyuttaraM kf.
REJOINDER: prativAdaH: v. Reply.
REJOINDER , s. prativAkyaM, prativacanaM, uttaraM, pratyuttaraM, uttarapakzaH, pratyuktiH f., pratyuktaM, pratyarTaM, kakzA, uttarottaraM. See REPLY.
Rejuvenate, v. t. balaM-satvaMsattvaM-vfD c., A-pyE c.

Relapse, v. i. punaH pat 1 P or Agam 1 P or prAp 5 P; oft. ex. by punaH with other words; ‘r(elaps)ed into a feverish state’ jvareRa punaraByaBUyata, punaH jvarAturo baBUva; ‘r(elaps)ed into vice’ punardurmArgaM gaMtuM pracakrame, satpa-TAt BrazwaH, sanmArgaM atyajat; ‘r(elaps)ed into his natural joviality’ sahajAmAnaMdavfttiM pratyapadyata. s. punaHpatanaM, Avftti f., pratyAga-manaM, pUrvAvasTAprApti f.
RELAPSE (v.): to r. into fever: punarjvareRABiBUyate (pass. of BU), Akramyate (pass of kram), etc.; to r. into vice: punarapanTAnaM gacCati or utpaTaM yAti etc.: v. Also to fall back.
RELAPSE (subs.): (1) gen. by circumlo.;(2) punaHpatanaM or -pAtaH (= falling again).

To RELAPSE , v. n. punaH pat (c. 1. patati -tituM), punar Agam (c. 1. -gacCati -gantuM), punar Avft (c. 1. -varttate -rttituM), pratyAvft, paryAvft, Avft, punargrastaH -stA -staM BU, punaH pIqitaH &c. BU, punarAvizwaH -zwA -zwaM BU; ‘relapse into a former state,’ pUrvvAvasTAM or pUrvvadaSAM gam or Apad or i or prAp, pUrvvavad BU; ‘relapse into vice,’ punar vyasanI BU, punar vyaBicArI BU, punar vyaBicAraM kf, punar vyaBicar, punar DarmmAd BraMS, punar Darmma tyaj, punaH satyaTAd BraMS or cyu or vical or utkram; ‘relapse into a fever,’ punar jvaragrastaH -stA -staM BU, punarjvarI -riRI &c. BU, punarjvarAturaH -rA -raM BU.

RELAPSE , s. punaHpatanaM, AvfttiH f., AvarttanaM, pratyAvfttiH f., pratyAvarttanaM, paryAvarttaH, pratyAgamaH; ‘into a former state,’ pUrvvAvasTAprAptiH f.; ‘into vice,’ punarvyaBicAraH, punarDarmmatyAgaH, punarGarmmAdBraMSaH, punaHsatpaTA- dBraMSaH; ‘into a fever,’ punarjvaragrastatA.

Relate, v. i. (To) uddiS 6 P, apekz 1 A, anuzaMj-saMbaMD pass.; by deriv. in Iya, or vizaya in comp.; ‘r(elat)ing to Sastras’ SAstrIya, SAstravizaya; ‘news r(elat)ing to the kingʼs murder’ rAjaGAta vizayakaH-saMbadDaH-vfttAMtaH; See Refer. v. t. kaT 10, AKyA 2 P, varR 10, SaMs 1 P, cakz 2 A, A-ni-vid c.; See Tell. [Relat]ed, a. kaTita, KyAta, varRita, &c. 2 saM-anu-badDa, anuzakta, anvita, saMsakta, saMpfkta, saMbaMDin, saMparkin, in comp. 3 saMbaMDin, sajAti, sajAtIya, eka-sa-gotra, sakulya, gotraja, ekaSarIrAnvaya. [Relat]er, s. AKyAyakaH, kaTayitf m. [Relat]ing, a. (To) saMbaMDin, vizaya in comp.; See Refer. [Relat]ion, s. saMbaMDaH, anvayaH, saMdarBaH, saMsargaH, saMparkaH, anuzaMgaH, BAvaH; ‘mutual r(elation)’ vyatizaMgaH, anyonyasaMbaMDaH, AkAMkzA (between a word and its meaning); ‘intimate r(elation)’ samavAya-nitya-saMbaMDaH; ‘the r(elaion) of the container and the thing contained’ ADArADeyaBAvaH. 2 baMDutA, jYAtiBAvaH, SarIrasaMbaMDaH, SarIrAnvayaH, sajAtitvaM, sagotratA, sapiMqatA. 3 baMDuH, bAMDavaH, jYAtiH, gotrajaH, sagotrajaH, sakulyaH, saMbaMDI, sapiMqaH (to the 7th degrees), samAnodakaH (8th to 14th degree); sanABiH, sodaryaH, samAnodaraH (by blood); ‘r(elation)s collectively’ bAMDavagaRaH-janaH, baMDu-jYAti-vargaH. 4 A-upA-KyAnaM, varRanaM, kaTanaM, nirUpaRaM, kIrtanaM. [Relat]ionship, s. baMDutA, sanABitA, jYAtiBAvaH, saMbaMDaH; ‘near r(elationship)’ pratyAsannatA; ‘distant r(elationship)’ vyavahitatA. [Relat]ive, s. sagotraH, sakulyaH, bAMDavaH, baMDuH, jYAtiH; See Relation. a. sApekza, avivikta, anyasA-pekza, akevala; ‘r(elative) importance’ tAratamyaM. 2 anyonyAnvita. 3 saMbaMDin, vizayaka, in comp.; anuvidDa, anuzakta, saMbadDa, sAnvaya, uddizwa. 4 saMbaMDavAcin. [Relat]ively, adv. anyApekzayA, anyasApekzaM, apekzya; See Comparative.

RELATE (v. i.): I To refer: q. v.:(1) uddiSati, sam-, (diS, c. 6.);(2) saMbaDyate (pass. of banD);(3) by a deriv. in Iya (f. yA), the story r. ing to the hawk and the dove: SyenakapotIyamupAKyAnam, Mah. i. 2. 168.: v. About (III)II To stand in relation to: expr. by sanABi (mfn. = r. d. by blood) or sambanDin (f. nI = r. d by marriage): v. Relative (I), Relation (IV).

RELATE (v. t.): (1) AKyAti, samA-, upA-, aBi-, (KyA, c. 2.), please r. it to me: tanmamAKyA- tumarhasi, Mah. iii. 52. 59.;(2) varRayati, upa-, sam-, anu-, (varR, c. 10. = to describe: q. v.); (3) A-cazwe, sam-, (cakz, c. 2.), please r. this to (me) asking (about it): etadAcakzva pfcCataH, Mah. iii. 99. 40.;(4) vakti, pra-, (vac, c. 2.), I will r. all this: etatsarvaM pravakzyAmi, Mah. iii. 107. 46.: v. To say.;(5) kaTayati (kaT, c. 10.).: v. To tell;(6) SrAvayati, anu-, (c. of Sru = to cause to hear: with double acc.).

To RELATE , v. a. kaT (c. 10. kaTayati -yituM), saMkaT, AKyA (c. 2. -KyAti -tuM), samAKyA, KyA in caus. (KyApayati -yituM), aBiKyA, SaMs (c. 1. SaMsati -situM), Sru in caus., ASru, saMSru vad, nivid, Avid, Acakz, samAcakz, pracakz, varR, upavarR, anuvarR, saMvarR, ni- gad, udAhf, vyAhf, aBiDA, vivf, vivaraRaM kf, kFt, anukFt, vft in caus., kaTanaM kf, see To NARRATE, TELL; ‘to relate over again,’ punar AKyA, sampratyAcakza.

To RELATE , v. n. (Have reference) uddiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM), apekz (c. 1. -Ikzate -kzituM), vizayakaH -kA -kaM BU, samranD in pass. (-baDyate). [Page672-b+ 51] sambadDaH -dDA -dDaM BU, sambanDa &c. BU. See To REFER.

RELATED , p. p. RELATER: (1) AKyAyaka (f. yikA);(2) kaTaka (f. kaTikA);(3) by verb.

RELATION: I Narration:(1) AKyAnam, sam-; (2) varRanam, -nA, upa-;(3) SaMsanam;(4) by verb. II Narrative: q. v.: AKyAnam.III Refer- -ence: q. v.IV Connexion: q. v.:(1) sambanDaH (= gen.: specially of r. by marriage), closely related Rākṣasas: aBinnasambanDA rAkzasAH, Vi. iv.; it is said r. is formed by conversation: sambanDamABAzaRapUrvamAhuH, R. ii. 58.;(2) sapiRqatA or sApiRqyam (of agnates): v. Relative (1); (3) not expr., what r. do you bear to him: ko'sya BavAn.V Relative (I): q. v.

RELATION , s. (Act of telling) kaTanaM, AKyAnaM, upakaTanaM, upAKyAnaM, KyAzanaM, varRanaM -nA, SaMsanaM, vivaraRaM, vyAharaRaM, anukIrttanaM, nirUpaRaM, SrAvaRaM, nivedanaM, udgAraH; ‘exact relation of particulars,’ vastu- kaTanaM, vfttAntakaTanaM, vastusTitikaTanaM. — (Reference) vipayatvaM, sambanDaH, uddeSaH, anvayaH, apekzA, gocaratvaM; ‘in reference to,’ apekzayA, uddiSya, see REFERENCE, REGARD. — (Connexion) sambanDaH -nDitvaM, aBisa- mbanDaH, samparkaH, anvayaH, samanvayaH, sandarBaH, anupaNgaH, saMsaktiH f., samAsaktiH f., saMsargaH; ‘mutual relation,’ anyonyasambanDaH, miTaHsambanDaH vyatizaNgaH; ‘intimate and inseparable relation, as of properties with substances,’ samavAyaH, samavAyasambanDaH, nityasambanDaH; ‘as of material with produce,’ samavAyikAraRaM. — (Connexion by blood, alliance of kin) ekaSarIratA, ekaSarIrasambanDaH, ekaSarIrAnvayaH, ekaSarIrA- vayavatvaM, jYAtitvaM, jYAtiBAvaH, sambanDitvaM, banDutA, bAnDavatvaM, sajAtitvaM, sagarBatvaM, samAnodaryyatA sodaryyatA, sagotratvaM, ekagotratA, samagotratA, gotra- sambanDaH, ekaraktasambanDaH, samaraktasambanDaH, sapiRqatA, ekapiRqatA, sApiRqyaM. — (Connexion on the mother's side, or by marriage) yonisambanDaH, SarIrasamranDaH, AptaBAvaH, AptatA. — (Kinsman) bAnDavaH, banDuH m., banDujanaH, gotrabanDuH m., jYAtiH m., svajYAtiH m., gotrajanaH, gotrapuruzaH, gotrajaH, samranDI m. (n), sapiRqaH, samAnodakaH, kuwumbI m., svakuwumbI, see KINSMAN; ‘relations,’ banDuvargaH, bAnDavAH m. pl., jYAtivargaH, bAnDavagaRaH, see KINDRED; ‘having relations,’ sabAnDavaH -vA -vaM, kOwusrikaH -kI -kaM. The sapiRqaH is a relation con- nected by be offering of the funeral cake to the manes of common ancestors; the samAnodakaH is connected by the offering of water only.

RELATIONSHIP: (1) sambanDaH (gen. term);(2) pratyAsannatA (= near r.), among these, first of all come one's own kinsmen on account of near r.: tatrApi pratyasannatvAt praTamamAtmabanDavaH, Mit.;(3) vyavahitatA (= distant r.);(4) sanABitA (by blood);(5) banDutA (= through females): v. Relative (I).
RELATIONSHIP , s. sambanDaH, sambanDitvaM, banDutA -tvaM, vAnDavatvaM -tA, jYAtitvaM, jYAtiBAvaH, jYAteya, sajAtitvaM. See under RELATION.

RELATIVE: I Kinsman:(1) sapiRqa (f. RqA, agnates up to the seventh degree), near r. s inherit the property of a childless (man), in their absence distant r. s: aputraDanADikAryAsanna- sapiRqastadaBAve vyavahitaH. Viv.;(2) samAnodaka (f. kA: 8th to 14th.), Mit.;(3) sagotra (f. trA) or gotraja (f. jA = of the same gotra); (4) banDuH or bAnDavaH (through females);(5) sanABi (mfn.: by blood);(6) jYAtiH (= 5); (7) sakulya (f. lyA = of the same class);(8) sometimes not expr., in the absence of any r.: sarvAmAve, Mit.II Not absolute:(1) sApekza (f. kzA);(2) by circumlo. Ph.: r. knowledge: sApekzabudDiH, Par. 107.III In gram.: *sambanDa- dyotaka (f. tikA) and sim. comp.s.

(Having relation) sambanDI -nDinI -nDi (n), sambanDakaH -kA -ka, sambanDIyaH -yA -yaM, vizayakaH -kA -kaM, anuzaNgI &c., Anuza- NgikaH -kI -kaM, samparkI &c., sasambanDaH -nDA -nDaM, sasamparkaH -rkA -rkaM. sAnvayaH -yA -yaM, uddeSakaH -kA -kaM, parAyaRaH -RA -RaM. — (Not abso- [Page673-a+ 51] lute) anyApekzakaH -kA -kaM, anyasApekzaH -kzA -kzaM, sApekzaH &c., anyo- ddeSakaH &c., akevalaH -lA -laM. — (Correlative, mutually related) anyonyasambanDI &c., anyonyASritaH -tA -ta, anyonyAnvitaH &c. — (In grammar) tatpadApekzakaH -kA -kaM, tatpadApekzI &c.
RELATIVE , s. banDuH m., bAnDavaH, sambanDI m. (n), jYAtiH m. See KINSMAN.

SraTnAti, SranTituM), SlaTIkf, sraMs (c. 10. sraMsayati -yituM), visraMs, srastIkf, visrastIkf, vigal in caus. — (Remit) muc (c. 6. muYcati, moktuM, c. 10. mocayati -yituM), vimuc, avamuc, avasfj (c. 6. -sfjati -srazwuM), visfj. — (Abate, diminish) Sam (c. 10. SAmyati, SamituM), upaSam, praSam, nyUnIBU. — (Remit in close attention) udyogaSETilyaM kf, SiTilodyogaH -gA -gaM BU.
RELAXATION: I The act: SiTilIkaraRam.II The state: SETilyam or SiTilatA: v. Also abatement, decrease.III Diversion, amusement: q. v.: vinodaH.

SAmyati, SamituM), SAntiM or sAntvaM gam.

To REMEDY , v. a. pratikf, pratisamADA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM), mamADA, upAyena pratikf or Sam (c. 10. Samayati -yituM), kit in des. (ciki- tsati -tsituM), svasTaM -sTAM kf, pariCid (c. 7. -Cinatti -CettuM), upacAraM kf, upAyaprayogaM kf, Bizaja (nom. Bizajyati), OzaDAkf; ‘by mild measures,’ sAmopAyEH pratikf.
REMELT: punardravati (dru, c. l.: intrans.) or drAvayati (c. of dru: trans.): v. To melt.

Remember, v. t. smf 1 P, saM-anu-, (with gen. when regret is shown), anu-ciMt 10, anu-buD 1 P, 4 A. 2 (Keep in mind) smf, hfdaye-citte ni-upa-DA 3 U, manasi kf 8 U, ava-Df 10; ‘please, r(emember) these words well’ hfdi enAM (BAratIM) upaDAtumarhasi (R. viii. 77); ‘r(emember) me to your brother’ smartavyohaM tava BrAtuH. Remembrance, s. smaraRaM, smfti f., anuciMtanaM, avaDAraRaM-RA. 2 smA-rakaM, smAraRaM, smaraRavastu, aBijYAnaM; ‘r(emembrance) of love’ prItyaBijYAnaM. [Remembranc]er, s. smArakaH, udboDakaH.

REMEMBER: I To recollect: smarati, saM-, anu-, (smf, c. l.: with acc. or gen.), I do not r. having accepted this lady: na Kalu svIkaraRamatraBavatyAH smarAmi, Sa. v.; r. ing the powers of the son of Indra: anusmftAKaRqalasUnuvikramaH, Ki. i. 24.: v. Also to think of.II To keep in mind: (1) smarati, r. what you say: smarasi KalvetadAtmano vacanam, V. i.;(2) hfdaye nidaDAti (DA, c. 3.) and sim. expr. s, N. ii. 47.III To remind: q. v.

To REMEMBER , v. a. smf (c. 1. smarati, smattu), anusmf, saMsmf, anusaMsmf, aBisaMsmf, anucint (c. 10. -cintayati -yituM), samanucint, anubuD (c. 4. -buDyate -bodDuM), smaraRaM kf, hfdaye kf, manasi kf. — (Recollect) smf, aBijYA. See To RECOLLECT.
REMEMBERED , p. p. smftaH -tA -taM, saMsmftaH &c., hfdayasTaH -sTA -sTaM, hfdgataH &c.
REMEMBERER , s. smarttA m. (rttf), smaraRakft, smftimAn m. (t), anucintakaH.

REMEMBRANCE: I In gen.: smaraRam or smftiH, saM-, anu-, the favour of your r.: anugrahaM saMsmaraRa- pravfttam, Ku. iii. 3.; dispelled by r.: smftiBinna-, Sa. vii. 22.II A memorial:(1) smaraRacihnam, and sim. comp. s;(2) perh. simply smaraRam or smftiH;(3) by adv. smaraRArTam.

REMEMBRANCE , s. smaraRaM, smftiH f., saMsmftiH f., saMsmaraRaM, anusmftiH f., smarttftvaM, avismftiH f., anucintA, DAraRaM -RA, avaDAraRaM; ‘continual remembrance,’ santatasmaraRaM. See RECOLLECTION. — (Memorial, memento) smArakavastu n., smArakavizayaH, smAraRaM, smaraRArTakavastu n., smfticihnaM; ‘of friendship,’ prItidAnaM, prItidAyaM. See MEMORIAL.
REMEMBRANCER: smAraka (f. rikA). Ph.: legal r.: *smftiSAsakaH.
REMEMBRANCER , s. smArakaH, smAraRaH -RaM, udboDakaH, smaraRakArI m. (n).

Remind, v. t. smf c., anu-saM-°, ud-pra-anu-buD c.; ‘this group of gallants, as if, r(emind)s me to-day of Pātala’ pAtAlaM mAmadya saMsmarayatIva BujaMgalokaH (Rat. 1), ‘Oh I am well r(emind)ed’ aye samyaganuboDitosmi (S. 1). [Remind]er, s. udboDakaH, anuboDakaH.

REMIND: smArayati, saM-, anu-, (c. of smf: with two acc.), these wild mountain sceneries r. me the Deccan mountains: etA araRyagiriBUmayaH smArayanti [mAM] dakziRAraRyaBUDarAn, Ma. ix.; constantly r. ing the attendants of Śiva of the conflagration of Tripura: muhuranusmarayantaM.. tripuradAhamumApatisevinaH, Ki. v. 14.

To REMIND , v. a. smf (c. 10. smArayati -yituM), saMsmf, anusmf, buD (c. 10. boDayati -yituM), udbuD, prabuD, pratibuD, sUc (c. 10. sUcayati -yituM), smAraRaM kf, smftiM or smaraRaM jan (c. 10. janayati -yituM), sUcanaM kf. The construction of the sentence will require 2 acc.; as, ‘the Kandalī with its flowers reminds me of her eyes,’ kusumEH kandalI smArayati mAM locane tasyAH; ‘the Vimba reminds me of her lower lip,’ vimbaM smArayati mAm aDaraM tasyAH.
REMINDED , p. p. smAritaH -tA -taM, udboDitaH -tA -taM, udbudDaH -dDA -dDaM.
REMINDING , REMINDER, part. or s. smArakaH -kA -kaM, smftijanakaH -kA -kaM, smAraRaH -RA -RaM, udboDakaH -kA -kaM, upalamBakaH -kA -kaM.
Reminiscence, s. smfti f., smaraRaM; See Memory.
REMINISCENCE: smaraRam: v. Remembrance, memory.
REMINISCENCE , s. smftiH f., smaraRaM. See MEMORY, RECOLLECTION.

Remiss, a. anavaDAna, asAvaDAna, pramatta, nirapekza, upekzaka, maMdAdara, SiTilodyama; ‘to be r(emiss)’ pramad 4 P (with abl.). [Remiss]ly, adv. anavaDAnena, upekzayA, nirapekzaM, pramAdena. [Remiss]ness, s. anavaDAnaM, upekzA, nirape(ve)-kzA, pramAdaH, SETilyaM.
REMISS: (1) anavahita (f. tA): v. Careless, negligent;(2) SiTila (f. lA = lack).

REMISS . a. anavaDAnaH -nA -naM, anavahitaH -tA -taM, asAvaDAnaH &c., upekzakaH -kA -kaM, nirapekzaH -kzA -kzaM, mandAdaraH -rA -raM, avyavasAyI -yinI -yi (n), avyavasAyavAn -vatI -vat (t), SiTilaH -lA -laM, [Page675-b+ 51] SiTilodyogaH -gA -gaM, SiTilayatnaH -tnA -tnaM, alasaH -sA -saM, pramattaH -ttA -ttaM.
REMISSION: I Abatement, cessation: q. v.: upaSamaH.II Release, discharge: q. v.: mokzaH. III Pardon, forgiveness: q. v.: kzamA.

REMISSION , s. (Relaxation) SETilyaM, SiTilatA, mocanaM, muktiH f. — (Abatement) SAntiH f., upaSAntiH f., SamaH, upaSamaH. — (Release) muktiH f., vimuktiH f., mokzaH, udDAraH, nistAraH, visarjanaM. — (Pardon) kzamA, kzAntiH f., mocanaM, muktiH f., nizkftiH f.; of sin,’ pApamocanaM, pApamuktiH f., pApamArjanA. — (Intermission) virAmaH, viratiH f., ava- ratiH f., nivfttiH f., vicCedaH, CedaH; ‘of study, &c.,’ avakASaH, anaDyAyaH, aDyayanavirAmaH, aDyayananivfttiH f.
REMISSLY: (1) anavaDAnena;(2) by adj.: v. Carelessly, negligently.
REMISSLY , adv. anavaDAnena, anavahitaM, mandAdaraM, anapekzayA, saSETilyaM.
REMISSNESS: (1) anavaDAnam;(2) SETilyam: v. Carelessness, negligence.
REMISSNESS , s. anavaDAnaM -natA, anavahitatvaM, upekzA, anapekzA, anavekzA, avyavasAyaH, pramAdaH, pramattatA, SETilyaM, SiTilatA, yatnaSETilyaM, ayatnaH.

Remit, v. t. pra-hi 5 P, prez c., prati-f c. (arpayati); saMcar c., saMkram c. 2 SiTilIkf 8 U, muc 6 P, vi-ut-sfj 6 P, tyaj 1 P, viram 1 P, nivft 1 A, (with abl.). 3 kzam 1 A, nivft c., muc, avasfj, tyaj. 4 pra-upa-Sam c., (Samayati), laGUkf, nyUnIkf. v. i. pra-upa-Sam 4 P, SiTilIBU 1 P, viram. [Remit]tance, s. prezaRaM, saMkrAmaRam; prezitaDanasaMKyA. [Remit]tent, a. saMtata, avisargin. [Remit]ting, a. virata, visargin, SiTilita. Remission, s. SETilyaM, pra-upa-SamaH-SAMti f., virAmaH. 2 mocanaM, muktiM f., nistAraH, udDAraH. 3 mArjanaM, kzamAM, vicCedaH, nivftti f., utsargaH.

REMIT (v. t.): I To send: q. v.: prerayati (Ir, c. 10.).II To forgive, pardon: q. v.: nirvartayati (c. of vft).III To relax, diminish: q. v.: SiTilIkaroti.IV To give up, surren- -der: q. v.: arpayati, sam-, (c. of f).
REMIT (v. i.): SiTilIBavati: v. To relax, dimi- -nish, abate.

To REMIT , v. a. (Relax, slacken) SiTilIkf, SiTila (nom. SiTi layati -yituM), muc (c. 6. muYcati, moktuM, c. 10. mocayati -yituM), vimuc, avasfj, visfj. — (Abate, diminish) Sam (c. 10. Samayati -yituM), upaSam, nyUnIkf, laGUkf. — (Release, relinquish) muc, vimuc, mokz, visfj (c. 6. -sfjati -srazwuM), avasfj, tyaj. — (Pardon) kzam (c. 1. kzamate -ti, kzantuM), saMkzam, muc, vimuc, yApamocanaM kf. — (Transmit, as money, &c.) saMcar in caus., DanAdi saMkram in caus., huRqi- kApatradvArA or leKyapatrAdidvArA DanaM samf in caus.
To REMIT , v. n. (Become less intense) SiTilIBU, Sam (c. 4. SAmyati SamituM), upaSam, praSam, nyUnIBU.
REMITTANCE: I The act: preraRam: v. To send.II The thing remitted: expr. by prerita or prezita (f. tA).
REMITTANCE , s. (The act) huRqikApatradvArA or leKyapatrAdidvArA Danasa- marpaRaM or DanasaMkrAntiH f. — (The sum) leKyapatradvArA samarpitaDanaM.
REMITTANT: visargin (f. RI) and sim. comp. s,: v. Intermittent.
REMITTED , p. p. muktaH -ktA -ktaM, mocitaH -tA -taM, avasfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, SAntaH -ntA -ntaM, upaSAntaH &c., kzAntaH &c., tyaktaH -ktA -ktaM.
REMITTENT , a. vizamaH -mA -maM, santataH -tA -taM, avirataH -tA -taM; ‘fever,’ vizamajvaraH, santatajvaraH.
Remnant, s. ava-, SezaH-zaM; See Remainder.
REMNANT: Seza (f. zA): v. Remaining, re- -mainder.
REMNANT , s. SezaH -zaM, SizwaM, avaSizwaM, ucCizwaM. See REMAINDER.
REMONSTRANCE: (1) prativAdaH;(2) virudDavAkyam; and sim. expr. s.
REMONSTRANCE , s. ApattiH f., ApattivAdaH, ApattiBAzaRaM, ApattileKaH, pratyAdeSakavAdaH, praboDavAkyaM, OpadeSikavAdaH. See EXPOSTULATION.
Remonstrate, v. i. (With) nivAraRArTaM upadiS 6 P, nivArayituM yat 1 A, pratyAdiS pratyAKyA 2 P; See Dissuade. Remonstrance, s. pratyAdeSaH, praboDavacanaM, nivAraRopadeSaH, nivartanaM.
REMONSTRATE: (1) prativAdaM karoti;(2) virudDavAkyaM vadati (vad, c. l.); etc.
To REMONSTRATE , v. n. ApattiM kf, ApattipUrvvaM vad (c. 1. vadati -dituM) or BAz, ApattivAdaM kf, pratyAdiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM). See To EXPOSTULATE.
Remorse, s. anutApaH, anuSayaH, anuSokaH, paScAttApaH. [Remorse]ful, a. anutapta, anuSayArta; See Repentance, &c. [Remorse]less, s. kaWina, nirdaya; See Cruel.
REMORSE: (1) anutApaH;(2) anuSayaH;(3) anu- SokaH.
REMORSE , s. paScAttApaH, paScAtsantApaH, anutApaH, manastApaH, anuSokaH, anuSocanaM, anvADiH m., anuSayaH.
REMORSEFUL: (1) anutapta (f. ptA);(2) anutApayuta (f. tA);(3) anuSayin (f. nI); and sim. comp.s.
REMORSEFUL , a. paScAttApI -pinI -pi (n), anutApI &c., anutaptaH -ptA -ptaM.
REMORSELESS: (1) kaWina (f. nA): v. Hard; (2) nirdaya (f. yA): v. Merciless.
REMORSELESS , a. nirdayaH -yA -yaM, ugradaRqaH -RqA -RqaM. See RELENTLESS.

Remote, a. dUra, dUrasTa, dUravartin, asannihita, viprakfzwa; See Distant. [Remote]ly, adv. dUraM, viprakfzwaM; ‘he is r(emotely) connected with me’ sa mama viprakfzwaH baMDuH. [Remote]ness, s. viprakarzaH, asannikarzaH, dUratA.

REMOTE: (1) dUrasTa (f. sTA): v. Far;(2) anAsanna (f. nnA);(3) viprakfzwa (f. zwA), r. cause: viprakfzwaM nidAnam, Bha.; still the time for awaking is very r.: adyApi viprakfzwatamaH praboDakAlaH, Vi. vi. and sim. comp.s.: v. Near, not.

REMOTE , a. dUraH -rA -raM, dUrasTaH -sTA -sTaM, dUrasTitaH -tA -taM, dUrasTAyI -yinI -yi (n), dUravarttI -rttinI &c., vidUraH &c., viprakfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, asannikfzwaH &c., asannihitaH -tA -taM, davizWaH -zWA -zWaM, davIyAn -yasI -yaH (s), anupasTAyI &c., anupasTaH -sTA -sTaM, nopasTaH &c., nopa- sTAtA -trI -tf (tf), asamIpaH -pA -paM, ArAtIyaH -yA -yaM, paraH -rA -raM.
REMOTELY , adv. dUraM, dUrAt -reRa, vidUraM, viprakfzwaM, asamIpaM.
REMOTENESS: (1) dUratA, -tvam;(2) viprakarzaH.
REMOTENESS , s. dUratA -tvaM, vidUratA -tvaM, dUrasTatA, asanniDAnaM, asAnniDyaM, viprakarzaH, asamIpatA, asAmIppaM, asannikarzaH.
Remount, s. aSrAMtaH aSvaH. v. i. aSvaM punar Aruh 1 P.
REMOVABLE: (1) apasArya (f. ryA);(2) apaneya (f. yA);(3) bahizkArya (f. ryA);(4) nirasanIya (f. yA); etc.: v. Remove, removal.

REMOVABLE , a. apaneyaH -yA -yaM, apanetavyaH -vyA -vyaM, apanayanIyaH -yA -yaM, apaharaRIyaH -yA -yaM, apahAryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM, hAryyaH &c., parihAryyaH &c., apAdeyaH -yA -yaM, vyAvarttyaH -rttyA -rttyaM, vineyaH -yA -yaM, apasAryyaH &c., sTAnAntarakaraRIyaH &c.

REMOVAL (subs.): I Personal:(1) sTAnAntara- gamanam;(2) apasaraRam;(3) often by gamanam etc. (= going).II Of things etc.:(1) sTAnAntara- nayanam;(2) apasAraRam.III Driving away: (1) dUrIkaraRam;(2) apanayaH, -nam (= taking away); (3) nirAsaH or nirasanam (casting away);(4) nirAkaraRam or -kftiH (= expulsion);(5) nirvAsanam (= banishment).

REMOVAL , s. (Act of removing or causing to change place) apanayanaM, vinayanaM, apasAraRaM, utsAraRaM, niHsAraRaM, sAraRaM, apaharaRaM, [Page676-a+ 51] haraRaM, apahAraH, parihAraH, apakarzaRaM, apAdAnaM, apavarttanaM, apanodaH -danaM, apanuttiH f., cAlanaM, vicAlanaM, sTAnAntarIkaraRaM, sTalAntarIkaraRaM. — (State of being removed, change of place, going away) sTAnaBedaH, sTalaBedaH, sTAnAntaraM, sTalAntaraM, apagamaH, apAyaH, vicalanaM, apasaraH -raRaM, apayAnaM, vyAvfttiH f., vyAvftiH f. — (Act of displacing or expelling) nirasanaM, nirAsaH, apAsanaM, nirAkaraRaM, nirAkftiH f., apAkftiH f., apAkaraRaM, nizkAsanaM, niHkAsanaM, apasAraRaM, apanodanaM, vahizkaraRaM, dUrIkaraRaM, nikftiH f.; ‘from an office,’ padAtM or sTAnAt praBraMSanaM or nirAkaraRaM, padaBraMSanaM. — (Putting an end to) KaRqanaM, nASaH -SanaM, paricCedaH, ucCedaH, udDaraRaM, aBiGAtaH, pratiGAtaH, sADanaM, sidDiH f., pratikAraH, pratIkAraH; ‘removal of obstacles,’ viGnanASanaM, viGnasidDiH f., viGnaKaRqanaM; ‘of ignorance,’ ajYAnaKaRqanaM; ‘of disease,’ roganASaH, rogapratIkAraH; ‘of fear,’ BayapratIkAraH.

Remove, v. t. sTAnAMtaraM nI 1 P or gam c., apa-sf c., vi-, cal c. 2 dUrIkf 8 U, nirvas c., nizkas c., apa-niH-ut-sf c., bAhizkf; (from office) pra-, BraMS c., cyu c.; See Dismiss, Discharge. (of things) apanI, vinud c., apahf 1 P, apa-ava-kfz 1 P, apa-apA-nud 6 P or c., apa-vyapa-Uh 1 U, nir-apa-as 4 U, nirAkf, apAkf, ucCid 7 P, vi-naS c., pratikf, KaMq 10, vi-prati-han 2 P, BaMj 7 P, nir-ava-DU 5, 9 U, 6 P. v. i. sTAnAMtaraM gam 1 P or yA-i- 2 P; apasf 1 P, apagam-yA. s. puruzaH (in geneologygenealogy) ‘separated by one r(emove) from the creator’ srazwurekAMtaraM (dvaMdvaM) (S. 7). 2 padaM, padavI, kramaH. 3 apagamaH, apasaraRaM, &c.; See below. [Remov]al, s. apa-nayanaM, utsAraRaM, dUrIkaraRaM, vicAlanaM, sTA-nAMtarIkaraRaM. 2 apasaraH-raRaM, apayAnaM, apa-gamaH-gamanaM, sTAnAMtaraM, sTalaBedaH. 3 nirAsaH, nirAkaraRaM, praBraMSanaM, apa-pari-hAraH-haraRaM, ucCedaH, vinASaH-SanaM, apanodaH, apohaH, pratiGAtaH, prati (tI) kAraH, KaMqanaM, BaMgaH &c. [Remov]er, s. apanetf m., apahartA, nASakaH, ucCettA; gen. ex. by hAraH, hArI, apahaH, hA, GnaH, aMtakaH in comp., also hft, nud in comp.; ‘r(emover) of darkness’ tamonut, tamo-hft, tamaScCid &c.
REMOVE (subs.): I Removal: q. v.II A step.: q. v.: BaNgiH.

REMOVE (v. t.): I To move, change place: (1) sTAnAntaraM nayati (nI, c. l.);(2) apasArayati (c. of sf).II To drive away, banish: q. v.: dUrIkaroti: v. Also to dismiss (II). III To take away, destroy: q. v.:(1) apanayati (nI, c. l.);(2) harati, apa- (hf, c. l.), to r. thirst; tfzRAM harati, Bha.;(3) nudati, pra- (nud, c. l.), r. s phlegms: kaPanut (mfn.);(4) hanti, apa- (han, c. 2. = kill), r. s phlegms: kaPApaha (f. hA), Bha.;(5) vinASayati (c. of naS = destroy), r. s cold: pratiSyAyaM vinASayati, Bha.; (6) Cinatti, ut (Cid, c. 7. = cut off), r. d the doubt: vitarkaM cicCeda, M. n. on, Ki. iv. 5.
REMOVE (v. i.): (1) sTAnAntaraM gacCati (gam, c. l.), yAti (yA, c. 2.), etc.;(2) apasarati (sf, c. 1.): v. To go away.

To REMOVE , v. a. (Take away) apanI (c. 1. -nayati -netuM), vinI, vyapanI, apasf (c. 10. -sArayati -yituM), utsf, niHsf, sf, apahf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), hf, apakfz (c. 1. -karzati -krazwuM), vyapakfz, avakfz apAdA (c. 3. -dadAti -dAtuM), apanud (c. 6. -nudati -nottuM), apAnud, vyapanud, vyapAnud, apoh (c. 1. apohate -ti -hituM, rt. Uh), vyapoh. — (Move, cause to change place) vical (c. 10. -cAlayati -yituM), cal, sTAnAntaraM gam in caus., sTAnAntarIkf, sTalAntarIkf, anyatra kf. — (Displace, expel) niras (c. 4. -asyati -situM), apAs, nirAkf, apAkf, nizkas (c. 10. -kAsayati -yituM), apasf in caus., apanud, apasiD (c. 1. -seDati -sedDuM), vahizkf, vahiH kf, dUrIkf; ‘from an office, &c.,’ padAt or sTAnAt praBraMS (c. 10. -BraMSayati -yituM) or BraMS or cyu in caus. (cyAvayati -yituM) or nirAkf. — (Put an end to) KaRq (c. 10. KaRqayati -yituM), naS (c. 10. nASayati -yituM), udDf (c. 1. udDarati, udDarttuM, rt. hf), ucCid (c. 7. -Cinatti -CettuM), pariCid, pratikf; ‘doubt is removed,’ apanIyate or nirRIyate saMSayaH.

To REMOVE , v. n. (Move or change place) cal (c. 1. calati -lituM), vical, sTAnAntaraM gam (c. 1. gacCati, gantuM), sTalAntaraM gam or yA. — (Change residence) vAsAntaraM gam or yA, gfhAntaraM gam. — (Go away) apagam, apasf (c. 1. -sarati -sarttuM), apayA (c. 2. -yAti -tuM).
REMOVE , s. (Removing or changing place), see REMOVAL. — (Going away) apagamaH, apasaraH -raRaM, apayAnaM. — (Step in a scale) padaM, padaviH -vI f., kramaH.

REMOVED , p. p. (Taken away) apanItaH -tA -taM, apasAritaH &c., utsAritaH &c., niHsAritaH &c., apahftaH -tA -taM, hftaH &c., apaka- rzitaH &c., apanoditaH &c., apoQaH -QA -QaM. — (Moved, changed in place) cAlitaH -tA -taM, vicAlitaH &c., sTAnAntarIkftaH -tA -taM, sTAnAntaragataH &c., sTAnAntaraNgataH &c., sTAnAntaraNgamitaH &c., sTAnA- ntaraprAptaH -ptA -ptaM, sTalAntarIkftaH &c., vyAvfttaH -ttA -ttaM, vyAvftaH &c. — (Displaced, expelled) nirastaH -stA -staM, apAstaH &c., udastaH &c., parAstaH &c., nirAkftaH -tA -taM, apAkftaH &c., nizkAsitaH &c., vahizkftaH &c., dUrIkftaH &c., nirDUtaH -tA -taM, avaDUtaH &c., nikftaH &c., vipra- kftaH &c., avakfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, avasfzwaH &c., pratyAdizwaH -zwA -zwaM, pratyAKyAtaH -tA -taM; ‘from office,’ sTAnaBrazwaH -zwA -zwaM, sTAnAtpraBraMSitaH &c., padacyA- vitaH -tA -taM.

REMOVER , s. apanetA m. (tf), apanAyakaH, vinAyakaH, apahArakaH, apa- hArI m. (n), hArI m., hArakaH, haraH in comp., aBiharaH, apakarzI m. (n), apanodakaH, apahaH in comp., haH in comp., GraH in comp., nASakaH, nASI m., antakaH in comp.; ‘remover of obstacles,’ [Page676-b+ 51] viGnavinAyakaH, viGnahArI m., viGnaharaH, viGnanASakaH, viGnanASanaH; ‘of fear,’ BayApahaH; ‘of disease,’ rogaGnaH, rogahaH, rogAntakaH. ‘of wind,’ mArutApahaH.
Remunerate, v. t. mUlyaM-vetanaM-pratiPala dA 3 U; See Recompense, Reward. [Remunerat]ion, s. mUlyaM, vetanaM, pratiPalaM, pAritozikaM.
REMUNERATE: mUlyaM dadAti (dA, c. 3.): v. To recompense.
REMUNERATED , p. p. gfhItapAritozikaH -kA -kaM, gfhItavetanaH -nA -naM.
REMUNERATION: mUlyam: v. Also reward, pay.
REMUNERATION , s. pAritozikaM, vetanaM, PalaM, nistAraH, see COMPENSATION.
Renaissance, s. (vidyAyAH) punarujjIvanaM.
Rencounter, s. saMmardaH, dvaMdvaM, saMGawwaH, aBi-GAtaH; See Battle, Collision.

Rend, v. t. dF 9 P or c., Bid 7 P, Cid 7 P, vyaD 4 P, viSF 9 P; vi-ud-dal c. (dalayati), KaMq 10; See Tear, ‘heart-r(end)ing’ hfdayaspfS, hfdispfS, hfdayamarmacCid. [Rend]er, s. vidArakaH, BedakaH. [Rend]ing, s. vidAraRaM, BidA, sPuwanaM, BedaH, BaMgaH. Rent, a. vidIrRa, sPuwita, Binna &c. s. CidraM, raMDraM, BedaH, vidaraH, sPuwanaM, BidA, BaMgaH.
REND: dArayati (rarely dfRAti), vi-, pari-, ava-, rent the mountain: dadArAdrim, Mah.; the thunderbolt rent that hole: vajraM tadvilamadArat, Mah. i. 3. 163.

To REND , v. a. dF (c. 9. dfRAti, darituM -rItuM, c. 10. dArayati -yituM), vidF, avadF, Bid (c. 7. Binatti, BettuM), viBid, nirBid, vidal (c. 10. -dalayati -yituM), vidalIkf, dal, Cid, vyavaCid, viCid, KaRq (c. 10. KaRqayati -yituM); ‘in two,’ dviDA Bid or Cid, dviKaRqIkf.

Render, v. t. pratidA 3 U, prati-f c. (arpayati), pratipad c., niryat c. 2 dA, kf 8 U, upakxp c. 3 jan c., utpad c., kf; by the causal of roots; ‘r(ender) help’ sA-hAyyaM kf or dA; ‘to r(ender) proud’ dfp c.; ‘r(ender) unfriendly’ vikf c., &c. viraMj c. 4 Translate, q. v.
RENDER: I In gen.: karoti, to r. clear: viSadI- karoti, M. n.; to r. into Persian: pArasIkaBAzAyAM karoti, Raj.: v. To make, do.II To give back: pratidadAti (dA, c. 3.): v. To give, return.
RENDER , s. (One who tears) vidArakaH, dArakaH, viBedakaH.

To RENDER , v. a. (Pay back, restore) pratidA, punar dA. pratyf in caus. (pratyarpayati -yituM, rt. f). pratipad in caus. — (Give, afford) dA, pradA, prayam (c. 1. -yacCati -yantuM), pratiyam, pratipad (c. 10. -pAdayati -yituM), f in caus. (arpayati -yituM), upasTA in caus., upakxp. — (Cause to be, make, effect) kf, jan (c. 10. janayati -yituM), sAD (c. 10. sADayati -yituM), utpad (c. 10. -pAdayati -yituM), yuktaM -ktAM kf, viSizwaM -zwAM kf, kal (c. 10. kalayati -yituM). Or more commonly expressed by the use of the caus. form of any verb; as, ‘to render proud,’ dfz in caus. (darpayati -yituM); ‘to render fat,’ pyE in caus. (ppAyayati -yituM); ‘to render illustrious,’ yaSasvinaM kf, kIrttiM dA. — (Translate) BAzAntarIkf, avatF.

RENDERED , p. p. (Restored) pratidattaH -ttA -ttaM, pratyarpitaH -tA -taM, prati- pAditaH &c. — (Given) dattaH -ttA -ttaM, arpitaH &c. — (Made, caused to be) kfta in comp., jAta in comp., janitaH -tA -taM, or ex- pressed by the pass, part. of the caus. form; ‘rendered poor,’ daridrIkftaH -tA -taM; ‘rendered proud,’ jAtadarpaH -rpA -rpaM, darpitaH -tA -taM; ‘rendered beautiful,’ SoBitaH -tA -taM; ‘rendered populous,’ vAsitaH -tA -taM; ‘rendered unfriendly,’ vikAritaH -tA -taM.
RENDERING , s. (Version) BAzAntaraM, pAWaH, pAWAntaraM.
RENDEZ-VOUS , s. samAgamasTAnaM, saNgamasTAnaM, saNketasTAnaM, saNketasTalaM.
To RENDEZ-VOUS , v. n. saNketasTAne samAgam (c. 1. -gacCati -gantuM) or saMgam
Rendezvous, s. samAgama-saMketa-sTAnaM, saMketa gfhaM-sTalaM.
RENDEZVOUS: samAgama- or saNgamasTAnam and sim. comp.s.
RENDING (subs.): dAraH, -Ram, vi-, ava-.
RENDING , s. vidAraH -raRaM, dAraRaM, vidaraH, viBedanaM, BidA, sPuwanaM.
Renegade, s. DarmaBrazwaH, patitaH, pAKaMqaH, svaDarma-svapakza-tyAgin m.
RENEGADE: I Apostate: q. v.II A term of abuse: pAzaRqaH.
RENEGADE , RENEGADO, s. svapakzatyAgI m. (n), svaDarmmatyAgI m., svaDarmmaBrazwaH.

Renew, v. t. navIkf 8 U, pratisamA-DA 3 U, udDf 1 P, pUrvAvasTAM nI 1 P or prAp c. or gam c. 2 punaH kf; gen. ex. by punaH AraB 1 A with other words; ‘r(enew)s studies’ punaH aDyayanaM prAraBate; ‘they r(enew)ed hostilities’ punaH vEraM prAreBire. [Renew]al s. navIkaraRaM, pUrvavatkaraRaM, pratisamADAnaM, udDAraH, punaH karaRaM, punaH prAraMBaH.

RENEW: I To make again: punaH karoti or punaH and the corresponding verb, r. a fight: punaryudDaM karoti or yuDyate; r. studies: punaraDyanaM karoti or aDIte; r. an application: punaH prArTanAM karoti or prArTayate, etc.II To make new: navIkaroti.

To RENEW , v. a. (Make new) navIkf, navInIkf, navaM -vAM kf, navInaM -nAM kf, nUtanaM -nAM -nIM kf, nUtanIkf. — (Restore to a former state repair) pUrvvavat kf, pUrvvAvasTAM or pUrvvadaSAM gam (c. 10. gamayati -yituM) or nI (c. 1. nayati, netuM), pratisamADA, pratikf, pratisaMkf, udDf (c. 1. udDarati, udDarttuM, rt. hf), udDaraRa kf, jIrRodDAraM kf. — (Make or do again) punaH kf, vAraM bAraM kf, muhuH kf. — (Begin again) punar AraB, punarAramBaM kf.
RENEWABLE , a. navIkaraRIyaH -yA -yaM, punaHkaraRIyaH &c., udDaraRIyaH &c.

RENEWAL , s. (Making new) navIkaraRaM, navInIkaraRaM, nUtanIkaraRaM. (Restoration to a former state, repairing) pUrvvavatkaraRaM, prati- sramADAnaM, sanDAnaM, samADAnaM, udDaraRaM, udDAraH, jIrRodDAraH. — (Doing again, beginning again) punaHkaraRaM, punarAramBaH.
RENEWED , p. p. nabIkftaH -tA -taM, mabInIkftaH &c., punaHkftaH &c., pUrvva- vatkftaH &c.

Renounce, v. t. na svIkf or aMgIkf 8 U, pratyAKyA 2 P, pratyAdiS 6 P, pratyAcakz 2 A; See Refuse. 2 tyaj 1 P, apAs 4 U, vi-ut-sfj 6 P, hA 3 P; See Abandon, ‘to r(enounce) the world’ saMnyas, sarvasaMgaM parityaj. Renunciation, s. pratyAdeSaH, pratyAKyAnaM, parityAgaH, utsargaH, parihAraH; ‘r(enunciation) of the world’ saMnyAsaH, sarvasaMgaparityAgaH.
RENOUNCE: I Not to own:(1) pratyAKyAti (KyA, c. 2.);(2) na svIkaroti, aNgIkaroti, etc. II To forsake, abandon: q. v.: tyajati, pari-, saM- (tyaj, c. 1.).

To RENOUNCE , v. a. (Disown, disclaim) pratyAKyA (c. 2. -KyAti -tuM), pratyAdiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM), nihnu (c. 2. -hnute -hnotuM), apahu, nirasa [Page677-a+ 51] (c. 4. -asyati -situM), apAs, udas, vyudas, nirAkf, pratyAcakz, na svIkf, na grah, na aNgIkf. — (Relinquish) tyaj (c. 1. tyajati, tyaktuM), parityaj, saMtyaj, hA (c. 3. jahAti, hAtuM), vihA, apahA, apAhA, utsfj (c. 6. -sfjati srazwuM) visfj, avasfj, vyapasfj, apasfj, projJ (c. 6. -ujJati -jJituM), ujJ, pfzwataH kf; ‘to renounce the world,’ sannyas, sannyAsaM kf, sarvvasaNgAn parityaj.
RENOUNCED , p. p. pratyAKyAtaH -tA -taM, pratyAdizwaH -zwA -zwaM, tyaktaH -ktA -ktaM, parityaktaH &c., nirastaH -stA -staM, apAstaH &c., sannyastaH &c.
Renovate, v. t. navIkf 8 U, punaH kf. [Renovat]ion, s. navInatA, nUtanAvasTA, udDAraH; See Refresh, Renew.
RENOVATE: navIkaroti: v. To renew, refresh.
To RENOVATE , v. a. navIkf, navInIkf, nUtanIkf, pUrvvavatkf. See To RENEW.
RENOVATED , p. p. navIkftaH -tA -taM, pUrvvatkftaH &c. See RENEWED.
RENOVATION: I The act: navIkaraRam.II The state:(1) navIBAvaH (of things);(2) pratyASvAsaH (of persons).
RENOVATION , s. navIkaraRaM, navInIkaraRaM, navatA, navInatA, nUtanAvasTA, tavatAprAptiH f., udDAraH. See RENEWAL.
Renown, s. kIrti f., yaSas n., pra-vi-KyAti f., viSruti f. [Renown]ed, a. pra-vi-KyAta, viSruta, praTita, labDakIrti, prasidDa, labDapratizWa; See Fame, [Fam]ous.
RENOWN: (1) kIrtiH, of world-wide r.: viSva- viKyAtakIrtiH, D. s.;(2) KyAti, pra-;(3) yaSasa (n.): v. Fame.
RENOWN , s. kIrttiH f., KyAtiH f., yaSas n., viSrutiH f., pratipattiH f., praKyAtiH f., pratiKyAtiH f., AKyA, praKyA. See FAME.
RENOWNED: (1) KyAta (f. tA), vi-, pra-;(2) viSruta (f. tA);(3) praTita (f. tA);(4) prasidDa (f. dDA);(5) kIrtimat (f. tI); yaSasvin (f. nI); etc. (possessing renown).

RENOWNED , a. kIrttimAn -matI -mat (t), yaSasvI -svinI -svi (n), KyAtaH -tA -taM, AKyAtaH &c., praKyAtaH &c., prasidDaH -dDA -dDaM, suprasidDaH &c., jagatprasidDaH &c., KyAtyApannaH -nnA -nnaM, pratizWitaH -tA -taM, AKyA- sampannaH -nnA -nnaM, praTitaH -tA -taM, viSrutaH &c., mahAyaSAH -SAH -SaH (s), prAptayaSAH &c., kIrttiyutaH -tA -taM, kIrttiyuktaH -ktA -ktaM, nAmaDArI &c., rUQaH -QA -QaM.
Rent, s. karaH, baliH, rAjasvaM. v. t. BAwakena dA 3 U; Baw c., BAwakena-mUlyadAnena-grah 9 U or sev 1 A or Buj 7 A. [Rent]al, s. ‘r(ental) bill’ karapatrikA.
RENT (subs.): I Of lands: karaH.II Cleft, fissure: q. v.: Cidram.
RENT (v.): I To grant by lease: BAwakena dadAti (dA, c. 3.).II To take by lease:(1) BAwakena gfhRAti (graha, c. 9.);(2) BAwayati, Viv.

RENT , p. p. (Torn) vidAritaH -tA -taM, vidIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, dAritaH &c., dIrRaH &c., pravidAritaH &c., dalitaH -tA -taM, vidalitaH &c., BinnaH -nnA -nnaM, viBinnaH &c., pAwitaH -tA -taM, sPuwaH -wA -waM, sPuwitaH -tA -taM.

RENT , s. (Tear) CidraM, BedaH, BittiH f., BaNgaH, vidaraH, darI, dAraRaM, CedaH. — (Revenue) karaH, mahAkaraH, utpannaM, see PRODUCE. — (Sum paid for any thing held of another) karaH, mUlyaM; ‘raising the rent of land,’ paricAyyaH.

To RENT , v. a. (Grant the possession of lands &c., by lease, for a certain sum) pawwolikApUrvvaM nirUpitamUlyamapekzya kzetragfhAdi paraprayojanIyaM dA, AvihitakAlAd vArzikamUlyamapekzya kzetragfhAdi parahaste samf in caus. — (Take or hold by lease) pawwolikApUrvvaM vArzikamUlyaM pratijYAya kzetragfhAdi parahastAd grah (c. 9. gfhlAti, grahItuM) or paraha- stAd gfhItvA prayuj or parahastAd gfhItvA aDyAs or aDivas.
RENTAL, RENT-ROLL: *karapatrikA and sim. comp.s.
RENTAL , RENT-ROLL, s. karaparisaMKyA, karaparisaMKyApatraM.
RENTER , s. (One who leases) pawwadAyI m. (n), pawwadaH. — (One who takes on lease) pawwAdAyI m. (n), pawwagrAhI m., pawwaDArI m., pawwo- likAGArI m.
RENUNCIATION: I Not owning:(1) pratyA- KyAnam;(2) nirAkftiH (= rejection);II Abandonment: q. v.: parityAgaH, r. of sītā: sItAparityAgaH.

RENUNCIATION , s. pratyAKyAnaM, pratyAdeSaH, tyAgaH, parityAgaH, utsargaH, utsarjanaM, visargaH, visarjanaM, nirasanaM, nirAsaH, projJanaM, varjanaM, parihAraH, asvI- kAraH, agrahaRaM; ‘of the world,’ saKyAsaH, saKyAsitvaM, sarvvasaNgaparityAgaH.
Reorganize, v. t. punar vi-rac 10 or Gaw c.
REPAID , p. p. pratidattaH -ttA -ttaM, pratyarpitaH -tA -taM, pratikftaH -tA -taM.

Repair, v. t. navIkf 8 U, saM-DA 3 U, pratisamA-samA-DA, udDf 1 P, pUrvavatkf, punaH svasTIkf, susTita a. kf. 2 (Loss &c.) pUr 10, pramfj 2 P, nizkf, SuD c. pratikf, saM-DA. v. i. ASri 1 U, prapad 4 A, gam-vraj 1 P, SaraRaM prapad or gam or yA 2 P or aByupa-i 2 P. s. prati-, samADAnaM, saMskAraH, saMDAnaM, udDAraH, navIkaraRaM, pUrvAvasTAprApaRaM. Reparable, a. pUraRIya; udDArya, pratisamADeya; ‘loss not r(eparable)’ apUraRIyA hAniH. Reparation, s. Repair, q. v. 2 kzati or hAni-pUraRaM or nizkfti f., SoDanaM, pratiPalaM.

REPAIR (v. t.): I To restore:(1) navIkaroti, r. ed the town: puraM navIcakAra;(2) pUrayati, pari-, (pUr, c. 10.: by filling up what is in- -complete);(3) saMskaroti (kf, c. 8.: by embellishing);(4) pratisaMskaroti (kf, c. 8.). II To make amends for: pUrayati, pari-.
REPAIR (v. i.): (1) gacCati (gam, c. l.): v. To go;(2) samASrayati (Sri, c. l.): v. To betake, (have) recourse.
REPAIR (subs.): saMskAraH or prati-: v. To repair (v. t.).

To REPAIR , v. a. (Restore to a sound state, after decay, &c.) pratisanADA (c. 3. -daDAti -Datte -DAtuM), punaH samADA, punaH sanDA, udDf (c. 1. udDarati, udDarttuM, rt. hf), udDAraM kf, jIrRodDAraM kf, jIrRodDaraRaM kf, pratikf, pratisaMkf, punaH svasTaM -sTAM kf or svasTIkf, punaH susTaM -sTAM kf or susTa (nom. susTayati -yituM), sAD (c. 10. sADayati -yituM), pUrvvavat kf, sanDAnaM kf, pratisamADAmaM kf. — (Make good a loss) kzatiM pF (c. 10. pUrayati -yituM) or sampF, kzatipUraRaM kf, kzatinizkftiM kf, kzatiM nizkf or Suz (c. 10. SoDayati -yituM), hAnipUraRaM kf, hAni- pratikAraM kf.

To REPAIR , v. n. (Have recourse, go to) ASri (c. 1. -ayati -yituM), [Page677-b+ 51] Sri, ASrayaRaM kf, SaraRArTaM gam (c. 1. gacCati, gantuM) or Agam or upagam or aBigam or pratigam or yA (c. 2. yAti -tuM) or aBiyA or pratyAyA or i (c. 2. eti -tuM), aByupe.
REPAIR , s. pratisamADAnaM, sanDAnaM, punaH sanDAnaM, samADAnaM, sADanaM, udDAraH, jIrRodDAraH, jIrRodDaraRaM, pratikAraH, pratIkAraH, pratikaraRaM, svasTakaraRaM, susTakaraRaM, pUrvvavatkaraRaM.

REPAIRED , p. p. jIrRodDftaH -tA -taM, punaH sanDitaH -tA -taM, yunaH sADitaH &c., pratisamAhitaH &c., punaH samAhitaH &c., pUrvvavatkftaH &c., pratikftaH &c., svarsTAkftaH &c., svasTaH -sTA -sTaM, susTIkftaH &c., susTitaH &c.
REPAIRER , s. jIrRodDArakaH, jIrRodDarttA m. (rttf) sanDAtA m. (tf).
REPARABLE (1) pUraRIya (f. yA), pari-;(2) prati- samADeya (f. yA).
REPARABLE , a. sanDeyaH -yA -yaM, samADeyaH &c., pratisamADeyaH &c., sADyaH -DyA -DyaM, sADanIyaH -yA -yaM, pratikAryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM, udDAryyaH &c. udDara- RIyaH -yA -yaM.
REPARATION: (1) pUraRam, pari-: v. Compen- -sation, redress.
REPARATION , s. (Repair), see above. — (Amends) kzatipUraRaM, hAni- pUraRaM, kzatinizkftiH f., hAninizkftiH f., kzatiSoDanaM. See INDEM- NITY, COMPENSATION.
Repartee, s. kziprottaraM, vyaMgokti f., BaMgi-BAzaRaM, sarasoktiH.
REPARTEE: (1) vyaNgyoktiH (?);(2) kziprottaram (= quick reply: q. v.).
REPARTEE , s. rasikottaraM, sarasottaraM, sarasapratyuktiH f., BaNgiH f.
Repast, s. BojanaM, annaM, AhAraH, aSanaM, aByupahAraH.
REPAST: (1) AhAraH: v. Meal;(2) Bojanam: v. Food.
REPAST , s. AhAraH BojanaM, BakzaRaM, BakzikA, aSanaM, prASanaM, aByAhAraH; ‘light repast,’ laGuBojanaM, laGvAhAraH, alpAhAraH, upAhAraH, PalAhAraH.
Repatriate, v. t. (nirvAsitaM) svadeSaM prAp c.

Repay, v. t. pratidA 3 U, prati-f c. (arpayati), niryat 10, pratipad c., nivft c., pratikf 8 U. 2 pratiPalaM-nizkftiM-dA, nizkf, apAkf, SuD c., apavfj 10, oft. by prati; ‘r(epay) kindness’ pratyupakf; ‘r(epay) an injury’ pratyapakf, vEraM sAD c. [Repay]ment, s. pratidAnaM, pratyarpaRaM, niryAtanaM, SoDanaM, SudDi f., pratiPalaM.
REPAY: (1) niryAtayati (yat, c. 10.: lit. and fig., in good and bad sense);(2) pratidadAti (dA, c. 3. = to give back, return).

To REPAY , v. a. pratidA (c. 3. -dadAti -datte -dAtuM), punar dA or pradA punar f in caus. (arpayati -yituM), pratyf, punaH pratipad (c. 10. -pAda- yati -yituM) or prayam (c. 1. -yacCati -yantuM), niryat (c. 10. -yAtayati -yituM), nivft (c. 10. -varttayati -yituM), pratikf. — (Requite) pratikf, niryat, pratiPala (nom. pratiPalayati -yituM); ‘to repay a kind- ness,’ pratyupakAraM kf, pratyupakf; ‘an injury,’ pratyapakf, pratyapakAraM kf. — (Compensate) pratiPalaM dA, nizkftiM dA or kf, nistAraM kf, apAkf, nizkf, see To COMPENSATE, RECOMPENSE.
REPAYMENT: (1) niryAtanam;(2) pratidAnam or pratyarpaRam (= giving back).
REPAYMENT , s. pratidAnaM, punardAnaM, pratyarpaRaM, punararpaRaM, pratipAdanaM, punaH- pratipAdanaM, niryAtanaM, nivarttanaM, pratiPalaM. See REQUITAL, RECOM- PENSE, COMPENSATION.
Repeal, v. t. KaMq 10, niras 4 U, vi-, lup c., ni-parA-vft c., ucCid 7 P. s. vi-, lopaH, nivartanaM, KaMqanaM, nirasanaM, pracAralopaH-BaMgaH. [Repeal]er, s. nivartakaH, vilopakaH.

KaRqayati -yituM), pracAraKaRqanaM kf, avaruh in caus. (-ropayati -yituM), pracAraBaNgaM kf, pracAraBaYjanaM kf, ucCid, ucCedaM kf, pracArocCedaM kf, pracAraroDaM kf.

[Repeat]ed, a. punarukta, punarBaRita, punaH punaH kfta, Avftta, Avartita; ‘with r(epeated) exertions’ punaH punaH kftEH prayatnEH; ‘in r(epeated) birth’ parivartini janmani, janmani janmani. REPEAT: I To utter again:(1) punar udIrayati (Ir, c. 10.);(2) BUyo gadati, ni-, (gad, c. 1.);(3) dviH (= twice) vyAharati (hf c. l.), as if r. ed the same thing with an echo: dviriva pratiSabdena vyAjahAra tamevArTam, Ku. vi. 64; etc.: v. To utter, say, again.II To do again: (1) punaH or BUyaH karoti or by corresponding verb;(2) samaBi- or samaBivyA-harati (hf, c. 1.). III To recite, read: q. v.: vyAharati.

To REPEAT , v. a. (Say again) punar vad (c. 1. vadati -dituM), anuvad, muhur vad, anuvac (c. 2. -vakti -ktuM), punar vac, punaruktiM kf, punarvacanaM kf, muhurvacanaM kf, Amreq (c. 1. -sbeqati -qituM), punar BAz, muhurBAzAM kf. — (Do or make again) punaH kf, punaH punaH kf, muhuH kf, punar viDA, punar anuzWA or Avft in caus., muhur anuzwA, vAraM vAraM kf. — (Rehearse. recite) paW (c. 1. paWati -WituM), sampaW, anuvad, kaT (c. 10. kaTayati -yituM), AKyA (c. 2. -KyAti -tuM), samAKyA, Sru (c. 10. SrAvayati -yituM), gF (c. 9. gfRAti, garituM -rItuM), paWanaM kf. — [Page678-a+ 51] — (Tell) kaT, vad. — (A sound or word) Amreq, AmreqanaM kf.

REPEATED , p. p. (Said again) punaruktaH -ktA -ktaM, muhuruktaH &c., punarBA- zitaH -tA -taM; ‘said twice,’ dviruktaH -ktA -ktaM. — (Done again or often) punaH kftaH -tA -taM, punarAvfttaH -ttA -ttaM, punarAvattitaH -tA -taM, punaH punaH kftaH &c., muhuH kftaH &c., vAraM vAraM kfta &c., pOnaHpunikaH -kI -kaM, aBIkzRaH -kzRA -kzRaM; ‘twice,’ dvirAvftta. &c. — (Recited, told) paWitaH -tA -taM, kaTitaH &c.
REPEATEDLY (1) vAraM vAram;(2) BUyoBUyaH;(3) punaHpunaH;(4) muhuH;(5) muhurmuhuH;(6) aBIkzRam; (7) by frequentative verbs (rare).
REPEATEDLY , adv. punaH, punar, muhus, muhurmuhus, vAraM vAraM, anuvAraM, asakft, BUyas, BUyoBUyas, bahuvAraM, vAreRa, SaSvat, anekaSas.
REPEATER: I Reciter: vyAhartf (f. rtrI).II A watch: *horAvAdaH.
REPEATER , s. anuvAdakaH, anuvAdIM m. (n), kaTakaH, AKyAyakaH.

Repel, v. t. apAs 4 U, prati-vyA-han 2 P, pratisf c. niras, pratikzip 6 P, prativf c., apAnud 6 P, ni-parA-vft c., pratyAdiS 6 P; See Dispel, Drive. [Repel]lent, [Repel]ling, a. pratiGAtin pratikAraka, apAnodin. s. prati(tI)kAraH, pratiGAtaH, prativAraRaM.
REPEL: nirasyati (as, c. 4.): v. To drive away, dispel.

To REPEL , v. a. pratihan (c. 2. -hanti -ntuM), parAhan, vyAhan, pratisf (c. 10. -sArayati -yituM), apAs, prativf (c. 10. -vArayati -yituM), nivf, vf, apAnud (c. 6. -nudati -nottuM), vyapAnud, apanud, pratikzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzeptuM), samavakzip, pratibAD (c. 1. -bADate -DituM), niras (c. 4. -asyati -asitaM), apAsf, parAs, nirAkf, apAkf, pratikf, apoh (c. 1. -Uhate -hituM), apAvft in caus., pratyAdiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM), nivft in caus. See To RESIST.

REPELLED , p. p. parAhataH -tA -taM, pratihataH &c., vyAhataH &c., pratisAritaH -tA -taM, prativAritaH &c., parAstaH -stA -staM, nirastaH &c., nirAkftaH &c., apAvfttaH -ttA -ttaM, apanoditaH -tA -taM.
REPELLENT (adj.): (1) krUra (f. rA = fierce: as of looks);(2) pramATin (f. nI: as a r. medicine).

REPELLENT , REPELLING, a. or part. pratiGAtI -tinI -ti (n), prati- vArakaH -kA -kaM, nivArakaH &c., prativAraRaH -RA -RaM, pratisArakaH &c., pratikArakaH -kA -kaM; ‘a repellent,’ pratikAraH -raM, pratIkAraH -raM.
REPELLING , s. pratiGAtaH -tanaM, pratisAraRaM, prativAraRaM, nivAraRaM, vAraRaM, nirAkaraRaM, nirasanaM, parAsanaM, pratikAraH, pratikaraRaM.

Repent, v. t. anu-paScAt-tap 4 A, anuSI 2 A, anuSuc 1 P, anutApaM vah-vraj-gam 1 P, paScAt pIq-Kid pass. To REPENT , v. n. (Feel regret or remorse) anutap in pass. (-tapyate), paScAt tap, pratyanutap, paScAt santap, tap, manasA tap, anuSuc (c. 1. -Socati -cituM), paScAt Suc, Kid in pass. (Kidyate), paScAt Kid, anuSi (c. 2. -Sete -SayituM), pApasmftyA pIq in pass., anutApaM kf, paScAttApaM kf, anutaptaH -ptA -ptaM BU, santaptaH &c. BU, anuSokaM kf, anu- SayaM kf. — (Change the mind) manaH parivft (c. 10. -varttayati -yituM) or parAvft or vyAvft, anyamAnasIBU.
REPENTANCE: (1) paScAttApaH or anutApaH, “paScAttApa- sadfSavezaH, Sa. vi.;(2) anuSayaH, “anuSayAdanurodimi cotsukaH”, Sa. vi. 8.

REPENTANCE , s. paScAttApaH, anutApaH, santApaH, paScAtsantApaH, manastApaH, anuSokaH, anuSocanaM, anuSayaH, duzkftaKedaH, pApaKedaH, KedaH, paScAtKedaH, anvADiH m., paScAcCokaH, vimUritaM, vipratIsAraH, vipratisAraH, nivarttanaM, paScAttApabudDiH f., anutApabudDiH f. — (Change of mind) manaHparivarttanaM, manaHparAvarttanaM, manovyAvarttaH.
REPENTANT: (1) sAnutApaH (pA, paM);(2) paScAttApa- yutaH (tA, taM);(3) saYjAtAnuSayaH (yA, yaM);(4) anutApin (f. nI); etc.

REPENTANT , a. anutApI -pinI -pi (n), paScAttApI &c., anutaptaH -ptA -ptaM, anuSocakaH -kA -kaM, anuSayI -yinI &c., paScAttApayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, paScAttApAnvitaH -tA -taM, jAtAnutApaH -pA -paM, jAtapaScAttApaH &c., jAtAnuSokaH -kA -kaM, jAtAnuSayaH -yA -yaM, pApasmftipIqitaH -tA -taM, nuzkftasmftipIqitaH &c., jAtaKedaH -dA -daM, KedAnvitaH &c., anutApabudDiH -dDiH -dDi, paScAttApabudDiH &c., SAkuRaH -RI -RaM.

Repercussion, s. pratiDAtaH, pratipatanaM.

REPERCUSSIVE , a. pratiGAtI -tinI -ti (n), parAGAtI &c., pratisArakaH -kA -kaM.
REPERTORY: kozaH: v. Treasury, receptacle.
REPERTORY , s. kopaH, kopAgAraM, BARqAgAraM, saYcayAgAraM, BARqagfhaM.
REPETITION: I Reiteration:(1) punaruktiH; (2) dviruktiH;(3) by verb: v. To repeat (1). II Of acts;(1) samaBihAraH;(2) samaBivyAhAraH, S. k.III Recital, rehearsal: q. v.: vyAhAraH.

(Saying again) anuvAdaH, punarvAdaH, punaruktiH f., pOna- ruttayaM, punaHkaTanaM, punarvacanaM, punaruccAraRaM, muhurvacanaM, muhurBApA, punarBApA, anulApaH; ‘saying twice,’ dviruktiH f. — (Doing again) punaH- karaRaM, muhuHkaraRaM, punarviDAnaM, punaranuzWAnaM, punarAvfttiH f., punarAvarttanaM, [Page678-b+ 51] AvfttiH f., AvarttanaM, pOnaHpunyaM; ‘doing twice,’ dvirAvfttiH f. — (Of a word or sound) AmreqanaM, AmreqitaM. — (A word repeated) kaTitapadaM, kaTitavAkyaM. — (Of an act) kriyAsamaBihAraH, kriyAvfttiH f. — (Recital, rehearsal) paWanaM, pAWaH, anuvAdaH; ‘from memory,’ aByasanaM, aByAsaH.
Repine, v. i. vyaT 1 A, Suc 1 P, avasad 1 P, Kid-pIq-du-saMtap- pass.; See Fret. [Repin]ing, s. manastApaH, manovyaTA, SokaH.
REPINE: paritapyate (pass. of tap): v. To grieve.

REPINING (subs.): paritApaH: v. Grief, lamen- -tation.
REPINING , s. AtmavyaTA, manastApaH, manaHsantApaH, manovyaTA, avasAdaH.

Replace, v. t. (sTAne) punaH A-ni-DA 3 U or niviS c. or nyas 4 U or sTA c. (sTApayati); pUr 10, sTAne niviS c., pratiniDiM dA 3 U; ‘one servant was r(eplac)ed by two’ kiMkarasTAne kiMkaradvayaM niveSitaM; See Substitute.
REPLACE: I Lit.: pratizWApayati (c. of sTA): v. [Page589] To put again.II To supply the place of: pUrayati, pari-, saM-, (pUr, c. 10.).

To REPLACE , v. a. (Put again in its place) svasTAne punar f in caus. (arpayati -yituM) or punar DA (c. 3. daDAti, DAtuM) or punar ADA or punaH sTA in caus. (sTApayati -yituM) or punar nyas, pratisf (c. 10. -sArayati -yituM), punarADAnaM kf, punararpaRaM kf, punaHsTApanaM kf. — (Supply the place of) upakxp (c. 10. -kalpayati -yituM), upasfj (c. 6. -sfjati -srazwuM), upasarjanaM kf, pratiniDiM dA.
REPLACED , p. p. punararpitaH -tA -taM, punaHsTApitaH &c., pratisAritaH &c.

Replete, s. saM-pari-pUrRa, saM-A-kIrRa, pari-pUrita, A-ni-cita, AQya, maya (yI f.) in comp. [Replet]ion, s. pUrRatA, paryApti f.; pari-, pUrti f.
REPLETE: pUrRa (f. rRA): v. Full.

REPLETE , a. pUrRaH -rRA -rRaM, sampUrRaH -rRA -rRaM, paripUrRaH &c., payAptaH -ptA -ptaM, pUritaH -tA -taM, saMkIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, AkIrRaH &c., AQyaH -QyA -QyaM in comp., mayaH -yI -yaM in comp.; ‘replete with knowledge,’ vidyApUrRaH &c., sampUrRavidyaH -dyA -dyaM; ‘with guile,’ mAyAmayaH &c.
REPLETION: pUrRatA: v. Fullness, satiety.

REPLETION , s. (State of being completely filled) pUrRatA, paripUrRatA, sampUrRatA, paryAptiH f., pUrttiH f., ApUrttiH f., paripUrttiH f., ABogaH. — (Fulness of the blood or system from eating, &c.) ati- puzwiH f., atisOhityaM, raktabAhulyaM, raktavfdDiH f., raktADikyaM.
Replica, s. pratikfti f.
REPLICANT , s. uttaravAdI m. (n), prativAdI m., uttarapakzI m.
REPLIED , p. p. pratyuktaH -ktA -ktaM, punaruktaH &c. See ANSWERED.

Reply, s. uttaraM, prati-vacanaM-vAkyaM-vAc f.- ukti f. 2 uttarapakzaH, prativAdaH; ‘leave no room for r(eply)’ niruttarIkf 8 U. v. i. dA 3 U with (s.), uttaraM pratipad 4 A, prativac 2 P, prativad 1 P, BAz 1 A. 2 Echo, q. v. Replicant, s. uttara-vAdin m., prativAdI.

Ph.: to leave no ground for r. (i. e. to shut the mouth): niruttarIkaroti.
REPLY (v.): uttaraM dadAti (dA, c. 3.): v. To answer.

To REPLY , v. a. prativac (c. 2. -vakti -ktuM), prativad (c. 1. -vadati -dituM), punar vad, anuvad, punar vac, pratibrU, punar brU, pratiBAz, punar BAz, pratiBaR, punar BaR; ‘he replied,’ pratyuvAca, punarAha, pratyAha; see To ANSWER. — (In law) uttaraM vad, uttaraM kf, prativad.

REPLY , s. (Answer) prativacanaM, prativAkyaM, pratyuktiH f., pratyuktaM, uttaraM, pratyuttaraM, prativAk f. (c), prativAdaH, prativARI -RiH f. — (In dispu- tation) uttaraM, pratyuttaraM, kakzA, udgrAhaH, kowiH f., pratyarTaM.

Report, v. t. A-ni-vid c., AKyA 2 P or c. (KyApayati), vijYA c. (jYApayati), buD c., (vfttAMtaM liK) 6 P, Sru c.; ‘he is r(eport)ed to be dead’ sa mfta iti SrUyate, iti janaSrutiH-pravAdaH. s. ni-A-vedanaM, vijYA-panA, vijYapti f.; kaTanaM; ‘written r(eport)’ AvedanapatraM, vijYaptileKaH. 2 KyAti f., viSruti f., kIrti f.; ‘evil or bad r(eport)’ kOlInaM, akIrtiH. 3 vArtA, vfttAMtaH, pravAdaH, jana-loka-vAdaH-pravAdaH-SrutiH-vArtA, upaSruti, janaravaH; kiMvadaMtI; ‘there goes a r(eport)’ iti janapravAdaH &c. SrUyate, iti pravAdaH. 4 DvaniH, nAdaH, SabdaH; See Noise. [Report]er, s. vfttAMtanivedin m.
REPORT (v. t.): I To inform, relate: q. v.: Avedayati (c. of vid).II To make a r.: to r. about an abortion: BrURahatyAvfttAntam Avedayati or prerayati (Ir, c. 10 = to send).

Ph.: of good r.: puRyayaSas (mfn.): v. Fame.IV Sound, noise: q. v.: DvaniH.

To REPORT , v. a. (Give an account, relate) Avid (c. 10. -veda- yati -yituM), nivid, vid, AKyA, KyA in caus., jYA in caus., vijYA in caus., kaT, saMkaT, SaMs, buD in caus. — (Give an official account) aDikArapUrvvaM vijYApanaM kf or AvedanaM kf or vijYA in caus.

REPORT , s. (Account given, statement) AvedanaM, vijYApanaM, vijYaptiH f., vAdaH, kaTA; ‘written report,’ AvedanapatraM, vijYApanapatraM, leKaH. — (Rumor, common talk) pravAdaH, janapravAdaH, janavAdaH, janaSrutiH f., janavArttA, janaravaH, janavadantI, lokapravAdaH, lokavArttA, vArttA, kiMva- dantI, vadantI, vAdaH, upaSrutiH f., ravaH, vfttAntaH, AKyA, carcA, udGozaH, — (Reputation) kIrttiH f., KyAtiH f., yaSas n.; ‘good report,’ suKyAtiH f.; ‘evil,’ kuKyAtiH f., kukIrttiH f., akIrttiH f., kOlInaM. — (Sound, noise) SabdaH, DvaniH m., kvaRaH -RitaM.
REPORTED , p. p. (Related) AveditaH -tA -taM, kaTitaH &c., vijYaptaH -ptA -ptaM, vijYApitaH -tA -taM, AKyAtaH &c., SaMsitaH &c. — (Rumored) GozitaH -tA -taM, udGozitaH &c., kIrttitaH &c.
REPORTER , s. vfttAntaleKakaH, samAcAraleKakaH, vAkyasAraleKakaH.

(sTApayati), ni-A-DA 3 U. s. viSrA(Sra)maH, viSrAMti f., virAmaH, upa-pra-SamaH, pra-SAMti f., SramacCedaH-nivftti f., nirvfti f.
REPOSE (subs.): viSrAmaH: v. Rest (1).
