REPOSE (v. t.): I To lay at rest: viSrAmayati (c. of Sram).II To entrust: q. v.: nikzipati (kzip, c. 6.).

To REPOSE , v. n. (Lie, rest) SI (c. 2 Sete, SayituM), saMviS (c. 6. -viSati -vezwuM), viSram (c. 4. -SrAmyati -SramituM), SayanaM kf, see To LIE. — (Rest on) avalamb, samAlamb, saMSri, samASri, upASri, nilI, avalambanaM kf. — (Confide in) viSvas, viSramB.
REPOSE , s. viSrAmaH, viSrAntiH f., viSramaH, SamaH, SAntiH, virAmaH, SramaCedaH, klAntiCedaH, SramanivfttiH f., nirvftiH f., SIH f.
REPOSED , p. p. viSrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, gataSramaH -mA -maM, gataklamaH &c., nazwaSramaH &c., apahftaSramaH &c., nivfttaSramaH &c., CinnaklAntiH -ntiH -nti.
Reposit, v. t. ni-A-DA 3 U, nyas 4 P, rakz 1 P. [Reposit]ory, s. niDiH, AgAraM, niDAnaM, pAtraM, BAjanaM, ASrayaH, ASayaH, ADAraH, kozWaH, rakzaRasTAnaM.
To REPOSIT , v. a. niDA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM), nyam (c. 4. -asyati -asituM), nyAsIkf, rakzaRArTaM nyas or niDA, rakz (c. 1. rakzati -kzituM), saMrakz, niDiM kf.
REPOSITED , p. p. nyastaH -stA -staM, nihitaH -tA -taM, rakzitaH -tA -taM.
REPOSITORY: (1) niDiH, r. of knowledge: jYAna- niDiH: v. Abode;(2) kozaH (= treasury: q.v.): (3) AgAram (= house);(4) ASrayaH (= refuge).
REPOSITORY , s. niDiH m., niDAnaM, ADAraH, kozaH, AgAraM, BARqaM, BAjanaM, pAnaM, kozWaH -zWakaM, rakzaRasTAnaM; ‘of corn,’ DAnyAgAraM, DAnyakozWakaM.

Reprehend, v. t. Barts 10 A, paruzaM niMd 1 P, or upAlaB 1 A; See Censure. Reprehensible, a. niMdya, upAlaBya, garhita, garhaRIya, dUzaRIya. Reprehension, s. niMdA, garhA, BartsanaM-nA, dUzaRaM, upAlaMBaH.
REPREHEND: upAlaBate (laB, c. l.): v. To censure, blame.
REPREHENSIBLE: upAlaBya (f. ByA): v. Blame- -able, culpable.

REPREHENSIBLE , a. nindyaH -ndyA -ndyaM, nindanIyaH -yA -yaM, garhyaH -rhyA -rhyaM, garhaRIyaH -yA -yaM, vigarhyaH &c., pariBAzaRIyaH &c., dUzaRIyaH &c., dUzyaH -zyA -zyaM, dUzaRArhaH -rhA -rhaM, dozavAn -vatI -vat (t), sadozaH -zA -zaM, nindApAtraM, nindABAjanaM, pariBAzaRIyaH &c.
REPREHENSION: upAlamBaH: v. Censure, blame.
REPREHENSION , s. nindA -ndanaM, upAlamBaH. See REPROOF, BLAME.

Represent, v. t. varR 10, vi-vf 5 U, nirUp 10; oft. ex. by sTA c.; ‘r(epresent) even vices as virtues’ dozAnapi guRapakzamaDyAropayaMti, guRapakze sTApayaMti (Ka. 108); ‘r(epresent) in writing’ aBi-, liK 6 P, leKye niviS c. or Aruh c. 2 pra-, dfS c., sUc 10, A-vizkf 8 U, nirUp. 3 ni-A-vid c., vi-jYA c. (jYApayati); See Inform. 4 BUmO-sTAne-sTA 1 P, or vft 1 A; pratiniDiH BU; ‘you r(epresent) the queen’ BavAn rAjYIsTAne vartate, rAjYIpratiniDiH. 5 rUpaM-vezaM-grah 9 U or Df 1 P, 10; See Personate; (a play &c.) prayuj 10, ‘have not seen it r(epresent)ed’ na prayogato dfzwaM (Rat. 1); nAwakaM pra-yogeRADikriyatAM (S. 1) ‘let it be r(epresent)ed on the stage’; ‘r(epresent) a character’ BU-mikAyAM vft; ‘Urvaśī r(epresent)ing Lakshmī’ urvaSI lakzmIBUmikAyAM vartamAnA (V. 3). [Represent]ation, s. varRanaM, nivedanaM, vijYApanA, pradarSanaM, nirUpaRaM, vijYapti f. 2 prayogaH, aBinayaH. 3 pratikfti f., pratirUpaM, AleKyaM, praticCaMdaH, pratimA, pratimUrti f.; See Picture. [Represent]ative, s. pratiniDiH, pratiBUH, pratipuruzaH. a. pratiniDIBUta, AdarSaBUta.

REPRESENT: I To portray, delineate: q. v.: varRayati (varR, c. 10.).II To describe: q. v.: varRayati.III To inform: q. v.: A-vedayati, ni-, (c. of vid).IV To stand in the place of: BUmO tizWati (sTA, c. 1.), vartate (vft, c. l.), etc.V To personate: BUmikAyAM tizWati, etc., Urvasī r. ing Lakṣmī: lakzmIBUmikAyAM vartamAnorvaSI, V. iii.

To REPRESENT , v. a. (Exhibit) dfS (c. 10. darSayati -yituM), pradfS, see To SHOW. — (Describe) varR (c. 10. varRayati -yituM), anuvarR, vivf, nirUp; ‘in writing or drawing,’ liK (c. 6. liKati, leKituM), AliK, viliK. — (Personate) rUp (c. 10. rUpayati -yituM), aBinI, vezaM Df or Bf. — (State respectfully) nivid (c. 10. -veda- yati -yituM), vijYA in caus. (-jYApayati -yituM), nivedanaM kf, vijYApanaM kf. — (Stand in the place of) pratiniDir BU or as, pratiBUr as, pratipuruzo BU or as.

REPRESENTATION: I Delineation, descrip- -tion: q. v.: varRanA.II Information, respect- -ful statement:(1) Avedanam;(2) nivedanam. III Image, likeness:(1) pratikftiH;(2) pratirUpam.IV Theatrical: aBinayaH.

REPRESENTATION , s. (Act of exhibition) darSanaM, pradarSanaM, prakASanaM; ‘on the stage,’ aBinayaH -yanaM. — (Description) varRanaM -nA, anu- varRanaM, upavarRaM, nirUpaRaM. — (Respectful statement) nivedanaM, vi- jYApanaM -nA, vijYaptiH f., AvedanaM, upanyAsaH, upapAdanaM, — (Delinea- tion, sketch) AleKyaM, AleKanaM, leKyaM. — (Image, likeness, pic- ture) pratirUpaM, pratikftiH f., pratimA, pratimAnaM, pratimUrttiH f., mUrttiH f., pratiniDiH m., prativimbaM, praticCAyA, praticCandaH -ndakaM, citraM, citraleKA.
REPRESENTATIVE: I Subs.: pratiBUH: v. Subs- -titute, agent.II Adj.: expr. by verb or deriv., r. of the people: prajAsTAnIya (f. yA).
REPRESENTATIVE , a. pradarSakaH -kA -kaM, udbADakaH -kA -kaM, pratirUpakaH &c.
REPRESENTATIVE , s. pratiniDiH m., pratiBUH m., pratipuruzaH, upasarjanaM.

REPRESENTED , p. p. (Exhibited) darSitaH -tA -taM, pradarSitaH &c. — (Described) varRitaH -tA -taM. — (In a picture, &c.) citraliKitaH -tA -taM, AliKitaH &c., see PAINTED. — (Stated respectfully) niveditaH -tA -taM, AveditaH &c., vijYApitaH &c., vijYaptaH -ptA -ptaM, upanyastaH -stA -staM, upapAditaH &c. — (Having substitutes) saprati- niDiH -DiH -Di, sapratiBUH -BUH -Bu.
Repress, v. t. prati-ni-ruD 7 U, saM-ni-yam 1 P, niyaMtr 10, nigrah 9 P, praSam c.; See Check. [Repress]ion, s. niroDaH, niyamaH, nigrahaH, niyaMtraRaM. [Repress]ive, a. niroDin, nigrahakArin.
REPRESS: niyacCati (yam, c. l.): v. To res- -train, check.
To REPRESS , v. a. nigrah (c. 9. -gfhlAti -grahItuM), niyam (c. 1. -yacCati -yantuM), saMyam.
REPRESSED , p. p. nigfhItaH -tA -taM, saMyataH &c., jAtanigrahaH -hA -haM.
REPRESSION: niyantraRA: v. Restraint.
REPRESSION , s. nigrahaH -haRaM, saMyamaH -manaM, nigfhItiH f., yantraRaM.
REPRESSIVE , a. niyAmakaH -kA -kaM, nigrahakArI -riRI -ri (n).
Reprieve, s. viSrAmaH, virati f. 2 daMqavyAkzepaH-vilaMbaH. v. t. daMqaM vyAkzip 6 P or vi-laMb c., vyavahAradarSanaM vyAkzip.
REPRIEVE (subs.): I Lit.: daRqavyAkzepaH and sim. comp.s. (??).II Respite: viSrAmaH.III Reproof: BartsanA.
REPRIEVE (v.): expr. with vyAkzipati (kzip, c. 6.) or by subs.

REPRIEVE , a. daRqavilambaH -mbanaM, daRqanavilambaH, AkAlAntarAd daRqatyAgaH or daRqayApanaM, daRqakAlayApanaM, daRqakAlAntaranayanaM, parAvarttaH, daRqakAla- [Page679-b+ 51] parAvarttaH, daRqaparAvarttaH.

To REPRIEVE , v. x. daRqavilambanaM kf, daRqAvalambaM kf, AkAlAntarAd daRqanaM tyaj or yA in caus., SikzAvilambanaM kf, daRqaM or daRqakAlaM parAvft (c. 10 -varttayati -yituM), daRqakAlaparAvarttaM kf, prARadAnaM kf, prARadaRqa- vilambaM kf.
Reprimand, v. t. niMd 1 P, Barts 10 A, upAlaB 1 A, vAcA daMq 10, ava-aDi-kzip 6 P. s. niMdA, BartsanA-naM, upAlaMBaH, vAgdaMQaH, vAktAqanaM; See Censure.
REPRIMAND (v.): Bartsayati: To reprove, cen- -sure.
REPRIMAND (subs.): BartsanA: v. Reproof, censure.

To REPRIMAND , v. a. nind (c. 1. nindati -ndituM), pratyAdiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM), upAlaB (c. 1. -laBate -labDuM), garh, vigarh, aBiSaMs, kzip, Barts, SabdatAqanaM kf, muKadaRqanaM kf, vAgdaRqaM kf, DigdaRqaM kf. See To REPROVE.
REPRIMAND , s. upAlamBaH, vAgdaRqaH, SabdadaRqaH, SabdatAqanaM, DigdaRqaH, muKadaRqaH -RqanaM, pratyAdeSaH, pratyAdeSavAkyaM, BartsanavAkyaM, aBiSaMsanaM, nindA.
REPRIMANDED , p. p. upAlabDaH -bDA -bDaM, pratyAdizwaH -zwA -zwa, aBiSastaH &c.
REPRINT: I Verb: punamudrayati (?).II Subs.: expr. with punarmudritaH (tA, taM).
To REPRINT , v. a. punar mudra (nom. mudrayati -yituM), punar mudrIkf.
REPRINTED , p. p. punarmudritaH -tA -taM, punarmudrIkftaH &c., punarmudrANkitaH &c.
Reprisal, s. pratyapaharaRaM, pratipIqanaM.
REPRISAL: pratyapahAraH and sim. expr.s. (??).
REPRISAL , s. pratyapahAraH, pratyapaharaRaM, pratyapakAraH, pratyapakaraRaM, pratipIqanaM, kzatipUraRArTam apaharaRaM or apahAraH, hAnipUraRArTaM pratyapaharaRaM or pratiharaRaM.

Reproach, v. t. (paruzaM) niMd 1 P, garh 1, 10 A, upAlaB 1 A, AkruS 1 P, apa-pari-vad 1 A, nir-Barts 10 A, A-aDi-kzip 6 P, duz c. (dUzayati), kuts 10; sA-vajYaM niMd, tira-skf 8 U, Dikkf, avaman 4 A. s. DikkAraH, niMdA, garhA, tiraskAraH, A-aDi-kzepaH, pari(rI)vAdaH, upAlaMBaH, AkroSaH, BartsanaM-nA, paruzokti f., vAkpAruzyaM, duruktaM, vAgdaMqaH, niMdA-BartsanA-vAkyaM. 2 dUzaRaM, kalaMkaH, a-apa-kIrti f., lajjAspadaM. [Reproach]ful, a. niMdAgarBa; niMdAtmaka, parivAdaka; better by (s.) in comp.; ‘r(eproachful) words’ niMdAvaca-nAni. 2 garhita, niMdya, garhaRIya, lajjAprada [Reproach]fully, adv. sADikzepaM, sopAlaBaM.

REPROACH (v.): (1) garhayati, vi-, pari-, (garh, c. 10.); I r. ed the garland: tAmekAvalImagarhayam, K. ;(2) upAlaBate (laB, c. l.), (that you may) not be reviled by elders, r. ed by your friends: na Dik kriyase guruBiH, nopAlaByase suhfdBiH, K. ;(3) AkroSati (kruS, c. l. = to cry against), surely the birds r. ed him with (their) cries: KagAstamAcukruSu- rAravEH Kalu, N. i. 128.: v. censure.
REPROACH: I Censure, reviling:(1) upA- [Page590] -laBmaH;(2) tiraskAraH;(3) aDikzepaH;(4) Dik- kAraH;(5) garhaRam, -RA.II A disgrace: kalaNkaH: v. Also scandal.

To REPROACH , v. a. nind (c. 1. nindati -ndituM), vinind, pratinind, praRind, tiraskf, parivad (c. 1. -vadati -dituM), pariBAz (c. 1. -BAzate -zituM), upAlaB (c. 1. -laBate -labDuM), garh, vigarh, parigarh, kuts, aBikuts, Barts, apavad, AkruS, samAkruS, upakruS, gup in des., tarj, kzip, aDikzip, dozam Aruh in caus., dozaM kzip, dozAropaM kf, dozIkf, vAkpAruzyaM kf, Dikkf, DikpAruzyaM kf. See To BLAME, CENSURE.

REPROACH , s. nindA -ndanaM, tiraskAraH, tiraskriyA, parivAdaH, parIvAdaH, pariBAzA -zaRaM, garhA -rhaRaM, upAlamBaH, upakroSaH, AkroSaH, jugupsA, paruzoktiH f., paruzavacanaM, vAkpAruzyaM, DikpAruzyaM, DikkriyA, durvAkyaM, duruktaM, kutsA, GfRA, ftIyA, paryanuyogaH, arttanaM, vAcyatA, vacanIyatA, hfRIyA, rIjyA, CiH m., apakAragIH f.
REPROACHABLE , a. nindyaH -ndyA -ndyaM, pariBAzaRIyaH &c., garhyaH -rhyA -ryaM.
REPROACHED , p. p. ninditaH -tA -taM, tiraskftaH &c., upAlabDaH -bDA -bDaM, pariBAzitaH &c., garhitaH &c., aBikruzwaH -zwA -zwaM, DikkftaH &c.
REPROACHFUL: I Opprobrious:(1) by comp., r. speech: AkzepavacaH, Ki. xiv. 25.; tiraskAra- vacanam, M. n.;(2) aDikzepaka (f. pikA) and sim. deriv. (rare).II Shameful, vile: q. v.: garhita (f. tA).

REPROACHFUL , a. (Opprobrious) nindakaH -kA -kaM, parivAdakaH &c., kutsAvAdI -dinI -di (n), nindAtmakaH &c., GfRAkaraH -rA -raM, nindA- mayaH -yI -yaM. — (Shameful) garhyaH -rhyA -rhyaM, lajjAkaraH -rA -rI -raM, lajjApradaH -dA -daM.
REPROACHFULLY: I Opprobriously:(1) sADi- kzepam;(2) sopAlamBam;(3) by verb.II Shamefully:(1) garhitam;(2) better by adj.
REPROACHFULLY , adv. saninda, nindayA, satiraskAraM, sAsUyaM, saparivAdaM.

Reprobate, v. t. Dikkf 8 U, nyakkf, duz c., (dUzayati), garh 1, 10 A; See Reproach. a., s. durvftta, durAcAra, pApa-KaMqita-vftta, duzwa, pApAtman, duHSIla, durAtman; (of acts) duzwa, niMdya, garhya. [Reprobat]ion, s. garhA, garhaRaM, atiduzwatA.
REPROBATE (adj.): I Of men:(1) KaRqitavftta (f. ttA);(2) durAcAra (f. rA);(3) asADu (f. also DvI);(4) pApAtman (mfn.); etc.II Of acts etc.:(1) duzwa (f. zwA): v. Vicious;(2) aSudDa (f. dDA = impure).
REPROBATE (v.): nirAkaroti (kf, c. 8.): v. To condemn, reject.

REPROBATE , a. duzwaH -zwA -zwaM, durAcAraH -rA -raM, durAtmA -tmA -tma (n), DarmmavAhyaH -hyA -hyaM tyaktaDarmmA -rmmA -rmma(n), duzwaBAvaH -vA -vaM, pApAtmA &c., pApacetAH -tAH -taH (s), tyaktalajjaH -jjA -jjaM, duHSIlaH -lA -laM.
REPROBATE , s. duzwajanaH, kulanASaH -SanaH, vfzalaH hataparalokA.
To REPROBATE , v. a. garh (c. 1. garhate -rhituM), vigarh, garhApUrvvam asammatiM sUc (c. 10. sUcayati -yituM), nind (c. 1. nindati -ndituM), GfRAM kf, nyakkf.
REPROBATED , p. p. garhitaH -tA -taM, garhApUrvvaM ninditaH &c., vigarhitaH &c.
REPROBATION: nirAkftiH or -kriyA: v. Condem- -nation, censure, rejection.
REPROBATION , s. (Act) garhA -rhaRaM, vigarhaRaM -RA, nindA -ndanaM, GfRA. — (State) atiduzwatA, tyaktatvaM, garhyatA.
Reproduce, v. t. punaH kf 8 U or utpad c. or jan c.; ‘he r(eproduc)ed the whole speech’ samagrameva BAzaRaM sa yaTAtaTamudIrayAmAsa Reproduction, s. pratyutpatti f., punarjananaM.
REPRODUCE: (1) pratyutpAdayati (c. of pad);(2) punar janayati (c. of jan); etc.
REPRODUCED , p. p. pratyutpannaH -nnA -nnaM, pratyutpAditaH -tA -taM, punarutpannaH &c.
REPRODUCTION: (1) pratyutpattiH;(2) punarmilanam; etc.
REPRODUCTION , s. pratyutpAdanaM, pratyutpattiH f., punarutpAdanaM, punarutpattiH f.
REPROOF: (1) BartsanA;(2) DikkAraH: v. Cen- -sure, reproach.
REPROOF , s. nindA -ndanaM, pariBAzaRaM, parivAdaH, parIvAdaH, upAlamBaH, pratyAdeSaH, nindAvAkyaM, BartsanavAkyaM, BartsanA, vAgdaRqaH, muKadaRqaH, Sabda- daRqaH. See CENSURE, CHIDING.
REPROVABLE , a. nindyaH -ndyA -ndyaM, nindanIyaH -yA -yaM, pariBAzaRIyaH &c.
REPROVE: (1) Bartsayati, -te, nir-, sam- (Barts, c. 10.);(2) upAlaBate, sam-, (laB, c. l.): v. To censure, reproach.

To REPROVE , v. a. nind (c. 1. nindati -ndituM), pratinind, vinind, praRind, pratyAdiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM), upAlan (c. 1. -laBate -labDuM), parivad, apavad, pariBAz, apaBAz, garh, vigarh, Barts, gup in des., kuts, aBikuts, kzip, aDikzip, tiraskf, vAgdaRqaM kf, AkruS, upa- kruS, Dikkf. See To CENSURE.
REPROVED , p. p. ninditaH -tA -taM, pratyAdizwaH -zwA -zwaM, upAlabDaH -bDA -bDaM.
REPROVER , s. nindakaH, pratyAdeSakaH, parivAdakaH, vAgdaRqakArI m. (n).
Reptile, s. sarIsfpaH, sarpaRaSIlaH, uragaH, uro-gaH-gAmin m. uraMgamaH, sarpaH. a. sarpin, sarpaRaSIla.
REPTILE: (1) sarpajAtiH;(2) sarIsfpaH: v. Also snake.
REPTILE , s. uragaH, urogAmI m. (n), urogaH, urogamaH, uraNgaH, uraNgamaH, sarpaH, sarIsfpaH, sarpI m. (n), kfmiH m., vilavAsI m. (n), vile- vAsA m., vilOkAH m. (s), apadaH, apAdaH, bahupAdaH.
REPTILE , a. (Creeping) sarpI -rpiRI -rpi (n), sarpan -rzantI -rzat (t), sarpaRaH -RA -RaM. — (Relating to a reptile) sArpaH -rpI -rpaM, kfmilaH -lA -laM.

Republic, s. prajAsattAkaM-prajAtaMtraM-rAjyaM, loka-prajA-praButvaM. [Republic]an, a. prajApraButvaviSizwa, lokapraButvasaMbaMDin, (s.) in comp. s. prajA-praButvavAdin m., prajApakzavAdI. [Republic]anism, s. prajApraButvavAdaH, prajAtaMtrapakzaH.
REPUBLIC: *prajAtantram; prajArAjyam (comp. L. iii. “tezAM...noccamaDyavfdDajyezWAnupAlitA . ekEka eva manya- te'haM rAjAhaM rAjeti”).

REPUBLIC , s. lokapraButvaM, sarvvalokapraButvaM, lokakarttfkapraButvaM, prajApraButvaM, sarvvavarRapraButvaM, sarvvavarRADipatyaM, sADAraRapraButvaM, sADAraRADipatyaM, sADAra- RajanapraButvaM, lokasADAraRADipatyaM, sarvvaprajADipatyaM, lokakarttfkarAjyaM, sAmAnyajanakarttfkarAjyaM, lokapAlitaM rAjyaM, sADAraRajanapAlitarAjyaM, prajApAlitarAjyaM.
REPUBLICAN: I Belonging to a republic: expr. by comp.II = subs., of men: *prAjAtantra (f. ntrI); prajAtantrAnuga (f. gA); etc.
REPUBLICAN , a. lokapraButvasambanDI -nDinI -nDi (n), prajApraButvasambanDI &c., lokADipatyasambanDI &c., lokapraButvavizayakaH -kA -kaM, lokapraBu- tvAnusArI &c., lokapraButvAnurUpaH -pA -paM.
REPUBLICAN , a. lokapraButvavAdI m. (n), lokADipatyapakzapAtI m., loka- praButvAvalambI m., prajADipatyavAdI m., prajADipatyAnugrAhI m., prajAnATaH, lokanATaH.
REPUBLICANISM: prajAtantrAnurAgaH and sim. comp.s.
REPUBLICANISM , s. lokapraButvapakzapAtaH, lokADipatyapakzapAtaH, lokapraBu- tvAvalambanaM, prajADipatyavAdaH, lokADipatyAnugrahaH.
REPUBLICATION: perh. punaHprakASaH and sim. comp.s.

Repudiate, v. t. pratyAdiS 6 P, nirAkf 8 U, nir-apa-as 4 U, niH-sf c., pari-tyaj 1 P, pratyAKyA 2 P, apaDvaMs c., ava-nir-DU 5, 9 U, 6 P; See Reject also [Repudiat]ion, s. pratyAdeSaH, nirAkaraRaM, pratyAKyAnaM, parityAgaH, apAsanaM. 2 vivAhasaMbaMDatyAgaH, dAMpatyaviSlezaH.
REPUDIATE: pratyAKyAti (KyA, c. 2.): v. To reject.
To REPUDIATE , v. a. pratyAKyA (c. 2. -KyAti -tuM), nirAkf, niras, pratTAdiS, tyaj, parityaj, pratyAcakz, nirnud, apaDvaMs. See To REJECT.
REPUDIATED , p. p. pratyAKyAtaH -tA -taM, nirAkftaH &c., pratyAdizwaH -zwA -zwaM.
REPUDIATION: pratyAKyAnam: v. Rejection.

REPUDIATION , s. pratyAKyAnaM, nirasanaM, nirAsaH, nirAkaraRaM, nirAkftiH f., tyAgaH, parityAgaH, pratyAdeSaH, see REJECTION. — (Divorce) vivA- hasambanDatyAgaH, vivAhasambanDamuktiH f., dAmpatyamuktiH f., BAryyAnirAkaraRaM.
REPUGNANCE (v.): (1) virAgaH: v. Aversion; (2) dvezaH: v. Hatred.
REPUGNANCE , REPUGNANCY, s. pratikUlatA, prAtikUlyaM, viroDaH, viru- dDatA, vEparItyaM, vimuKatA, vimatiH f., adicCA.
Repugnant, a. pratIpa, virudDa, pratikUla, viparIta, atyaMtavimuKa-virakta. Repugnance, s. viroDaH, prAtikUlyaM, vEparItyaM, virAgaH, vidvezaH, anicCA, vEmuKyaM, vimati f., virakti f.
REPUGNANT: (1) virudDa (f. dDA = opposed to, contrary);(2) pratIpa (f. pA = disagreeable, perverse).
REPUGNANT , a. pratikUlaH -lA -laM, virudDaH -dDA -dDaM, viparItaH -tA -taM, viroDI -DinI &c., vimuKaH -KA -KI -KaM. See OPPOSED, ADVERSE.
REPUGNANTLY: (1) virakta (f. ktA = with aver- -sion);(2) pratIpam (= with opposition, per- -versely).

Repulse, v. t. nirAkf 8 U, niH-prati-vf c., avaDIr 10; pratyAdiS 6 P, pratyAKyA 2 P, parA-prati-han 2 P, BaMj 7 P, vi-dru c., (army). [Repuls]ion, s. nirAkaraRaM, niHsAraRaM, pratyAdeSaH, avaDIraRaM-RA, pratiGAtaH, pratihananaM; vidrAvaRaM, parAjayaH, BaMgaH [Repuls]ive, a. a priya, dvizwa, niMdya, bIBatsa, bIBatsAvaha; See Hideous. 2 pratiGAtin, pratisArin.
REPULSE: I Verb: nirAkaroti (kf, c. 8.): v. To drive away.II Subs.: nirAkftiH or nirA- kriyA: v. Rejection.
REPULSE , s. pratiGAtaH, pratihatiH f., parAhananaM, pratihananaM, pratisAraRaM, nivAraRaM, vAraRaM, vyapAkftiH f., vidravaH, vidrAvaRaM, parAjayaH, apajayaH.
To REPULSE , v. a. parAhan (c. 2. -hanti -luM), pratihan, pratisf. See To REPEL.

REPULSED , p. p. parAhataH -tA -taM, pratihataH &c., vyAhataH &c., nihataH &c., AhataH &c., prahataH &c., pratisAritaH &c., pratikziptaH -ptA -ptaM, vidrAvitaH &c., nivAritaH &c., vyapAkftaH &c., parAjitaH &c., pratyA- KyAtaH &c.
REPULSION: nirAkaraRam: v. Repulse, rejection.
REPULSION , s. pratisArakatvaM, pratiGAtakatvaM, pratisAraRaguRaH, pratisAraRa- SaktiH f., pratihananaSaktiH f., pratihananaM, pratisAraRaM. See REPULSE.
REPULSIVE: Fig.: (1) krUra (f. rA = fierce);(2) apriya (f. yA = unpleasant);(3) dvizwa (f. zwA = hated).

REPULSIVE , a. (Repelling) pratiGAtI -tinI -ti (n), pratiGAtakaH -kA -kaM, pratisAgkaH -kA -kaM, nivArakaH &c., vArakaH &c. — (Forbidding) aprItijanakaH -kA -kaM, trAsajanakaH &c., trAsakaraH -rI -raM, amaNgalaH -lA -laM, aprasannamuKaH -KI -KaM.
REPUTABLE: mAnya (f. nyA): v. Respectable.

REPUTABLE , a. (In good esteem) nAnyaH -nyA -nyaM, sammAnyaH &c. mAnanIyaH -yA -yaM, AdaraRIyaH &c., praSaMsanIyaH &c., mAnArhaH -rhA -rhaM, [Page680-b+ 51] sammAnArhaH &c., SizwaH -zwA -zwaM. — (Conferring reputation, not disgraceful) mAnadaH -dA -daM, mAnapradaH &c., mAnadAyI -yinI &c., yaSasyaH -syA -syaM, yaSaskaraH -rI -raM, kIrttikaraH -rI -raM, KyAtikaraH &c., supratizWaH -zWA -zWaM, alajjAkaraH &c.
REPUTABLY: (1) by circumlo.;(2) suzWu (= well).
REPUTABLY , adv. samAnaM, yaTA suKyAtir utpadyate taTAprakAreRa.
REPUTATION, REPUTE (subs.): I Fame, re- -nown: q. v.: kIrtiH.II Estimation, regard: of bad r.: duzkIrtimat (f. tI); better by verb.

REPUTATION , s. kIrttiH f., KyAtiH f., viKyAtiH f., pratizWA, samAKyA, yaSas n., pariKyAtiH f., pratiKyAtiH f., praviKyAtiH, prakIrttiH f., kIrttanA -naM, pratipattiH f., praTA, sampraTA, maryyAdA, samAjYA, prasidDiH f., gOravaM, cAritraM; ‘one who has established a reputation,’ labDapratizWaH -zWA -zWaM, prAptapratizWaH &c.; ‘good reputation,’ sukIrttiH f., satkI- rttiH f., suKyAtiH f.; ‘bad reputation,’ kukIrttiH f., duzkIrttiH f., akIrttiH, apakIrttiH f., kuKyAtiH f., aKyAtiH f., ayaSas n., vAcyatA.

Repute, v. t. man 4 A, aBi-saM-°, gaR 10; See Consider, ‘r(eput)ed as authors’ kartftvenABimatAH [Reput]ation, s. kIrti f., KyAti f., pra-vi-°, yaSas n., pratizWA, praTA-pratipatti f., gOravaM, prasidDi f.; ‘of established r(eputation)’ labDapratizWa; ‘good r(eputation)’ suKyAtiH; ‘bad r(eputation)’ duzkIrtiH, apa-a-kIrtiH, vAcyatA, kOlInaM, durnAma. [Reput]able, a. saM-, mAnya, praSasya, mAnanIyaM, AdaraRIya. 2 yaSaH-kIrti-kara (rI f.), kIrti-mAna-prada. [Reput]ed, a. aBimata, jana-loka-viSruta, sarvajYAta, jana-prasidDa.
REPUTE (v.): manyate (man, c. 4.): v. To regard, consider.
To REPUTE , v. a. gaR (c. 10. gaRayati -yituM), vigaR, man (c. 4. manyate, mantuM, c. 10. mAnayati -yituM), saMKyA, parisaMKyA, kFt (c. 10. kIrttayati -yituM).
REPUTE , s. kIrttiH f., KyAtiH f., prasidDiH f. See REPUTATION.
REPUTED , p. p. mataH -tA -taM, gaRitaH &c., vigaRitaH &c., kIrttitaH &c.

Request, v. t. yAc 1 A, arT 10 A, pra-aBi-°, vi-jYA c. (jYApayati), savinayaM ni-A-vid c. s. prArTanA, aByarTanA, yAcanA, vijYApanA, vijYapti f., ni-A-vedanaM, yAcYA. 2 AkAMkzA, icCA, aBilAzaH, ApekzA; ‘in general r(equest)’ sarvABIpsita, bahuSaH izwa.
REQUEST (v.): prArTayate (arT, c. 10.): v. To ask (II), beg, entreat.

REQUEST (subs.): (1) prArTanA or aByarTanA, r. s to stronger (men) end in evils: prArTanADikabale vipatPalA, Ki. xiii. 61.;(2) yAcYA, it is better that a r. to a good man is unsuccessful: yAcYA moGA varamaDiguRe, Me. i. 6.;(3) yAcitam, pra- (rare).

REQUEST , s. (Entreaty) prArTanaM -nA, arTanA, aByarTanA, arTaH, yAcanA, yAcYA, svArTanivedanaM, arTavijYApanA, saniH -nI m. f. — (Desire) AkAMkzA, aBikAMkzA, kAMkzA, icCA, ezA, aDyezaRA. — (State of being desired or held in estimation) apekzA, AkAMkzA, mAnyatA -tvaM, mAnanIyatA; ‘general request,’ lokamAnyatA.

To REQUEST , v. a. prArT (c. 10. -arTayate -ti -yituM), aByarT, samprArT, arT, yAc (c. 1. yAcati -te -cituM), aBiyAc, prayAc, samprayAc, saMyAc, arTaM nivid (c. 10. -bedayati -yituM) or vijYA in caus. (-jYApa- yati -yituM), vf (c. 9. vfRIte, varituM -rItuM, c. 10. vArayati -yituM), kAMkz, AkAMkza, aBikAMkz.
REQUESTED , p. p. prArTitaH -tA -taM, aByarTitaH &c., arTitaH &c., yAcitaH &c., arditaH -tA -taM.

Require, v. t. prArT 10 A, pracC 6 P, yAc 1 A. 2 (Need) vi-, apekz 1 A, AkAMkz 1 P; oft. ex. by upayogaH, prayojanaM, kAryaM, with instr.; or arh 1 P; or by pot. pass. part.; ‘that it is affection and should r(equire) a cause is a contradiction’ srehaSca nimittasavyapekza iti vipratizidDametat (Mal. 1); ‘I do not r(equire) his help’ na mama tasya sAhAyyena prayojanaM; ‘r(equire)s a careful consideration’ nipuRamavekzaRIyaH, nipu-RAvekzaRamarhati. [Require]ment, s. Ex. by (v.); ‘all the r(equirement)s of man’ yadyannarErapekzyate or izyate. Requisite, a. AvaSyaka (kI f.), avaSyaka, AkAMkzita, apekzita. s. avaSyaka-vastu-dravyaM, apekzitaM. Requisition, prArTanA-naM, apekzA, AkAMkzA.
REQUIRE: I To ask, demand: q. v.: prArTayate. II To need, call for: apekzate (Ikz, c. l.), r. s you as the best cause: apekzate pratyayamunttamaM tvAm, Ku. iii. 18.

To REQUIRE , v. a. (Ask, demand) prArT (c. 10. -arTayati -te -yituM), yAc (c. 1. yAcati -cituM), aBiyAc. — (Need, call for) AkAMkz (c. 1. -kAMkzati -kzituM), aBikAMkz, kAMkz, arh (c. 1. arhati -rhituM), prArT; or expressed by BU or as in conjunction with the nouns prayojanaM, upayogaH or kAryyaM. See To NEED. The desid. form may sometimes be used to express the sense of ‘require,’ thus; ‘three quantities being given, it is re- quired to find a fourth,’ trIn rASIn nirdiSya caturTo jijYAsyate (desid. pass. of jYA).
REQUIRED , p. p. AkAMkzitaH -tA -taM, aBikAMkzitaH &c., prArTitaH &c.
REQUIREMENT: expr. by verb, all her r. s were supplied: yadeva vavre tadapaSyadAhftam, R. iii. 6.: v. Requisition.
REQUISITE: (1) AvaSyakIya (f. yA = necessary: q. v.);(2) by verb: v. To require (II).
REQUISITE , a. AkAMkzitaH -tA -taM, AkAMkzaRIyaH -yA -ya, aBikAMkzitaH &c., prayojanIyaH &c., prayojanArhaH -rhA -rhaM, avaSyakaH -kA -kaM, Ava- SyakaH -kI -kaM, avaSyaprApaRIyaH &c. See NEEDFUL.
REQUISITE , s. avaSyakavastu n., avaSyakadravyaM, avaSyakavizayaH; ‘requi- sites,’ prayojanIyadravyasAmagrI, upakaraRasAhityaM. See NECESSARIES.
REQUISITION: (1) anuyogaH (= demand);(2) [Page591] prArTanA (= request). Ph.: to be in r.: apekzate: v. To require.
REQUISITION , s. AkAMkzA, aBikAMkzA, kAMkzA, prArTanaM -nA, aByarTanaM -nA, arTanA, yAcanaM -nA, apekzA -kzaRaM; ‘is in requisition,’ sevyatAM yAti.
REQUITAL: I Retaliation, punishment:(1) prati (tI) kAraH;(2) pratikriyA.II Reward, com- -pensation: q. v.

REQUITAL , s. (Recompense, return) pratiPalaM, pratidAnaM, nistAraH, nizkftiH f., pratyupakAraH, pAritozikaM, upakAramokzaH, upakAraSudDiH f., SudDiH f., pariSoDaH, parivarttanaM. — (Retaliation) pratikAraH, pratIkAraH, pratikftiH f., pratikriyA, pratyapakAraH, pratikarmma n. (n), pratihiMsA, niryAtanaM

Requite, v. t. pratidA 3 U, pratiPalaM dA, pratyupakf 8 U, nistF c.; See Recompense, Repay; (grudge &c.) pratikf, niryat 10, SuD c., sAD c. [Requit]al, s. pratidAnaM, pratiPalaM, nistAraH, nizkfti f., pratyu-pakAraH, pAritozikaM, niryAtanaM. 2 prati(tI-)kAraH, pratikriyA, SudDi f.; sADanaM.
REQUITE: I To retaliate, punish: q. v.: pratikaroti.II To reward, repay: niryAtayati (c. of yat).

To REQUITE , v. a. (Compensate, repay) pratiPalaM dA, pratidA, pratiPala (nom. pratiPalavati -yituM), nizkftiM dA; pratyupakf; nistAra kf, pAri [Page681-a+ 51] tozikaM dA. — (Retaliate) pratikf, vipratikf, pratyapakf, pratikAraM kf, pratihiMs (c. 1. -hiMsati -situM, c. 7. -hinasti), niryat (c. 10. -yAta- yati -yituM).
REQUITED , p. p. pratiPalitaH -tA -taM, pratikftaH &c., vipratikftaH &c., niryAtitaH &c.
To RESALUTE , v. a. pratyaBinand (c. 1. -nandati -ndituM), pratinand, pratyaBi- vad, pratyarc.
Rescind, v. t. vilup c., KaMq 10, niras 4 U, nivft c. Rescission, s. vi-, lopaH, KaMqanaM, nirasanaM; See Repeal.
RESCIND: KaRqayati (KaRq, c. 10.): v. To repeal, cancel.
To RESCIND , v. a. lup (c. 6. lumpati, loptuM), lopaM kf, KaRq (c. 10. KaRqa- yati -yituM), ucCid (c. 7. -Cinatti -CettuM), pariCid, ucCid, BaNgaM kf, BaYj. See To REPEAL.
RESCINDED , p. p. luptaH -ptA -ptaM, KaRqitaH &c., ucCinnaH -nnA -nnaM, pariCinnaH &c.
RESCISSION , s. lopaH, KaRqanaM, ucCedaH, paricCedaH, BaNgaH, udDaraRaM, nirudDaraRaM, ava- ropaH -paRaM, anuSayaH, vipratipattiH f.; ‘of sale,’ krayAnuSayaH. See REPEAL.
RESCRIPT: SAsanam: v. Edict, command.
RESCRIPT , s. SAsanaM, AjYApatraM, SAsanapatraM, rAjAjYA, nibanDaH.

Rescue, v. t. muc 6 P or c., mokz 10, vi-nir-°, nistF c., ud-hf 1 P or Df 10; pari-trE 1 A, rakz 1 P; See Protect. s. vi-, mukti f., mocanaM, mokzaH-kzaRaM, udDAraH; pari-, trARaM, rakzaRaM, nistAraH, tAraRaM; ‘on, on, to the r(escue)’ satvaraM paritrAyaDvaM. [Rescu]er, s. udDartf m., trAtA, rakzakaH, mokzakaH.
RESCUE (v.): mocayati or mokzayati, pari-, vi-, nir- (muc and mokz, c. 10.), was r. d by you: tvayA mocitaH, Mr. x.: v. Also to save.
RESCUE (subs.): (1) muktiH or mokzaH, pari-, vi-; (2) udDAraH, sam-: v. Also release, deliverance.

To RESCUE , v. a. trE (c. 1. trAyate, trAtuM), paritrE, saMtrE, udDf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), samudDf, rakz (c. 1. rakzati -kzituM), parirakz, aBirakz, saMrakz, muc (c. 6. muYcati, moktuM), c. 10. mocayati -yituM), vimuc, nirmuc, mokz (c. 10. mokzayati -yituM), vimokz, nistF (c. 10. -tArayati -yituM), tF, udDaraRaM kf, udDAraM kf, rakzaRaM kf; ‘from confinement,’ banDanAd muc.

RESCUE , s. trARaM, paritrARaM, udDaraRaM, udDAraH, samudDAraH, samudDaraRaM, rakzA -kzaRaM, parirakzaRaM, nistAraH, nistaraRaM, tAraRaM, muktiH f., mocanaM, vimocanaM, mokzaH -kzaRaM, parimokzaRaM; ‘to the rescue!’ trAhi, trAyasva.

RESCUED , p. p. udDftaH -tA -taM, samudDftaH &c., trARaH -RA -RaM, trAtaH -tA -taM, rakzitaH -tA -taM, parirakzitaH &c., muktaH -ktA -ktaM, mocitaH -tA -taM, vimocitaH &c., nistAritaH &c.; ‘from confinement,’ muktabanDanaH -nA -naM, banDanamuktaH -ktA -ktaM.
RESCUER , s. trAtA m. (tf), udDarttA m. (rttf), rakzakaH, muktidAtA m. (tf), udDArakaH, mocakaH, nivarttakaH. See DELIVERER.
Research, s. anvezaRaM-RA, nirUpaRaM, amu-saMDAna, jijYAsA, mArgaRaM, vicAraRA.
RESEARCH (subs.): (1) gavezaRam, -RA;(2) gave- zitam: v. Also search.

RESEARCH , s. anvezaRaM -RA, paryezaRaM -RA, anusanDAnaM, parIzwiH f., saMvIkzaRaM, gavezaRaM -RA, nirUpaRaM, jijYAsA, mImAMsA, mArgaRaM, mfgaRA, mfgayA, mfgaH, vicAraRA, tattvAnusanDAnaM, vicayaH, vIcayanaM, vicayanaM.

RESEMBLANCE: (1) sAdfSyam, r. between them and Rāma: rAmasya tayoSca sAdfSyam, R. xv. 67.; so close r. that it cannot be ascertained: IdfSaM sOsA- dfSyaM yena na jYAyate, Na. ii.;(2) sArUpyam or sarUpatA, your excellences bear our r.: guRAstvadIyA naH sarUpatAM majante, Ki. iii. 42.;(3) sADarmyam or saDarmatA (in qualities), (the only) r. in imitating me is (your) great enmity: sADarmyaM madanukfteH praDAnavEram, Mu. iii. 12.

RESEMBLANCE , s. (Likeness) OpamyaM, sAdfSyaM, sadfSatA, sarUpatA, sArUppaM, samatA, sAmyaM, samAnatA, tulyatA -tvaM, tulA, tOlyaM, sArUpyaM, sarUpatA, upamA, upamitiH f., upamAnaM -natA, anukAraH, anuhAraH, see LIKENESS. — (Something similar, a representation) upamA, pratimA -mAnaM, pratirUpaM, pratiBAsaH, pratikftiH f., pratimUrttiH f., praticCAyA, prativimbaM, pratiniDiH m.

Resemble, v. t. saM-vad 1 P (with instr.), anukf 8 U (with gen.), anuhf 1 P (with acc.); ‘the characters r(esemble) each other’ saMvadaMtyakzarARi (Mu. 5); gen. by tulya, sadfSa, samAna, upama, anurUpa in comp., (‘Like’, q. v.); Bava pituranu-rUpo guREH (V. 5) ‘r(esemble) your father in qualities’; dehabaMDena svareRa ca rAmaBadramanu-harati, asya muKaM vaDvA muKacaMdreRa saMvadatyeha (U. 4). 2 upa-prati-mA 3 A, 2 P, samIkf. [Resembl]ance, s. sAdfSyaM; sArUpyaM, tulyatvaM, saMvAdaH, sAmyaM, OpamyaM, upamA, anukAraH, anuhAraH, tulA; sADarmyaM (in qualities); ‘to bear r(esemblance)’ sAdfSyaM-tulAM-aDiruh or samAruh 1 P; See (v.); (tulAM yadArohati daMtavAsasA K. v. 34). 2 pratikfti f., pratirUpaM, AleKyaM; See Picture. [Resembl]ing, a. saMvAdin, (na kevalama-smadaMgasaMvAdinI AkftiH U. 6); anurUpa, tulya, sama, samAna, anukArin, anuhArin.

To RESEMBLE , v. a. (Be like) sadfSaH -SI -SaM BU or as, sadfSIBU, anukf (c. 8. -karoti -karttuM), tulyaH -lyA -lyaM BU, samaH -mA -maM BU, samAnaH -nA -naM BU, upamaH -mA -maM BU, sarUpaH -pA -paM BU, anurUpaH -pA -paM BU; ‘the son resembles his father,’ putraH pitur anukaroti or putraH pitfrUpo Bavati or putraH pitrA sadfSAkAro Bavati; ‘no one re- sembles him,’ anena sadfSaH kaScin nAsti or tasya tulyaH or tena tulyaH or tena samo na ko'pi Bavati. A nominal verb may some- times express the sense of ‘resemble,’ thus; ‘he resembles a lion,’ siMhAyate; ‘it resembles heaven,’ svargAyate. — (Liken) upamA (c. 2. -mAti, c. 3. -mimIte -mAtuM), sadfSIkf, samIkf, samAna (nom. samAnayati -yituM).
RESEMBLING: sadfSaH (SA, SaM): v. Like.

RESEMBLING , part. anukArI -riRI -ri (n), sadfSaH -SI -SaM, tulyaH -lyA -lyaM, samaH -mA -maM, samAkAraH -rA -raM, sarUpaH -pA -paM, rUpaDft m. f. n., rUpaBft m. f. n., savarRaH -rRA -rRaM &c. See LIKE.

Resent, v. i. aBi-prati-kruD 4 P (with acc.) kruD-kup-ruD 4 P, apakArApekzayA kup. [Resent]ful, a. kroDila, kroDaSIla, samanyu, sAsUya, pratyapakArabudDi. [Resent]ment, s. kopaH, kroDaH, rozaH, amarzaH, manyuH; See Indignant, &c.
RESENT: kupyati (kup, c. 4.): v. (To be) angry, indignant.

To RESENT , v. n. apakAram apekzpa kup (c. 4. kuppati, kopituM) or prakup or kruD (c. 4. kruDyati, krodDuM) or ruz (c. 4. rupyati, rozituM) or rozaM kf or manyuM kf, apakAramapekzya pratyapakArAya or pratikArAya manaH kf, apakAramapekzya jAtamanyuH -nyuH -nyu BU or jAtakroDaH -DA -DaM BU, apakAramapekzya kroDAt pratyapakAraM kf in des., hiMsAm apekzya jAtakro- DatvAt pratihiMsAM kf in des. (cikIrzati -rzituM) or pratidrohAya manaH kf
RESENTFUL: kroDaSIla (f. lA) and sim. comp. s: v. Angry, irritable.

RESENTFUL , a. samanyuH -nyuH -nyu, jAtamanyuH &c., pratihiMsAbudDiH -dDiH -dDi, pratidrohabudDiH &c., pratyapakArabudDiH &c., kroDaSIlaH -lA -laM, kopa- SIlaH &c., pratihiMsASIlaH &c., daMSI -SinI -Si (n), sAsUyaH -yA -yaM.
RESENTMENT: manyuH: v. Anger.
RESENTMENT , s. manyuH m., kroDaH, kopaH, rozaH, prakopaH, pratidrohabudDiH f., pratyapakArabudDiH f., pratihiMsAbudDiH f., daMSaH, dvezaH, asUyA, IrzyA, mAtsaryyaM.
RESERVATION: I Keeping back, concealing: (1) saMvftiH;(2) saMvaraRam.II Exception, res- -triction: q. v.

RESERVATION , s. (Keeping back, concealing) gopanaM, guptiH f., upasaMhAraH, upasaMharaRaM, upasaMhftiH f., saMharaRaM, saMhftiH f., pratyAhAraH, pratyAharaRaM, saMvftiH f., saMvaraRaM, apavaraRaM, apAvaraRaM, DftiH f., DaraRaM, viDftiH f., viDaraRaM, vinigrahaH, niBfte sTApanaM. — (Mental reser- vation) manoguptiH f., manogopanaM, manosaMvftiH f., manosaMvaraRaM, nihnutiH f., apahnutiH f., nihnavaH, apahnavaH. — (Custody, keeping in store) rakzA -kzaRaM, parirakzaRaM, saMgrahaRaM, saYcayaH -yanaM.

Reserve, v. t. saM-pratisaM-hf 1 P, nigrah 9 P. 2 (AkAlAMtarAt) saM-ci 5 U, ni-DA 3 U, saMgrah, rakz 1 P, avaSiz 7 P or c., tyaj 1 P, (temporarily); ApadarTe DanaM rakzet ‘should r(eserve) his money for times of want’. 3 gup 1 P, saM-vf 5 U, apahnu 2 A, na spazwIkf na viSadIkf. s. saMvaraRaM, saMvfti f., ni-apa-hnavaH, manogupti f. 2 ni-, yaMtraRaM-RA, nigrahaH, niroDaH; ‘without any r(eserve)’ vivftaM, nirvyAjaM, aniyaMtraRaM, niryaMtraRaM. 3 (Of disposition) vAgyaMtraRaM, kaTA-AlApa-virakti f., parANmuKatA, alpaBAzaRaM, vAgyatatvaM. 4 saMcayaH, saMgrahaH. 5 (Of an army) prati-pari-grahaH, pratyAsA(sa)raH, pArzRitraM sEnyaM. [Reserv]ation, s. gopanaM, nigrahaH, saMhAraH, guptiH, apavAraRaM. 2 ni-apa-hnavaH, manoguptiH, saMtaraRaM, saMvftiH. 3 parivarjanaM, apavAdaH, vyAvftti f.; ‘with this r(eservation) only’ ayameva tasyApavAdaH. 4 saMgrahaH-haRaM, saMcayaH. [Reserv]ed, a. rakzita, gupta, avaSezita. 2 saMvftimat, gUQaBAva, guptAMtaH-karaRa, anuttAnahfdaya, saMvaraRaSIla; vAgyata, yaMtritavAk, kaTA or AlApa-virakta or vimuKa, alpaBAzin, alpAlApin. [Reserv]edly, adv. gUQaBAvena, saMvftacetasA. Reservoir, s. jalASayaH, taqAgaH-gaM, jalADAraH, toyADAraH, vApI.
RESERVE (v.): I To keep, retain: q. v.: rakzati (rakz, c. 1.).II To except: q. v.: varjayati (vfj, c. 10.).

RESERVE (subs.): I In gen.:(1) saMvftiH, r. only disclose one's affections: kaTayati saMvftireva kAmitAni, Ki. x. 44.; r. d mind: saMvftimanmanaH, Si. xv. 11.;(2) saMvaraRam, it is (his) r.: saMvaraRaM hi tat, Mal. i. Ph.: without r.: vivftam;(3) saMkocaH, M. n. on Si. vi. 74;(4) ASaNkA (= apprehension), without r.: samudDwatASaNkam, Si.: v. Also openly.II Of troops: pari (prati) grahaH.

To RESERVE , v. a. (Keep back, withhold to a future time) upasaMhf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), pratyAhf, saMhf, viDf (c. 1. -Darati -DarttuM, c. 10. -DArayati -yituM), vinigrah (c. 9. -gfhlAti -grahItuM), nigrah, AkA- lAntarAt or kAlAntaraM yAvad upasaMhf or rakz (c. 1. rakzati -kzituM) or parirakz. — (Lay up, keep in store to a future time) rakz, parirakz, AkAlAntarAt or parakAlaM yAvad rakz or niDA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM) or sannyas (c. 4. -asyati -situM) or saMci (c. 5. -cinoti -cetuM) or saMgrah. — (Conceal to another time) AkAlAntarAd gup (c. 1. gopAyati, c. 10. gopayati, goptuM) or gopanaM kf or niBfte sTA in caus. (sTApayati -yituM) or saMvf (c. 5. -vfRoti -varituM, c. 10. -vAra- yati -yituM) or apavf or apAvf or saMvaraRaM kf; ‘in the mind,’ manasA gup, manogopanaM kf — (Suffer to remain to another time) AkAlAntarAt Siz (c. 10. Sezayati -yituM) or pariSiz or avaSiz or rakz; ‘one should reserve one's money for a time of want,’ ApadarTaM DanaM rakzet.

RESERVE , s. (Withholding, keeping back), see RESERVATION. — (Something concealed in the mind, withheld from dis- closure) manoguptiH f., manoguptaM, nihnutiH f., apahnutiH f. — (Restraint) yantraRaM, nigrahaH, vinigrahaH, nigfhItiH f. — (In manner, disin- clination to talk) kaTAviraktiH f., kaTAvimuKatA, kaTAvEraktyaM, vAgyatatvaM, vAgyatiH f., vAgyantraRaM, alpaBAzaRaM, kaTAparANmuKatA, saMlApaparANmuKatA, AlApaviraktiH f., DIratA. — (Stock laid up) saYcayaH, saYcitaM, saMgrahaH, nicayaH. — (Stratagem in reserve, double resource) dvEDaM. — (Of an army) pratigrahaH, parigrahaH, sarjjanaM, pArzRitraM, patadgrahaH. See REAR-GUARD. — (Without reserve), see UNRESERVEDLY. — (In reserve) niBfte, gopane, guptaM. See the next.
RESERVED (adj.): In disposition: saMvftimat (f. tI) and sim. comp.s.

RESERVED , p. p. or a. (Kept back or concealed to a future time) AkAlAntarAt or parakAlaM yAvad rakzitaH -tA -taM or upasaMhftaH -tA -taM or viDAritaH &c. or viDftaH &c. or guptaH -ptA -ptaM or niBfte sTApitaH -tA -taM or saMvftaH &c. — (Left remaining) SizwaH -zwA -zwaM, avaSezitaH -tA -taM, AkAlAntarAd avaSezitaH &c. — (Restrained in manner, disinclined to talk) vAgyataH -tA -taM, vAgyanvitaH &c., yantritakaTaH -TA -TaM, yantritavAk m. f. n. (c), kaTAviraktaH -ktA -ktaM, [Page682-a+ 51] saMvAdaviraktaH &c., kaTAvimuKaH -KA -KI -KaM, kaTAparANmuKaH &c., saMlApavimuKaH &c., AlApaviraktaH &c., anAlApI -pinI -pi (n), alpaBAzI -ziRI &c., alpAlApI &c., parimitAlApI &c., parimi- takaTaH &c., gUQaBAvaH -vA -vaM, gUQasvaBAvaH &c., lajjASIlaH -lA -laM, DIraH -rA -raM.
RESERVEDLY , adv. vAgyatas, vAgyatatvAt, parimitavAcA, gUQaBAvena.
RESERVEDNESS , s. vAgyatatvaM, kaTAviraktiH f., DIratA. See RESERVE.
RESERVOIR: (1) jalASayaH;(2) taqAgaH: v. Tank.
RESERVOIR , s. jalASayaH, taqAgaH, jalADAraH, udakADAraH, nipAnaM, KAtaM, vApI, amBoniDiH m., jaladAnagfhaM, sarovaraH, krIqAsaras n., varAsanaM, tallaH.
Resetter, s. loptragrAhin m.

Reside, v. t. vas 1 P, ni-prati-°; aDi-zWA 1 P, aDivas (with acc.); nilI 4 A; ASri 1 U, vft 1 A; See Dwell. 2 sad 1 P; avaSiz pass. [Resid]ence, s. sTiti f., vasati f., vartanaM, aDizWAnaM, vAsaH; ‘r(esidence) abroad’ pravAsaH. 2 vasatiH, vAsasTAnaM, ni-, vAsaH, gfhaM, A-ni-layaH, ASrayaH, aDizWAnaM, sTAnaM, niketanaM; See House, ‘change of r(esidence)’ sTalAMtaragamanaM. [Resid]ent, s. ni-, vAsin, or by deriv.; ‘r(esident) of this or that place’ atratyaH; tatratyaH; AyoDyikaH, kOSAMbIyaH, &c. a. ni, vAsin, sTa, vartin in comp.; ASrita, kftAlaya. Residue, s. ava-, SezaH-zaM-SizwaM. [Residu]al, [Residu]ary, a. ava-Sizwa, Seza in comp.
RESIDE: vasati (vas, c. l.): v. To dwell, remain.

To RESIDE , v. n. vas (c. 1. vasati, vastuM), nivas, aDivas, Avas, samAvas, prativas, vAsaM kf, vft, sTA, ASri, nilI, aDyAs. See To DWELL. — (Reside together or with) saMvas, sahavAsaM kf; ‘resided,’ uzitaH -tA -taM.
RESIDENCE: I The act:(1) vAsaH, ni-;(2) sTitiH (= stay). Ph.: r. abroad: pravAsaH.II The place.:(1) vAsaH, ni-;(2) vasatiH;(3) vAsaBUmiH and sim. comp.s.

RESIDENCE , s. (Act of dwelling) vAsaH -sanaM, vasanaM, vasatiH f., ni- vasatiH f., nivAsaH, aDivAsanaM -sitA, aDizWAnaM, aDizWitiH f., avasTi- tiH f., sTitiH f., saMsTitiH f., pratizWA, varttanaM, nilayanaM, ASrayaRaM, aGyAsaH -sanaM; ‘residence abroad,’ pravAsaH. — (Place of dwell- ing) vasatiH f., vAsaH, vAsasTAnaM, nivasatiH f., nivAsaH, nivAsasTAnaM, nivAsaBUyaM, gfhaM, AvAsaH, aDivAsaH, samAvAsaH, AvasaTaH, vAstuH -stu m. n., sTAnaM, avasTAnaM, pratizWA, AyatanaM, niketanaM, AlayaH, nilayaH, nilAyitA, kziH f.; ‘permanent residence,’ sTirapratizWA, sTAvarapratizWA; ‘changing of residence,’ gfhAntaragamanaM, sTAnAnta- ragamanaM, sTalAntarakaraRaM. See DWELLING.
RESIDENT: (1) by deriv., r. of this, that place: ihatya, tatratya (f. tyA);(2) nivAsin (f. nI): v. Inhabitant.

RESIDENT , a. vAsI -sinI -si(n), nivAsI &c., vAsakArI &c., sTAyI &c., sTaH -sTA -sTaM in comp., saMsTaH -sTA -sTaM in comp., nilAyI &c., kfta- vAsaH -sA -saM, kftAlayaH -yA -yaM, ASritaH -tA -taM, samASritaH &c., samAvAsitaH &c., avasTitaH &c., aDizWitaH &c.; ‘resident in Mathurā,’ maTurAvAsI &c., maTurAnivrAsI &c.; ‘in the city,’ nagarasTaH &c.; ‘the people resident there,’ tatrasTA janAH.
RESIDENT , s. vAsI m. (n); ‘temporary resident,’ AgantuH -ntukaH.
RESIDENTIARY , a. vAsI -sinI &c., vAsakArI &c. See RESIDENT, a.
RESIDUARY: avaSizwa (f. zwA): v. Remaining.
RESIDUARY , RESIDUAL, a. SezasambanDI -nDinI &c.; ‘legatee,’ Seza- BAgI m. (n), SezADikArI m., SezarikTaBAgI m., SezarikTaBAk m. (j).
RESIDUE: SezaH: v. Remainder.
RESIDUE , s. SezaH -zaM, avaSezaH, avaSizwaH, paraBAgaH, see REMAINDER.

Resign, v. t. pari-, tyaj 1 P, ut-vi-sfj 6 P, hA 3 P, pratyAdiS 6 P, parAkzip 6 P, See Abandon. 2 saM-, f c. (arpayati), AyattIkf, A-ni-viS c., samA-DA 3 U, nyas 4 U, nikzip, pratipad c. 3 kzam 1 A, sah 1 A; ‘of those who r(esign) themselves to you’ tvayyAveSitacittAnAM, tvatsa-mAhitacetasAM; ‘r(esign) oneʼs claims’ svatvaM nivft c., aDikAraM tyaj; ‘r(esign) oneself to his fate’ dEvADInIBU. [Resign]ation, s. pari-, tyAgaH, utsargaH, pratyAdeSaH, parAkzepaH; ‘r(esignation) of oneʼs claim’ svatvani-vfttiH; ‘written r(esignation)’ tyAgapatraM-leKaH. 2 samarpaRaM, nikzepaRaM, nyasanaM, niveSanaM. 3 kzamA, kzAMti f., saMtozavftti f.; ‘r(esignation) to God’ ISvarADInatA; ISvarecCAnuvartanaM. [Resign]ed, a. tyakta, arpita, nyasta, &c. 2 kzamAvat, titikzu, SAMta, ISvarecCADIna, ISvaranyastacitta.
RESIGN: I To give up, surrender: arpayati, sam-, (c. of f).II To relinquish, abandon: q. v.: tyajati, pari-, (tyaj, c. 1.).

To RESIGN , v. a. (Give up) tyaj (c. 1. tyajati, tyaktuM), parityaj, saMtyaj, utsfj (c. 6. -sfjati -srazwuM), visfj, avasfj, utsargaM kf, utsarjanaM kf, hA (c. 3. jahAti, hAtuM), vihA, prahA, projJ, sannyas, pratyAdiS; ‘by writing,’ tyAgapatreRa utsfj; ‘to resign a title or claims,’ aDi- kAratyAgaM kf, svatvatyAgaM kf, svatvanivfttiM kf. — (Commit) samf in caus. (-arpayati -yituM), f in caus., nyas, nikzip, nyAsIkf, pratipad in caus., paridA, samarpaRaM kf. — (Submit to) sah (c. 1. sahate, soQuM), vizah, kzam (c. 1. kzamate, kzantuM), tij in des.
RESIGNATION: I Relinquishment, abandon- -ment: q. v.: tyAgaH, pari-.II Giving up, yielding: (Atma-) arpaRam, sam-: v. Also sub- -mission.

RESIGNATION , s. (Giving up) tyAgaH, parityAgaH, utsargaH, utsarjanaM, visarjanaM, sannyasanaM, sannyAsaH; ‘written resignation,’ tyAgapatraM, parityAgapatraM, tyAgaleKaH; ‘of claim,’ svatvatyAgaH, svatvanivfttiH f. — (Commit- ting, yielding) samarpaRaM, arpaRaM, nikzepaH, nyasanaM, nyAsIkaraRaM. — (Submission) kzamA, kzAntiH f., titikzA, sahanaM, sahizRutA, DIratA, marmaH SAntiH f., santozavfttiH f. — (To the will of God) ISvarecCA- santozavfttiH f., ISvarecCAnuvfttiH f., ISvarecCAnuvarttanaM, ISvarecCAnumatiH f., ISvarecCAnuroDaH, ISvarecCAparitozaH, BagavadicCAnumatiH f., titikzA, ISva- rasaMkalyAnudattiH f.

RESIGNED , p. p. or a. (Given up) tyaktaH -ktA -ktaM, parityaktaH &c., utsarjitaH -tA -taM, utsfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, sannyastaH -stA -staM. — (Submissive) kzAntaH -ntA -ntaM, kzamAvAn -vatI -vat (t), sahizRuH -zRuH -zRu, titikzuH &c., SAntaH &c., see PATIENT. — (To the will of God) ISvarecCA- santozavfttiH -ttiH -tti, ISvarecCAnuvarttI -rttinI -rtti (n), ISvarecCAnu- roDI &c., ISvarecCAsantuzwaH -zwA -zwaM, ISvarecCABimataH -tA -taM, ISvarecCA- numataH &c., ISvarasaNkalpAnuvarttI &c., BagavatsaNkalpaparituzwaH &c., yatacittaH -ttA -ttaM, SAntacetAH -tAH -taH (s).
RESILIENCE , RESILIENCY, s. pratiGAtaH. See REBOUND.
Resilient, a. utpatizRu. 2 sTitisTApaka. 3 ullAsita.
Resin, s. a-, rAlaH, sarjarasaH, yakzaDUpaH; See Pitch.
RESIN: (1) arAlaH or rAlaH;(2) DUnakaH;(3) sarja- rasaH.

RESIN , s. sarjjarasaH, yakzaDUpaH, arAlaH, rAlaH, vfkzaDUpaH, vfkzaniryyAsaH, SAlaniryyAsaH, sarjjamaRiH m., suraDUpaH, DUpanaH, sarvvarasaH, rasAhvaH, daDi n., tIkzRatElaM, agnivallaBaH, vahnivallaBaH, mahArUpaH, bahurUpaH, kalakalaH, DUnakaH.
RESINOUS , a. sarjjarasaguRakaH -kA -kaM, yakzaDUpasaguRaH -RA -RaM.

Resist, v. t. pratibaMD 9 P, prati-vi-ruD 7 U, ni-, vAr 10, pratyavasTA 1 A; pratikf 8 U, pratyA-vyA-han 2 P; bAD 1 A, nigrah 9 P, pratizwaMB 9 P, paripaMTIBU; See Oppose. [Resist]ance, s. prati-vi-roDaH, pratibaMDaH, prati(tI)kAraH, pratiyogaH, paryavasTAnaM, pratizwaMBaH, pratiyatnaH, pratyAGAtaH. [Resist]er, s. pratiyogin m., pratibaMDakaH. [Resist]less, a. anivArya, durnivAra, apratikAra, anavagraha, durnigraha.
RESIST: (1) pratikUlayati (nomi.): v. To oppose; (2) bADate, pra., (bAD, c. l.): v. To obstruct; (3) nivArayati, vi-, (c. of vf): v. To hinder; (4) pratyavatizWate (sTA, c. l.): v. To withstand.

To RESIST , v. a. or n. (Oppose, withstand) pratikf, vipratikf, viprakf, viruD (c. 7. -ruRadDi -rodDuM), pratiruD, pratikUla (nom. pratikUlayati -yituM), pratikUlaH -lA -laM BU, paryavasTA (c. 1. -tizWati -sTAtuM), pratyava- sTA, pratyAhan (c. 2. -hanti -ntuM), vyAhan, nihan, pratIpa (nom. pratI- pAyate), pratiyuD, pratisamAs (c. 2. -Aste -AsituM), paripanTa (nom. paripanTayati -yituM), vipakzatAM kf, viroDaM kf, pratiroDaM kf, prAtikUlyaM kf. — (Hinder) nivf (c. 10. -vArayati -yituM), bAD (c. 1. bADate -DituM), pratibanD (c. 9. -baGnAti -bandDuM), ruD, niruD. — (Check) nigrah (c. 9. -gfhlAti -grahItuM), vinigrah, stamB (c. 10. stamBayati -yituM), pratizwamB.
RESISTANCE: (1) pratiroDaH (= opposition);(2) pratiGAtaH (= striking against, as of forces); (3) nivAraRam (= hindrance);(4) pratyavasTAnam or -sTitiH (rare).

RESISTANCE , s. pratikAraH, pratIkAraH, vipratikAraH, pratikriyA, viroDaH, pratiroDaH, pratikUlatA, prAtikUlyaM, pratiyogaH -gitA, paryavasTAnaM, paryavasTA, paryavasTitiH f., pratyavasTAnaM, pratyavasTitiH f., praticCedaH, nikAraH, prati- banDaH -nDakatA, pratizwamBaH, nigrahaH -haRaM, avagrahaH, nivAraRaM, pratiyatnaH, pratyupAyaH. — (In mechanics) pratyAGAtaH, pratiGAtaH.

RESISTED , p. p. pratikftaH -tA -taM, vipratikftaH &c., viprakftaH &c., prati- rudDaH -dDA -dDaM, rudDaH &c., paryavasTitaH &c., pratyavasTitaH &c., pratizwabDaH -bDA -bDaM, nivAritaH -tA -taM, pratihataH &c., vyAhataH &c.
RESISTER , s. viroDI m. (n), pratiroDI m., pratiyogI m., paryavasTAtA m. (tf), pratyavasTAtA m., pratiroDakaH, pratiGAtI m., viroDakArI m.
RESISTLESS: (1) anivArya (f. ryA);(2) durnivAra (f. rA), Si. xiv. 72.
RESISTLESS , s. apratikAryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM, anavagrahaH -hA -haM, See IRRESISTIBLE.
RESOLUTE: (1) sTiraniScaya (f. yA), a r. mind: sTiraniScayaM manaH, Ku. v. 5.;(2) sTiramati (mfn.); (3) dfQasaMkalpa (f. lpA); and sim. comp.s.

RESOLUTE , a. dfQaniScayaH -yA -yaM, sTiraniScayaH &c., dfQasaMkalpaH -lpA -lpaM, sTiramatiH -tiH -ti, sTiracetAH -tAH -taH (s), susTiracetAH &c., sTitaDIH -DIH -Di, vajrasaMkalpaH -lpA -lpaM, sTiraH -rA -raM, susTiraH &c., DIraH -rA -raM, suDIraH &c., DEryyavAn -vatI -vat (t), DftimAn &c., sANkalpikaH -kI -kaM, pragalBaH -lBA -lBaM, vyavasAyI -yinI -yi (n), kftaniScayaH &c.
RESOLUTELY: (1) expr. by adj.;(2) dfQam (= firmly);(3) sAgraham (= obstinately).
RESOLUTELY , adv. dfQaniScayapUrvvaM, sasTiraniScayaM, susTiraM, sTiracetasA.
RESOLUTENESS , s. sTiramatitvaM, dfQasaMkalyatA, DEryyaM See the next.

sanskrit.slp1: gfhARa SastraM yadi sarga eza te
sanskrit.word: गृहाण शस्त्रं यदि सर्ग एष ते
sanskrit.iast: gṛhāṇa śastraṃ yadi sarga eṣa te

details.body: RESOLUTION: I Dissolution, analysis: viSleza- Ram (?).II Solution, explanation: q. v. III Firmness, constancy: q. v.: sTEryam. IV Determination, resolve:(1) niScayaH, it is my firm r.: eza me sTiro niScayaH, Mu. i.;(2) sargaH (rare), take up arms if this is your r.: gfhARa SastraM yadi sarga eza te, R. iii. 51.:V Deci- -sion: nirRayaH.

RESOLUTION , s. (Fixed purpose, determination) niScayaH, viniScayaH, saNkalpaH, vyavasAyaH, aDyavasAyaH, nirRayaH, dfQaniSrayaH, dfQasaNkalyaH, sTiraniScayaH, kalpaH, matiH f., dfQasatiH f., sampaDAraRza. — (Constancy) sTiramatitvaM, sTiratA, susTiratA, sTEryyaM, DIratA, DEryyaM, DftiH f., Dfti- mattvaM, DAraRaM -RA, pragatrByA, prAgalByaM, AgrahaH, nirbanDaH. — (Decision or proposition offered for determination) niScayaH, nirRayaH, upanyAsaH. — (Separation of parts), see DISSOLUTION, SOLUTION.
RESOLVABLE: viSlezaRIyaH (yA, yaM) (?): v. To resolve.
RESOLVABLE , s. vilayanIyaH -yA -yaM, viBAjyaH -jyA -jyaM viBedyaH -dyA -dyaM.

Resolve, v. i. niSci 5 U, nirRI 1 P, vyava-so 4 P, aDyava-so, saMkxp c., matiM-budDiM-kf 8 U; See Determine. v. t. vi-lI c., vi-dru c. (melt); gal c., kzar c.; sAgare nadyo vilIyaMte ‘rivers are r(esolv)ed into the sea’ 2 vi-yuj 7 A, 10, viSliz c., vyAkf, viBid c., pfTak kf; See Separate, 3 (Doubts) Cid 7 P, apAkf, apanI 1 P, niras 4 U; See Dispel. s. Resolution, q. v. [Resolv]ed, a. viSlezita, vyAkfta, &c. 2 kftaniScaya-saMkalpa-mati-budDi, vyavasita, niScita, nirRIta, saMkalpita. [Resolv]ent, s. drAvaRaM, SoTahft. [Resolv]er, s. viBetf m., CettA, Cid m., in comp. Resolute, a. dfQa or sTira or niScaya-saMkalpa, sTiraDI mati, DIra, Dftimat; See Resolved also. [Resolute]ly, adv. dfQaM, saniScayaM, sTiracetasA. [Resolute]ness, s. See below. Resolution, s. niScayaH, nirRayaH, saMkalpaH, vyavasAyaH, sargaH, aDyavasA-yaH; sTira or dfQa-niScayaH or saMkalpaH, mati f., saMpra-ava-DAraRA. 2 sTiratA, sTEryaM, DEryaM, Dfti f., nirbaMDaH, sTiramatitvaM, aBiniveSaH. 3 viSlezaRaM, viyojanaM, viBedanaM. 4 upanyAsaH, pratijYA, upakzepaH.

RESOLVE (v. t.): I To dissolve, analyze: no prop. equiv.:(1) viSlezayati (c. of Sliz ?); (2) vidrAvayati (c. of dru = to melt: q. v.).II To solve, explain: q. v.: vyAkaroti (kf, c. 8.).III In music: perh. BinnI- or BinnakI- karoti, Si. xi. 1.
RESOLVE (v. i.): I To determine: q. v.: niScayaM karoti.II To pass a resolution: perh. vyavasyati (so, c. 4.).

To RESOLVE , v. a. (Dissolve) vilI in caus., vidru in caus., see DISSOLVE, LIQUEFY. — (Separate component parts) pfTakkf, [Page683-a+ 51] viBaj, viyuj, viBid, viCid, viSliz in caus., vidru in caus., mUlatattvaSoDanaM kf, upodGAtaM kf. — (Resolve doubts or difficulties) saMSayAn Cida (c. 7. Cinatti, CettuM) or ucCid, vyAKyA (c. 2. -KyAti -tuM), see To SOLVE. — (Constitute by resolution) niScayapUrvvaM vyavasTA in caus. or saMsTA or viDA or kxp.

To RESOLVE , v. n. (Determine in the mind) niScayaM kf, viniScayaM kf, nirRayaM kf, saNkalpaM kf, manasA niSci (c. 5. -cinoti -cetuM) or nirRI (c. 1. -Rayati -RetuM) or saMkxp (c. 10. -kalpayati -yituM), vyavaso (c. 4. -syati -sAtuM), aDyavaso, matiM kf, budDiM kf, manaH kf with dat. or loc. c.; as, ‘he resolves to go,’ gamanAya manaH or matiM karoti, gamanAya niScayaM karoti; ‘he resolves to do that,’ tat karttuM vyava- syati; ‘he is resolved to sacrifice his life,’ svaprARAn parityaktuM vyavasito 'sti. — (Dissolve), see DISSOLVE, MELT.

RESOLVED , p. p. (Analyzed) pfTakkftaH -tA -taM, vyAkftaH &c., viBaktaH -ktA -ktaM. — (Determined) kftaniScayaH -yA -yaM, kftasaNkalpaH -lpA -lpaM, niScitaH -tA -taM, suniScitaH &c., saNkalpitaH &c., sANkalpikaH -kI -kaM, vyavasitaH -tA -taM, prayatitaH &c., kftabudDiH -dDiH -dDi; ‘having re- solved on going to the forest,’ vanagamanAya kftabudDiH or vanaM gantuM vyavasitaH.
RESOLVENT , s. (In medicine) drAvakaH, drAvaRaM, SoTaGnaH, SoTahft.
RESOLVER , s. (Of doubts) saMSayaCettA m. (ttf), saMSayocCedI m. (n).
RESONANCE , s. anunAdaH, vyanunAdaH, prodGozaRaM, udGozaRaM, pratiDvaniH m.
Resonant, a. muKarita, pratiDvAnita, pratinA-dita, anunAdin, saMGuzwa. Resonance, s. anu-prati-nAdaH, pratiDvaniH-svanaH.
RESONANT: (1) muKarita (f. tA), the quarters r. with bees: alimAlAmuKaritakakuBaH, Ma. i. 1.;(2) pratiDvanita (f. tA);(3) prati- or anu- nAdin (f. nI): v. To echo, sound.
RESONANT , a. anunAdI -dinI -di (n), anunAdaH -dA -daM, prodGuzwaH -zwA -zwaM, saMGuzwaH &c., parisaMGuzwaH &c., upaGuzwaH &c., nihrAdI &c., muKaritaH -tA -taM.

Resort, v. i. (To) sev 1 A, ni-pari-°, Sri 1 U, A-saM-samA-upA-°, upa-aBi-gam 1 P or i-yA 2 P, aBi-upa-sf 1 P; juz 6 A, (frequently). s. ASrayaRaM, sevanaM, gamanaM, &c. 2 ASrayaH, SaraRaM, AyatanaM, aBigamanasTAnaM. 3 gati f., upAyaH, SaraRaM.

RESORT (v.): sevate, upa-, pari-, saM-, ni-, (sev, c. 1.), sometimes r. ed to drink: kadAcit pAnamasevata, R. ; the forest r. ed to by barbarians and robbers: vanaM mlecCataskarasevitam: v. To (have) recourse, frequent.
RESORT (subs.): (1) expr. by verb;(2) SaraRam (= refuge).

To RESORT , v. n. ASri (c. 1. -Srayati -yituM), Sri, ASrayaRaM kf, gam (c. 1. gacCati, gantuM), upagam, pratigam, aBigam, Agam, upe (c. 2. upEti -tuM, rt. i), aByupe, aBisf (c. 1. -sarati -sarttuM), yA (c. 2. yAti -tuM), pratiyA, pratyAyA, aBiyA, yA, sev (c. 1. sevate -vituM); ‘re- sorted to,’ ASritaH -tA -taM; ‘having resorted to,’ ASritya.

RESORT , s. (Act of going or betaking one's self) ASrayaRaM, SrayaRaM, upagamaH -manaM, aByupagamaH -manaM, pratigamanaM, aBigamaH -manaM, gamanaM, aBi- sAraRaM. — (Place of resort) gamanAgamanasTAnaM, aBigamanasTAnaM, aBi- sAraRasTAnaM, ASrayaRasTAnaM, ASrayaH, samASrayaH, AyatanaM, ASayaH; ‘resort of man,’ lokayAtrA. — (Refuge, means of relief) gatiH f., upAyaH.

Resound, v. i. prati-nad-svan-Dvan 1 P, anu-ras 1 P; See Echo. v. t. pratiDvan c. &c.; ninAdena pUr 10; ‘r(esound)ing the directions’ diSaH pratininAdena pUrayan, diSaH pratiDvAnayan. [Resound]ing, a. Resonant, q. v.
RESOUND (v. i.): (1) prati-nadati (nad, c. 1.): v. To echo;(2) Dvanati (Dvan. c. 1.): v. To sound. Ph.: r. ing (adj.): v. Resonant.
To RESOUND , v. a. anunad (c. 10. -nAdayati -yituM), vyanunad, aBinad. Anad, sannad, nad, Dvan (c. 10. Dvanayati -yituM), pratiDvan, pratiDvaniM kf.

To RESOUND , v. n. Dvan (c. 1. Dvanati -nituM), pratiDvan, praDvan, svan (c. 1. svanati -nituM), pratisvan, stan (c. 1. stanati -nituM), prodGuz (c. 1. -Gozati -zituM), parisaMGuz, guYj (c. 1. guYjati -YjituM), prakzveq (c. 1. -kzveqati -qituM), ras (c. 1. rasati -situM).
RESOUNDING , part. (Sounding with) anunAdaH -dA -daM, nirGuzwaH -zwA -zwaM, parisaMGuzwaH &c., upakUjitaH -tA -taM, vikUjitaH &c.

Resource, s. upAyaH, gati f., prayukti f., kalpanA, sADanaM; ‘having no other r(esource)’ ananyagatika. 2 (‘r(esource)s’) viBavaH, dravyasA-DanaM, AyaH, vitta-dravya-sAmagrI, arTaH, DanaM; ‘of small r(esource)s’ alpaviBava.
RESOURCE: I Means, remedy: q. v.: upAyaH. II In pl., fortune, affluence: q. v.: viBavaH.

RESOURCE , s. gatiH f., upAyaH, aByupAyaH, yuktiH f., prayuktiH f., upapattiH f., taraRopAyaH, kxptiH f., kalpanA; ‘other resource,’ gatyantaraM, anyo- pAyaH, anyagatiH f.; ‘having no other resource,’ ananyagatiH -tiH -ti, ananyagatikaH -kA -kaM; ‘having no resource,’ agatikaH -kA -kaM, gatihInaH -nA -naM, nirupAyaH -yA -yaM; ‘last resource,’ caramagatiH f., caramopAyaH, agatikagatiH f. — (Resources) viBavaH, vittaM, samBavaH, DanaM, arTaH, AgamaH, AyaH; ‘of small resources,’ alpaviBavaH -vA -vaM; ‘of concealed resources,’ upaguptavittaH -ttA -ttaM.
RESOURCELESS , a. agatikaH -kA -kaM, gatihInaH -nA -naM, nirupAyaH -yA -yaM.

Respect, v. t. pUj 10, arc 1 P, 10; saM-man c., Adf 6 A, sev 1 A, Baj 1 U, saM-BU c., satkf 8 U, puraskf. 2 apekz 1 A, uddiS 6 P; See Refer, Relate. s. apekzA, uddeSaH, saMbaMDaH, anuzaMgaH, vizayaH; ‘with r(espect) to the result’ PalApekzayA, PalamuddiSya. 2 saM-, mAnaH, pUjA, aBi-, arcanaM, AdaraH, saMBAvanA, praSrayaH, gOravaM, puraskAraH, satkAraH, arhaRA, arcA, Bakti f. 3 dfzwi f., avekzA. 4 vizayaH, prakaraRaM; vastu n., arTaH. 5 (‘r(espect)s’) namaskAraH, praRAmaH, praRati f., aBivaMdanaM, praRipAtaH, saBAjanaM; ‘in this r(espect)’ atra vizaye; ‘in all r(espect)s’ sarvaTA; ‘pay oneʼs r(espect)s’ praRam 1 P, saBAj 10, praRipat 1 P. [Respect]able, a. pUjya, mAnanIya, &c.; viSizwa, Arya, sapratizWa, guru; ‘a r(espectable) person’ Arya-su-janaH; ‘of a r(espectable) family’ aBijAta, aBijanavat, kulIna. 2 maDyama, sAmAnya, nAtiguru. [Respect]ably, adv. Arya; udAra, in comp.; Aryavat, Sizwavat, sagOravaM; ‘r(espectably) dressed’ udAranepaTyaBft, AryavezaDArin. [Respect]ful, a. sAdara, sapraSraya, sagOrava, savinaya, Adara-maryAdA-SIla, mAnapuraH-sara, Adara-mAna-pUrva. [Respect]fully, adv. sAdaraM, sapraSrayaM, savinayaM. [Respect]ing, a. uddiSya, aDikftya, apekzya; See Regarding. [Respect]ive, (Own) a. Ex. by sva-sva, (‘Own’ q. v.); ‘they went to their r(espective) houses’ svaM svaM gfhaM te jagmuH ‘in their r(espective) places’ svezu svezu sTAnezu. 2 sApekza, akevala, aDivikta, anyasaMbadDa; itaretara-anyonya in comp. [Respect]ively, adv. yaTAkramaM, yaTAnukramaM, pOrvAparyeRa, pratyekaM pratyekaM.
RESPECT: I To honour: q. v.:(1) saMmAnayati (c. of man);(2) gOraveRa paSyati (dfS, c. 1. = look upon with r.), he was highly r. ed: gOraveRa dadfSetarAmasO, Si. xiv. 42.II To regard, relate; q. v.
RESPECT (subs.): I Reference: Ph.: with r. to: v. R. ing.II Honour, regard:(1) sammAnaH (= honour);(2) AdaraH (= attention, consideration;(3) gOravam (= reverence); (4) pUjA or arcanA (= adoration).

To RESPECT , v. a. (Regard, relate to) apekz (c. 1. apekzate -kzituM, rt. Ikz), avekz, pratIkz, uddiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM), vizayakaH -kA -kaM BU, sambanD in pass. (-baDyate), sambadDaH -dDA -dDaM, BU, sambanDI -nDinI -nDi BU. — (Esteem, reverence) man (c. 10. mAnayati -yituM), pratiman, samman, pUj (c. 10. pUjayati -yituM), sampUj, aBipUj, Adf (c. 6. -driyate -darttuM), sev (c. 1. sevate -vituM, c. 10. sevayati -yituM), Baj (c. 1. Bajati, BaktuM), arh (c. 10. arhayati -yituM), arc. (c. 1. arcati -rcituM, c. 10. arcayati -yituM), aByarc, samaByarc, samarc, samBU (c. 10. -BAvayati -yituM), puraskf, AdaraM kf, sammAnaM kf.

RESPECT , s. (Relation, reference, regard) apekzA, pratIkzA, uddeSaH, vizayatvaM -tA, sambanDaH, avekzA, anvavekzA, sanDAnaM; ‘with respect to,’ apekzayA, apekzya, pratIkzya, uddiSya, uddeSena, prati affixed; as, ‘with respect to me,’ mAM prati. — (Esteem, reverence) mAnaM, sammAnaM, AdaraH, mAnyatvaM, pUjA, arhA -rhaRaM -RA, samBAvanA, arcA, arcanaM -nA, aByarcA -rcanaM, sevA -vanaM, puraskAraH, pratItiH f., satkAraH, anunayaH, BaktiH f., samBramaH, maryyAdA; ‘much respect,’ bahumAnaM. — (Respects, act of reverence) praRipAtaH, praRAmaH, praRatiH f., praRi- patanaM, aBivAdanaM, namaskAraH, namas, namasyA, vandanaM, aBivandanaM; ‘to pay one's respects,’ praRipat, praRam, namaskf, aBivad, aBivand, vandanaM kf, praRAmaM kf. — (Regard, view) avekzA, anvavekzA, pratIkzA, dfzwiH f.; ‘respect of persons,’ BedadfzwiH f., pakzadfzwiH, pakzapAtaH. — (Particular) vizayaH, prakaraRaM.
RESPECTABILITY: (1) mAnanIyatA;(2) pUjanIyatA; (3) pUjArhatA; etc.
RESPECTABILITY , s. sAnyatA, sammAnyatA, AryyatA -tvaM, gOravaM, gurutA -tvaM, maryyAdA, pratizWA; ‘family respectability,’ kulamaryyAdA.
RESPECTABLE: I Honourable:(1) mAnanIya (f. yA);(2) mAnya (f. nyA);(3) pUjanIya (f. yA); (4) pUjya (f. jyA);(5) arcanIya (f. yA).II Moderate: q. v.

RESPECTABLE , a. AryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM, mAnyaH -nyA -nyaM, mAnanIyaH -yA -yaM, sammAnyaH &c., AdaraRIyaH -yA -yaM, pUjanIyaH -yA -yaM, pUjyaH -jyA -jyaM, pUjanArhaH -rhA -rhaM, pratIkzyaH -kzyA -kzyaM, pratIkzaRIyaH -yA -yaM, arcyaH -rcyA -rcyaM, arcanIyaH -yA -yaM, guruH -rvI -ru, sagOravaH -vA -vaM, gOravitaH -tA -taM, maryyAdAvAn -vatI -vat (t), maryyAdApAlakaH -kA -kaM, kulamaryyA- dApAlakaH &c., mAnI -ninI -ni (n), puraskaraRIyaH &c., SizwaH -zwA -zwaM, samBAvitaH -tA -taM, BadrakaH -kA -kaM, akutsitaH -tA -taM, pratizWitaH &c., sapratizWaH -zWA -zWaM; ‘highly respectable,’ paramamAnyaH &c.; ‘a respectable person,’ AryyajanaH, AryyakaH, AryyamiSraH, sajjanaH, sujanaH; ‘respectable woman,’ AryyikA, AryyakA, kulapA- likA, kulamaryyAdApAlikA, kulastrI, kulavaDUH f. — (Moderate, fair) maDyamaH -mA -maM.
RESPECTABLY: r. dressed: Aryaveza (f. zA); r. connected: pUjyasambanDa (f. nDA); etc.
RESPECTABLY , adv. AryyaM, sagOravaM, samaryyAdaM, Aryyavat, mAnyavat, Sizwavat, Aryyajanavat, Aryya in comp.; as, ‘respectably dressed,’ AryyaveSaH -SA -SaM.
RESPECTED , p. p. sammAnitaH -tA -taM, pUjitaH &c., AdftaH &c., kftA- daraH -rA -raM, sevitaH -tA -taM, arcitaH &c., pratIkzitaH &c.
RESPECTER , s. pUjakaH, sampUjakaH, Adarakft, pratIkzakaH, avekzakaH.
RESPECTFUL: (1) vinIta (f. tA);(2) sAdara (f. rA);(3) sagOrava (f. vA).

RESPECTFUL , a. AdarakArI -riRI -ri (n), AdftaH -tA -taM, dattAdaraH -rA -raM, kftAdaraH &c., sAdaraH -rA -raM, AdarapUrvvaH -rvvA -rvvaM, AdaraSIlaH -lA -laM, AdarayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, mAnakArI &c., maryyAdASIlaH &c., samaryyAdaH -dA -daM, pratItaH -tA -taM, sampratItaH &c.
RESPECTFULLY: (1) savinayam;(2) sagOravam, B. xii. 8.
RESPECTFULLY . adv. sAdaraM, samAnaM, AdarapUrvvaM, AdarapuraHsaraM, sasammAnaM, sammAnapUrvvaM, samaryyAdaM, arcApUrvvakaM.
RESPECTFULNESS , s. AdaraSIlatA, maryyAdASIlatA, sAdaratvaM, maryyAdA.
RESPECTING: uddiSya, r. the regent of the quarter: dikpatimuddiSya, N. xiii. 15.: v. About (III).
RESPECTING , part. pratIkzakaH -kA -kaM, apekzakaH &c., uddeSakaH &c., [Page684-a+ 51] apekzya, pratIkzya, uddiSya, prati affixed with an acc. c.

RESPECTIVE: I Each to each: expr. by doub- -ling words meaning own, let the employees also attend to their r. works: sve sve karmaRyaTa samavaDattApyaDikftAH, Vi. vii. 37.II Relative: q. v.III Careful: q. v.

RESPECTIVE , a. (Relative, not absolute) sApekzaH -kzA -kzaM, apekzakaH -kA -kaM, sasambanDaH -nDA -nDaM. See RELATIVE. — (Several) itaretaraH -rA -raM, anyonyaH -nyA -nyaM, see SEVERAL; ‘respective incli- nation,’ itaretarakAmyA. — (Own) expressed by doubling the pronouns sva, svakIya, svIya, svaka, nija, Atma, AtmIya &c.; thus, ‘in their respective stations.’ svezu svezu sTAnezu or simply by doubling the noun; thus, ‘they dwell each in their respective houses,’ gfhe gfhe pratyekaM vasanti.
RESPECTIVELY: I As relating to each: expr. as above.II According to position:(1) pOrvAparyeRa;(2) by circumlo.
RESPECTIVELY , adv. itaretaraM, anyonyaM, pratyekaM, prati or anu prefixed, or more usually expressed by doubling a pronoun or noun, see the last.
RESPIRATION: I In gen.:(1) SvAsaH;(2) SvAsapraSvAsaH.II Resurrection: ujjIvanam, prati-.
RESPIRATION , s. SvAsapraSvAsaM, SvAsocCvAsaM, SvAsaH, SvasanaM, ucCvAsanaM, prARaH.
RESPIRATORY: SvAsa- in comp. (?) or by cir- -cumlo.
RESPIRATORY , a. SvAsapraSvAsakArI -riRI &c., SvAsocCvAsasambanDI &c.
Respire, v. i. ut-ni-Svas 2 P, pra-an 2 P. [Respir]ation, s. SvAsaH, SvAsocCvAsaH, prARaH. [Respir]atory, a. SvAsa in comp.; ‘r(espiratory) organ’ SvAseMdriyaM.
RESPIRE: I To breathe: q. v.: Svasiti (Svas, c. 2.).II To inhale: q. v.: AcAmati (cam, c. 1).
To RESPIRE , v. n. SvAsapraSvAsaM kf, SvAsocCvAsaM kf, Svas (c. 2. Svasiti -tuM), ASvas, ucCvas, praSvas, prAR (c. 2. prARiti -tuM, rt. an).
Respite, s. virAmaH, viSrAmaH, virati f., avakASaH, vilaMbaH, vicCedaH, pra-upa-SamaH. v. t. viSrAmaM-avakASaM-dA 3 U.
RESPITE: I Subs.:(1) vilambaH (= delay: q. v.);(2) virAmaH (= pause: q. v.).II Verb.:(1) avakASaM dadAti (dA, c. 3.);(2) by circumlo.
RESPITE , s. viSrAmaH, viSrAntiH f., virAmaH, viratiH f., nivfttiH f., upaSamaH, apaSamaH, SamaH, SAntiH f., vicCedaH, avaratiH f. See REPRIEVE.
To RESPITE , v. a. viSrAmaM dA, viSrAntiM dA, viSram in caus. (-SrAmayati -yituM), virAmaM dA, avakASaM dA. See To REPRIEVE.
RESPLENDENCE: Ojjvalyam: v. Brilliancy, brightness.
RESPLENDENCE , RESPLENDENCY, s. pratApaH, tejas n., atitejas. See SPLENDOR.
Resplendent, a. dedIpyamAna, viBrAjamAna, atitejas; See Bright, Splendid.
RESPLENDENT: samujjvalaH (lA, laM): v. Brilli- -ant, splendid.
RESPLENDENT , a. pratApI -pinI -pi (n), supraBaH -BA -BaM, dedIpyamAnaH -nA -naM, prakASamAnaH &c., viBrAjamAnaH &c., atyAdityaH -tyA -tyaM, BAnumAn -matI -mat (t). See SPLENDID.

Respond, v. i. prativac 2 P, prativad 1 P, uttaraM dA 3 U; See Reply. [Respond]ent, s. prativAdin m., pratyarTin, uttaravAdin m. Response, s. uttaraM, prativacanaM, prativAkyaM. 2 prativAdaH, uttaraM. Responsible, a. anuyogADIna, anuyojya, AhvAnA-DIna, prazwavya; oft. by uttaraM dA; ‘you are r(esponsible) for this act’ asya tvayEvottaraM dAtavyaM. 2 DUrvaha, DUrvoQf, DuraMDara, DurIRa. Responsibility, s. BAraH, BaraH, Dur f.; ‘the whole r(esponsibility) of the kingdom’ rAjyasya samasto BaraH, rAjyaDurA. 2 anuyo-gADInatA, prazwavyatA. Responsive, a. uttaradAyin. 2 saMvAdin.
RESPOND: I To answer, reply: q. v.: prati- vAcaM dadAti (dA, c. 3.).II To suit.: q. v. III To pay: q. v.
To RESPOND , v. n. prativac (c. 2. -vakti -ktuM), prativad (c. 1. -vadati -dituM), pratibrU, pratiBaR, pratijalp. See To ANSWER, REPLY, CORRESPOND.
RESPONDENT: I One who answers: prativaktwa (f. ktrI).II In law: prativAdin (f. nI).
RESPONDENT , s. (In law) prativAdI m. (n), uttaravAdI m., pratipakzI m., uttarapakzI m., samADAnapakzI m. — (Party or cause of the respon- dent) uttarapakzaH, pratipakzaH, samADAnapakzaH.
RESPONSE: I An answer:(1) pratyuktiH;(2) prativAdaH (in disputation):II Of an oracle: samAdeSaH.III An anthem; sUktam (?).

RESPONSE , s. (Answer) prativAkyaM, prativacanaM, uttaraM, see REPLY. — (In disputations) prativAdaH, uttaraM, pratyuttaraM, samADAnaM. — (Of an oracle) SakunaH -naM, praSnaH, prasAdaH, devavARI, AkASavARI. — (In a litany, &c.) uttaravAkyaM.
RESPONSIBILITY: (1) BAraH or BaraH (= burden), to throw r.: BaraM nasyati, Ra.;(2) dAyaH (used in Bengali): v. Also obligation.

RESPONSIBILITY , s. anuyogADInatA, anusanDAnADInatA, vicArADInatA, AhvAnADInatA, aBiyojyatA, anuyojyatA, aBiyojanIyatA, paryanuyo- gADInatA, paryanuyojyatA, anusanDAnayogyatA, AhvAnayogyatA, AhveyatA, uttaradAnADikAraH, uttaradAnADInatA, pfcCADInatA.
RESPONSIBLE: I Accountable: dAyin (f. nI) (used in Bengali) or by circumlo.II Subs- -tantial, able to pay: samarTaH (rTA, rTaM).

RESPONSIBLE , a. RESPONSIVE , a. uttarakArI -riRI -ri (n), uttaradAyakaH -kA -kaM, utta- radAyI &c.

Rest, v. t. viSram 4 P, vi-A-ram 1 P, (kAryAt) nivft 1 A; niScalIBU 1 P, sTirIBU, niScezwIBU. 2 (Lean against) AlaMb 1 A, upA-samA-A-Sri 1 U; ni-upa-DA pass.; ‘with her face r(est)ing on her; left hand’ vAmahastopahitavadanA (S. 4); oft. by BaraM kf 8 U (with loc.); ‘r(est)ing on his three hoof (legs)’ Kuratraye BaraM kftvA (H. 2); daMqe BAraM niDAya, yazwi-mavalaMbya, &c. 3 pra-upa-Sam 4 P, suKin-nirvfta-svasTa a. BU. 4 SI 2 A, svap 2 P, saM-viS 6 P, ni-drA 2 P, ni-lI 4 A. 5 sTA 1 P, BU, vft; ‘r(est) with’ avalaMb, apekz 1 A, aDIna-Ayatta a. BU; See Depend (on); ‘further than this r(est)s with fate’ BAgyATattamataH paraM (S. 4). v. t. viSram c., SI c., saMviS c. 2 niviS c., nyas 4 U, avalaMb c., sTA c., A-ni-DA 3 U; cApe vijayASaMsAM nidaDO ‘r(est)ed his hope of victory on his bow’ sakalaripujayASA yatra badDA sutEste (Ve. 5) ‘on whom your sons has r(est)ed their hopes of overthrowing all enemies’. s. viSrA(Sra)maH, viSrAMti f., kArya-vyApAra-nivfttiH. 2 (Of a body) sTiratA, niScalatA, niScezWatA, acalatA. 3 suKaM, sOKyaM, svAsTyaM, nirvfti f., pra-upa-SamaH-SAMti f.; See Ease. 4 avalaMbanaM, ADAraH, sTAnaM. 5 nidrA, SayanaM, saMveSaH-SanaM. 6 ava-, SezaH-SizwaM; anya, itara, apara (a. pl.) (of persons); Adi, praBfti, in comp. 7 yati f., avasAnaM; ‘at r(est)’ niScala, niScezwa, acala, sTira; susTa, pra-upa-SAMta, nirvfta, viSrAMta; nirvyApAra, nirudyoga. [Rest]ing, a. AlaMbita, ASrita, ni-upa-hita, sTita; sTa, vartin in comp.; ‘r(esting) place’ Sayana-viSrAma-sTAnaM. [Rest]less, a. vyAkula, paryA-samA-kula, pAriplava, aSAMta, vihvala, asvasTa, vyagra, anirvfta, udvigna. 2 capala, caMcala, cala; sadAgati, sAspaMda. 3 unnidra, vinidra, nirRidra, ‘passes r(estless) nights’ unnidrA rajanIM gamayati (Mal. 3). [Rest]lessly, adv. anirvftaM, vyagraM; caMcalatayA. [Rest]lessness, s. anirvftiH, asvAsTyaM, udvegaH, vyagratA, cApalyaM, cAMcalyaM, &c.

REST (subs.): I Repose:(1) viSrAmaH, and let this bow get r.: viSrAmaM laBatAmidaM ca DanuH, Sa. ii. 6.;(2) viSrAntiH (rare), your majesty also gets r. in the sixth portion of the day: zazWe kAle tvamapi laBase deva viSrAntimahnaH, Vi. ii. 1.;(3) viSramaH (rare). “paScAtputrErupahitaBaraH kalpate viSramAya”,V iii. 1.II In music: yatiH.III Support, prop.: avalambaH, -nam.IV Remainder:(1) avaSizwa (f. zwA): v. Remaining, remainder; (2) anye (= others: in contrasting two).

REST (v. i.): I To repose:(1) viSrAmyati (Sram, c. 4.), r. one day, return next morning: ekamaho viSramya SvoBUte pratyAgamizyasi, K. ; r. ed in the cool shade of rose-apple tree: jambUvfkzasya SItalacCAyAyAM viSaSrAma, Va.;(2) viSrAmaM karoti.II To lean: (1) ava-lambate, samA- (lamb, c. 1.: with acc.); (2) A-Srayati, -te, upA-, samA-, sam, (Sri, c. 1.), the arm of Rāma on which no other (woman) r. ed: rAmabAhuranupASrino'nyayA, U. i. 37.III To stand, lie: q. v.: tizWati (sTA, c. 1.).IV With on or with = depend on: q. v.:V To rely: q. v.
REST (v. t.): I To cause to repose: viSrAmayati (c. of Sram), r. the yoked (horses): DUryAnviSrAmaya, R. i. 54.II To place: q. v.: sTApayati (c. of sTA).

REST , s. (Cessation of action or motion) viSrAmaH, viSrAntiH f., [Page684-b+ 51] viSramaH, nirvftiH f., nivfttiH f., virAmaH, viratiH f., avaratiH f., upa- ratiH f., cezwAnivfttiH f., vyApAranivfttiH f., SramanivfttiH f., niScalatA, Srama- cCedaH, nirvyApAratA, nirudyamatA, vyApArABAvaH, udyoganivfttiH f., sTiratA, nEScalyaM, acalatA, calanABAvaH. See QUIESCENCE. — (Tranquillity, ease, quiet) suKaM, SAntiH f., SamaH, upaSamaH, SAntatA, praSAntiH f., svasTatA, svAsTyaM, sOKyaM, samADAnaM. — (Sleep, repose) nidrA, nidrA- vasTA, nidrAdaSA, svapnaH, SayanaM; ‘at rest,’ SAntaH -ntA -ntaM, nirvftaH -tA -taM, viSrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, niScalaH -lA -laM, nirvyApAraH -rA -raM, niScezwaH -zwA -zwaM, nirudyamaH -mA -maM, nirudyogaH -gA -gaM. — (Pause in music or poetry) yatiH f., avasAnaM. — (That which is left) SizwaM, avaSizwaM, ucCizwaM, SezaH -zaM, avaSezaH, see REMAINDER. — (The others) SizwajanAH m. pl., avaSizwajanAH m. pl., itare m. pl., apare m. pl., anye m. pl. See ET-CAETERA.

To REST , v. n. (Cease from action or motion, be still) viSram (c. 4. -SrAmyati -SramituM), niScalIBU, niScalaH -lA -laM BU, viram (c. 1. -ramati -rantuM), Aram, uparam, nivft (c. 1. -varttate -rttituM), nirvft, vi- nivft, sTirIBU. — (Be tranquil, quiet) Sam (c. 4. SAmyati, SamituM), upaSam, praSam, suKI -KinI -Ki BU, svasTaH -sTA -sTaM BU. — (Repose, sleep) SI (c. 2. Sete, SayituM), svap (c. 2. svapiti -tuM), saMviS (c. 6. -viSati -vezwuM), nidrA, SayanaM kf, svaptaM kf, nidrAM kf. — (Lean on) avalamb (c. 1. -lambate -mbituM), samAlamb, Alamb, saMSri (c. 1. -Srayati -te -yituM), samASri, upASri, avasTA (c. 1. -tizWati -sTAtuM), nilI (c. 4. -lIyate -letuM), sannilI, avalambanaM kf. — (Confide) viSvas, viSramB. — (Remain) sTA, vft.

To REST , v. a. (Lay to rest, cause to rest) SI in caus. (SAya- yati -yituM), viSram (c. 10. -SrAmayati -yituM), saMviS (c. 10. -veSayati -yituM), SayanaM kf. — (Lay, place on a support) avalamb in caus. (-lambayati -yituM), nyas (c. 4. -asyati -situM), niDA, ADA, niviS, sTA in caus., f in caus., samf, ADAraM kf, ASrayaM kf.
Restaurant, s. upAhAragfha.

RESTED , p. p. (Relieved from fatigue) viSrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, gataklamaH mA -maM, gataSramaH -mA -maM, see REFRESHED. — (Laid on for sup- port) avalambitaH -tA -taM, ASritaH -tA -taM, nilInaH -nA -naM, nizaRRaH -RRA -RRaM, nihitaH &c., nyastaH -stA -staM; ‘having rested upon,’ avalambya, upaDAya.

RESTING-PLACE: viSrAmasTAnam and sim. comp. s

RESTIVE , RESTIFF, a. durdamyaH -myA -myaM, durvinItaH -tA -taM, durvineyaH -yA -yaM, durvaSyaH -SyA -SyaM, adamyaH &c., avaSyaH &c., avineyaH &c., pratIpaH -pA -paM, vizamaH -mA -maM, durnigrahaH -hA -haM, durdDaraH -rA -raM, duzwaH -zwA -zwaM; ‘horse,’ SUkalaH, SUlakaH; ‘elephant,’ aMkuSadurdDaraH.

(Unquiet) aSAntaH -ntA -ntaM, SAntihInaH nA -naM, anirvftaH -tA -taM, aSAntacittaH -ttA -ttaM, asvasTaH -sTA -sTaM, vyagraH -grA -graM, vyagracittaH &c., pariplavaH -vA -vaM, vyAkulaH -lA -laM, vihvalaH -lA -laM, asamAhitaH -tA -taM. — (Fidgety, always moving) caYcalaH -lA -laM, capalaH -lA -laM, sadAcalaH &c., satatagatiH -tiH -ti, sadA- [Page685-a+ 51] gatiH &c., nirAspadaH -dA -daM, atyantInaH -nA -naM. — (Sleepless) nirnidraH -drA -draM, vinidraH &c., anidraH &c., unnidraH &c., nidrAhInaH -nA -naM, svapnahInaH &c.

RESTORATIVE: (1) balya (f. lyA), Sr.;(2) balavarDana (f. nI); and sim. comp.s.

[Restor]ation, s. pratidAnaM, pratyarpaRaM, pratipAdanaM, niryAtanaM, parAvartanaM, pratyAnayanaM, udDAraH, pUrvAvasTAprApaRaM, &c. [Restor]ative, a. agnivarDana (nI f.), satva-bala-varDanasattva-bala-varDana. s. balavarDanaM, balyaM, vAjIkaraRaM. [Restor]er, s. pratidAtf m., pratyarpayitA.

RESTORE: (1) often expr. by punarlaBate (laB, c. 1.), avApnoti (Ap, c. 5.), etc. (= to get back = be r. d), and Puru was r. d to his former youth: yOvanaM pratipede ca puruH svaM punarAtmanaH, Mah. i. 83. 18.; let the king be r. d to his sight and strength: sa labDacakzurbalavAn BavennwapaH, Mah. iii. 297. 27.; r. d to life (lit. form): pratipannamUrti (mfn.), Ku. vii. 92.;(2) pratidadAti or punar dadAti (dA, c. 3.) and sim. comp.s. (= to give back);(3) navIkaroti (= repair: q. v.), (4) pratyAnayati (nI, c. 1. = to bring back: q. v.);(5) udDarati (hf, c. 1. = to save, free: q. v.).

To RESTORE , v. a. (Give back) pratidA (c. 3. -dadAti -datte -dAtuM), paridA, pratyf in caus. (-arpayati -yituM), pratipad (c. 10. -pAdayati -yituM), punaH pratipad, punar f in caus., punar dA, punaH pradA, parAvft in caus. (-varttayati -yituM), prayam (c. 1. -yacCati -dAtuM), punaH prayam, niryat (c. 10. -yAtayati -yituM), samupAkf, pratyarpaRaM kf, pratidAnaM kf, parAvarttaM kf. — (Replace) punaH sTA in caus. (sTApayati -yituM), pratizwA, pratiruh in caus., pratiDA, see REPLACE. — (Bring back to its former state, repair) pUrvvavat kf, pUrvvasTitim AnI or gam in caus., pUrvvadaSAm AnI or pratyAnI, udDf (c. 1. udDarati, udDarttuM, rt. hf), jIrRodDAraM kf, pratikf, pratisaMskf, sAD, see To REPAIR. — (Bring back) pratyAnI (c. 1. -nayati -netuM), pratinI, punar AnI. — (Restore to life) jIv in caus., see To RE-ANIMATE. — (To health), see To CURE, RECOVER.

RESTORED , p. p. (Given back) pratidattaH -ttA -ttaM, paridattaH &c., pratya- rpitaH -tA -taM, punararpitaH &c., pratipAditaH &c., pratyApannaH -nnA -nnaM, pradattaH -ttA -ttaM, parAvfttaH -ttA -ttaM, parAvarttitaH -tA -taM. — (Replaced) punaHsTApitaH -tA -taM, pratizWApitaH &c. — (Repaired) udDftaH -tA -taM, jIrRodDftaH &c., pratisaMskftaH &c. — (Brought back) pratyAnItaH -tA -taM, punarAnItaH &c. — (To life) prAptajIvanaH -nA -naM. — (To one's senses) labDacetAH -tAH -taH (s), prAptacEtanyaH -nyA -nyaM. See RECOVERED.
RESTORER: (1) pratipAdaka (f. dikA);(2) pratidAtf (f. trI); etc.
