(scope) apavAda ivotsargaM vyAvartayitumISvaraH (R. xv. 7) ‘can r(estric) the scope of a rule’. [Restrict]ed, a. niyata, samaryAda, sAvaDika, parimita &c.; See Limited. [Restrict]ion, s. sImA, iyattA, niyamaH, maryAdA, avaDiH, paricCedaH, nibaMDaH, niroDaH, avaDAraRA, vyAvftti f., yaMtraRA; ‘without r(estriction)’ svEraM, yaTecCaM, ani-yaMtraRaM. [Restrict]ive, a. vyAvartaka, niyAmaka, paricCedaka, avaDAraRa; tuSabdo'vaDAraRArTaH, vyAvfttyarTakaH (S. B.) ‘has a r(estricive) sense’.
RESTRICT: niruRadDi (ruD, c. 7.), when my ac- tions are thus r. ed by you on all sides: AryeREvaM sarvato nirudDacezwAprasarasya, Mu. iii.: v. Also to restrain, limit.

To RESTRICT , v. a. nibanG (c. 9. -baGnAti -bandDuM), parimA (c. 2. -mAti -tuM), parimitaM -tAM kf, saparimARaM -RAM kf, niyam (c. 1. -yacCati -yantuM), saMyam, nigrah (c. 9. -gfhlAti, grahItuM), nirUp (c. 10. -rUpayati -yituM), maryyAdAM or sImAM nirUp, samaryyAdaM -dAM kf, sasImaM -mAM kf.

RESTRICTED , p. p. nibadDaH -dDA -dDaM, parimitaH -tA -taM, mitaH &c., niyataH &c., niyamitaH &c., samaryyAdaH -dA -daM, sAvaDikaH -kA -kaM, sasImaH -mA -maM; ‘as a word,’ mitArTaH, yogarUQaH. See LIMITED.
RESTRICTION: (1) niroDaH: v. Restraint;(2) sImA: v. Limit. Ph.: without r.: yaTecCam, (= at pleasure).

RESTRICTION , s. nibanDaH -nDanaM, banDaH -nDanaM, niyamaH -manaM, saMyamaH, ni- yatiH f., nigrahaH, maryyAdA, sImA, parisImA, avaDiH m., parimitiH f., parimitatA, parimARaM, paricCedaH, viSezaH -zaRaM; ‘without restric- tion,’ anibanDanaH -nA -naM, aviSezaRaH -RA -RaM.
RESTRICTIVE: (1) niroDin (f. nI);(2) by verb or circumlo.
RESTRICTIVE , a. nibanDanaH -nA -naM, niyAmakaH -kA -kaM, parimApanaH -nA -naM, paricCedakaH &c., maryyAdAnirUpakaH &c., sImAnirUpakaH &c.

Result, v. i. ava-paryava-so 4 P, vi-, pari-Ram 1 U; See End. 2 utpad-nizpad 4 A, pra-saM-ud-BU 1 P, jan 4 A, pravft 1 A; See Produce; gen. ex. by (s.); ‘it will r(esult) in nothing’ tannirarTakaM Bavet; ‘it will r(esult) in destructing’ tasya nASa eva PalaM Bavet s. pariRAmaH, PalaM. 2 arTaH, guRaH, nizpannaM, sidDi f.; aMtaH, avasAnaM, SevaH, udarkaH; pAkaH; ‘good r(esult)’ SuBaPalaM. 3 sidDAMtaH, maTitArTaH, niScitArTaH; ‘producing no r(esult)’ nizPala, nirguRa, vyarTa. [Result]ing, a. ja, janya, udBava, Pala in comp.; See Produced.
RESULT (subs.): (1) pariRAmaH, this is the unfor- tunate r. of my quietude: eza me praSamasya karkaSaH pariRAmaH, Vi. iii.;(2) Palam: v. Consequence, fruit;(3) sidDAntaH (r. of reasoning).

RESULT (v. i.): utpadyate (pad, c. 4.), r. ing from the murder of Parvataka: parvatakavaDotpanna (f. nnA), Mu. i.: v. To proceed (III); (2) pari- Ramate, vi-, (nam, c. l. = to terminate), it r. s from his own misdeeds: Atmana eva duScaritametadvi- pariRamayati, Vi. vii.

To RESULT , v. n. (Issue, proceed) utpad (c. 4. -padyate -pattuM), samutpad jan (c. 4. jAyate, janituM), upajan, siD (c. 4. siDyati, sedDuM), praBU (c. 1. -Bavati -vituM), udBU, anuBU in pass., pravft (c. 1. -varttate -rttituM), anuvft, niHsf, udi. — (End in) avaso (c. 4. -syati -sAtuM), paryavaso, nizpad in pass., vigam, nirgam, apagam.

RESULT , s. (Consequence, issue) pariRAmaH, PalaM, utpattiH f., sidDiH f., prayuktiH f., prayogaH, utpannaM, udBUtaM, nizpannaM, uttaraM, PalamuttaraM, PalodayaH, PalotpattiH f., nirgamaH, SezaH, antaH, udarkaH, janyaM, anuBavaH, BavyaM, anu- sAraH, anuvarttanaM, anvayaH, pratyayaH, anuzaNgaH, yogaH, kAryyaM, arTaH, Pali- tArTaH, avasAnaM, avasAyaH, paryavasAnaM, guRaH, paripAkaH, see EFFECT; ‘unexpected result,’ vipAkaH; ‘happy result,’ SuBaPalaM. — (Result of reasoning, conclusion) sidDAntaH, sidDiH f., niSci- tArTaH, maTitArTaH, nirRItArTaH, upapattiH f., anuBUtiH f., anumitiH f., GawitArTaH.

RESULTING , part. prayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, utpannaH -nnA -nnaM, jAtaH -tA -taM, janitaH &c., janyaH -nyA -nyaM, udBUtaH &c., anuvfttaH -ttA -ttaM, pravfttaH &c., anu- sArI -riRI &c., anuyAyI &c., Pala in comp., praBava in comp., udBava in comp.; ‘pain resulting from sin,’ pApaprayuktaM duHKaM; ‘fever resulting from fasting,’ upavAsaprayukto jvaraH; ‘obedience resulting from fear,’ BayaprayuktA BaktiH; ‘resulting from that,’ tatPalaH -lA -laM.
RESUMABLE , a. pratyAharaRIyaH -yA -yaM, pratyAhAryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM, avahAryyaH &c.

Resume, v. t. punaH-BUyaH-AdA 3 A or grah 9 U or Ap 5 P or laB 1 A, pratyAhf 1 P; ‘let us r(esume) (the thread of) our discourse’ prakftaM-prastutavizayaM-anusaMdaDAma or anusarAma; oft. by punaH-BUyaH-AraB 1 A or kf, with other words; ‘r(esum)ed their fighting’ punaryodDumAreBire, ataH paraM punaH kaTayizyAmi (M. 4) ‘I shall r(esume) my story from this point afterwards’; ‘he r(esum)ed his discourse’ punarvaktuM pracakrame. s. sAraH, saMgrahaH, sArArTaH Resumption, s. pratyAdAnaM, punargrahaRaM, pratyAhAraH.
RESUME (subs.): sAraH or sArasaMgrahaH: v. Also epitome.
RESUME (v.): punar or BUya Adatte (dA, c. 3.): v. To take again. Ph.: to r. an argument or discourse: prakftamanusarati (sf, c. l. = to follow).
RESUMÉ , s. sAraH, sArArTaH, sArasaMgrahaH, saMgrahaH, upasaMhAraH.

To RESUME , v. a. (Take back or again) punar AdA (c. 3. dadAti- [Page686-a+ 51] datte -dAtuM), pratyAdA, punar grah (c. 9. gfhlAti, grahItuM), pratyAhf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), punar Ahf, punar hf, apahf, anuprAp (c. 5. -Apnoti -AptuM), punaH prAp, pratyavAp, punar laB. — (Take up again after interruption, begin again) prakftam or prastutam or mUlavizayam anusf (c. 1. -sarati -sarttuM), prakftaprasaNgaM kf, prakftAnusaraRaM kf, punar AraB (c. 1. -raBate -rabDuM), punaHprasaNgaM kf, punar vad or brU; ‘he re- sumed,’ punarAha.
RESUMED , p. p. pratyAhftaH -tA -taM, apahftaH &c., punargfhItaH -tA -taM.
RESUMING , part. dattApahArI -riRI -ri (n), pratyAhArakaH -kA -kaM.
RESUMPTION: (1) pratyAhAraH;(2) punarAdAnam and sim. expr. s.
RESUMPTION , s. pratyAharaRaM, pratyAhAraH, punarAharaRaM, punarharaRaM, apahAraH, apaharaRaM, punargrahaRaM, pratyAdAnaM, punarAdAnaM; ‘of a grant,’ dattApahAraH, dattApaharaRaM.
Resurrection, s. punarujjIvanaM, mftotTApanaM.
RESURRECTION: (1) ujjIvanam, prati-;(2) mfto- tTAnam after Ku. vii. 4.

RESURRECTION , s. mftotTAnaM, mftotTitiH f., mftalokotTAnaM, punarutTAnaM, punarutTitiH f., mftapunarutTAnaM, nyAyadine or vicAradine mftalokAnAM punarutTitiH f. or SmaSAnAdutTitiH f.; ‘resurrection day,’ mfto- tTAnakAlaH.
Resuscitate, v. t. punarjIv c. or utTA c. (utTApayati), ujjIv c., pratyud-jIv c. [Resuscitat]ion, s. punarjIvanaM, utTApanaM, ujjIvanaM, pratyujjIvanaM.
To RESUSCITATE , v. a. pratijIv (c. 10. -jIvayati -yituM), saMjIv, ujjIv, nIv, punaH sajIvaM -vAM kf, utTA in caus. See To REVIVE.
RESUSCITATED: (1) ut-jIvayati, saM-, pratyut- (c. of jIv), the animal kingdom was suddenly r.: udajIvat sahasEva jIvalokaH, Si. xx. 39.
RESUSCITATED , p. p. saMjIvitaH -tA -taM, pratijIvitaH &c., punaH sajIvI- kftaH &c.
RESUSCITATION: (1) ujjIvanam, prati-;(2) saYjI- vanam.
RESUSCITATION , s. pratijIvanaM, saYjIvanaM, punaH sajIvIkaraRaM, punarutTApanaM.
Retail, s. alpaSaH vikrayaH, paRyakrayaH. v. t. alpaSaH vikrI 9 A or paR 1 A. [Retail]er, ‘r(etail) dealer’ s. alpaSaH paRyavikrayin m., KaMqa-vaRij m.
RETAIL: alpaSaH or pAdaSaH vikrIRIte (krI, c. 9.).
RETAIL (subs.): perh. alpaSaH or pAdaSo vikrayaH.
RETAIL , RETAILING, s. alpavikrayaH, KaRqavikrayaH, kzudravikrayaH, alyapaRAyA, alpavipaRaH, alpabARijyaM, KaRqabARijyaM, kzudrabARijyaM.
To RETAIL , v. a. alpaSaH or KaRqaSo vikrI (c. 9. -krIRAti -RIte -kretuM), alpavikrayaM kf, KaRqavikrayaM kf, alpapaRAyAM kf, paR (c. 1. paRate -RituM), KaRqavARijyaM kf.
RETAILER: i. e. retail-dealer: perh. pAdakAraH; paRyavikrayin (m. ?), Ram. ii. 90. 18.
RETAILER , s. KaRqavikrayI m. (n), KaRqavikrayakArI m., alyavikrayakArI m., vipaRI m. (n), prApaRikaH, ApaRikaH, KaRqabARijyakft m., KaRqa- baRik m. (j).

Retain, v. t. Df 1 P, 10, rakz 1 P, DA 3 U; grah 9 U. 2 (Servants) vetanaM datvA ni-yuj 7 A, 10, vyA-pf c., upa-nI 1 A, (karmakarAnupanayate S. K.); (in memory) citte-manasi kf 8 U or ni-DA or niviS c., avaDf. [Retain]er, s. anuyAyin m., anugaH, anucaraH, pArSvakaH, anugAmin m., anujI-vin m., sevakaH, BftyaH, kiMkaraH, ASritaH; See Servant, ‘body of r(etainer)s’ parivAraH, Bftya-anuyAyi-vargaH. Retention, s. DAraRA-RaM, grahaRaM. 2 (Faculty) See below; ‘r(etention) of urine’ mUtrasaMgaH. Retentive, a. DAraRAvat, DAraRakzama; ‘r(etentive) faculty’ DAra-RASakti f., DAraRA, meDA, DAraRAvatI DIH, grahaRasAmarTyaM. 2 Dara, grAhin in comp., DAraka.

RETAIN: I To keep, hold: q. v.:(1) DArayati, saM-, vi- (Df, c. 10.), boldness and ability to r. (i. e. remember): prAgalByaM DArayizRutA, Ka. i. 21.;(2) na muYcati (muc, c. 6. = not to leave: q. v.).II To engage, hire: (mUlyaM dattvA etc.) rakzati (rakz, c. l.).

To RETAIN , v. a. (Keep, hold) Df (c. 10. DArayati -yituM, c. 1. Darati, DarttuM), sanDf, DA (c. 3. daDAti, Datte, DAtuM), rakz (c. 1. rakzati -kzituM), saMrakz, aBirakz, DAraRaM kf. — (Keep back) viDf, nigrah, vinigrah sannigraq, saMhf, upasaMhf. — (Hire, engage) vetanena or mUlyena grah, nirUpitavetanaM pratijYAya karmmaRi niyuj or sTA in caus. — (Remem- ber), see the word.
RETAINED , p. p. DftaH -tA -taM, DAritaH &c., viDftaH &c., sTApitaH &c.
RETAINER: I Lit.: anugaH (= follower);(2) anujIvin (m. = dependent);(3) svapakzaH (= partisan);(4) BftyaH (= servant).II Re- -taining fee: *rakzAmUlyam.

RETAINER , s. (Dependant, adherent) ASritaH, ASrayI m. (n), anucaraH, anujIvI m. (n), upajIvI m., BAktikaH, BftyaH, avalambI m., anuzaNgI m., anugAmI m., anucArI m., anuyAyI m., anugaH, sapakzaH, sevakaH, pArSvakaH; ‘an old retainer,’ cirASritaH, cirasevakaH; ‘body of retainers,’ parivAraH, BftyavargaH, sevakavargaH, anuyAyivargaH.
RETAINING , s. DAraRaM, DaraRaM, DftiH f., rakzaRaM, niyojanaM, sTApanaM.
Retaliate, v. t. prati-kf 8 U, pratyapakf; (vEraM) niryat 10, SuD c., sAD c., prati-hiMs 7 P. [Retalia]tion, s. pratikriyA, prati(tI)kAraH, pratyapakAraH, pratihiMsA, vErasADanaM-SudDiH-niryAtanaM.
RETALIATE: pratikaroti, has come to r.: pratikarta- mupAgataH, Ki. xii. 11.: v. Also revenge.

To RETALIATE , v. a. pratikf, vipratikf, viprakf, pratyapakf, vErapratikAraM kf, pratyapakAraM kf, pratiPala (nom. pratiPalayati -yituM), pratiPalaM dA, pratiyatnaM kf, pratihiMs (c. 7. -hinasti, c. 1. -hiMsati -situM), pratihiMsAM kf, vEraSudDiM kf, vErodDAraM kf, niryat (c. 10. -yAtayati -yituM), vEraniryAtanaM kf.
RETALIATED , p. p. pratikftaH -tA -taM, vipratikftaH &c., viprakftaH &c., pratyapakftaH &c., pratiPalitaH -tA -taM, niryAtitaH -tA -taM.
RETALIATION: (1) prati (tI) kAraH or -kriyA;(2) pratyapakAraH (in bad sense).

RETALIATION , s. pratikAraH, pratikAraH, pratikftiH f., pratikriyA, pratikarmma n. (n), vipratikAraH, viprakAraH, viprakftiH f., pratyapakAraH, vErapratikriyA. vErapratikAraH, prativiDiH m., pratiPalaM, pratiyatnaH, pratihiMsA, vEraSudDiH f., [Page686-b+ 51] vErodDAraH, niryAtanaM, vEraniryAtanaM, apakAraH, apakriyA, apakaraRaM, samADiH m., CudraM.

Retard, v. t. prati-ni-ruD 7 U, staMB 9 P, pratibaMD 9 P, bAD 1 A, ni-vf c.; See Obstruct. 2 vilaMb c., vyAkzip 6 P, gatiM avaruD or staMB. [Retard]ation, s. niroDaH, pratibaMDaH, vega-gati-roDaH, vilaMbaH, vyAkzepaH. [Retard]ed, a. nirudDa, vilaMbitagati, avarudDavega.
RETARD: (1) vilambayati (c. of lamb): v. To delay;(2) ruRadDi (ruD, c. 7): v. To hinder, restrain.

To RETARD , v. a. (Diminish the velocity of motion) vegaroDaM kf, vegAvaroDaM kf, vegaM or gatiM ruD (c. 7. ruRadDi, rodDuM) or avaruD or viDf (c. 10. -DArayati -yituM), vegaviDAraRaM kf, vegavilambanaM kf, gati- vilambanaM kf, gatimandatAM kf, mandagatiM -tiM -ti kf. — (Cause delay) vilamb (c. 10. -lambayati -yituM), vilambaM kf, vilambanaM kf, mandatAM kf, mandaM -ndAM kf. — (Hinder) ruD, niruD, pratiruD, avaruD, saMruD, bAD, stamB, pratibanD.
RETARDATION , RETARDING, s. vegaroDaH, vegAvaroDaH, vegaviDAraRaM, vegavi- lambanaM, gativilambanaM, gatipratibanDaH, vegasaMkocaH, roDaH, avaroDaH, vilambanaM.

RETARDED , p. p. rudDavegaH -gA -gaM, avarudDavegaH &c., rudDagatiH -tiH -ti, avarudDagatiH &c., vilambitaH -tA -taM, vilambitavegaH -gA -gaM, vilambi- tagatiH -tiH -ti, viDAritavegaH &c., ‘gradually retarded motion,’ kzIyamARo vegaH, kzIyamARA gatiH.
RETARDING , part. vilambI -mbinI &c., vegaroDakaH -kA -kaM, vegAvaroDakaH &c.
RETCH: perh. vivamizati (desi. of vam), or CardirAgacCati (gam, c. l.: gen. of person). R. ing: vivamizA (?) or by circumlo.
To RETCH , v. n. vamituM or CardayituM yatnaM kf or udyamaM kf or udyam, vamanodyamaM kf.
RETENTION: I The act: expr. by verb.II The faculty: DAraRA.
RETENTION , s. DAraRaM -RA, DftiH f., DaraRaM, AgrahaH, grahaH, saMgrahaH -haRaM. — (Faculty of the mind) DAraRASaktiH f., DAraRA, smftiH f., meDA.
RETENTIVE: (1) DAraRAvat (f. tI);(2) DArayizRu (mfn.). R. memory:(1) meDA, and has excel- lent r. m.: meDAvinI ca, Mal. i.;(2) DArayizRutA, Ka. i. 21.

RETENTIVE , a. (As memory) DAraRAvAn -vatI -vat (t), DAraRASa- ktiviSizwaH -zwA -zwaM, DAraRASaktiyuktaH -ktA -ktaM. — (Retaining) DArakaH -kA -kaM, DaraH -rA -raM, AgrahI -hiRI &c.; ‘of moisture,’ kledaDArakaH -kA -kaM; ‘of life,’ durmaraH -rA -raM.
RETENTIVENESS: (1) DAraRASaktiH;(2) DArayizRutA.
RETENTIVENESS , s. DAraRaSaktiH f., DAraRakzamatA, DArakatvaM, DftiH f., dfQatA.
Reticence, s. mOnaM, saMvfti f., mUkaBAvaH, vAgyamaH. Reticent, a. mOnAvalaMbin saM-vftimat, yaMtritavAc, vAgyata; See Reserved.
RETICENCE: (1) mOnam (silence);(2) saMvftiH (= reserve).
RETICENT: mOnAvalambin (f. nI = silent); (2) saMvfttimat (f. tI = reserved).
Reticular, a. jAlAkAra, jAlarUpa. Reticulation, s. jAlakarman m.
RETICULAR, RETICULATED: jAlAkAra (f. rA) and sim. comp.s.
RETICULAR , RETICULATED, a. jAlAkAraH -rA -raM, jAlAkftiH -tiH -ti, jAlarUpaH -pA -paM, vyatyastareKAviSizwaH -zwA -zwaM, jAlavad antarAlaviSizwaH &c.
RETICULATION , s. jAlakarmma n. (n), jAlAkArakarmma n., jAlavatkarmma n.
RETICULE , a. strIlokena hastena BftaM sUcyAdiDAraRayogyo laGukozaH.
Retina, s. netrAMtaH pawalaM.
RETINA: perh. dfzwiH, 'dfzwidvayaM kfzRagolO, Bha.
RETINA , s. netrAntaHsTitacitrapatraM, netrAntaHsTacitrapatraM.
Retinue, s. parijanaH, parivAraH, paribarhaH, paricCadaH, anuyAyi-Bftya-vargaH, paricarAH, anucarAH.
RETINUE: (1) parijanaH;(2) parivAraH;(3) pari- [Page595] -varhaH;(4) paricCadaH: v. Attendant, follower, servant.
RETINUE , s. parivAraH, parivarhaH, varhaH, parigrahaH, tantraM, parikaraH, parijanaH, parijanAH m. pl., paricarAH m. pl., anucarAH m. pl., paricaravargaH, sahacaravargaH, BftyavargaH, paricCadaH.

Retire, v. i. apakram 1 U, 4 P, apagam 1 P, apa-yA-i 2 P, cal 1 P, parAvft 1 A; eka-pArSve sTA 1 P. 2 viSrAmArTaM udyogAd-viram 1 P or kAryaM-aDikAraM-tyaj 1 P, vivikta-vfttiM sev 1 A, sevAM tyaj; ‘r(etire) from the world’ sarvasaMgaM parityaj, saMnyas 4 U, vi-vikte vas; SAMtimArgotsukoBUt (R. vii. 71) ‘wished to r(etire) from the world’. [Retir]ed, a. vivikta, gupta, vijana, gUQa, pracCanna, ekAMta, niBfta, nirjana; See Lonely, ‘a r(etired) spot’ rahaHsTAnaM, viviktaM. 2 (Disposition) saMvf-timat, gUQa, anuttAna; See Reserved. 3 tyaktakarman, viviktasevin, tyaktADikAra; ‘a r(etired) person’ saMnyAsin m., muktasaMgaH. [Retire]ment, s. apasaraRaM, apakramaRaM, apagamanaM, &c. 2 nirjana-vivikta-sTAnaM, rahaHsTAnaM. 3 vivikta-vftti f., aDikAra-kArya-tyAgaH; viviktasevanaM; saMnyAsaH. [Retir]ing, a. apakrAmin &c. 2 vivikta-priya-sevin, aDfzwa; See Reserved.

RETIRE: I To go away, retreat: q. v.: apa- krAmati (kram, c. 1.).II To withdraw: r. d from the world: SAntimArgotsuko'BUt, R. vii. 71.; you will again r. to this hermitage: karizyasi padaM punarASrame'smin Sa. iv. 19.; shall r. to a wood: vanaM vrajet, Y. iii. 45.

To RETIRE , v. n. apakram (c. 1. -krAmati -kramituM), vyapakram, parAvft (c. 1. -varttate -rttituM), pratinivft, nivft, pArSve parAvft, avasTA (c. 1. -tizWate -sTAtuM), apasf (c. 1. -sarati -sarttuM), apayA (c. 2. -yAti -tuM), apagam (c. 1. -gacCati -gantuM), vyapagam, cal (c. 1. calati -lituM), palAy (c. 1. palAyate -yituM, rt. i), vipalAy. — (Retire into privacy or pri- vate life) viviktatAM or viviktavfttim AsTA or sev, sarvvasaNgAn sannyas (c. 4. -asyati -situM) or tyaj, saNgasannyAsaM kf, gfhasannyAsaM kf, viviktadeSe vas.
RETIRED (adj.): I Solitary, secluded: q. v.: vivikta (f. ktA).II From office: karmApasfta (f. tA), tyaktakarman (mfn.) and sim. comp.s. (?).

RETIRED , a. (Sequestered, secluded) viviktaH -ktA -ktaM, vijanaH -nA -naM, niBftaH -tA -taM, ekAntaH -ntA -ntaM, nirjanaH &c., niHSalAkaH -kA -kaM. — (Secret) gUQaH -QA -QaM, guptaH -ptA -ptaM, pracCannaH -nnA -nnaM; ‘a retired spot,’ viviktasTAnaM, nirjanasTAnaM, nirjanadeSaH, rahaHsTAnaM; ‘a place whence water has retired,’ parApaH -pA -paM, parepaH -pA -paM; ‘leading a retired life,’ viviktasevI -vinI -vi (n).
RETIREMENT: I In gen.: expr. by verb: v. To retire.II Seclusion: viviktatA.III From office: karmApasfti; and sim. comp. s (?).

RETIREMENT , s. (Act of retiring) parAvarttaH -rttanaM, pratinivarttanaM, nivarttanaM pArSvaparivarttanaM, apakramaH -maRaM, apasaraRaM, apagamaH -manaM, palAyanaM. — (Act of retiring into privacy or private life) viviktaseyanaM, vivi- ktavfttisevanaM, viviktavAsasevanaM, viviktadeSe vAsaH, saNgasannyAsaH, gfhasa- nnyAsaH. — (Private or retired life or state) viviktatA -tvaM, [Page687-a+ 51] viviktavfttiH f., viviktadaSA, ekAntatA, ekAntavfttiH f. — (Place of retirement) viviktasTAnaM, nirjanasTAnaM, niBftasTAnaM, nizadyA.
RETIRING (adj.): I Reserved, not forward: viviktapriya (f. yA) and sim. comp. s;(2) SAnta (f. ntA = quiet).II Suitable at retire- -ment; r. pension: *karmApasftivfttiH.

RETIRING , part. or a. (Withdrawing) parAvarttI -rttinI -rtti (n), apakrAman -mantI -mat (t), pArSvaparivarttI &c. — (Not forward or bold) viviktasevI &c., ekAntasevI &c., viviktapriyaH -yA -yaM, ekA- ntapriyaH &c., apragalBaH -lBA -lBaM, aDfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, mandAsyaviSizwaH -zwA -zwa, mandasvaBAvaH -vA -vaM. See RESERVED.
Retort, v. i. pratyuttaraM dA 3 U, pratyavaskaMd 1 P, pratyAkzip 6 P, pratikf 8 U, pratyaBi-yuj 7 A, 10. s. pratyuttaraM, pratyavaskaMdanaM, pratyapavAdaH, pratyaBiyogaH, pratyAropaH. 2 bakayaMtraM.
RETORT (v.): (1) pratyavaskandate (skand, c. l.); (2) pratyuttaraM dadAti (dA, c. 3.).
RETORT (subs.): (1) pratyavaskandaH;(2) pratyuttaram (= rejoinder).
To RETORT , v. a. pratikzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzeptuM), pratyavakzip, punaH kziz or avakzip, pratikf, pratyAruh in caus. (-ropayati -yituM). See To RECRIMINATE.
To RETORT , v. n. pratyapavad (c. 1. -vadati -dituM), pratyapavAdaM kf, pratyabakzepaM kf, pratyuttaraM kf, pratinind (c. 1. -nindati -ndituM), punar nind, pratyAropaM kf.

RETORT , s. (Return of an accusation or incivility) pratyapavAdaH, pratyavakzepaH, pratyAropaH, pratyaBiyogaH, pratyuttaraM, pratinindA, viprakftiH f., viprakAraH, vipratikAraH, pratikAraH. — (Vessel in chemistry for distillation) vakaH, vakayantraM, mUzaH -zI -zA -zikA; ‘glass retort,’ kAcavakaH, kAcavakayantraM.
Retrace, v. t. (Oneʼs steps) pratyAvft, nivft, 1 A; See Return.
RETRACE: to r. one's steps: pratyAvartate (vft, c. l.): v. To return.
To RETRACE , v. a. (One's steps) nivft, prAtanivft. See To RETURN.

Retract, v. t. pratyAKyA 2 P, pratyAdiS 6 P (word, promise, &c.) nivft; c., nivft 1 A (with abl.); vyatikram 1 U, 4 P, aticar 1 P. [Retract]ion, s. pratyAKyAnaM, pratyAdeSaH, nivartanaM, ukta-tyAgaH-vyatikramaH.
RETRACT: (1) perh. saMharati (hf, c. l.);(2) KAdati (KAd, c. l. = to eat up?);(3) pratyA- KyAti (KyA, c. 2. = to gainsay).

To RETRACT , v. a. or n. kaTitatyAgaM kf, uktatyAgaM kf, uktAsvIkAraM kf, kaTi- tAsvIkAraM kf, uktapratyAdeSaM kf, vyatikramaM kf, anuSayaM kf, nivft (c. 1. -varttate -rttituM) with abl.; ‘induce to retract,’ nivft in caus. See To RECANT, RECALL.
RETRACTATION , RETRACTION, s. kaTitatyAgaH, uktatyAgaH, uktapratyAdeSaH, uktAsvIkAraH, kaTitAsvIkAraH, nivarttanaM, nivfttiH f., anuSayaH, vyati- kramaH. See RECANTATION.
RETRACTED , p. p. anuSayitaH -tA -taM, pratyAdizwaH -zwA -zwaM, vyatikrAntaH -ntA -ntaM.
RETRACTION, RETRACTATION: (1) by circumlo; (2) pratyAKyAnam or prativAdaH (= gainsaying).

Retreat, v. i. apa-yA 2 P, -gam-sf 1 P, apa-kram 1 U, 4 P, pratini-ni-pratyA-vft 1 A See Retire. 2 pra-vi-dru 1 P, -apaDAv 1 P, palAy 1 A. s. apasaraRaM, apakramaH-maRaM, apayAnaM, parAvartanaM, parAvftti f., apagamaH, pratinivfttiH. 2 palAyanaM, pra-vi-drAvaH. 3 SaraRaM, ASrayaMsTAnaM, nilayaH, vivikta or nirjana-deSaH or sTAnaM.
RETREAT (subs.): The act: (1) apayAnam or apasaraRam (= going away);(2) palAyanam (= fleeing).II The place:(1) SaraRam: v. Refuge.;(2) AlayaH (= adodeabode: q. v.).
RETREAT (v.): I To retire, go away:(1) apakrAmati (kram, c. l.);(2) apasarati (sf, c. 1.). II From an enemy: palAyate: v. To flee.

RETREAT , s. (Act of retiring) apakramaH -maRaM, apasaraRaM, apayAnaM, parAvarttaH, parAvfttiH f., apAvarttanaM, azAvfttiH f., parivarttaH -rttanaM, vipra- yARaM, pratiprayARaM, apAyaH, apagamaH -manaM, upakramaH, nivarttanaM, pratini- varttanaM, vakramaH. — (Of an army) palAyanaM, vipalAyanaM, prapalAyanaM, drAvaH, vidravaH, pradrAvaH, sandrAvaH, uddrAvaH, dravaH, saMyuge nivarttanaM. — (Place of retirement) viviktasTAnaM, viviktadeSaH, nirjanasTAnaM, nirjanadeSaH, niBftasTAnaM, rahaHsTAnaM, parAvarttanasTAnaM.

To RETREAT , v. n. (Retire) apakram (c. 1. -krAmati -krimituM), vyapakram, parAvft, apayA, apagam, see To RETIRE. — (As an army) palAy (c. 1. palAyate -yituM, rt. i), vipalAy, prapalAy, sampalAy, pradru (c. 1. -dravati -drotuM), vidru, vipradru, apaDAv (c. 1. -DAvati -vituM), praDAv. — (Withdraw into privacy), see To RETIRE.
RETREATED , p. p. parAvfttaH -ttA -ttaM, apAvfttaH &c., palAyitaH -tA -taM.
Retrench, v. t. nyUnIkf 8 U, hras c., a-lpIkf, avacCid 7 P, avakft 6 P, KaMq 10, apa-ci 5 U. [Retrench]ment, s. avacCedaH, KaMqanaM, vyavacCedaH, nyUnavyayaH, vyayApacayaH.
RETRENCH: (1) nyUnIkaroti: v. To lessen, diminish;(2) laGayati (nomi.) or laGUkaroti: v. To lighten.

To RETRENCH , v. a. (Cut off, curtail) Cid (c. 7. Cinatti, CettuM), avaCid, avakft (c. 6. -kfntati -karttituM), lU (c. 9. lunAti, lavituM), lap (c. 6. lumpati, loptuM), KaRq, CedanaM kf. — (Lessen expenses, &c.) vyayaM nyUnyIkf or alpIkf or hras in caus. or saMhf.
RETRENCHMENT: expr. by verb.; vyayasaMkzepaH (?).
RETRENCHMENT , s. CedaH, avacCedaH, lopaH, vyayacCedaH, vyayalopaH, nyUnavyayaH.
Retribution, s. prati(tI)kAraH, pratiPalaM; See Revenge. Retributive, Retributory, a. pratikArin, pratikAra in comp.
RETRIBUTION: I Retaliation: pratiPalam.II Reward: q. v.
RETRIBUTION , s. pratiPalaM, pratikriyA, pratikftiH f., pratikAraH, nizkftiH f.
RETRIBUTIVE: perh. pariSoDaka (f. DikA); better by circumlo.
RETRIBUTIVE , RETRIBUTORY, a. pratiPalapradaH -dA -daM, pratiPaladAyakaH -kA -yikA -kaM, pratiPaladaH &c., pariSoDakaH -kA -kaM, pratikArakaH -kA -kaM, pratikArI -riRI -ri (n).
RETRIEVABLE: (1) udDaraRIya (f. yA), sam-;(2) pratisamADeya (f. yA).
RETRIEVABLE , a. udDaraRIyaH -yA -yaM, punarudDaraRIyaH &c., punaHprApaRIyaH &c.
Retrieve, v. t. punaH prAp 5 P or laB 1 A, pratyAhf 1 P, udDf 1 P, prati-, samA-DA 3 U; See Recover, ‘irretrievably gone’ asannivfttaye gataM.
RETRIEVE: udDarati, sam- (Df, c. l.): v. To recover, restore.
To RETRIEVE , v. a. udDf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), samudDf, punar udDf, punaH prAp (c. 5. -Apnoti -AptuM), punar laB, punar AnI, udDAraM kf, udDaraRaM [Page687-b+ 51] kf. See To RECOVER, RESTORE.
RETRIEVED , p. p. udDftaH -tA -taM, samudDftaH &c., punaH prAptaH -ptA -ptaM.
Retrocede, v. t. parAvft 1 A; See Return. Retrocession, s. parAvartanaM.
To RETROCEDE , v. n. pratigam (c. 1. -gacCati -gantuM), viparItaM gam, parAvft.
RETROCESSION: (1) pratIpagamanam (going back); (2) pratidAnam (giving b.).
RETROCESSION , s. pratigamanaM, paScAdgamanaM, viparItagamanaM, parAvarttanaM.
RETROGRADATION , s. pratikramaH, vyatikramaH, viparItagatiH f., vakragatiH f.

Retrograde, a. pratIpa, pratiloma, vakra, parAvftta, viparIta, pratIpagAmin; ‘in a r(etograde) direction’ vi-, pratIpaM; ‘turn in a r(etograde) direction’ pratI-payati (D.), parAvft c. v. i. parAvft 1 A, pratIpaM gam 1 P; viparItaM yA-i 2 P. 3 Decline, Decay, q. v. [Retrograd]ation, Retrogression, s. pratIpagamanaM, viparItagamanaM-gati f.
RETROGRADE: I Adj.:(1) pratIpa (f. pA= reverse);(2) vakra (f. krA = crooked: in Astro.), Su. ii. 14.;(3) parAvftta (f. ttA = back- -ward).II Verb: parAvartate (vft, c. 1.).

RETROGRADE , a. viparItagAmI -minI -mi (n), pratigAmI &c., vyatikrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, viparItagatikaH -kA -kaM, parAvfttaH -ttA -ttaM, pratIpaH -pA -paM, prAtIpikaH &c. — (In astronomy) vakragatiH -tiH -ti, vakraH -krA -kraM.

To RETROGRADE , v. n. (Go backward) parAvft (c. 1. -varttate -rttituM), viparItaM gam (c. 1. gacCati, gantuM), pratigam, paScAd gam, pratikram (c. 1. -krAmati -kramituM), vyatikram, vyatikramaM kf. — (Decline) kzIRasattvaH -ttvA ttvaM BU, mUlasattvAd BraMS. See To DEGENERATE, DECLINE.
RETROGRESSION: (1) vakragatiH (of planets etc.); (2) pratIpagamanam etc.
RETROGRESSION , s. paScAdgamanaM, viparItagamanaM, pratigamanaM, vyatikramaH.
Retrospect, s. atItaparyAlocanaM, siMhAva-lokanaM, anudarSanaM, BUtAvalokanaM. [Retrospect]ive, a. anudarSin, gatAvalokin. 2 BUtApekza, gata-kAlasApekza.
RETROSPECT (subs.): gatasya paryAlocanam; atIta- paridarSanam (?); etc.

RETROSPECT , s. gatAvalokanaM, atItAvalokanaM, gatakAlAvalokanaM, atI- takAlAvalokanaM, BUtAvalokanaM, BUtakAlAvalokanaM, anudarSanaM, anudfzwiH f., paScAddarSanaM, paScAddfzwiH f., paScAdavalokanaM, anvavalokanaM.
RETROSPECTIVE: r. view = retrospect: q. v.; with r. effect: gatena kAlena or samayena (?).

RETROSPECTIVE , a. (Looking back) paScAddarSI -rSinI -rSi (n), paScA- davalokI &c., gatAvalokI &c., gatakAlAvalokI &c., anudarSI &c. — (Relating to what is past) gatApekzakaH -kA -kaM, BUtApekzakaH &c., atItApekzakaH &c., gatakAlApekzakaH &c., gatakAlApekzI -kziRI &c., gatakAlasApekzaH -kzA -kzaM, BUtakAlasApekzaH &c.
RETROSPECTIVELY: (1) gatena kAlena (?);(2) atItAvaDi (?).
RETROSPECTIVELY , adv. gatApekzayA, gatakAlApekzayA, gatakAlasApekzaM, BUtApekzayA.

Return, v. i. ni-pratyA-pratini-vft 1 A, prati-yA 2 P, punaryA, punar-i 2 P, pratyAgam-parApat 1 P, prati with words for ‘Come’ ‘Go’, q. v.; ‘it is gone never to r(eturn)’ asannivfttyE tadatItameva (S. 6); ‘r(eturn) to life’ cetanAM laB 1 A or pratipad 4 A, socCvAsa a. BU. 2 Answer, q. v. v. t. prati-dA 2 P, 3 U, prati-f c. (arpayati-) -niryat 10, pratipad c. 2 punaH AnI; ‘r(eturn) good for good’ pratyupakAraM kf 8 U; ‘r(eturn) an injury’ pratyapakf, pratihiMs 7 P. s. nivftti f., pratyAgamanaM, pratyAvfttiH, parApatanaM, punarAgamanaM, nivartanaM, pratyAyAnaM, &c.; ‘on your r(eturn)’ pratinivftte tvayi. 2 pratyarpaRaM, pratidAnaM, niryAtanaM, pratikAraH, pratyupakAraH. 3 parivartaH, parivftti f., paryAyaH, AvartaH. 4 PalaM, lABaH, prApti f., udayaH, utpannaM; ‘in r(eturn)’ prati in comp.; ‘injury in r(eturn)’ pratyapakAraH; ‘benefit in r(eturn)’ pratyupakAraH; ‘in r(eturn) for’ vinimayena, parivartanena.

RETURN (v. t.): (1) dadAti (dA, c. 3. = to give: when the sense is clear), to r. a reply: pratyuttaraM dadAti; he should r. or take back the thing within ten days: so'ntardaSAhAttaddravyaM dadyAccE vAdadatIta ca, M.;(2) pratidadAti (= to give back), it is to be r. ed to the seller: vikretuH pratideyaM tat, N. s.; (3) pratyarpayati (c. of f = 2.), as if after r. ing a pledge: pratyarpitanyAsa iva, Sa. iv. 21.:(5) niryAtayati, -te, prati-, (c. of yat), I shall r. (it): niryAtayizye, Mr. i.;(6) by prati- (in r.: q. v.), by r. ing evil for evil: pratyapakAreRa, Si. ii. Ph.: time for r. ing (in sales): anuSayaH (parAvartana- yogyaH kAlaH), Kat.

RETURN (v. i.): (1) nivartate, prati-, vi-, saM-, (vft, c. l.), to (our) governor Kanva when he r. s from his stay abroad: pravAsapratinivfttAya tAtakaRvAya, Sa. iv.; the king has r. ed to his town: rAjA pratinivftto nagaram, V. v.;(2) pratyAyAti (yA, c. 2.), (= to come back: q. v.), days gone by do not r. again: pratyAyAnti gatA punarna divasAH, J.; (3) pratigacCati (= to go back: q. v.), please give us (your) message here and r.: atra naH sandiSya pratigantumarhasi, Sa. iv.;(4) punareti (i, [Page596] c. 2. = to come again: q. v.), cunning youth (once) past does not r.: na punareti gataM caturaM vayaH, R. ix. 47.

RETURN (subs.): I Coming back:(1) pratyAgamaH, -nam;(2) pratiyAnam (= going back); (3) nivfttiH, prati-, saM-, vi-, (rare), “asannivftyE tadatItameva”, Sa. vi. 10.;(4) better by verb, I am desirous of embracing you on your r.: pratyAgataM tvAM parirabDukAmA, Ki. iii. 54.II Giving back:(1) pratyarpaRam;(2) pratidAnam;(3) niryAtanam, prati-: v. To return. (v. t.).III Produce, profit: q. v.: Palam: v. An official declaration: *gaRanA, mortuary r.: mftyugaRanApatrikA (?).

RETURN, IN: prati- in comp. If I do not do some good to you in r.: pratipriyaM cedBavato na kuryAm, R. v. 56.; Ś. has done befiltingbefitting good to f. in r. for his life: prARapradasya susadfSaM pratyupakftaM jImUtavAhanasya SaNKacUqena, Na. v.; action in r.: pratikriyA, Mr. iii.

To RETURN , v. n. (Come back, go back) punar Agam (c. 1. -gacCati -gantuM), pratyAgam, pratigam, nivft (c. 1. -varttate -rttituM), pratyAvft, prAte- nivft, sannivft, paryAvft, upAvft, vyAvft, vinivft, Avft, punar Avft, pratiyA (c. 2. -yAti -tuM), pratyAyA, punar AyA, pratyupayA, pratye (c. 2. pratyEti -tuM, rt. i), punar e, pratikram (c. 1. -krAmati -kramituM), pratipad (c. 4. -padyate -pattuM), punar aBipad, punar upasTA (c. 1. -tizWati -sTAtuM), pratyupasTA, punar Avraj; ‘he returned to the place whence he came,’ pratijagAma yaTAgataM. — (Turn back or round) parAvft, parivft, paryAvft, parivarttanaM kf. — (Answer), see REJOIN, RETORT.

To RETURN , v. a. (Give back) pratidA (c. 3. -dadAti -dAtuM), punar dA, paridA, pratyf in caus., punar f, pratipad, see To RESTORE. — (Bring or send back) punar nI or AnI, punar AnI in caus. (-nAya- yati -yituM), punar gam in caus., punaH prAp in caus. — (Give in recompense) pratikf, pratiPalaM dA, pratiPalAya dA, pratidA; ‘to re- turn a benefit,’ pratyupakf; ‘an injury,’ pratyapakf, pratihiMs, prati- hiMsAM kf; ‘to return evil for good,’ pareRopakAre kfte pratyapakAraM kf or Acar, upakArAt prati apakAraM kf, upakAraM prApya apakAraM kf; ‘to return good for evil,’ pareRApakAre kfte pratyupakAraM kf or Acar. — (Render an official account), see To REPORT.

RETURN , s. (Coming back) punarAgamanaM, pratyAgamaH -manaM, pratigamanaM, pratyAvfttiH f., pratyAvarttanaM, nivarttanaM, nivfttiH f., pratinivfttiH f., sanni- vfttiH f., paryAvfttiH f., paryAvarttaH -rttanaM, punarAvfttiH f., AvfttiH f., parA- vfttiH f., upayAtaM. — (Turning back or round) parAvarttanaM, parA- vfttiH f., parivfttiH f. — (Periodical revolution) parivarttaH -rttanaM, parivfttiH f., punarAvarttaH, punarAvfttiH f., vivarttaH, paryyayaH, paryyAyaH; ‘of the seasons,’ ftuparivarttaH, ftuparyyAyaH. — (Repayment) pratidAnaM, paridAnaM. — (Requital) pratikriyA, pratikftiH f., pratikarmma n. (n) [Page688-a+ 51] pratikAraH, pratIkAraH, pratiPalaM, see REQUITAL; ‘return of a benefit,’ pratyupakAraH, upakAramokzaH; ‘of an injury,’ pratyapakAraH; ‘of good for evil,’ pareRApakAre kfte tasya pratyupakArAcaraRaM. — (Pro- fit, return of trade) utpannaM, PalaM, PalodayaH, lABaH, labDiH f., prAptiH f. — (Official statement), see REPORT. — (In return for) prati with abl. c., vinimayena, hetoH, hetO, see FOR.

RETURNED , p. p. punarAgataH -tA -taM, pratyAgataH &c., pratigataH &c., AgataH &c., punarAyAtaH &c., pratyAvfttaH -ttA -ttaM, pratinivfttaH &c., vinivfttaH &c., nivfttaH &c., punarAvfttaH &c., parAvfttaH &c. — (Given back) pratidattaH -ttA -ttaM, paridattaH &c. — (Requited) pratikftaH -tA -taM, prati- PalitaH &c.
REUNION: I Lit.: punaHsaMyogaH and sim. comp.s. II An assembly, meeting: q. v.:(1) saNgamaH; (2) samAgamaH.
Re-unite, v. t. punaH saMyuj 7 U, 10 or saM-DA 3 U. Re-union, s. punaH saMyogaH-samA-gamaH-saMsargaH.

Reveal, v. t. vi-vf 5 U, prakAS c., vyaMj 7 P or c., Avizkf 8 U, vyaktIkf, prakawI-kf; KyA c., jYA c. (jYApayati); ‘the missiles r(eveal)ed themselves to us’ svataH-prakASAnyAvayorastraRi (U. 6); ‘the sacred hymns were r(eveal)ed to the sages’ fzayaH maMtrARAM drazwAraH, maMtrAn svayaM dadfSuH; ‘r(eveal) a secret’ rahasyaM prakAS c. or Bid 7 P &c. [Reveal]er, s. prakASakaH, vyaMjakaH, BedakaH. Revelation, s. vivaraRaM, prakASanaM, vyaktI-karaRaM, AvizkaraRaM. 2 SrutiprakASaH; ESo-nmezaH.

REVEAL: (1) vi-vfRoti, apA- (vf, c. 5.), to r. one's heart: hfdayaM vivfRoti, Ki. xiv. 12;(2) Binatti, nir- (Bid, c. 7. = to break), secretly r. state secrets: mindanti mantraM pracCannAH, Ka. xi. 65.;(3) prakASayati (kAS, c. 10. = to give out: q. v.);(4) by circumlo., through my favour all these will be r. ed to you: sarvaM vidita- Betatte matprasAdAdBavizyati, Ram. i. 2. 31.; as it was r. ed to him: drazwwatvAt, Say.; r. s divine truths to all beings: dadAti savarvaBUtAnAM paraM jYAnam, Mah.

To REVEAL , v. a. prakAS (c. 10. -kASayati -yituM), vikAS, vivf (c. 5. -vfRoti -Rute -varituM -rItuM), apavf, apAvf, vyaktIkf, vyaJj (c. 7. -anakti -aMktuM, c. 10. -aYjayati -yituM) prakawIkf, prakawa (nom. prakawayati -yituM), Avizkf, prAduzkf. — (Tell) sUc, jYA in caus., KyA in caus., ni- vid. — (A secret) rahasyaBedaM kf.
REVEALED , p. p. prakASitaH -tA -taM, vivftaH &c., AvizkftaH &c., prAduzkftaH &c., vyaktIkftaH &c., sUcitaH &c., jYApitaH &c., prakawitaH -tA -taM.
REVEALER: (1) expr. by verb.;(2) Bedaka (f. dikA), nir- (= breaker: as of secrets):(3) vivarItf (f. trI: rare);(4) prakASaka (f. SikA).
REVEALER , s. prakASakaH, vivaraRakft, sUcakaH, jYApakaH, KyApakaH; ‘of a secret,’ rahasyaBedakaH, rahasyaprakASakaH.
REVEALING , REVEALMENT, s. prakASanaM, vivaraRaM, vivftiH f., vyaktIkaraRaM, prakawIkaraRaM, AvizkaraRaM, spazwIkaraRaM; ‘of a secret,’ rahasyaBedaH,
Revel, s. nirBaraM pAnagozwIsuKaM, saMpIti f., tumulaH pAnamahotsavaH. v. i. anu-BU 1 P or sev 1 A with (s.). [Revel]ry, s. See (s.) above.
REVEL (v.): praBUtaBakzyapeyena modate (mud, c. l.: see Mah. xvi. 3. 10.).
REVEL, -LING (subs.): BakzyamahotsavaH (?); pAna- gozWImahotsavaH (?).
To REVEL , v. n. atiSayahAsyaSabdena utsavaM kf, rAtrikAle hAsikAdiSabdena utsavaM kf or atiSayatumulena sampItiM kf or keliM kf; ‘one who revels in his lusts,’ kAmakAmI m. (n).
REVEL , s. atiSayahAsyaSabdena utsavaH, hAsikAdiSabdena sampItiH f. or keliH m. f.; ‘master of the revels,’ kelisacivaH.
REVELATION: (1) vivftiH;(2) BedaH, nir-, -vinir;(3) prakASaH, -nam: for dif.: v. To reveal. Ph.: divine r.: ESonmezaH.
REVELATION , s. prakASanaM, vivaraRaM, prAduzkaraRaM, AvizkaraRaM, spazwIkaraRaM, prakASitavAkyaM, ISvarapratyAdeSaH. See REVEALING.
REVELER , s. atiSayahAsyaSabdena or atiSayahAsikAdiSabdena utsavakArI m. (n), sampItirataH, sampItiprasaktaH, sampItipriyaH, pAnotsukaH, pAnAsaktaH.
REVELRY , s. atiSayahAsikAdiSabdena utsavakaraRaM. See REVEL.

Revenge, s. pratyapakAraH, prati(tI)kAraH, pratihiMsA, pratidrohaH, vErasADanaM-niryAtanaM-SudDi f., pratikriyA. 2 (‘Desire for r(evenge)’) jiGAMsA, pratyapakArabudDi f. v. t. (Persons) vEra-niryAtanaM or vErasADanaM-SudDiM kf 8 U (with gen.); pratihiMs 7 P, pratidruh 4 P, pratya-pakf. 2 (Insult &c.) niryat 10, sAD c., SuD c., pratikf, nistF c. [Reveng]er, s. pratyapakA-rakaH, pratihiMsakaH [Revenge]ful, a. pratikAraparAyaRa, pratyapakAra or pratihiMsA-SIla or budDi, pratyapa-kArecCu, akzamin, amarzaRa. [Revenge]fully, adv. pratyapakArabudDyA.

REVENGE (subs.): (1) pratihiMsA;(2) pratyapakAraH; (3) vEraniryAtanam and sim. comp. s (the act); (4) prati (tI) kAraH or -kriyA (= requital), in order to take r.: praticikIrzayA, Ki. xi. 74.; if un- forgivingness had not supported r.: yadyamarzaH pratIkAraM BujAlambaM na lamBayet, Ki. xi. 57.

To REVENGE , v. a. pratikf, vEraSudDiM kf, vErapratikriyAM kf, vErapratikAraM kf, apakAraSudDiM kf, apakAraM prAppa pratyapakf, hiMsAM prApya pratihiMs (c. 7. -hinasti, c. 1. -hiMsati -situM), pareRApakAre kfte pratyapakAraM kf, apakA- rAt prati apakAraM kf, pareRa drohe kfte pratidrohaM kf, vErodDAraM kf, vErani- ryAtanaM kf, niryat (c. 10. -yAtayati -yituM), apakAramokzaM kf; ‘to re- venge an insult,’ avalepapratikAraM kf, avalepaSudDiM kf.

REVENGE , s. vEraSudDiH f., vErapratikriyA, vErapratikAraH, vErapratikftiH f., vEraniryAtanaM, vErodDAraH, apakAraSudDiH f., pratikAraH, pratIkAraH, prati- kriyA, pratikftiH f., pratikarmma n. (n), vipratikAraH, pratihiMsA, pratyapa- kAraH, pratidrohaH, niryAtanaM, pratiPalaM, prativiDiH m. — (Feeling or desire of revenge) pratihiMsAbudDiH f., pratidrohabudDiH f., pratyapakAra- budDiH f., pratidvezaH, pratyapakArecCA, pratidrohecCA, vEritA, jiGAMsA.
REVENGED , p. p. pratikftaH -tA -taM, niryAtitaH &c., vEraSudDaH -dDA -dDaM.
REVENGEFUL: (1) pratihiMsAparAyaRa (f. RA) and sim. comp. s;(2) cikIrzu or praticikIrzu (mfn.: rare).

REVENGEFUL , a. pratihiMsAbudDiH -dDiH -dDi, pratidrohabudDiH &c., pratyapa- kArabudDiH &c., pratihiMsASIlaH -lA -laM, pratihiMsecCuH -cCuH -cCu, prati- [Page688-b+ 51] drohecCuH &c., pratyapakArecCuH &c., pratikArecCuH &c., niryAtanaSIlaH &c., daMSI -SinI -Si (n), dvizantapaH -pA -paM.
REVENGEFULLY , adv. pratihiMsAbudDyA, pratyapakArabudDyA, pratidrohaSIlatvAt.
REVENGEFULNESS , s. pratihiMsASIlatvaM, pratihiMsAbudDiH f., pratyapakAraSIlatA.
REVENGER: prati (tI) kartf (f. trI = avenger: q. v.).
REVENGER , s. pratikArakaH, pratihiMsakaH, vEraSoDakaH, pratyapakArakaH.
Revenue, s. karaH, baliH, AyaH, udayaH, BAgaDeyaH, rAjasvaM.
REVENUE: (1) karaH, annual r.: AbdikaH karaH, M. vii. 129.;(2) baliH, he took r. from them: sa tAByo balimagrahIt, R. i. 18.;(3) BAgaDeyaH (rare), A.;(4) rAjasvam (royal): v. Also fruit, produce.
REVENUE , s. valiH m., karaH, AyaH, rAjasva, rAjaDanaM, rAjakaraH -raM, utpannaM, nfpAMSaH, rAjAMSaH, upasvatvaM, BAgaDeyaH, kAraH, lABaH, prAptiH f.
Reverberate, v. i. pratiDvan-nad 1 P, anu-nad-garj 1 P. v. t. pratiDvan c. &c. 2 pratikzip 6 P, pratihan 2 P. [Reverberat]ion, s. prati-DvaniH-nAdaH-SabdaH. 2 pratikzepaH.
REVERBERATE: pratiDvanati (Dvan, c. l.): v. To resound, echo.
To REVERBERATE , v. a. (Send or beat back) pratikzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzeptuM), pratiprakzip, pratihan (c. 2. -hanti -ntuM), pratihananaM kf, pratiGAtaM kf.

To REVERBERATE , v. n. pratiDvan (c. 1. -Dvanati -nituM), pratiDvaniM kf, pratiDvananaM kf, pratinad (c. 1. -nadati -dituM), anunad, vyanunad, pratinAdaM kf, pratigarj (c. 1. -garjati -rjituM), pratigarjanaM kf; ‘cause to rever- berate,’ anunad in caus., vyanunad, pratinad. See To RESOUND.
REVERBERATING , part. pratiDvanan -nantI -nat (t), pratigarjan &c., pratinAdayan &c.
REVERBERATION: I Of sound: pratiDvaniH: v. Echo.II Of light or heat:(1) pratiPalaH (?);(2) pratikzepaH (?).

REVERBERATION , s. (Sending or beating back) pratikzepaH -paRaM, pratiprakzepaH -paRaM, pratiGAtaH, pratihananaM. — (Of sound) pratiDvaniH m., pratiDvananaM, pratinAdaH, anunAdaH, vyanunAdaH, pratigarjanaM -nA, -pratiSabdaH, pratininadaH.

Revere, v. t. saM-, man c., pUj 10, saM-BU c., puraskf 8 U, satkf, Baj 1 U, upAs 2 A, Adf 6 A, arc 1 P, 10. [Rever]ence, s. saM-, mAnaH, arcanA, praSrayaH, pUjA, satkAraH, AdaraH, saparyA, puraskAraH, upAsanA; arhaRA, Bakti f.; ‘his r(everence)’ tatraBavAn, BagavAn, ‘your r(everence)’ atraBa-vAn ‘act of r(everence)’ namaskAraH, namasyA, praRipAtaH, praRAmaH, aBivaMdanaM. v. t. See (v.). [Rever]ed, a. pUjya, arcanIya, saM-, mAnya, Arya, pUjArha, namasya, upAsya; oft. ex. by sugfhItanAman (when dead) pUjyapAda; ‘r(evered) sir’ Bagavan. [Rever]ent, [Rever]ential, a. Baktimat, sAdara, sapraSraya, mAnapuraHmaramAnapuraHsara, BaktipUrva; ‘with a r(everential) bow’ BaktipraRAmaM kftvA. [Rever]ently, adv. BaktyA, BaktipuraHsaraM, sAdaraM, sapraSrayaM.
REVERE, REVERENCE (v.): (1) arcayati, aBi-, sam- (arc, c. 10.);(2) pUjayati, sam-, aBi- -(pUj, c. 10.): v. To honour, respect.

To REVERE , v. a. pUj (c. 10. pUjayati -yituM), aBipUj, sampUj, man (c. 10. mAnayati -yituM), samman, arc (c. 1. arcati -rcituM), c. 10. arcayati -yituM), samarc, aByarc, upAs (c. 2. -Aste -AsituM), sev (c. 1. sevate -vituM, c. 10. sevayati -yituM), Adf (c. 6. -driyate -darttuM), Baj (c. 1. Bajate, BaktuM), namaskf, puraskf, satkf, pUjAM kf, AdaraM kf. See OBEISANCE.

REVERED, REVEREND (adj.): (1) pUjya (f. jyA) or pUjanIya (f. yA), saM-;(2) arcanIya (f. yA) or arcya (f. rcyA), aBi-, samaBi-;(3) mAnanIya (f. yA) or mAnya (f. nyA), saM-, prati-;(4) pUjArha (f. rhA) and sim. comp.s. Ph.: r. sir: Bagavan: v. Reverence.
REVERED , p. p. pUjitaH &c., sevitaH &c., aYcitaH &c., See HONOURED.

REVERENCE (subs.): arcanA or arcA, aBi-, r. paid by me to Kṛṣṇa: vihitaM mayAcyutArcanam, Si. xv. 46.; or if he commands your highest r.: yadi vArcanIyatama eza BavatAm, 18.; (2) pUjanam or pUjA, saM-;(3) apacitiH;(4) pratimAnanA: v. Also respect. Ph.: Your or His r. (in address): Bagavat (f. tI).

REVERENCE , s. pUjA -janaM, mAnaM, sammAnaM, arcanaM -nA, arcA, aByarcA -rcanaM, AdaraH, sevA -vanaM, arhA -rhaRaM -RA, BaktiH f., SradDA, namas ind., satkAraH, saparyyA, ArADanaM, puraskAraH, mAnyatvaM, bahumAnaM, samBramaH, upAsanA; ‘act of reverence,’ namaskAraH, namasyA, praRAmaH, praRatiH f., namas, aBi- vAdanaM, aBivandanaM; ‘your reverence,’ BagavAn m. (t), BavAn m.
To REVERENCE , v. a. pUj, sampUj, namas (nom. namasyati). See To REVERE.
REVERENCED , p. p. pUjitaH -tA -taM, AdftaH &c., sammAnitaH &c., upAsitaH &c.,

REVEREND , a. pUjyaH -jyA -jyaM, pUjanIyaH -yA -yaM, pUjArhaH -rhA -rhaM, arcyaH -rcyA -rcyaM, arcanIyaH -yA -yaM, AryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM, mAnyaH -nyA -nyaM, sammAnyaH &c., mAnanIyaH -yA -yaM, arcArhaH &c., arhyaH -rhyA -rhyaM, arhaRIyaH &c., AdaraRIyaH &c., namaskAryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM, namasyaH -syA -syaM, upAsyaH &c., upAsanIyaH &c., SradDeyaH &c., pUjilaH -lA -laM, BawwAraH -rA -raM.
REVERENT, REVERENTIAL: (1) Baktimat (f. tI); (2) by circumlo.: v. To revere, respectful.

REVERENTIAL , REVERENT, a. sAdaraH -rA -raM, AdarayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, pUjakaH -kA -kaM, sampUjakaH &c., pUjAkArI -riRI &c., AdarabudDiH -dDiH -dDi, AdarakArI &c., BaktimAn -matI -mat (t), BaktisUcakaH -kA -kaM, Ada- rasUcakaH &c.
REVERENTIALLY , adv. sAdaraM, samAnaM, sanamaskAraM, AdarapUrvvaM, SirasA.
REVERENTLY, REVERENTIALLY: (1) BaktyA;(2) BaktipuraHsaram;(3) BaktipUrvakam: v. Also respect- -fully.
Reverie, s. DyAnaM, ciMtanaM, BAvanA.
REVERIE: DyAnam: v. Meditation, dream.
REVERIE , s. DyAnaM, cintA, BAvanA, anarTakaDyAnaM, viSfNKalaDyAnaM, aprakfta- DyAnaM, anarTakacintA, anarTakavAsanA, anarTakaBAvanA, budDivilAsaH.
REVERSAL: (1) parAvartaH, -nam;(2) parAvfttiH: v. To reverse.
REVERSAL , s. parAvarttaH -rttanaM, parAvfttiH f., pratyAvarttanaM, parivarttanaM.

Reverse, s. pfzWaM, pfzWaBAgaH. 2 pariRAmaH, vi-kAraH, parivftti f.; ‘r(everse)s of fortune’ dEvadurvipAkaH, BAgyavipariRAmaH, atyAhitaM, Apad-vipad f.; See Misfortune. 3 vi-paryayaH, vyatyayaH, vyatyAsaH, viparyAsaH, vya-tikramaH, vEparItyaM, vi-pati-pakzaH; ‘if r(everse) be the case’ viparyaye tu; ‘r(everse) of’ ex. by itara in comp.; ‘r(everse) of red’ raktetara, &c. a. viparIta, vyatyasta, vi-prati-loma, pratIpa, viparyasta, virudDa, vyatikrAMta, vi-prati-pakza; ‘r(everse) order’ viparyayaH, vyatikramaH, prAtilomyaM; ‘in the r(everse) order’ vi-prati-lomaM, viparyAsena, vyatyAsena. v. t. parivft c., viparyAsaM nI 1 P, parAvft c., viparyas 4 U, vyatyas; aDomuKIkf 8 U; See Overuturn, Change, (in law) pratyAdiS 6 P, parAvft c., aDa-rIkf, KaMq 10, pratikzip 6 P. [Revers]al, s. parA-pari-vftti f. -vartanaM. [Revers]ed, a. viparyasta, pari-vftta, vi-prati-loma, aDarottara, aDomuKa, &c.; See (a.); ‘my fortune being r(eversed)’ parivfttaBAgyatayA, BAgyaviparyAsAt, &c. [Revers]ion, s. parA-pratyA-vfttiH-vartanaM, viparyAsaH. [Reverse]ly, adv. viparyayeRa, vi-prati-lomaM, vyati-krameRa, vyatyAsena.

REVERSE (subs.): I The back side: pfzWam.II Misfortune: q. v.: vipad (f.) or vipattiH.III Contrary, opposite: q. v.: viparyayaH.IV Change: q. v.: parAvartaH. Ph.: r. of cold: Sotetara (f. rA); r. of white: sitetara (f. rA); etc.

REVERSE (v.): I To annul, make void: perh. parAvartayati (c. of vft);(2) KaRqayati, pari- -(KaRq, c. 10.).II To change, alter: q. v.: parivartayati. Ph.: r. ing you and I: yuzmada- smadorvyatyayena, Mu. v.
REVERSE, -D (adj.): viparyasta (f. stA): v. Contrary.

To REVERSE , v. a. (Turn upside down) parAvft (c. 10. -varttayati -yituM), parivft, paryas, viparyas, aDomuKIkf, see To OVERTURN, INVERT. — (Change to the contrary) parivft, viparItaM -tAM kf, viparyastaM -stAM kf, vyatyastaM -stA kf, viparyAsaM kf, viparyayaM kf, vEparItyaM kf, vyatikramaM kf. [Page689-a+ 51] (In law, overthrow a decision) parAvft, parAvarttaM kf, parAvfttiM kf.

REVERSE , s. (Change, vicissitude) parivarttanaM, parivfttiH f., AvfttiH f., paryyayaH, avasTAntaraM, pariRAmaH, vikAraH. — (The contrary) viparyyayaH, viparyyAsaH, vyatyayaH, vyatyAsaH, viparyyAyaH, pratyavAyaH, viparItaM, vEparItyaM, vyatikramaH, vipakzaH, pratipakzaH. — (Reverse of) expressed by itara, see OPPOSITE, a. — (Misfortune) kAryyavipattiH f., see MISFORTUNE.

REVERSE , a. viparItaH -tA -taM, viparyyastaH -stA -staM, vyatyastaH &c., vyati- krAntaH -ntA -ntaM, virudDaH -dDA -dDaM, apasavyaH -vyA -vyaM, prasavyaH &c., savyaH &c., pratIpaH -pA -paM, vipratIpaH &c., pratIkaH -kA -kaM, vipakzaH -kzA -kzaM, pratipakzaH &c., vilomaH -mA -maM, pratilomaH &c., prAtIpikaH -kI -kaM, arvAcInaH -nA -naM, pratikUlaH -lA -laM, vAmaH -mA -maM; ‘re- verse order,’ vyatikramaH.

REVERSED , p. p. viparyyastaH -stA -staM, paryyastaH &c., vyatikrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, vyatyastaH -stA -staM, apavfttaH -ttA -ttaM. — (Turned upside down or with the end downwards) aDomuKIkftaH -tA -taM, aDomuKaH -KA -KaM, aDaHkftaH -tA -taM, aDarottaraH -rA -raM, aDarAgraH -grA -graM. — (As a sentence) parAvfttaH -ttA -ttaM, parAvarttitaH -tA -taM.
REVERSELY: viparyayeRa: v. Conversely.
REVERSELY , adv. viparyyayeRa, vyatikrameRa, viparItaM, vEparItyena, AdipaScAt.
REVERSIBLE: parAvartanIya (f. yA); (2) parAvartya (f. rtyA);(3) by circumlo.
REVERSIBLE , a. parAvarttyaH -rttyA -rttyaM, parAvarttanIyaH -yA -yaM, parivarttanIyaH &c.
REVERSION: I Reversing: parAvartaH, -nam.II Reverting: pratyAvartaH, -nam: v. Also succession.

REVERSION , s. parAvarttaH -rttanaM, parAvfttiH f., pratyAvarttanaM, pratyAvfttiH f., paryA- vfttiH f., paryAvarttanaM, parivarttanaM, AvfttiH f. — (Succession, right to future possession) uttarADikAraH, anyaBogottarADikAraH, anyaBo- gottaraprAptiH f. -prApaRaM.
REVERSIONARY: r. heir: SezADikArin (f. RI) (?); r. interest or right: SezaBogADikAraH (?).
REVERSIONARY , a. anyaBogottaraprApyaH -pyA -pyaM, anyaBogottaraprAzaRIyaH -yA -yaM, uttaraprApaRIyaH &c., uttaraBogyaH -gyA -gyaM, krameRa BogyaH &c.

Revert, v. i. pratyA-parA-ni-vft 1 A, pratyAgam 1 P. v. t. Reverse, q. v. Reversion, s. pratyAvftti f., parAvartanaM, punarAgamanaM. 2 uttarADikAraH. [Reversion]ary, a. uttaraBogya; ‘r(eversionary) right’ SezaBogADikAraH; ‘r(eversionary) heir’ utta-rADikArin.
REVERT: (1) pratyAvartate (vft, c. l.);(2) punar AgacCati (gam, c. l.): v. To come, again, at last.
To REVERT , v. n. pratyAvft (c. 1. -varttate -rttituM), parAvft, paryAvft, prati- nivft, parivft, Avft, punar Avft, pratyAgam, punar Agam.
REVERTIBLE , a. parAvarttyaH -rttyA -rttyaM, parivarttanIyaH -yA -yaM, parivarttyaH &c.

Review, v. t. (Book) guRadozaM vi-vic 3, 7 U or nirUp 10 or parIkz 1 A. 2 punaH Ikz or dfS 1 P or A-ava-lok 1 A, 10, punaH vicar c. or parIkz or nirUp 10 or anusaM-DA, pratyAloc 10. s. guRadozavivecanaM, guRAguRavicAraH-nirUpaRaM-parIkzA; parIkzA-kzaRaM, nirUpaRaM. 2 punarIkzaRaM, punardarSanaM, pratyAlo-nacaM-canaM, punaH vicAraH-nirUpaRaM-parIkzA. [Review]er, s. guRadozavivecakaH.

REVIEW (subs.): I Inspection: paridarSanam.II Of books: paryAlocanA (?); dozaguRavicAraH (?). III In law: punardarSanam, a r. (should be made) if objections are raised against witnesses or assessors by losing parties: sAkzisaByAvasannAnAM dUzaRe darSanaM punaH, N. s.
REVIEW (v.): I Lit. and in law: punardarSanaM karoti.II To revise, inspect: paripaSyati (dfS, c. 1.).III As books: paryAlocayati (luc, c. 10.): v. To examine, criticize.

To REVIEW , v. a. (Look back on) paScAd avalok (c. 1. -lokate -kituM, c. 10. -lokayati -yituM), paScAd dfS (c. 1. paSyati, drazwuM), anu- dfS, gatAvalokanaM kf, gatakAlAvalokanaM, kf, paScAdavalokanaM kf. — (Examine again, revise) punaH parIkz (c. 1. -Ikzate -kzituM), punar nirUp (c. 10. -rUpayati -yituM), punar anusanDA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM), punar Alok or avalok or samavalok or dfS, punar vicar, puna- rvicAraM kf. — (Inspect) nirUp, parIkz, anusanDA, dfS. — (A book, &c.) kAvyagranTAder guRadozO parIkz or prakAS, guRadozavivecanaM kf, dozAdozavicAraM kf, granTadopAdozavicAraM kf.

REVIEW , s. (Looking back) paScAddarSana, paScAddfzwiH f., paScAdavalokanaM, anudarSanaM, anudfzwiH f., gatAvalokanaM. — (Examining again) punaH- parIkzA, punarnirUpaRaM, punaranusanDAnaM, punardarSanaM, punardfzwiH f., punarvicAraH. — (Inspection) nirUpaRaM, darSanaM, nirIkzaRaM, parIkzaRaM. — (Of a book) kAvyagranTAder guRadozavivecanaM or guRadozavicAraH, granTaguRadozavivecanaM or guRadozaprakASanaM or dozAdozaprakASanaM.
REVIEWER: (1) paryAlocaka (f. cikA);(2) guRa- dozavicAraka (f. rikA) and sim. comp.s.
REVIEWER , s. granTadozAdopaprakASakaH, granTaguRadozavivecakaH -vicArakaH.
